        fallbackWalls = [];  
        animatedProps = [];  
        const roomConfig = getActiveRoomConfig();  
        const hasCustomRoom = buildCustomRoom(roomConfig);  
        if (hasCustomRoom) {  
            baseFloor.visible = false;  
            gridHelper.visible = false;  
        } else {  
            baseFloor.visible = true;  
            gridHelper.visible = true;  
            setPalette(null);  
            buildFallbackRoom();  
            addFallbackDecor();  
        } 
        if (characterGroup) {  
            characterGroup.position.y = 0;  
        } 
        applyActivePalette();  
    } 
    function getActiveRoomConfig() {  
        if (!window.KayKitLoader || typeof 
window.KayKitLoader.getRoomConfig !== 'function') {  
            return null;  
        } 
        return window.KayKitLoader.getRoomConfig(currentRoomName);  
    } 
    function buildCustomRoom(roomConfig) {  
        if (!roomConfig) {  
            return false;  
        } 
        if (roomConfig.palette) {  
            setPalette(roomConfig.palette);  
        } else {  
            setPalette(null);  
        } 
        let built = false;  
        if (roomConfig.floor && addFloor(roomConfig.floor)) {  
            built = true;  
        } 
        if (roomConfig.walls && addWalls(roomConfig.walls)) {  
            built = true;  
        } 
        if (Array.isArray(roomConfig.props)) {  
            addProps(roomConfig.props);  
        } 
        return built;  
    } 
    function addFloor(floorConfig) {  
        const model = getModel(floorConfig.model);  
        if (!model) {  
            return false;  
        } 
        const span = floorConfig.span || defaults.span;  
        const result = createInstance(model, {  
            targetSpan: span,  
            rotation: floorConfig.rotation,  
            scale: floorConfig.scale,  
            position: floorConfig.position,  
            tint: floorConfig.tint  
        }); 
        roomGroup.add(result.object);  
        return true;  
    } 
    function addWalls(wallConfig) {  
        const model = getModel(wallConfig.model);  
        if (!model) {  
            return false;  
        } 
        const span = wallConfig.span || defaults.span;  
        const offsetY = wallConfig.heightOffset || 0;  
        const wallTint = wallConfig.tint;  
        const wallScale = wallConfig.scale;  
        const placements = [  
            { rotation: [0, 0, 0], axis: 'front' },  
            { rotation: [0, Math.PI, 0], axis: 'back' },  
            { rotation: [0, Math.PI / 2, 0], axis: 'left' },  
            { rotation: [0, -Math.PI / 2, 0], axis: 'right' }  
        ]; 
        let success = false;  
        placements.forEach(placement => {  
            const result = createInstance(model, {  
                targetSpan: span,  
                rotation: placement.rotation,  
                scale: wallScale,  
                tint: wallTint  
            }); 
            const wall = result.object;  
            const size = result.size || new THREE.Vector3(span, 
defaults.wallHeight, 1);  
            if (placement.axis === 'front') {  
                wall.position.z += (span / 2) + (size.z / 2);  
            } else if (placement.axis === 'back') {  
                wall.position.z -= (span / 2) + (size.z / 2);  
            } else if (placement.axis === 'left') {  
                wall.position.x -= (span / 2) + (size.x / 2);  
            } else if (placement.axis === 'right') {  
                wall.position.x += (span / 2) + (size.x / 2);  
            } 
            wall.position.y += offsetY;  
            roomGroup.add(wall);  
            success = true;  
        }); 
        return success;  
    } 
    function addProps(props) {  
        props.forEach(prop => {  
            const model = getModel(prop.model);  
            if (!model) {  
                return; 
            } 
            const result = createInstance(model, {  
                targetSpan: prop.span,  
                rotation: prop.rotation,  
                scale: prop.scale,  
                position: prop.position,  
                tint: prop.tint  
            }); 
            roomGroup.add(result.object);  
            if (prop.float) {  
                animatedProps.push({  
                    mesh: result.object,  
                    speed: prop.float.speed || 0.6,  
                    offset: prop.float.offset || Math.random() * Math.PI 
* 2, 
                    amplitude: prop.float.amplitude || 0.1  
                }); 
            } 
        }); 
    } 
    function buildFallbackRoom() {  
        const wallHeight = defaults.wallHeight;  
        const wallWidth = defaults.span;  
        const wallThickness = 0.6;  
        const wallMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({  
            color: 0x3a3a4e,  
            roughness: 0.7,  
            metalness: 0.3  
        }); 
        const backWall = new THREE.Mesh(  
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(wallWidth * 2, wallHeight, 
wallThickness),  
            wallMaterial.clone()  
        ); 
        backWall.position.set(0, wallHeight / 2, -wallWidth);  
        backWall.castShadow = true;  
        backWall.receiveShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(backWall);  
        fallbackWalls.push(backWall);  
        const leftWall = new THREE.Mesh(  
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(wallThickness, wallHeight, wallWidth * 
2), 
            wallMaterial.clone()  
        ); 
        leftWall.position.set( -wallWidth, wallHeight / 2, 0);  
        leftWall.castShadow = true;  
        leftWall.receiveShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(leftWall);  
        fallbackWalls.push(leftWall);  
        const rightWall = new THREE.Mesh(  
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(wallThickness, wallHeight, wallWidth * 
2), 
            wallMaterial.clone()  
        ); 
        rightWall.position.set(wallWidth, wallHeight / 2, 0);  
        rightWall.castShadow = true;  
        rightWall.receiveShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(rightWall);  
        fallbackWalls.push(rightWall);  
    } 
    function addFallbackDecor() {  
        const pillarGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 
defaults.wallHeight, 8);  
        const pillarMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({  
            color: 0x4a4a5e,  
            roughness: 0.6,  
            metalness: 0.4  
        }); 
        const pillar1 = new THREE.Mesh(pillarGeometry, 
pillarMaterial.clone());  
        pillar1.position.set( -defaults.span, defaults.wallHeight / 2, -
defaults.span);  
        pillar1.castShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(pillar1);  
        const pillar2 = new THREE.Mesh(pillarGeometry, 
pillarMaterial.clone());  
        pillar2.position.set(defaults.span, defaults.wallHeight / 2, -
defaults.span);  
        pillar2.castShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(pillar2);  
        const orbGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3, 16, 16);  
        const orbMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({  
            color: 0xff6b6b,  
            emissive: 0xff6b6b,  
            emissiveIntensity: 0.5,  
            roughness: 0.3,  
            metalness: 0.7  
        }); 
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {  
            const orb = new THREE.Mesh(orbGeometry, orbMaterial.clone());  
            orb.position.set(  
                Math.random() * defaults.span - defaults.span / 2,  
                2 + Math.random() * 3,  
                Math.random() * defaults.span - defaults.span / 2  
            ); 
            animatedProps.push({  
                mesh: orb,  
                speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,  
                offset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,  
                amplitude: 0.15  
            }); 
            roomGroup.add(orb);  
        } 
    } 
    function createInstance(model, options = {}) {  
        const clone = model.clone(true);  
        clone.traverse(node => {  
            if (node.isMesh) {  
                if (node.material) {  
                    node.material = node.material.clone();  
                    node.material.side = THREE.DoubleSide;  
                    if (node.material.map) {  
                        node.material.map.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;  
                        node.material.map.needsUpdate = true;  
                    } 
                } 
                node.castShadow = true;  
                node.receiveShadow = true;  
            } 
        }); 
        if (options.scale) {  
            if (Array.isArray(options.scale) && options.scale.length === 
3) { 
                clone.scale.set(options.scale[0], options.scale[1], 
options.scale[2]);  
            } else if (typeof options.scale === 'number') {  
                clone.scale.multiplyScalar(options.scale);  
            } 
        } 
        if (options.targetSpan) {  
            const sizeBefore = new 
THREE.Box3().setFromObject(clone).getSize(new THREE.Vector3());  
            const spanBefore = Math.max(sizeBefore.x, sizeBefore.z, 
0.0001);  
            const factor = options.targetSpan / spanBefore;  
            clone.scale.multiplyScalar(factor);  
        } 
        if (options.rotation) {  
            const rot = normalizeVector(options.rotation, 0);  
            clone.rotation.set(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]);  
        } 
        const bbox = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(clone);  
        const center = bbox.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());  
        const size = bbox.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());  
        clone.position.sub(center);  
        clone.position.y += size.y / 2;  
        if (options.position) {  
            const pos = normalizeVector(options.position, 0);  
            clone.position.x += pos[0];  
            clone.position.y += pos[1];  
            clone.position.z += pos[2];  
        } 
        if (options.tint) {  
            applyTint(clone, parseColor(options.tint, null));  
        } 
        return { object: clone, size };  
    } 
    function applyTint(object, color) {  
        if (color === null || color === undefined) {  
            return; 
        } 
        object.traverse(node => {  
            if (node.isMesh && node.material && node.material.color) {  
                node.material.color.setHex(color);  
                if (node.material.emissive) {  
                    node.material.emissive.setHex(color);  
                    node.material.emissiveIntensity = 
Math.min(node.material.emissiveIntensity || 0.4, 0.6);  
                } 
            } 
        }); 
    } 
    function onKeyDown(event) {  
        if (event.code.startsWith('Arrow')) {  
            event.preventDefault();  
        } 
        activeKeys.add(event.code);  
    } 
    function onKeyUp(event) {  
        activeKeys.delete(event.code);  
    } 
    function getMovementVector() {  
        let forward = 0;  
        let strafe = 0;  
        if (activeKeys.has('KeyW') || activeKeys.has('ArrowUp')) forward 
+= 1; 
        if (activeKeys.has('KeyS') || activeKeys.has('ArrowDown')) 
forward -= 1; 
        if (activeKeys.has('KeyA') || activeKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) strafe 
-= 1; 
        if (activeKeys.has('KeyD') || activeKeys.has('ArrowRight')) 
strafe += 1;  
        const vector = new THREE.Vector3(strafe, 0, -forward);  
        if (vector.lengthSq() > 0) {  
            vector.normalize();  
        } 
        return vector;  
    } 
    function updateCharacter(delta) {  
        if (!characterGroup) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const move = getMovementVector();  
        if (move.lengthSq() > 0) {  
            const motion = move.clone().multiplyScalar(characterSpeed * 
delta); 
            characterGroup.position.add(motion);  
            characterGroup.position.y = 0;  
            characterHeading = Math.atan2(move.x, -move.z);  
            characterGroup.rotation.y = characterHeading;  
        } 
    } 
    function updateCamera(delta) {  
        if (!camera) {  
            return; 
        } 
        if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.ORBIT || !characterGroup) {  
            orbitTime += delta;  
            const t = orbitTime * 0.5;  
            camera.position.x = Math.sin(t * 0.8) * 8;  
            camera.position.z = 12 + Math.cos(t * 0.6) * 3;  
            camera.position.y = 5 + Math.sin(t) * 0.8;  
            camera.lookAt(0, 2, 0);  
            return; 
        } 
        const forwardDir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(characterHeading), 
0, -Math.cos(characterHeading));  
        const eyeTarget = characterGroup.position.clone().add(new 
THREE.Vector3(0, characterHeight * 0.85, 0));  
        if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.THIRD) {  
            const followOffset = forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar( -18); 
            const desiredPosition = eyeTarget.clone().add(new 
THREE.Vector3(0, 4, 0)).add(followOffset);  
            camera.position.lerp(desiredPosition, Math.min(delta * 6, 
1)); 
            camera.lookAt(eyeTarget);  
        } else if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.FIRST) {  
            const eyePosition = 
eyeTarget.clone().add(forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar(1.8));  
            const lookPoint = 
eyeTarget.clone().add(forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar(6));  
            camera.position.copy(eyePosition);  
            camera.lookAt(lookPoint);  
        } 
    } 
    function animate() {  
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);  
        const delta = clock.getDelta();  
        const time = Date.now() * 0.001;  
        updateCharacter(delta);  
        updateCamera(delta);  
        animatedProps.forEach(item => {  
            if (!item.mesh) {  
                return; 
            } 
            const amplitude = item.amplitude || 0.1;  
            const speed = item.speed || 0.5;  
            const offset = item.offset || 0;  
            item.mesh.position.y += Math.sin(time * speed + offset) * 
amplitude * 0.01;  
            item.mesh.rotation.y += 0.01;  
        }); 
        if (renderer && scene && camera) {  
            renderer.render(scene, camera);  
        } 
    } 
    function onWindowResize() {  
        const container = document.getElementById('scene');  
        if (!container || !camera || !renderer) {  
            return; 
        } 
        camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;  
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();  
        renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);  
    } 
    function changeRoom(roomName) {  
        currentRoomName = roomName;  
        console.log('         Room changed to:', roomName);  
        rebuildRoom();  
    } 
    function setPrivateMode(enabled) {  
        privateMode = !!enabled;  
        applyActivePalette();  
    } 
    function setCameraMode(mode) {  
        if (!mode || !Object.values(CAMERA_MODES).includes(mode)) {  
            return cameraMode;  
        } 
        cameraMode = mode;  
        return cameraMode;  
    } 
    async function toggleWebcam(videoEl) {  
        if (webcamStream) {  
            webcamStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());  
            webcamStream = null;  
            if (webcamElement) {  
                webcamElement.srcObject = null;  
            } 
            if (videoEl) {  
                videoEl.srcObject = null;  
            } 
            return false;  
        } 
        if (!navigator.mediaDevices || 
!navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {  
            alert('Webcam wird nicht unterstützt.');  
            return false;  
        } 
        try { 
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ 
video: true, audio: false });  
            webcamStream = stream;  
            webcamElement = videoEl || webcamElement;  
            if (webcamElement) {  
                webcamElement.srcObject = stream;  
            } 
            return true;  
        } catch (error) {  
            console.warn('Webcam Zugriff fehlgeschlagen', error);  
            alert('Webcam konnte nicht gestartet werden.');  
            return false;  
        } 
    } 
    function setPalette(palette) {  
        if (!palette) {  
            activePalette = { ...DEFAULT_PALETTE };  
        } else {  
            const normalized = normalizePalette(palette);  
            activePalette = {  
                ...DEFAULT_PALETTE,  
                ...normalized  
            }; 
        } 
        applyActivePalette();  
    } 
    function normalizePalette(palette) {  
        const result = {};  
        if (palette.background !== undefined) {  
            result.background = parseColor(palette.background, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.background);  
        } 
        if (palette.fog !== undefined) {  
            result.fog = parseColor(palette.fog, DEFAULT_PALETTE.fog);  
        } 
        if (palette.floor !== undefined) {  
            result.floor = parseColor(palette.floor, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.floor);  
        } 
        if (palette.primary !== undefined) {  
            result.primary = parseColor(palette.primary, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.primary);  
        } 
        if (palette.secondary !== undefined) {  
            result.secondary = parseColor(palette.secondary, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.secondary);  
        } 
        if (palette.dir !== undefined) {  
            result.dir = parseColor(palette.dir, DEFAULT_PALETTE.dir);  
        } 
        if (palette.ambient !== undefined) {  
            result.ambient = palette.ambient;  
        } 
        if (palette.dirIntensity !== undefined) {  
            result.dirIntensity = palette.dirIntensity;  
        } 
        return result;  
    } 
    function applyActivePalette() {  
        if (!scene) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const palette = privateMode  
            ? { ...activePalette, ...PRIVATE_PALETTE }  
            : activePalette;  
        const backgroundColor = palette.background ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.background;  
        const fogColor = palette.fog ?? backgroundColor;  
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(backgroundColor);  
        if (!scene.fog) {  
            scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(fogColor, 10, 50);  
        } else {  
            scene.fog.color.setHex(fogColor);  
        } 
        if (ambientLight) {  
            ambientLight.intensity = palette.ambient ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.ambient;  
            ambientLight.color.setHex(palette.dir ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.dir);  
        } 
        if (dirLight) {  
            dirLight.color.setHex(palette.dir ?? DEFAULT_PALETTE.dir);  
            dirLight.intensity = palette.dirIntensity ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.dirIntensity;  
        } 
        if (pointLight1) {  
            pointLight1.color.setHex(palette.primary ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.primary);  
        } 
        if (pointLight2) {  
            pointLight2.color.setHex(palette.secondary ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.secondary);  
        } 
        if (baseFloor && baseFloor.material && baseFloor.material.color) 
{ 
            baseFloor.material.color.setHex(palette.floor ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.floor);  
        } 
        if (gridHelper && gridHelper.material) {  
            const gridColor = palette.floor ?? DEFAULT_PALETTE.floor;  
            if (Array.isArray(gridHelper.material)) {  
                gridHelper.material.forEach(mat => {  
                    if (mat && mat.color) {  
                        mat.color.setHex(gridColor);  
                    } 
                }); 
            } else if (gridHelper.material.color) {  
                gridHelper.material.color.setHex(gridColor);  
            } 
        } 
    } 
    function parseColor(value, fallback) {  
        if (value === null || value === undefined) {  
            return fallback;  
        } 
        if (typeof value === 'number') {  
            return value;  
        } 
        if (typeof value === 'string') {  
            const trimmed = value.trim();  
            if (trimmed.startsWith('#')) {  
                return parseInt(trimmed.slice(1), 16);  
            } 
            if (trimmed.startsWith('0x') || trimmed.startsWith('0X')) {  
                return parseInt(trimmed.slice(2), 16);  
            } 
            const numeric = parseInt(trimmed, 16);  
            if (!Number.isNaN(numeric)) {  
                return numeric;  
            } 
        } 
        return fallback;  
    } 
    function normalizeVector(arr, fallback) {  
        if (!Array.isArray(arr)) {  
            return [fallback, fallback, fallback];  
        } 
        return [  
            Number(arr[0] ?? fallback),  
            Number(arr[1] ?? fallback),  
            Number(arr[2] ?? fallback)  
        ]; 
    } 
    function getModel(path) {  
        if (!path || !window.KayKitLoader || typeof 
window.KayKitLoader.getModel !== 'function') {  
            return null;  
        } 
        return window.KayKitLoader.getModel(path);  
    } 
    function onKayKitModelLoaded(event) {  
        const modelName = event?.detail?.name;  
        if (!modelName) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const roomConfig = getActiveRoomConfig();  
        if (!roomConfig) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const needed = collectModels(roomConfig);  
        if (needed.has(modelName)) {  
            console.log('       KayKit asset ready → rebuilding room');  
            rebuildRoom();  
        } 
    } 
    function collectModels(roomConfig) {  
        const set = new Set();  
        if (roomConfig.floor?.model) {  
            set.add(roomConfig.floor.model);  
        } 
        if (roomConfig.walls?.model) {  
            set.add(roomConfig.walls.model);  
        } 
        if (Array.isArray(roomConfig.props)) {  
            roomConfig.props.forEach(prop => {  
                if (prop?.model) {  
                    set.add(prop.model);  
                } 
            }); 
        } 
        return set;  
    } 
    window.Scene3D = {  
        init: init3D,  
        changeRoom,  
        setPrivateMode,  
        setCameraMode,  
        getCameraMode: () => cameraMode,  
        toggleWebcam,  
        get camera() {  
            return camera;  
        } 
    }; 
    if (typeof THREE !== 'undefined') {  
        console.log('    Three.js loaded, initializing...');  
        setTimeout(init3D, 100);  
    } else {  
        console.log('        Waiting for Three.js...');  
        const checkThree = setInterval(() => {  
            if (typeof THREE !== 'undefined') {  
                clearInterval(checkThree);  
                console.log('    Three.js loaded, initializing...');  
                init3D();  
            } 
        }, 100);  
    } 
})(); 
    let characterMesh = null;  
    let characterHeight = 4;  
    let characterHeading = 0;  
    const characterSpeed = 8;  
    const activeKeys = new Set();  
    let webcamStream = null;  
    let webcamElement = null;  
    function init3D() {  
        const container = document.getElementById('scene');  
        if (!container || typeof THREE === 'undefined') {  
            return; 
        } 
        scene = new THREE.Scene();  
        camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(  
            75, 
            container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,  
            0.1, 
            4000 
        ); 
        camera.position.set(0, 5, 12);  
        camera.lookAt(0, 2, 0);  
        renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });  
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio || 1);  
        renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);  
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;  
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;  
        const overlays = Array.from(container.children);  
        container.innerHTML = '';  
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);  
        overlays.forEach(node => container.appendChild(node));  
        renderer.domElement.style.width = '100%';  
        renderer.domElement.style.height = '100%';  
        renderer.domElement.style.display = 'block';  
        createLights();  
        createBaseFloor();  
        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);  
        document.addEventListener('kaykit:modelLoaded', 
onKayKitModelLoaded);  
        window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, false);  
        window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp, false);  
        loadCharacter();  
        rebuildRoom();  
        animate();  
        console.log('    3D Scene initialized');  
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('scene3d:ready'));  
    } 
    function createLights() {  
        ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(DEFAULT_PALETTE.dir, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.ambient);  
        scene.add(ambientLight);  
        dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(DEFAULT_PALETTE.dir, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.dirIntensity);  
        dirLight.position.set(6, 12, 6);  
        dirLight.castShadow = true;  
        dirLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;  
        dirLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;  
        scene.add(dirLight);  
        pointLight1 = new THREE.PointLight(DEFAULT_PALETTE.primary, 1, 
50); 
        pointLight1.position.set( -8, 4, -8); 
        scene.add(pointLight1);  
        pointLight2 = new THREE.PointLight(DEFAULT_PALETTE.secondary, 1, 
50); 
        pointLight2.position.set(8, 4, 8);  
        scene.add(pointLight2);  
        applyActivePalette();  
    } 
    function createBaseFloor() {  
        const size = defaults.span + 6;  
        const floorGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size, size);  
        const floorMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({  
            color: DEFAULT_PALETTE.floor,  
            roughness: 0.8,  
            metalness: 0.2  
        }); 
        baseFloor = new THREE.Mesh(floorGeometry, floorMaterial);  
        baseFloor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;  
        baseFloor.receiveShadow = true;  
        scene.add(baseFloor);  
        gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(size, size / 2, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.secondary, DEFAULT_PALETTE.floor);  
        gridHelper.material.opacity = 0.25;  
        gridHelper.material.transparent = true;  
        scene.add(gridHelper);  
    } 
    function loadCharacter() {  
        if (!THREE.GLTFLoader) {  
            console.warn('GLTFLoader nicht verfügbar – Charakter wird 
nicht geladen.');  
            return; 
        } 
        const loader = new THREE.GLTFLoader();  
        loader.load(  
            
'/assets/KayKit_Skeletons_1.0_FREE/KayKit_Skeletons_1.0_FREE/assets/gltf/
Skeleton_Staff.gltf',  
            gltf => {  
                characterMesh = gltf.scene;  
                characterMesh.traverse(node => {  
                    if (node.isMesh) {  
                        node.castShadow = true;  
                        node.receiveShadow = true;  
                        if (node.material) {  
                            node.material = node.material.clone();  
                        } 
                    } 
                }); 
                characterGroup = new THREE.Group();  
                characterGroup.add(characterMesh);  
                scene.add(characterGroup);  
                alignCharacterMesh();  
                characterGroup.scale.set(2.2, 2.2, 2.2);  
                characterGroup.position.set(0, 0, 0);  
                refreshCharacterHeight();  
                console.log('    Skeleton geladen');  
                const staffLoader = new THREE.GLTFLoader();  
                staffLoader.load(  
                    
'/assets/KayKit_Adventurers_1.0_FREE/KayKit_Adventurers_1.0_FREE/Assets/g
ltf/staff.gltf',  
                    staffGltf => {  
                        const staff = staffGltf.scene;  
                        staff.traverse(node => {  
                            if (node.isMesh) {  
                                node.castShadow = true;  
                                node.receiveShadow = true;  
                            } 
                        }); 
                        staff.scale.set(2.2, 2.2, 2.2);  
                        staff.position.set(0.6, 1.2, 0);  
                        staff.rotation.set(Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI / 10);  
                        if (characterMesh) {  
                            characterMesh.add(staff);  
                            console.log('    Stab befestigt');  
                            refreshCharacterHeight();  
                        } 
                    }, 
                    undefined,  
                    err => console.warn('Staff konnte nicht geladen 
werden:', err)  
                ); 
            }, 
            undefined,  
            err => console.warn('Skeleton konnte nicht geladen werden:', 
err) 
        ); 
    } 
    function alignCharacterMesh() {  
        if (!characterMesh) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const bbox = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(characterMesh);  
        const center = bbox.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());  
        const size = bbox.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());  
        characterMesh.position.sub(center);  
        characterMesh.position.y += size.y / 2;  
    } 
    function refreshCharacterHeight() {  
        if (!characterGroup) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const bbox = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(characterGroup);  
        const size = bbox.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());  
        if (size.y) {  
            characterHeight = size.y;  
        } 
    } 
    function getConfigDefaults() {  
        if (window.KayKitLoader && typeof window.KayKitLoader.getConfig 
=== 'function') {  
            const cfg = window.KayKitLoader.getConfig();  
            if (cfg && cfg.defaults) {  
                if (typeof cfg.defaults.span === 'number') {  
                    defaults.span = cfg.defaults.span;  
                } 
                if (typeof cfg.defaults.wallHeight === 'number') {  
                    defaults.wallHeight = cfg.defaults.wallHeight;  
                } 
            } 
        } 
        return defaults;  
    } 
    function rebuildRoom() {  
        if (!scene) {  
            return; 
        } 
        getConfigDefaults();  
        if (!roomGroup) {  
            roomGroup = new THREE.Group();  
            scene.add(roomGroup);  
        } 
        while (roomGroup.children.length) {  
            roomGroup.remove(roomGroup.children[0]);  
        } 
        fallbackWalls = [];  
        animatedProps = [];  
        const roomConfig = getActiveRoomConfig();  
        const hasCustomRoom = buildCustomRoom(roomConfig);  
        if (hasCustomRoom) {  
            baseFloor.visible = false;  
            gridHelper.visible = false;  
        } else {  
            baseFloor.visible = true;  
            gridHelper.visible = true;  
            setPalette(null);  
            buildFallbackRoom();  
            addFallbackDecor();  
        } 
        if (characterGroup) {  
            characterGroup.position.set(0, 0, 0);  
            refreshCharacterHeight();  
        } 
        updateCamera(0);  
        applyActivePalette();  
    } 
    function getActiveRoomConfig() {  
        if (!window.KayKitLoader || typeof 
window.KayKitLoader.getRoomConfig !== 'function') {  
            return null;  
        } 
        return window.KayKitLoader.getRoomConfig(currentRoomName);  
    } 
    function buildCustomRoom(roomConfig) {  
        if (!roomConfig) {  
            return false;  
        } 
        if (roomConfig.palette) {  
            setPalette(roomConfig.palette);  
        } else {  
            setPalette(null);  
        } 
        let built = false;  
        if (roomConfig.floor && addFloor(roomConfig.floor)) {  
            built = true;  
        } 
        if (roomConfig.walls && addWalls(roomConfig.walls)) {  
            built = true;  
        } 
        if (Array.isArray(roomConfig.props)) {  
            addProps(roomConfig.props);  
        } 
        return built;  
    } 
    function addFloor(floorConfig) {  
        const model = getModel(floorConfig.model);  
        if (!model) {  
            return false;  
        } 
        const span = floorConfig.span || defaults.span;  
        const result = createInstance(model, {  
            targetSpan: span,  
            rotation: floorConfig.rotation,  
            scale: floorConfig.scale,  
            position: floorConfig.position,  
            tint: floorConfig.tint  
        }); 
        roomGroup.add(result.object);  
        return true;  
    } 
    function addWalls(wallConfig) {  
        const model = getModel(wallConfig.model);  
        if (!model) {  
            return false;  
        } 
        const span = wallConfig.span || defaults.span;  
        const offsetY = wallConfig.heightOffset || 0;  
        const wallTint = wallConfig.tint;  
        const wallScale = wallConfig.scale;  
        const placements = [  
            { rotation: [0, 0, 0], axis: 'front' },  
            { rotation: [0, Math.PI, 0], axis: 'back' },  
            { rotation: [0, Math.PI / 2, 0], axis: 'left' },  
            { rotation: [0, -Math.PI / 2, 0], axis: 'right' }  
        ]; 
        let success = false;  
        placements.forEach(placement => {  
            const result = createInstance(model, {  
                targetSpan: span,  
                rotation: placement.rotation,  
                scale: wallScale,  
                tint: wallTint  
            }); 
            const wall = result.object;  
            const size = result.size || new THREE.Vector3(span, 
defaults.wallHeight, 1);  
            if (placement.axis === 'front') {  
                wall.position.z += (span / 2) + (size.z / 2);  
            } else if (placement.axis === 'back') {  
                wall.position.z -= (span / 2) + (size.z / 2);  
            } else if (placement.axis === 'left') {  
                wall.position.x -= (span / 2) + (size.x / 2);  
            } else if (placement.axis === 'right') {  
                wall.position.x += (span / 2) + (size.x / 2);  
            } 
            wall.position.y += offsetY;  
            roomGroup.add(wall);  
            success = true;  
        }); 
        return success;  
    } 
    function addProps(props) {  
        props.forEach(prop => {  
            const model = getModel(prop.model);  
            if (!model) {  
                return; 
            } 
            const result = createInstance(model, {  
                targetSpan: prop.span,  
                rotation: prop.rotation,  
                scale: prop.scale,  
                position: prop.position,  
                tint: prop.tint  
            }); 
            roomGroup.add(result.object);  
            if (prop.float) {  
                animatedProps.push({  
                    mesh: result.object,  
                    speed: prop.float.speed || 0.6,  
                    offset: prop.float.offset || Math.random() * Math.PI 
* 2, 
                    amplitude: prop.float.amplitude || 0.1  
                }); 
            } 
        }); 
    } 
    function buildFallbackRoom() {  
        const wallHeight = defaults.wallHeight;  
        const wallWidth = defaults.span;  
        const wallThickness = 0.6;  
        const wallMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({  
            color: 0x3a3a4e,  
            roughness: 0.7,  
            metalness: 0.3  
        }); 
        const backWall = new THREE.Mesh(  
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(wallWidth * 2, wallHeight, 
wallThickness),  
            wallMaterial.clone()  
        ); 
        backWall.position.set(0, wallHeight / 2, -wallWidth);  
        backWall.castShadow = true;  
        backWall.receiveShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(backWall);  
        fallbackWalls.push(backWall);  
        const leftWall = new THREE.Mesh(  
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(wallThickness, wallHeight, wallWidth * 
2), 
            wallMaterial.clone()  
        ); 
        leftWall.position.set( -wallWidth, wallHeight / 2, 0);  
        leftWall.castShadow = true;  
        leftWall.receiveShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(leftWall);  
        fallbackWalls.push(leftWall);  
        const rightWall = new THREE.Mesh(  
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(wallThickness, wallHeight, wallWidth * 
2), 
            wallMaterial.clone()  
        ); 
        rightWall.position.set(wallWidth, wallHeight / 2, 0);  
        rightWall.castShadow = true;  
        rightWall.receiveShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(rightWall);  
        fallbackWalls.push(rightWall);  
    } 
    function addFallbackDecor() {  
        const pillarGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 
defaults.wallHeight, 8);  
        const pillarMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({  
            color: 0x4a4a5e,  
            roughness: 0.6,  
            metalness: 0.4  
        }); 
        const pillar1 = new THREE.Mesh(pillarGeometry, 
pillarMaterial.clone());  
        pillar1.position.set( -defaults.span, defaults.wallHeight / 2, -
defaults.span);  
        pillar1.castShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(pillar1);  
        const pillar2 = new THREE.Mesh(pillarGeometry, 
pillarMaterial.clone());  
        pillar2.position.set(defaults.span, defaults.wallHeight / 2, -
defaults.span);  
        pillar2.castShadow = true;  
        roomGroup.add(pillar2);  
        const orbGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3, 16, 16);  
        const orbMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({  
            color: 0xff6b6b,  
            emissive: 0xff6b6b,  
            emissiveIntensity: 0.5,  
            roughness: 0.3,  
            metalness: 0.7  
        }); 
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {  
            const orb = new THREE.Mesh(orbGeometry, orbMaterial.clone());  
            orb.position.set(  
                Math.random() * defaults.span - defaults.span / 2,  
                2 + Math.random() * 3,  
                Math.random() * defaults.span - defaults.span / 2  
            ); 
            animatedProps.push({  
                mesh: orb,  
                speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,  
                offset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,  
                amplitude: 0.15  
            }); 
            roomGroup.add(orb);  
        } 
    } 
    function createInstance(model, options = {}) {  
        const clone = model.clone(true);  
        clone.traverse(node => {  
            if (node.isMesh) {  
                if (node.material) {  
                    node.material = node.material.clone();  
                    node.material.side = THREE.DoubleSide;  
                    if (node.material.map) {  
                        node.material.map.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;  
                        node.material.map.needsUpdate = true;  
                    } 
                } 
                node.castShadow = true;  
                node.receiveShadow = true;  
            } 
        }); 
        if (options.scale) {  
            if (Array.isArray(options.scale) && options.scale.length === 
3) { 
                clone.scale.set(options.scale[0], options.scale[1], 
options.scale[2]);  
            } else if (typeof options.scale === 'number') {  
                clone.scale.multiplyScalar(options.scale);  
            } 
        } 
        if (options.targetSpan) {  
            const sizeBefore = new 
THREE.Box3().setFromObject(clone).getSize(new THREE.Vector3());  
            const spanBefore = Math.max(sizeBefore.x, sizeBefore.z, 
0.0001);  
            const factor = options.targetSpan / spanBefore;  
            clone.scale.multiplyScalar(factor);  
        } 
        if (options.rotation) {  
            const rot = normalizeVector(options.rotation, 0);  
            clone.rotation.set(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]);  
        } 
        const bbox = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(clone);  
        const center = bbox.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());  
        const size = bbox.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());  
        clone.position.sub(center);  
        clone.position.y += size.y / 2;  
        if (options.position) {  
            const pos = normalizeVector(options.position, 0);  
            clone.position.x += pos[0];  
            clone.position.y += pos[1];  
            clone.position.z += pos[2];  
        } 
        if (options.tint) {  
            applyTint(clone, parseColor(options.tint, null));  
        } 
        return { object: clone, size };  
    } 
    function applyTint(object, color) {  
        if (color === null || color === undefined) {  
            return; 
        } 
        object.traverse(node => {  
            if (node.isMesh && node.material && node.material.color) {  
                node.material.color.setHex(color);  
                if (node.material.emissive) {  
                    node.material.emissive.setHex(color);  
                    node.material.emissiveIntensity = 
Math.min(node.material.emissiveIntensity || 0.4, 0.6);  
                } 
            } 
        }); 
    } 
    function onKeyDown(event) {  
        if (event.code.startsWith('Arrow')) {  
            event.preventDefault();  
        } 
        activeKeys.add(event.code);  
    } 
    function onKeyUp(event) {  
        activeKeys.delete(event.code);  
    } 
    function getMovementVector() {  
        let forward = 0;  
        let strafe = 0;  
        if (activeKeys.has('KeyW') || activeKeys.has('ArrowUp')) forward 
+= 1; 
        if (activeKeys.has('KeyS') || activeKeys.has('ArrowDown')) 
forward -= 1; 
        if (activeKeys.has('KeyA') || activeKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) strafe 
-= 1; 
        if (activeKeys.has('KeyD') || activeKeys.has('ArrowRight')) 
strafe += 1;  
        const vector = new THREE.Vector3(strafe, 0, -forward);  
        if (vector.lengthSq() > 0) {  
            vector.normalize();  
        } 
        return vector;  
    } 
    function updateCharacter(delta) {  
        if (!characterGroup) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const move = getMovementVector();  
        if (move.lengthSq() > 0) {  
            const motion = move.clone().multiplyScalar(characterSpeed * 
delta); 
            characterGroup.position.add(motion);  
            characterGroup.position.y = 0;  
            characterHeading = Math.atan2(move.x, -move.z);  
            characterGroup.rotation.y = characterHeading;  
        } 
    } 
    function updateCamera(delta) {  
        if (!camera) {  
            return; 
        } 
        if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.ORBIT || !characterGroup) {  
            orbitTime += delta;  
            const t = orbitTime * 0.5;  
            camera.position.x = Math.sin(t * 0.8) * 8;  
            camera.position.z = 12 + Math.cos(t * 0.6) * 3;  
            camera.position.y = 5 + Math.sin(t) * 0.8;  
            camera.lookAt(0, 2, 0);  
            return; 
        } 
        const forwardDir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(characterHeading), 
0, -Math.cos(characterHeading));  
        const eyeTarget = characterGroup.position.clone().add(new 
THREE.Vector3(0, characterHeight * 0.85, 0));  
        if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.THIRD) {  
            const followOffset = forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar( -18); 
            const desiredPosition = eyeTarget.clone().add(new 
THREE.Vector3(0, 4, 0)).add(followOffset);  
            camera.position.lerp(desiredPosition, Math.min(delta * 6, 
1)); 
            camera.lookAt(eyeTarget);  
        } else if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.FIRST) {  
            const eyePosition = 
eyeTarget.clone().add(forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar(1.8));  
            const lookPoint = 
eyeTarget.clone().add(forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar(6));  
            camera.position.copy(eyePosition);  
            camera.lookAt(lookPoint);  
        } 
    } 
    function animate() {  
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);  
        const delta = clock.getDelta();  
        const time = Date.now() * 0.001;  
        updateCharacter(delta);  
        updateCamera(delta);  
        animatedProps.forEach(item => {  
            if (!item.mesh) {  
                return; 
            } 
            const amplitude = item.amplitude || 0.1;  
            const speed = item.speed || 0.5;  
            const offset = item.offset || 0;  
            item.mesh.position.y += Math.sin(time * speed + offset) * 
amplitude * 0.01;  
            item.mesh.rotation.y += 0.01;  
        }); 
        if (renderer && scene && camera) {  
            renderer.render(scene, camera);  
        } 
    } 
    function onWindowResize() {  
        const container = document.getElementById('scene');  
        if (!container || !camera || !renderer) {  
            return; 
        } 
        camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;  
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();  
        renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);  
    } 
    function changeRoom(roomName) {  
        currentRoomName = roomName;  
        console.log('         Room changed to:', roomName);  
        rebuildRoom();  
    } 
    function setPrivateMode(enabled) {  
        privateMode = !!enabled;  
        applyActivePalette();  
    } 
    function setCameraMode(mode) {  
        if (!mode || !Object.values(CAMERA_MODES).includes(mode)) {  
            return cameraMode;  
        } 
        cameraMode = mode;  
        return cameraMode;  
    } 
    async function toggleWebcam(videoEl) {  
        if (webcamStream) {  
            webcamStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());  
            webcamStream = null;  
            if (webcamElement) {  
                webcamElement.srcObject = null;  
                webcamElement.style.display = 'none';  
            } 
            if (videoEl) {  
                videoEl.srcObject = null;  
                videoEl.style.display = 'none';  
            } 
            return false;  
        } 
        if (!navigator.mediaDevices || 
!navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {  
            alert('Webcam wird nicht unterstützt.');  
            return false;  
        } 
        try { 
            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ 
video: true, audio: false });  
            webcamStream = stream;  
            webcamElement = videoEl || webcamElement;  
            if (webcamElement) {  
                webcamElement.srcObject = stream;  
                webcamElement.style.display = 'block';  
            } 
            return true;  
        } catch (error) {  
            console.warn('Webcam Zugriff fehlgeschlagen', error);  
            alert('Webcam konnte nicht gestartet werden.');  
            if (webcamElement) {  
                webcamElement.style.display = 'none';  
            } 
            if (videoEl) {  
                videoEl.style.display = 'none';  
            } 
            return false;  
        } 
    } 
    function setPalette(palette) {  
        if (!palette) {  
            activePalette = { ...DEFAULT_PALETTE };  
        } else {  
            const normalized = normalizePalette(palette);  
            activePalette = {  
                ...DEFAULT_PALETTE,  
                ...normalized  
            }; 
        } 
        applyActivePalette();  
    } 
    function normalizePalette(palette) {  
        const result = {};  
        if (palette.background !== undefined) {  
            result.background = parseColor(palette.background, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.background);  
        } 
        if (palette.fog !== undefined) {  
            result.fog = parseColor(palette.fog, DEFAULT_PALETTE.fog);  
        } 
        if (palette.floor !== undefined) {  
            result.floor = parseColor(palette.floor, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.floor);  
        } 
        if (palette.primary !== undefined) {  
            result.primary = parseColor(palette.primary, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.primary);  
        } 
        if (palette.secondary !== undefined) {  
            result.secondary = parseColor(palette.secondary, 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.secondary);  
        } 
        if (palette.dir !== undefined) {  
            result.dir = parseColor(palette.dir, DEFAULT_PALETTE.dir);  
        } 
        if (palette.ambient !== undefined) {  
            result.ambient = palette.ambient;  
        } 
        if (palette.dirIntensity !== undefined) {  
            result.dirIntensity = palette.dirIntensity;  
        } 
        return result;  
    } 
    function applyActivePalette() {  
        if (!scene) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const palette = privateMode  
            ? { ...activePalette, ...PRIVATE_PALETTE }  
            : activePalette;  
        const backgroundColor = palette.background ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.background;  
        const fogColor = palette.fog ?? backgroundColor;  
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(backgroundColor);  
        if (!scene.fog) {  
            scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(fogColor, 10, 50);  
        } else {  
            scene.fog.color.setHex(fogColor);  
        } 
        if (ambientLight) {  
            ambientLight.intensity = palette.ambient ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.ambient;  
            ambientLight.color.setHex(palette.dir ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.dir);  
        } 
        if (dirLight) {  
            dirLight.color.setHex(palette.dir ?? DEFAULT_PALETTE.dir);  
            dirLight.intensity = palette.dirIntensity ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.dirIntensity;  
        } 
        if (pointLight1) {  
            pointLight1.color.setHex(palette.primary ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.primary);  
        } 
        if (pointLight2) {  
            pointLight2.color.setHex(palette.secondary ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.secondary);  
        } 
        if (baseFloor && baseFloor.material && baseFloor.material.color) 
{ 
            baseFloor.material.color.setHex(palette.floor ?? 
DEFAULT_PALETTE.floor);  
        } 
        if (gridHelper && gridHelper.material) {  
            const gridColor = palette.floor ?? DEFAULT_PALETTE.floor;  
            if (Array.isArray(gridHelper.material)) {  
                gridHelper.material.forEach(mat => {  
                    if (mat && mat.color) {  
                        mat.color.setHex(gridColor);  
                    } 
                }); 
            } else if (gridHelper.material.color) {  
                gridHelper.material.color.setHex(gridColor);  
            } 
        } 
    } 
    function parseColor(value, fallback) {  
        if (value === null || value === undefined) {  
            return fallback;  
        } 
        if (typeof value === 'number') {  
            return value;  
        } 
        if (typeof value === 'string') {  
            const trimmed = value.trim();  
            if (trimmed.startsWith('#')) {  
                return parseInt(trimmed.slice(1), 16);  
            } 
            if (trimmed.startsWith('0x') || trimmed.startsWith('0X')) {  
                return parseInt(trimmed.slice(2), 16);  
            } 
            const numeric = parseInt(trimmed, 16);  
            if (!Number.isNaN(numeric)) {  
                return numeric;  
            } 
        } 
        return fallback;  
    } 
    function normalizeVector(arr, fallback) {  
        if (!Array.isArray(arr)) {  
            return [fallback, fallback, fallback];  
        } 
        return [  
            Number(arr[0] ?? fallback),  
            Number(arr[1] ?? fallback),  
            Number(arr[2] ?? fallback)  
        ]; 
    } 
    function getModel(path) {  
        if (!path || !window.KayKitLoader || typeof 
window.KayKitLoader.getModel !== 'function') {  
            return null;  
        } 
        return window.KayKitLoader.getModel(path);  
    } 
    function onKayKitModelLoaded(event) {  
        const modelName = event?.detail?.name;  
        if (!modelName) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const roomConfig = getActiveRoomConfig();  
        if (!roomConfig) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const needed = collectModels(roomConfig);  
        if (needed.has(modelName)) {  
            console.log('       KayKit asset ready → rebuilding room');  
            rebuildRoom();  
        } 
    } 
    function collectModels(roomConfig) {  
        const set = new Set();  
        if (roomConfig.floor?.model) {  
            set.add(roomConfig.floor.model);  
        } 
        if (roomConfig.walls?.model) {  
            set.add(roomConfig.walls.model);  
        } 
        if (Array.isArray(roomConfig.props)) {  
            roomConfig.props.forEach(prop => {  
                if (prop?.model) {  
                    set.add(prop.model);  
                } 
            }); 
        } 
        return set;  
    } 
    window.Scene3D = {  
        init: init3D,  
        changeRoom,  
        setPrivateMode,  
        setCameraMode,  
        getCameraMode: () => cameraMode,  
        toggleWebcam,  
        get camera() {  
            return camera;  
        } 
    };

    function updateCharacter(delta) {  
        if (!characterGroup) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const move = getMovementVector();  
        if (move.lengthSq() > 0) {  
            const motion = move.clone().multiplyScalar(characterSpeed * 
delta); 
            characterGroup.position.add(motion);  
            characterGroup.position.y = 0;  
            characterHeading = Math.atan2(move.x, -move.z);  
            characterGroup.rotation.y = characterHeading;  
        } 
    } 
    function updateCamera(delta) {  
        if (!camera) {  
            return; 
        } 
        if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.ORBIT || !characterGroup) {  
            orbitTime += delta;  
            const t = orbitTime * 0.5;  
            camera.position.x = Math.sin(t * 0.8) * 8;  
            camera.position.z = 12 + Math.cos(t * 0.6) * 3;  
            camera.position.y = 5 + Math.sin(t) * 0.8;  
            camera.lookAt(0, 2, 0);  
            return; 
        } 
        const forwardDir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(characterHeading), 
0, -Math.cos(characterHeading));  
        const eyeTarget = characterGroup.position.clone().add(new 
THREE.Vector3(0, characterHeight * 0.85, 0));  
        if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.THIRD) {  
            const followOffset = forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar( -18); 
            const desiredPosition = eyeTarget.clone().add(new 
THREE.Vector3(0, 4, 0)).add(followOffset);  
            camera.position.lerp(desiredPosition, Math.min(delta * 6, 
1)); 
            camera.lookAt(eyeTarget);  
        } else if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.FIRST) {  
            const eyePosition = 
eyeTarget.clone().add(forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar(1.8));  
            const lookPoint = 
eyeTarget.clone().add(forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar(6));  
            camera.position.copy(eyePosition);  
            camera.lookAt(lookPoint);  
        } 
    } 
    function updateCharacter(delta) {  
        if (!characterGroup) {  
            return; 
        }

            characterGroup.position.x = clamp(characterGroup.position.x,

    } 
    function updateCamera(delta) {  
        if (!camera) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const target = getCameraTarget();  
        if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.ORBIT || !characterGroup) {  
            const cosPitch = Math.cos(orbitPitch);  
            const offset = new THREE.Vector3(  
                Math.sin(orbitYaw) * cosPitch,  
                Math.sin(orbitPitch),  
                Math.cos(orbitYaw) * cosPitch  
            ).multiplyScalar(orbitDistance);  
            camera.position.copy(target).add(offset);  
            camera.lookAt(target);  
            return; 
        } 
        const forwardDir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(characterHeading), 
0, -Math.cos(characterHeading));  
        const basePos = characterGroup ? characterGroup.position.clone() 
: new THREE.Vector3();  
        if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.THIRD) {  
            const followOffset = forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar( -18); 
            const desiredPosition = basePos.clone().add(new 
THREE.Vector3(0, 4, 0)).add(followOffset);  
            camera.position.lerp(desiredPosition, Math.min(delta * 6, 
1)); 
            camera.lookAt(target);  
        } else if (cameraMode === CAMERA_MODES.FIRST) {  
            const eyePosition = target.clone()  
                .add(new THREE.Vector3(0, -characterHeight * 0.15, 0))  
                .add(forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar(1.8));  
            const lookPoint = 
target.clone().add(forwardDir.clone().multiplyScalar(6));  
            camera.position.copy(eyePosition);  
            camera.lookAt(lookPoint);  
        } 
    }

    function clamp(value, min, max) {  
        return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));  
    } 
    function attachOrbitControls(canvas) {  
        if (!canvas) {  
            return; 
        } 
        orbitCanvas = canvas;  
        canvas.style.touchAction = 'none';  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, { passive: 
false });  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: 
false });  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp, { passive: 
false });  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', onPointerUp, { passive: 
false });  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp, { passive: 
false });  
        canvas.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });  
    } 
    function onPointerDown(event) {  
        if (!orbitCanvas || cameraMode !== CAMERA_MODES.ORBIT) {  
            return; 
        } 
        event.preventDefault();  
        orbitCanvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);  
        activePointers.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: 
event.clientY });  
        if (activePointers.size === 1) {  
            pointerMode = 'rotate';  
            dragStartPos = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };  
            dragStartYaw = orbitYaw;  
            dragStartPitch = orbitPitch;  
        } else if (activePointers.size === 2) {  
            pointerMode = 'pinch';  
            pinchStartDist = computePointerDistance();  
            pinchBaseDistance = orbitDistance;  
        } 
    } 
    function onPointerMove(event) {  
        if (!activePointers.has(event.pointerId) || cameraMode !== 
CAMERA_MODES.ORBIT) {  
            return; 
        } 
        event.preventDefault();  
        activePointers.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: 
event.clientY });  
        if (pointerMode === 'pinch' && activePointers.size >= 2) {  
            const dist = computePointerDistance();  
            if (pinchStartDist > 0) {  
                const ratio = dist / pinchStartDist;  
                if (ratio > 0) {  
                    orbitDistance = clamp(pinchBaseDistance / ratio, 
ORBIT_MIN_DIST, ORBIT_MAX_DIST);  
                } 
            } 
        } else if (pointerMode === 'rotate' && activePointers.size === 1) 
{ 
            const dx = event.clientX - dragStartPos.x;  
            const dy = event.clientY - dragStartPos.y;  
            orbitYaw = dragStartYaw - dx * 0.005;  
            orbitPitch = clamp(dragStartPitch - dy * 0.003, 
ORBIT_MIN_PITCH, ORBIT_MAX_PITCH);  
        } 
    } 
    function onPointerUp(event) {  
        if (!activePointers.has(event.pointerId)) {  
            return; 
        } 
        if (orbitCanvas && 
orbitCanvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {  
            orbitCanvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);  
        } 
        activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);  
        if (activePointers.size === 0) {  
            pointerMode = null;  
        } else if (activePointers.size === 1) {  
            pointerMode = 'rotate';  
            const remaining = Array.from(activePointers.values())[0];  
            dragStartPos = { x: remaining.x, y: remaining.y };  
            dragStartYaw = orbitYaw;  
            dragStartPitch = orbitPitch;  
        } else if (activePointers.size >= 2) {  
            pointerMode = 'pinch';  
            pinchStartDist = computePointerDistance();  
            pinchBaseDistance = orbitDistance;  
        } 
    } 
    function onWheel(event) {  
        if (cameraMode !== CAMERA_MODES.ORBIT) {  
            return; 
        } 
        event.preventDefault();  
        const delta = event.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1; 
        orbitDistance = clamp(orbitDistance + delta * 1.2, 
ORBIT_MIN_DIST, ORBIT_MAX_DIST);  
    } 
    function computePointerDistance() {  
        if (activePointers.size < 2) {  
            return 0;  
        } 
        const [p1, p2] = Array.from(activePointers.values());  
        const dx = p1.x - p2.x; 
        const dy = p1.y - p2.y; 
        return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);  
    } 
    function getCameraTarget() {  
        if (characterGroup) {  
            return characterGroup.position.clone().add(new 
THREE.Vector3(0, characterHeight * 0.75, 0));  
        } 
        return new THREE.Vector3(0, 2, 0);  
    } 
    function faceCharacterToCamera() {  
        if (!characterGroup || !camera) {  
            return; 
        } 
        const dir = 
camera.position.clone().sub(characterGroup.position.clone());  
        dir.y = 0;  
        if (dir.lengthSq() < 0.0001) {  
            return; 
        } 
        dir.normalize();  
        characterHeading = Math.atan2(dir.x, -dir.z); 
        characterGroup.rotation.y = characterHeading;  
    }

    }

                target.classList.remove('ready');  
                waiting = false;

                target.textContent = 'Zu früh!';  
                setTimeout(startRound, 1000);  
            }

// MINIGAMES MODULE v2  
(function() {  
    let currentGame = null;  
    let score = 0;  
    let gameInterval = null;  
    let cleanupFn = null;  
    let frameHandle = null;  
    const timeouts = new Set();  
    let currentGameLabel = '';  
    function scheduleTimeout(handler, delay) {  
        const id = setTimeout(() => {  
            timeouts.delete(id);  
            handler();  
        }, delay);  
        timeouts.add(id);  
        return id;  
    } 
    function cancelTimeout(id) {  
        if (timeouts.has(id)) {  
            clearTimeout(id);  
            timeouts.delete(id);  
        } 
    } 
    function clamp(value, min, max) {  
        return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));  
    } 
    function clearTimers() {  
        if (gameInterval) {  
            clearInterval(gameInterval);  
            gameInterval = null;  
        } 
        if (frameHandle) {  
            cancelAnimationFrame(frameHandle);  
            frameHandle = null;  
        } 
        timeouts.forEach(id => clearTimeout(id));  
        timeouts.clear();  
    } 
    function setCleanup(fn) {  
        cleanupFn = fn;  
    } 
    function createOverlay() {  
        if (document.getElementById('minigameOverlay')) return;  
        const overlay = document.createElement('div');  
        overlay.id = 'minigameOverlay';  
        overlay.className = 'minigame -overlay';  
        overlay.innerHTML = `  
            <div class="minigame -container">  
                <div class="minigame -header">  
                    <h2 id="minigameTitle">Minigame</h2>  
                    <div class="minigame -score">Score: <span 
id="minigameScore">0</span></div>  
                    <button class="minigame -close" 
onclick="MiniGames.close()">×</button>  
                </div> 
                <div class="minigame -content" id="minigameContent"></div>  
            </div> 
        `; 
        document.body.appendChild(overlay);  
    } 
    function updateScore(points = 0, reset = false) {  
        if (reset) {  
            score = 0;  
        } else {  
            score += points;  
        } 
        const scoreEl = document.getElementById('minigameScore');  
        if (scoreEl) {  
            scoreEl.textContent = Math.max(0, Math.round(score));  
        } 
    } 
    function open(gameName) {  
        createOverlay();  
        const overlay = document.getElementById('minigameOverlay');  
        const content = document.getElementById('minigameContent');  
        const title = document.getElementById('minigameTitle');  
        clearTimers();  
        if (cleanupFn) {  
            cleanupFn();  
            cleanupFn = null;  
        } 
        score = 0;  
        updateScore(0, true);  
        setCleanup(null);  
        overlay.classList.add('active');  
        currentGame = gameName;  
        currentGameLabel = 'Minigame';

            case 'rhythm':

    function close(showResult = true) {

        const handleKeyPress = (e) => {

            const keyEl = document.querySelector(`.rhythm -key[data -

            if (keyEl) {  
                keyEl.classList.add('pressed');

120); 
            } 
            const notes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.rhythm -

            const hitzoneRect = document.querySelector('.rhythm -

            let hit = false;

                const rect = note.getBoundingClientRect();  
                if (rect.bottom >= hitzoneRect.top && rect.top <=

                    updateScore(10);

            } 
        };

        setCleanup(() => document.removeEventListener('keydown',

    /* === BROOM DELIVERY GAME === */  
    function startBroomGame(content) {  
        content.innerHTML = `  
            <div class="broom -game"> 
                <canvas id="broomCanvas" width="720"

                <div class="broom -hud">

            </div> 
        `; 
        const canvas = document.getElementById('broomCanvas');  
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');  
        const livesEl = document.getElementById('broomLives');  
        const deliveriesEl = document.getElementById('broomDeliveries');  
        const timerEl = document.getElementById('broomTimer');  
        const player = { x: 90, y: canvas.height / 2, width: 42, height: 
22 }; 
        const packages = [];  
        const houses = [];  
        const keys = new Set();  
        let lives = 3;  
        let deliveries = 0;  
        let timer = 60;  
        let lastThrow = 0;  
        let running = true;  
        function spawnHouse() {  
            const doorY = 110 + Math.random() * (canvas.height - 180); 
            houses.push({  
                x: canvas.width + Math.random() * 220 + 200,  
                y: doorY,  
                width: 70,  
                height: 120  
            }); 
        } 
        while (houses.length < 4) {  
            spawnHouse();  
        } 
        function updateHud() {  
            livesEl.textContent = Math.max(0, lives);  
            deliveriesEl.textContent = deliveries;  
            timerEl.textContent = Math.max(0, timer);  
        } 
        function throwPackage() {  
            const now = performance.now();  
            if (now - lastThrow < 400) return;  
            lastThrow = now;  
            packages.push({  
                x: player.x + 28,  
                y: player.y,  
                vx: 6.2,  
                vy: 0 
            }); 
        } 
        function drawBackground() {  
            const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 
canvas.height);  
            gradient.addColorStop(0, '#05021d');  
            gradient.addColorStop(1, '#0f3057');  
            ctx.fillStyle = gradient;  
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);  
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';  
            for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {  
                const x = (i * 73 + performance.now() * 0.02) % 
canvas.width;  
                const y = (i * 53) % canvas.height;  
                ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, 2);  
            } 
        } 
        function drawPlayer() {  
            ctx.save();  
            ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);  
            ctx.fillStyle = '#452b7c';  
            ctx.beginPath();  
            ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 24, 16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);  
            ctx.fill();  
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf40';  
            ctx.fillRect(12, -4, 26, 8);  
            ctx.fillStyle = '#c08457';  
            ctx.fillRect(28, -8, 18, 16);  
            ctx.restore();  
        } 
        function drawHouse(house) {  
            ctx.save();  
            ctx.translate(house.x, house.y);  
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2f2a4a';  
            ctx.fillRect( -house.width / 2, -house.height / 2, 
house.width, house.height);  
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1b5e20';  
            ctx.fillRect( -house.width / 2, house.height / 2 - 50, 
house.width, 50);  
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffea00';  
            ctx.fillRect( -15, 10, 30, 40);  
            ctx.restore();  
        } 
        function gameLoop() {  
            if (!running) return;  
            frameHandle = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);  
            drawBackground();  
            if (keys.has('ArrowUp') || keys.has('KeyW')) player.y -= 4; 
            if (keys.has('ArrowDown') || keys.has('KeyS')) player.y += 4;  
            player.y = clamp(player.y, 50, canvas.height - 50); 
            drawPlayer();  
            const speed = 3.2 + deliveries * 0.04;  
            houses.forEach(house => {  
                house.x -= speed;  
                drawHouse(house);  
                if (house.x < -120) { 
                    lives -= 1; 
                    house.x = canvas.width + Math.random() * 220 + 200;  
                    house.y = 110 + Math.random() * (canvas.height - 
180); 
                } 
            }); 
            for (let i = packages.length - 1; i >= 0; i --) { 
                const pkg = packages[i];  
                pkg.x += pkg.vx;  
                pkg.y += pkg.vy;  
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7043';  
                ctx.fillRect(pkg.x - 6, pkg.y - 6, 12, 12);  
                if (pkg.x > canvas.width + 40) {  
                    packages.splice(i, 1);  
                    continue;  
                } 
                houses.forEach(house => {  
                    const doorY = house.y + house.height / 2 - 20; 
                    if ( 
                        pkg.x > house.x - house.width / 2 &&  
                        pkg.x < house.x + house.width / 2 &&  
                        Math.abs(pkg.y - doorY) < 30  
                    ) { 
                        deliveries += 1;  
                        updateScore(15);  
                        packages.splice(i, 1);  
                        house.x = canvas.width + Math.random() * 220 + 
220; 
                        house.y = 110 + Math.random() * (canvas.height - 
180); 
                    } 
                }); 
            } 
            if (lives <= 0) {  
                running = false;  
                triggerExplosion(content);  
            } 
            updateHud();  
        } 
        function triggerExplosion(contentContainer) {  
            clearTimers();  
            const splash = document.createElement('div');

            contentContainer.appendChild(splash);

        function tickTimer() {  
            timer -= 1; 
            updateHud();  
            if (timer <= 0) {  
                running = false;  
                const banner = document.createElement('div');  
                banner.className = 'broom -success';  
                banner.innerHTML = '<h3>     Alle Lieferungen 
geschafft!</h3><p>Najika ist zufrieden.</p>';  
                content.appendChild(banner);  
                scheduleTimeout(() => close(), 1500);  
            } 
        } 
        const keyDown = (e) => {  
            if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'KeyW', 
'KeyS'].includes(e.code)) {  
                keys.add(e.code);  
                e.preventDefault();  
            } 
            if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {  
                throwPackage();  
                e.preventDefault();  
            } 
        }; 
        const keyUp = (e) => {  
            if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'KeyW', 
'KeyS'].includes(e.code)) {  
                keys.delete(e.code);  
                e.preventDefault();  
            } 
        }; 
        window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);  
        window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);  
        setCleanup(() => {  
            window.removeEventListener('keydown', keyDown);  
            window.removeEventListener('keyup', keyUp);  
        }); 
        frameHandle = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);  
        gameInterval = setInterval(tickTimer, 1000);  
        updateHud();  
    }

ingredients[Math.floor(Math.random() * ingredients.length)]);  
            stepIndex = 0;  
            renderRecipe();  
            hintEl.textContent = 'Rezept zusammenstellen!';  
        } 
        function completeStep(name) {  
            const expected = currentRecipe[stepIndex];  
            if (expected && expected.name === name) {  
                stepIndex += 1;  
                updateScore(5);  
                if (stepIndex >= currentRecipe.length) {  
                    updateScore(20);  
                    hintEl.textContent = 'Perfekt! Neues Rezept...';  
                    newRecipe();  
                } else {  
                    renderRecipe();  
                } 
            } else {  
                updateScore( -8); 
                hintEl.textContent = 'Falsche Zutat!';  
            } 
            renderRecipe();  
        } 
        buttons.forEach(btn => {  
            btn.onclick = () => completeStep(btn.dataset.name);  
        }); 
        setCleanup(() => buttons.forEach(btn => (btn.onclick = null)));  
        newRecipe();  
        gameInterval = setInterval(() => {  
            timer -= 1; 
            timerEl.textContent = Math.max(0, timer);  
            if (timer <= 0) {  
                hintEl.textContent = 'Zeit vorbei!';  
                scheduleTimeout(() => close(), 1000);  
            } 
        }, 1000);  
    }

        function loop() {  
            frameHandle = requestAnimationFrame(loop);  
            const trackWidth = track.clientWidth;  
            const zoneStart = trackWidth / 2 - 50; 
            const zoneEnd = trackWidth / 2 + 50;  
            for (let i = items.length - 1; i >= 0; i --) { 
                const item = items[i];  
                item.x += item.speed;  
                item.el.style.transform = `translateX(${item.x}px)`;

                    item.el.remove();

        updateLives();

        open,

    };

// API Helper  
function setServerStatus(online) {  
    if (online === serverOnline) return;  
    serverOnline = online;  
    if (statusDotEl) {  
        statusDotEl.classList.toggle('offline', !online);  
    } 
    if (statusTextEl) {  
        statusTextEl.textContent = online ? 'Online' : 'Offline 
(Fallback)';  
    } 
} 
window.setServerStatus = setServerStatus;  
async function api(p, m = 'GET', b) {  
    return fetch(p, {  
        method: m,  
        headers: {'Content -Type': 'application/json'},  
        body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined  
    }).then(r => r.json());  
    try { 
        const response = await fetch(p, {  
            method: m,  
            headers: {'Content -Type': 'application/json'},  
            body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined  
        }); 
        if (!response.ok) {  
            throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);  
        } 
        const data = await response.json();  
        setServerStatus(true);  
        return data;  
    } catch (error) {  
        setServerStatus(false);  
        throw error;  
    } 
}

def _post_json(url, payload, timeout=90):  
    if requests:  
        r = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=timeout)  
        r.raise_for_status()  
        return r.json()  
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf -8") 
    req = urllib.request.Request(  
        url, 
        data=data,  
        headers={"Content -Type": "application/json"}  
    ) 
    try: 
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:  
            text = resp.read().decode("utf -8") 
    except urllib.error.URLError as e:  
        raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP error contacting {url}: {e}") from e  
    try: 
        return json.loads(text)  
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:  
        raise RuntimeError(f"Invalid JSON from {url}: {text[:120]}") from 
e

Über die neuen Konfigurationen wird jetzt jeder Raum mit eigenen KayKit -
Paketen, Requisiten und Farbwelten aufgebaut:  
 
assets/room_config_detailed.json:1 definiert für alle 12 Räume 
individuelle Floor -/Wall-Modelle, Props (z.B. Möbel, Bäume, 
Trainingsziele) plus Palette ‑Werte. Die Räume sind damit quadratisch 
skaliert und wirken deutlich unterschiedlicher.  
digivice/js/kaykit_loader.js:1 lädt diese Konfiguration, sammelt alle 
benötigten Modelle, stellt getRoomConfig() bereit und feuert Events, 
sobald ein Asset fertig geladen ist.  
digivice/js/3d_scene.js:1 ist komplett neu: baut Räume direkt aus der 
JSON, streckt Wände auf Raumgröße, blendet bei KayKit -Szenen den alten 
Platzhalterboden aus, übernimmt Paletten (inkl. Private ‑Mode-Override) 
und fällt nur noch bei fehlenden Assets auf das einfache Fallback zurück.  
Zum Testen: Server neu laden bzw. START_NAJIKA.bat erneut ausführen, dann 
im Browser mit Ctrl+Shift+R hart neu laden, durch alle Räume klicken und 
in der Konsole nach „KayKit asset ready → rebuilding room“ sowie 
fehlenden Assets Ausschau halten.

und Steuerung einhängen. Sag Bescheid, sobald ich das angehen soll.

    function attachOrbitControls(canvas) {  
        if (!canvas) {  
            return; 
        } 
        orbitCanvas = canvas;  
        canvas.style.touchAction = 'none';  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, { passive: 
false });  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: 
false });  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp, { passive: 
false });  
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', onPointerUp, { passive:
