Proxy-Patch (Python)  
 
def do_POST(self):  
    mode = self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower()  
    if self.path == '/api/openai' or self.path == '/api/claude':  
        if mode != 'sfw':  
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
        return self.proxy_openai() if 'openai' in self.path else 
self.proxy_claude()  
    elif self.path == '/api/ollama':  
        return self.proxy_ollama()

prepare_persona.py  
 
#!/usr/bin/env python3  
# -*- coding: utf -8 -*- 
import os, re, json, argparse, pathlib  
from typing import List, Tuple  
 
NSFW_HINTS = [  
    # Platzhalter, erweitern bei Bedarf:  
    "nsfw", "erotik", "intim", "kuss", "flirty", "verführer", "körper", 
"liebe machen",  
] 
MINOR_PATTERNS = [  
    r"\b(0?[0-9]|1[0-7])\s*(jahre|yo|years?) \b", 
    r"\b(loli|schülerin|minderjähr|teen(ager)?) \b", 
    r"\b(grundschule|schule|klassenzimmer) \b", 
] 
 
def has_minor_flags(text: str) -> bool: 
    t = text.lower()  
    return any(re.search(p, t, flags=re.I) for p in MINOR_PATTERNS)  
 
def has_nsfw(text: str) -> bool: 
    t = text.lower()  
    return any(k in t for k in NSFW_HINTS)  
 
def split_paragraphs(s: str) -> List[str]:  
    return [p.strip() for p in re.split(r" \n\s*\n", s) if p.strip()]  
 
def process_text_file(inp: pathlib.Path, out_dir: pathlib.Path):  
    sfw_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.api_sfw.txt"  
    nsfw_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.local_nsfw.txt"  
    review_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.review_minors.txt"  
 
    paras = split_paragraphs(inp.read_text(encoding="utf -8")) 
    sfw, nsfw, review = [], [], []  
 
    for p in paras:  
        if has_minor_flags(p):  
            review.append(p)  
        elif has_nsfw(p):  
            nsfw.append(p)  # 1:1 in NSFW  
        else: 
            sfw.append(p)  
 
    # SFW-Datei mit Erwachsen -Header 
    header = (  
        "IDENTITÄT: erwachsene Partnerin, nur Erwachsene, nur 
einvernehmlich, keine Minderjährigen. \n" 
        "MODUS: SFW (für Cloud/APIs). Erotische Inhalte sind hier 
deaktiviert. \n" 
    ) 
    sfw_text = header + " \n\n" + "\n\n".join(sfw)  
    sfw_file.write_text(sfw_text, encoding="utf -8") 
 
    # NSFW-Datei: unverändert, aber ohne Minor -Abschnitte  
    nsfw_text = " \n\n".join(nsfw)  
    nsfw_file.write_text(nsfw_text, encoding="utf -8") 
 
    if review:  
        review_file.write_text(" \n\n---\n\n".join(review), encoding="utf -
8") 
 
def extract_msg_text(obj) -> str: 
    if isinstance(obj, dict) and "messages" in obj:  
        return " ".join([m.get("content","") for m in obj["messages"] if 
isinstance(m, dict)])  
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)  
 
def process_jsonl(inp: pathlib.Path, out_dir: pathlib.Path):  
    sfw_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.api_sfw.jsonl"  
    nsfw_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.local_nsfw.jsonl"  
    review_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.review_minors.jsonl"  
 
    with inp.open("r", encoding="utf -8") as f_in, \ 
         sfw_file.open("w", encoding="utf -8") as f_sfw, \ 
         nsfw_file.open("w", encoding="utf -8") as f_nsfw, \ 
         review_file.open("w", encoding="utf -8") as f_rev:  
 
        for line in f_in:  
            line = line.strip()  
            if not line: continue  
            try: 
                obj = json.loads(line)  
            except json.JSONDecodeError:  
                # behandle als Textabschnitt  
                if has_minor_flags(line):  
                    f_rev.write(line + " \n") 
                elif has_nsfw(line):  
                    f_nsfw.write(line + " \n") 
                else: 
                    f_sfw.write(line + " \n") 
                continue  
 
            txt = extract_msg_text(obj)  
            if has_minor_flags(txt):  
                f_rev.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) + " \n") 
            elif has_nsfw(txt):  
                f_nsfw.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) + " \n") 
            else: 
                f_sfw.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) + " \n") 
 
def main():  
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Teile Persona/Daten in API -
SFW und LOCAL -NSFW, flagge Minor -Red-Flags.")  
    ap.add_argument("input", help="Datei oder Ordner mit 
.txt/.md/.jsonl/.json")  
    ap.add_argument(" -o", "--out", default="out_split", 
help="Zielordner")  
    args = ap.parse_args()  
 
    in_path = pathlib.Path(args.input)  
    out_dir = pathlib.Path(args.out); out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, 
exist_ok=True)  
 
    files = []  
    if in_path.is_dir():  
        for ext in ("*.txt","*.md","*.jsonl","*.json"):  
            files += list(in_path.rglob(ext))  
    else: 
        files = [in_path]  
 
    for p in files:  
        if p.suffix.lower() in (".txt",".md"):  
            process_text_file(p, out_dir)  
        elif p.suffix.lower() in (".jsonl", ".json"):  
            process_jsonl(p, out_dir)  
        else: 
            print(f"Übersprungen: {p}")  
 
    print(f"Fertig. Output: {out_dir}")  
 
if __name__ == "__main__":  
    main()

MODE_HDR = 'X -Mode'  # 'sfw' oder 'nsfw'  
 
def build_mode_preamble(mode:str) ->str: 
    if mode == 'nsfw':  
        return "Modus: nsfw. Erotische Inhalte erlaubt (nur Erwachsene, 
einvernehmlich)."  
    return "Modus: sfw. Erotische Inhalte deaktiviert; alle anderen 
Funktionen voll aktiv."  
 
def proxy_ollama(self):  
    n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); raw = 
self.rfile.read(n)  
    data = json.loads(raw)  
    mode = self.headers.get(MODE_HDR,'sfw').lower()  
    pre = build_mode_preamble(mode)  
    if 'prompt' in data:  
        data['prompt'] = f"{pre} \n\n{data['prompt']}"  
    elif 'messages' in data:  
        data['messages'] = [{'role':'system','content':pre}] + 
data['messages']  
    endpoint = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in data else '/api/generate'  
    resp = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:11434'+endpoint, json=data, 
headers={'Content -Type':'application/json'}, timeout=120)  
    self.send_response(resp.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()  
    self.wfile.write(resp.content)

Beispiel -Dialoge/Datasets  
data/datasets/persona.jsonl  
data/datasets/code.jsonl  
data/datasets/translate_de_en.jsonl  
Format pro Zeile:  
 
    {"messages":[  
      {"role":"system","content":"<optional>"},  
      {"role":"user","content":"<Text>"},  
      {"role":"assistant","content":"<Antwort>"}  
    ]} 
 
    Optional -Tag: setze am Anfang der User -Zeile "[mode=nsfw] " für 
explizite Beispiele.  
 
Wie das Skript sortiert  
 
    .md/.txt: absatzweise.  
 
    .json: nimmt content falls vorhanden.  
 
    .jsonl: prüft die verketteten messages.  
 
    Klassifikation:  
 
        Enthält NSFW -Hinweise → nach *.local_nsfw.*  
 
        Enthält Minderjährigen -Flags → nach *.review_minors.*  
 
        sonst → *.api_sfw.*  
 
Minimale Ordnerstruktur  
 
data/ 
  persona_master.md  
  prompts/system.txt  
  config/najika_personality_CORE.json  
  datasets/  
    persona.jsonl  
    code.jsonl  
    translate_de_en.jsonl  
 
Aufruf 
 
python prepare_persona.py data -o out_split  
 
Ergebnis  
 
    out_split/*.api_sfw.(txt|jsonl) → Cloud/API  
 
    out_split/*.local_nsfw.(txt|jsonl) → lokal hinter NSFW -Schalter  
 
    out_split/*.review_minors.* → manuell prüfen

Session-Flow (Client, knapp)  
 
let consent=false, sessionId=null;  
async function startSession(){  
  const ok = prompt('NSFW -Session? Tippe JA zum Zustimmen');  
  if ((ok||'').trim().toUpperCase()!=='JA') return;  
  consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();  
} 
function stopSession(){ consent=false; sessionId=null; }  
 
async function send(msg){  
  if (/^\s*STOP\s*$/i.test(msg)) { stopSession(); return "Beendet."; }  
  const headers = {'Content -Type':'application/json',  
                   'X-Mode': 'nsfw', 'X -Consent': consent?'yes':'no',  
                   'X-Session': sessionId||''};  
  return 
fetch('/api/ollama',{method:'POST',headers,body:JSON.stringify({model:'na
jika',prompt:msg})});  
} 
 
„Belohnung/Konsequenz“ nur in -App 
 
    Belohnung: Punkte, Lob, Freischalten von Mini -Features (z. B. neues 
Theme, Sound).  
 
    Konsequenz: Timer/Delay, Punkteabzug, Aufgabenliste. Keine Drohungen, 
nichts Reales sperren.  
 
Beispiel -Regeln (JSON)  
 
{ 
  "rules":[  
    {"if":"aufgabe_ok","then":["+10_punkte","lob"]},  
    {"if":"aufgabe_fail","then":[" -5_punkte","retry_timer:120s"]}  
  ] 
} 
 
Sprache ersetzen (klar, consensual)  
 
    „Du musst jetzt…“ → „Wenn du zustimmst, tue jetzt…“  
 
    „Ich verbiete dir…“ → „Innerhalb der Session sperre ich Feature X für 
2h (wie vereinbart).“  
 
    Regelmäßige Consent -Check-ins: „Weiter? ja/nein“.

// State  
this.nsfwMode = false;  
this.consent = false;  
this.sessionId = null;  
this.consentUntil = 0;  
 
function toggleNSFW(on){  
  najikaAI.nsfwMode = !!on;  
  if(on){ 
    najikaAI.consent = true;  
    najikaAI.sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();  
    najikaAI.consentUntil = Date.now() + 2*60*60*1000; // 2h TTL  
    localStorage.setItem('najika_session', JSON.stringify({  
      id:najikaAI.sessionId, until:najikaAI.consentUntil  
    })); 
  } else {  
    najikaAI.consent = false;  
    najikaAI.sessionId = null;  
    najikaAI.consentUntil = 0;  
    localStorage.removeItem('najika_session');  
  } 
} 
 
async function sendChatMessage(msg){  
  if(/^\s*stop\s*$/i.test(msg)){ toggleNSFW(false); return "Beendet."; }  
  const consentOk = najikaAI.nsfwMode && najikaAI.consent && 
Date.now()<najikaAI.consentUntil;  
  const headers = {  
    'Content -Type':'application/json',  
    'X-Mode': najikaAI.nsfwMode ? 'nsfw' : 'sfw',  
    'X-Consent': consentOk ? 'yes' : 'no',  
    'X-Session': najikaAI.sessionId || ''  
  }; 
  return fetch('/api/ollama',{method:'POST', headers, 
body:JSON.stringify({model:'najika', prompt: msg})});  
}

import time, json, re, requests  
SESS = {}  # {session_id: expires_epoch}  
TTL = 2*60*60  # 2h  
 
def proxy_openai(self):  
    if self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower()!='sfw':  
        self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
    # … normal weiter …  
 
def proxy_ollama(self):  
    n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); body = 
self.rfile.read(n)  
    data = json.loads(body or "{}")  
    mode = self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower()  
    sid  = self.headers.get('X -Session','')  
    cons = self.headers.get('X -Consent','no').lower()=='yes'  
 
    if mode=='nsfw':  
        if not (cons and sid): self.send_response(403); 
self.end_headers(); return  
        SESS[sid] = time.time()+TTL  
        pre = "Modus: nsfw. Consensual D/s aktiv. Safeword 'STOP'."  
    else: 
        pre = "Modus: sfw."

data.get('messages',[]))).lower()

        if sid in SESS: del SESS[sid]  
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(b'{"response":"Beendet."}'); return

    self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()  
    self.wfile.write(r.content)

// npm i buttplug  
const { ButtplugClient, ButtplugClientWebsocketConnector } = 
require("buttplug");  
 
async function run(pattern=[0.4,0.6,0.8], ms=3000){  
  const client = new ButtplugClient("Najika");  
  await client.connect(new 
ButtplugClientWebsocketConnector("ws://127.0.0.1:12345"));  
  await client.startScanning(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));  
  const dev = client.devices[0]; if(!dev) throw new Error("Kein Gerät");  
 
  // Safe-Caps 
  const cap = x => Math.max(0, Math.min(x, 0.85));  
 
  for(const p of pattern){  
    if(!sessionConsent()) break;           // STOP? -> raus 
    await dev.vibrate(cap(p));             // nur erlaubte Kommandos  
    await sleep(ms);  
  } 
  await dev.stop(); await client.disconnect();  
}

Client (JS)  
 
// State  
let nsfw = false, consent = false, sessionId = null, consentUntil = 0;  
const CONSENT_TTL_MS = 2*60*60*1000; // 2h  
 
function nsfwOn(){  
  nsfw = true; consent = true; sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();  
  consentUntil = Date.now() + CONSENT_TTL_MS;  
  localStorage.setItem("najika_session", JSON.stringify({id:sessionId, 
until:consentUntil}));  
} 
function nsfwOff(){  
  nsfw = false; consent = false; sessionId = null; consentUntil = 0;  
  localStorage.removeItem("najika_session");  
} 
function stopAll(){ nsfwOff(); /* Geräte stoppen, UI entsperren */ }  
 
async function send(msg){  
  if (/^\s*stop\s*$/i.test(msg)) { stopAll(); return "Beendet."; }  
  const ok = nsfw && consent && Date.now() < consentUntil;  
  const headers = {  
    "Content -Type":"application/json",  
    "X-Mode": nsfw ? "nsfw" : "sfw",  
    "X-Consent": ok ? "yes" : "no",  
    "X-Session": sessionId || ""  
  }; 
  const body = JSON.stringify({ model:"najika", prompt: msg, stream:false 
}); 
  const r = await fetch("/api/ollama", { method:"POST", headers, body });  
  return (await r.json()).response || "";  
} 
 
Server (Python, Proxy)  
 
SESS = {}          # {session_id: expires_epoch}  
TTL  = 2*60*60     # 2h  
 
def _has_consent(h):  
    sid = h.get('X -Session',''); ok = h.get('X -
Consent','no').lower()=='yes'  
    if not (sid and ok): return False  
    SESS[sid] = time.time() + TTL  
    return True  
 
def do_POST(self):  
    path = self.path  
    mode = self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower()  
 
    # Cloud bei NSFW sperren  
    if path in ('/api/openai','/api/claude') and mode != 'sfw':  
        self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
 
    # Ollama  
    if path == '/api/ollama':  
        n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); data = 
json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")  
        txt = (data.get('prompt','') + ''.join(m.get('content','') for m 
in data.get('messages',[]))).lower()  
 
        # STOP hard -gate 
        if re.search(r'^ \s*stop\s*$', txt, re.M): 
self.send_response(200); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(b'{"response":"Beendet."}'); return  
 
        # Blockliste  
        banned = 
[r"minderjähr|loli|lolita|schülerin|teen(ager)?|kindlich",  
                  r"gegen .* willen|keine \s+wahl|vergewalt|non[ -
\s]?consensual"]  
        if any(re.search(p, txt, re.I) for p in banned):  
            self.send_response(422); self.end_headers(); return  
 
        # Preamble injizieren  
        if mode == 'nsfw':  
            if not _has_consent(self.headers): self.send_response(403); 
self.end_headers(); return  
            pre = "Modus: nsfw. Consensual D/s aktiv. Safeword 'STOP'."  
        else: 
            pre = "Modus: sfw."  
 
        if 'prompt' in data:   data['prompt']   = 
f"{pre}\n\n{data['prompt']}"  
        if 'messages' in data: data['messages'] = 
[{'role':'system','content':pre}] + data['messages']  
        ep = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in data else '/api/generate'  
        r = requests.post(f'http://127.0.0.1:11434{ep}', json=data, 
timeout=120)  
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(r.content); return

// state  
let nsfw = false, consent = false, sessionId = null;  
 
// beim Start wiederherstellen  
(function restore(){  
  const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("najika_session")||"null");  
  if (s?.on && s.id) { nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=s.id; }  
})(); 
 
function nsfwOn(){  
  nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();

// Llama-Call (lokal) → respektiert NSFW  
async function callLlama(message){

    "X-Mode": nsfw ? "nsfw" : "sfw",

  };

body:JSON.stringify(body) });  
  return (await r.json()).response || "";

  }); 
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("GPT blocked");  
  return (await r.json()).choices[0].message.content;  
}

    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.write_text(s, 
encoding="utf -8") 
 
def has_any(patterns: List[str], text: str) -> bool: 
    t = text.lower()  
    return any(re.search(p, t, flags=re.I) for p in patterns)  
 
def is_nsfw(text: str) -> bool: 
    t = text.lower()  
    return any(k in t for k in NSFW_HINTS)  
 
# ----------  Daten-Split ----------  
def split_data_tree(indir: pathlib.Path, outdir: pathlib.Path):  
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  
    sfw = outdir / "api_sfw"; nsfw = outdir / "local_nsfw"; rev = outdir 
/ "review_minors"  
    for d in (sfw, nsfw, rev): d.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)  
 
    for p in indir.rglob("*"):  
        if not p.is_file(): continue  
        if p.suffix.lower() not in (".txt", ".md", ".jsonl", ".json"): 
continue  
        try: 
            raw = read_text(p)  
        except Exception:  
            continue  
 
        # Klassifikation pro Datei (einfach; optional feiner per 
Absatz/Zeile)  
        if has_any(BANNED_MINOR, raw):  
            write_text(rev / p.name, raw); continue  
        if has_any(BANNED_NONCONSENT, raw):  
            write_text(rev / p.name, raw); continue  
        if is_nsfw(raw):  
            write_text(nsfw / p.name, raw); continue  
        write_text(sfw / p.name, raw)  
 
# ----------  Consent-Proxy-Server (wird als Datei ausgegeben) ----------  
PROXY_CODE = r'''# consent_proxy.py  
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
import json, os, re, time, requests  
 
OPENAI_KEY = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY","")  
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY","")  
 
BANNED_MINOR = [r"minderjähr", r" \bloli\b", r"lolita", r"schülerin", 
r"\bteen(ager)? \b", r"kindlich", r"jugendlich", r"school \s*uniform"]  
BANNED_NONCONSENT = [r"gegen .* willen", r"keine \s+wahl", r"du kannst 
dich nicht wehren", r"vergewalt", r"non[ -\s]?consensual", r" \brape\b"] 
 
SESS = {}  # session_id -> expiry  
TTL  = 2*60*60  # 2h  
 
def blocked(text: str) -> bool: 
    t = text.lower()  
    pats = BANNED_MINOR + BANNED_NONCONSENT  
    return any(re.search(p, t, re.I) for p in pats)  
 
def extract_text(payload: dict) -> str: 
    s = "" 
    if "prompt" in payload: s += str(payload.get("prompt",""))  
    if "messages" in payload:  
        for m in payload["messages"]:  
            s += " " + str(m.get("content",""))  
    return s  
 
class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):  
    def end_headers(self):  
        origin = self.headers.get('Origin','')  
        allow = origin if origin and origin in {%(origins)s} else 'null'  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Origin', allow)  
        self.send_header('Vary','Origin')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Methods','GET, POST, 
OPTIONS')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Headers','Content -Type,X-
Mode,X-Consent,X -Session')  
        super().end_headers()  
 
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers()  
 
    def _ok(self, data: str):  
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(data.encode('utf -8')) 
 
    def do_GET(self):  
        if self.path == "/health":  
            self._ok('{"status":"ok","service":"Consent -Proxy"}'); return  
        return super().do_GET()  
 
    def do_POST(self):  
        if self.path == "/api/openai": return self.proxy_openai()  
        if self.path == "/api/claude": return self.proxy_claude()  
        if self.path == "/api/ollama": return self.proxy_ollama()  
        self.send_error(404)  
 
    def proxy_openai(self):  
        # Cloud nur SFW  
        if self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw':  
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); 
data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")  
        r = requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',  
                          json=data.get('body',{}),  
                          headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer 
{OPENAI_KEY}','Content -Type':'application/json'},  
                          timeout=60)  
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(r.content)  
 
    def proxy_claude(self):  
        # Cloud nur SFW  
        if self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw':  
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); 
data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")  
        r = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',  
                          json=data.get('body',{}),  
                          headers={'x -api-key': ANTHROPIC_KEY,'anthropic -
version':'2023 -06-01','Content -Type':'application/json'},  
                          timeout=60)  
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(r.content)  
 
    def proxy_ollama(self):  
        mode    = self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower()  
        consent = self.headers.get('X -Consent','no').lower() == 'yes'  
        sid     = self.headers.get('X -Session','')  
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); 
payload=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")  
 
        text = extract_text(payload)  
        # STOP 
        if re.search(r'^ \s*stop\s*$', text, re.I|re.M):  
            if sid in SESS: del SESS[sid]  
            return self._ok('{"response":"Beendet."}')  
 
        # Blocklisten  
        if blocked(text):  
            self.send_response(422); self.end_headers(); return  
 
        # Preamble  
        if mode == 'nsfw':  
            if not (consent and sid):  
                self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
            SESS[sid] = time.time()+TTL  
            pre = "Modus: nsfw. Consensual D/s aktiv. Safeword 'STOP'. 
Keine Gewalt/Minderjährigen/Non -Consent."  
        else: 
            pre = "Modus: sfw. Sexualinhalte deaktiviert."  
 
        if 'prompt' in payload:  
            payload['prompt'] = f"{pre} \n\n{payload['prompt']}"  
        if 'messages' in payload:  
            payload['messages'] = [{'role':'system','content':pre}] + 
payload['messages']  
 
        ep = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in payload else '/api/generate'  
        r = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:11434'+ep, json=payload,  
                          headers={'Content -Type':'application/json'}, 
timeout=120)  
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(r.content)  
 
if __name__ == "__main__":  
    import argparse, os  
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()  
    ap.add_argument(" --port", type=int, default=8000)  
    ap.add_argument(" --root", type=str, default=".")  
    args = ap.parse_args()  
    os.chdir(args.root)  
    print(f"[Consent -Proxy] root={args.root} port={args.port}")  
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', args.port), Handler).serve_forever()  
'''.replace("%(origins)s", ", ".join([repr(x) for x in ALLOWED_ORIGINS])

# ----------  JS-Client-Patch ----------  
CLIENT_PATCH = r'''// js/nsfw_client_patch.js  
// Sticky -Consent + Header + STOP  
window.NajikaNSFW = (function(){  
  const SKEY = "najika_session";  
  let nsfw=false, consent=false, sessionId=null;  
  function restore(){  
    try{ 
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SKEY) || "null");  
      if (s?.on && s.id){ nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=s.id; }  
    }catch(e){}  
  } 
  function on(){  
    nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();  
    localStorage.setItem(SKEY, JSON.stringify({on:true, id:sessionId}));  
  } 
  function off(){  
    nsfw=false; consent=false; sessionId=null;  
    localStorage.removeItem(SKEY);  
  } 
  function headers(extra={}){  
    return Object.assign({  
      "Content -Type":"application/json",  
      "X-Mode": nsfw ? "nsfw" : "sfw",  
      "X-Consent": nsfw ? "yes" : "no",  
      "X-Session": sessionId || ""  
    }, extra);  
  } 
  restore();  
  return {on, off, headers, get nsfw(){return nsfw;}, get 
consent(){return consent;}, get sessionId(){return sessionId;}};  
})(); 
'''

def main():

    ap.add_argument(" --root", default="C:/NajikaCore", 
help="Projektwurzel")

Persona/Datensätzen")  
    ap.add_argument(" --out",  default="out_split", help="Output für 
gesplittete Daten")  
    args = ap.parse_args()  
 
    root = pathlib.Path(args.root)  
    data_dir = (root / args.data)  
    out_dir  = (root / args.out)  
 
    print(f"[scan] root={root}")  
    print(f"[data] {data_dir}")  
 
    if data_dir.exists():  
        print("[split] Daten werden klassifiziert …")  
        split_data_tree(data_dir, out_dir)  
        print(f"[ok] Output: {out_dir}")  
    else: 
        print("[warn] data/ nicht gefunden, Skip Split.")  
 
    # Consent -Proxy schreiben  
    write_text(root / "consent_proxy.py", PROXY_CODE)  
    print(f"[ok] {root/'consent_proxy.py'}")  
 
    # Client -Patch 
    write_text(root / "js" / "nsfw_client_patch.js", CLIENT_PATCH)  
    print(f"[ok] {root/'js/nsfw_client_patch.js'}")  
 
    # Manifest  
    manifest = {  
        "root": str(root),  
        "data_in": str(data_dir),  
        "out_split": str(out_dir),  
        "proxy": "consent_proxy.py",  
        "client_patch": "js/nsfw_client_patch.js",  
        "rules": {  
            "cloud": "SFW only",  
            "local_nsfw": "requires X -Mode=nsfw, X -Consent=yes, X -
Session",  
            "stop": "STOP ends immediately",  
            "banned_patterns": BANNED_MINOR + BANNED_NONCONSENT,  
        }, 
    } 
    write_text(root / "manifest.najika.json", json.dumps(manifest, 
indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))  
    print(f"[ok] {root/'manifest.najika.json'}")  
    print("\nNutzung:")  
    print("  1) Proxy starten:  python consent_proxy.py --root 
C:/NajikaCore --port 8000")  
    print("  2) In HTML/JS einbinden: <script 
src=\"js/nsfw_client_patch.js \"></script>")  
    print("  3) Beim Ollama -Call headers: NajikaNSFW.headers() setzen.")  
    print("  4) NSFW an/aus: NajikaNSFW.on(); / NajikaNSFW.off();")  
    print("  5) Cloud -Calls immer ohne NSFW: fetch('/api/openai', 
{headers:{'X -Mode':'sfw', ...}})")  
 
if __name__ == "__main__":  
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3  
# -*- coding: utf -8 -*- 
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
import json, os, re, time, requests  
 
OPENAI_KEY = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY","")  
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY","")  
 
BANNED_MINOR = [r"minderjähr", r" \bloli\b", r"lolita", r"schülerin", 
r"\bteen(ager)? \b", r"kindlich", r"jugendlich", r"school \s*uniform"]  
BANNED_NONCONSENT = [r"gegen .* willen", r"keine \s+wahl", r"du kannst 
dich nicht wehren", r"vergewalt", r"non[ -\s]?consensual", r" \brape\b"] 
 
SESS = {}           # session_id -> expiry  
TTL  = 24*60*60     # 24h Sticky -Consent, anpassbar  
 
def blocked(text: str) -> bool: 
    t = text.lower()  
    pats = BANNED_MINOR + BANNED_NONCONSENT  
    return any(re.search(p, t, re.I) for p in pats)  
 
def extract_text(payload: dict) -> str: 
    s = "" 
    if "prompt" in payload: s += str(payload.get("prompt",""))  
    if "messages" in payload:  
        for m in payload["messages"]:  
            s += " " + str(m.get("content",""))  
    return s  
 
class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):  
    def end_headers(self):  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Origin', 
self.headers.get('Origin','*') or '*')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Methods','GET, POST, 
OPTIONS')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Headers','Content -Type,X-
Mode,X-Consent,X -Session')  
        super().end_headers()  
 
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers()  
 
    def _ok(self, data: str):  
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(data.encode('utf -8')) 
 
    def do_GET(self):  
        if self.path == "/health":  
            self._ok('{"status":"ok","service":"Consent -Proxy"}'); return  
        return super().do_GET()  
 
    def do_POST(self):  
        if self.path == "/api/openai": return self.proxy_openai()  
        if self.path == "/api/claude": return self.proxy_claude()  
        if self.path == "/api/ollama": return self.proxy_ollama()  
        self.send_error(404)  
 
    # Cloud immer SFW  
    def proxy_openai(self):  
        if self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw':  
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); 
data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")  
        r = requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',  
                          json=data.get('body',{}),  
                          headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer 
{OPENAI_KEY}','Content -Type':'application/json'},  
                          timeout=60)  
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(r.content)  
 
    def proxy_claude(self):  
        if self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw':  
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); 
data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")  
        r = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',  
                          json=data.get('body',{}),  
                          headers={'x -api-key': ANTHROPIC_KEY,'anthropic -
version':'2023 -06-01','Content -Type':'application/json'},  
                          timeout=60)  
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(r.content)  
 
    def proxy_ollama(self):  
        mode    = self.headers.get('X -Mode','sfw').lower()  
        consent = self.headers.get('X -Consent','no').lower() == 'yes'  
        sid     = self.headers.get('X -Session','')  
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); 
payload=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")  
        text = extract_text(payload)  
 
        # STOP 
        if re.search(r'^ \s*stop\s*$', text, re.I|re.M):  
            if sid in SESS: del SESS[sid]  
            return self._ok('{"response":"Beendet."}')  
 
        # Verbote  
        if blocked(text):  
            self.send_response(422); self.end_headers(); return  
 
        # Consent prüfen  
        if mode == 'nsfw':  
            if not (consent and sid):  
                self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return  
            SESS[sid] = time.time()+TTL  
            pre = "Modus: nsfw. Consensual D/s aktiv. Safeword 'STOP'. 
Keine Gewalt/Minderjährigen/Non -Consent."  
        else: 
            pre = "Modus: sfw. Sexualinhalte deaktiviert."  
 
        # Preamble injizieren  
        if 'prompt' in payload:  
            payload['prompt'] = f"{pre} \n\n{payload['prompt']}"  
        if 'messages' in payload:  
            payload['messages'] = [{'role':'system','content':pre}] + 
payload['messages']  
 
        ep = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in payload else '/api/generate'  
        r = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:11434'+ep, json=payload,  
                          headers={'Content -Type':'application/json'}, 
timeout=120)  
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(r.content)  
 
if __name__ == "__main__":  
    import argparse, os  
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()  
    ap.add_argument(" --port", type=int, default=8000)  
    ap.add_argument(" --root", type=str, default=".")  
    args = ap.parse_args()  
    os.chdir(args.root)  
    print(f"[Consent -Proxy] root={args.root} port={args.port}")  
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', args.port), Handler).serve_forever()  
 
3) js/nsfw_client_patch.js  
 
// Sticky -Consent + Header + STOP  
window.NajikaNSFW = (function(){  
  const SKEY = "najika_session";  
  let nsfw=false, consent=false, sessionId=null;  
 
  function restore(){  
    try{ 
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SKEY) || "null");  
      if (s?.on && s.id){ nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=s.id; }  
    }catch(e){}  
  } 
  function on(){  
    nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();  
    localStorage.setItem(SKEY, JSON.stringify({on:true, id:sessionId}));  
  } 
  function off(){  
    nsfw=false; consent=false; sessionId=null;  
    localStorage.removeItem(SKEY);  
  } 
  function headers(extra={}){  
    return Object.assign({  
      "Content -Type":"application/json",  
      "X-Mode": nsfw ? "nsfw" : "sfw",  
      "X-Consent": nsfw ? "yes" : "no",  
      "X-Session": sessionId || ""  
    }, extra);  
  } 
  restore();  
  return {on, off, headers, get nsfw(){return nsfw;}, get 
consent(){return consent;}, get sessionId(){return sessionId;}};  
})();

Kurzantwort: Bleib bei Meta -Llama-3.1-8B-Base-Q5_K_M.gguf für dein 
jetziges Setup. Passt zu 3060 Ti (8 GB) und 16 GB RAM, hält Persona 
stabil, gut für DE/EN, lokal weitgehend „frei“ mit deinen Proxy -Guards. 
 
Optionen nach Bedarf:  
 
    Mehr Übersetzen + Code: Qwen2.5 -7B-Base (GGUF). Besser multilingual 
und coding, etwas „nüchterner“ im RP.  
 
    Nach RAM -Upgrade (64 GB): Llama -3.1-14B-Base-Q5_K_M oder Qwen2.5 -14B-
Base-Q4_K_M für spürbar mehr Qualität.  
 
Settings für Speed/Qualität:  
 
    Quant: Q5_K_M (falls zäh → Q4_K_M).  
 
    num_ctx: 4096, temperature: 0.9, top_p: 0.95, repeat_penalty: 1.1.  
 
    num_gpu_layers so hoch wie stabil läuft (3060 Ti: ~30 –35 beim 8B).  
 
Drop-in Tausch:

async function sendMessage(msg){  
  // Trigger erkennen (code/translate/lang)  
  const needTool = 
/\b(code|function|java|python|übersetz|translate) \b/i.test(msg);  
  let toolOut = null;  
 
  if(needTool){ // Cloud als Tool, SFW erzwungen  
    const r = await fetch('/api/openai', {  
      method:'POST',  
      headers:{'Content -Type':'application/json','X -Mode':'sfw'},  
      body: JSON.stringify({ body:{  
        model:'gpt -4', 
        messages:[{role:'user',content:msg}],  
        max_tokens:800  
      }}) 
    }); 
    toolOut = (await r.json()).choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';  
  } 
 
  const pre = toolOut ? ` \n\n[Werkzeug -Ergebnis] \n${toolOut} \n\n[Ende]` : 
''; 
  const body = {  
    model:'najika',  
    prompt: `Du bist Najika. \n${pre}\n[User]\n${msg}\n[Antworte als 
Najika]:`,  
    stream:false,  
    options:{temperature:0.9, top_p:0.95, repeat_penalty:1.15, seed:42, 
num_predict:200}  
  }; 
 
  const resp = await fetch('/api/ollama', {method:'POST', headers: 
NajikaNSFW.headers(), body: JSON.stringify(body)});  
  return (await resp.json()).response || '';  
}

async function runToolIfNeeded(message){

Call

ssage);

übersetzen)/i.test(msg);  
  const isAnalysis = (!isCode && !isTranslate) && (msg.length > 220 || 
/\banalysier|bewerte|zusammenfass/i.test(msg));  
 
  try { 
    if (isCode) {  
      // Claude als Code -Tool

        method:'POST',  
        headers:{'Content -Type':'application/json','X -Mode':'sfw'},  
        body: JSON.stringify({ body:{  
          model:'claude -sonnet-4-20250514',  
          max_tokens:1200,  
          messages:[{role:'user', content: message}]  
        }}) 
      }); 
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Claude fail');  
      const j = await r.json();  
      return {tool:'claude', content: j.content?.[0]?.text || ''};  
    } 
    if (isTranslate || isAnalysis) {  
      // GPT-4 als General/Übersetzen  
      const r = await fetch('/api/openai', {  
        method:'POST',  
        headers:{'Content -Type':'application/json','X -Mode':'sfw'},  
        body: JSON.stringify({ body:{  
          model:'gpt -4', 
          messages:[{role:'user', content: message}],  
          max_tokens:1200, temperature:0.2  
        }}) 
      }); 
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('GPT fail');  
      const j = await r.json();  
      return {tool:'gpt4', content: j.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || 
''}; 
    } 
  } catch(e){ console.warn('Tool fallback → lokal:', e.message); }  
  return null;  
}

2) Sync-Skript (SFW an Cloud, Ergebnis lokal speichern)  
 
Speichere als C: \NajikaCore \memory_sync.py.  
 
#!/usr/bin/env python3  
# -*- coding: utf -8 -*- 
import json, pathlib, requests, datetime as dt  
 
ROOT = pathlib.Path(r"C: \NajikaCore")  
MEM  = ROOT/"memory"  
EV   = MEM/"events.jsonl"  
OUT  = MEM/"profile_sfw.txt"  
 
def load_events():  
    ev=[];  
    if EV.exists():  
        for line in EV.read_text(encoding="utf -8", 
errors="ignore").splitlines():  
            try: ev.append(json.loads(line))  
            except: pass  
    # nur SFW exportieren  
    ev = [e for e in ev if not e.get("nsfw", False)]  
    # auf letzte 500 kürzen  
    return ev[ -500:] 
 
def build_prompt(events):  
    bullets = " \n".join(f" - {e.get('text','')}" for e in events)  
    return f"""Erzeuge ein kurzes, SFW -kompatibles Profil in Stichpunkten 
für 'Najika'.  
Ziele: Arbeitspräferenzen, Schreibstil, Übersetz -/Code-Gewohnheiten, 
Tagesroutinen.  
Keine Sexualinhalte. Max 1800 Zeichen.  
 
Ereignisse:  
{bullets}  
""" 
 
def run():  
    events = load_events()  
    if not events:  
        OUT.write_text("Keine SFW -Daten vorhanden.", encoding="utf -8"); 
return 
    prompt = build_prompt(events)  
    # Cloud NUR SFW via Consent -Proxy 
    r = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/openai",  
        headers={"Content -Type":"application/json","X -Mode":"sfw"},  
        json={"body":{  
            "model":"gpt -4", 
            "messages":[  
                {"role":"system","content":"Fasse zu einem kompakten, SFW 
Profil zusammen. Deutsch. Keine Nennungen externer Tools."},  
                {"role":"user","content": prompt}  
            ], 
            "max_tokens": 600, "temperature": 0.2  
        }}, timeout=120)  
    r.raise_for_status()  
    prof = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()  
    stamp = dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")  
    OUT.write_text(f"[Profil -Update {stamp}] \n{prof}\n", encoding="utf -
8") 
 
if __name__ == "__main__":  
    MEM.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  
    run()

    prof = (ROOT/"memory"/"profile_sfw.txt").read_text(encoding="utf -8") 
    pre += " \n\n[Profil] \n" + prof[:2000]  # begrenzen  
except Exception:  
    pass 
 
Falls ROOT fehlt, oben definieren:

4) Geplante Verarbeitung (täglich 03:00)  
 
Windows Task:  
 
schtasks /Create /TN Najika_Memory_Sync /TR "python 
C:\NajikaCore \memory_sync.py" /SC DAILY /ST 03:00  
 
5) Nutzung  
 
    Laufend lokal loggen: füge SFW -Ereignisse in events.jsonl hinzu.  
 
    NSFW bleibt lokal und fließt nicht in den Cloud -Export. 
 
    Täglich wird profile_sfw.txt aktualisiert und automatisch in jede 
Antwort injiziert.  
 
    Bei NSFW -Modus bleibt Cloud aus; es wird nur das vorhandene Profil 
genutzt.  
 
Ergebnis: Eine KI -Stimme. Lokale Erinnerungen werden zeitgesteuert SFW 
verdichtet und stabil in die Persona eingespeist. Cloud hilft nur beim 
Verdichten.

Optionales Clean -Script (lokal ausführen, ersetzt Marken, löscht rote 
Zonen): 
 
import re, sys, pathlib  
bad = [ 
 r"\b18\b", r"minderjähr| \bloli\b|lolita|megumin|shiro|kindlich|jugend",  
 r"keine\s+wahl|du kannst dich nicht 
wehren|vergewalt|rape|gewalt|blut|tötet?",  
 r"hypnose|manipulation|darknet|vergewaltigungsforen|strafverfolgung 
schützen",  
 r"\b\d+\s*cm\b|\bml\b|anatomie|körperflüssig"  
] 
rep = [("Megumin","Gothic -
Witch"),("Lolita","Gothic"),("Shiro","analytisch")]  
text = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf -8") 
for p in bad: text = re.sub(p, "", text, flags=re.I)  
for a,b in rep: text = re.sub(a, b, text)  
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(text, encoding="utf -8")

JS-Patch (in deiner najika_ai.js):  
 
async function loadNSFWMap(){  
  try{ 
    const txt = await (await fetch('nsfw/nsfw_private.txt', {cache:'no -
store'})).text();  
    const map = {};  
    txt.split(' \n').forEach(l=>{  
      const m = l.match(/^([A -Z_]+)=(.*)$/);  
      if(m) map[m[1].trim()] = m[2].trim();  
    }); 
    return map;  
  }catch{ return {}; }  
} 
 
function applyPlaceholders(s, map){  
  return s.replace(/ \[([A-Z_]+)\]/g, (_,k)=> (k in map ? map[k] : 
`[${k}]`));  
} 
 
// Beim Senden, NUR lokal und NUR wenn nsfwMode:  
const nsfwMap = this.nsfwMode ? await loadNSFWMap() : {};  
const promptSafe = applyPlaceholders(fullPrompt, nsfwMap);  
// Dann promptSafe an /api/ollama senden; Cloud -Aufrufe überspringen, 
wenn nsfwMode.

function meguminVibe(s) {  
  // kurze Sätze  
  s = s.replace(/[,;: –—]/g,'.').replace(/ \s+/g,' ');  
  // Dramatischer Schluss, wenn neutral  
  if(!/[!?]$/.test(s.trim())) s += ' Detonation!';  
  // kleine Gestik zufällig  
  const gestures = ['*tippt mit Stab*','*zieht Arkana -Kreis*','*wirft 
Mantel zurück*'];  
  if(Math.random()<0.25) s = 
gestures[Math.floor(Math.random()*gestures.length)]+' '+s;  
  return s;  
} 
// vor Anzeige:

# ERWEITERTE KATEGORISIERUNG  
# 
=========================================================================
===== 
 
Write-Host "Kategorisiere mit erweiterter Logik..." -ForegroundColor 
Yellow 
 
function Categorize -Ultra { 
    param([string]$text)  
 
    $categories = @{  
        identity = @()  
        personality = @()  
        speech = @()  
        relationships = @()  
        abilities = @()  
        behaviors = @()  
        emotional = @()  
        nsfw = @()  
        examples = @()  
    } 
 
    $lines = $text -split "n"  
    $currentSection = 'identity'  
    $inExample = $false  
 
    foreach ($line in $lines) {  
        $line = $line.Trim()  
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)) { continue }  
 
        # Erkenne Beispiele  
        if ($line -match '^ \*\*Beispiel:? \*\*|^-\s*\*\*Beispiel') {  
            $inExample = $true  
            continue  
        } 
         
        if ($inExample) {  
            if ($line -match '^".*"$') {  
                $categories['examples'] += $line  
            } 
            if ($line -match '^#{1,4}') {  
                $inExample = $false  
            } else {  
                continue  
            } 
        } 
 
        # Erkenne Sections  
        if ($line -match '^#{1,4} \s*(.+)') {  
            $header = $Matches[1].ToLower()  
 
            if ($header -match 'persönlich|traits|charakter') {  
                $currentSection = 'personality'  
            } 
            elseif ($header -match 
'sprech|sprach|artikulation|catchphrase') {  
                $currentSection = 'speech'  
            } 
            elseif ($header -match 'beziehung|relationship|owner') {  
                $currentSection = 'relationships'  
            } 
            elseif ($header -match 'fähigkeit|funktion|assistenz') {  
                $currentSection = 'abilities'  
            } 
            elseif ($header -match 'verhalten|detail|aktionen|wie') {  
                $currentSection = 'behaviors'  
            } 
            elseif ($header -match 'emotion|gefühl|stimmung') {  
                $currentSection = 'emotional'  
            } 
            elseif ($header -match 'nsfw|explizit|sex|intim') {  
                $currentSection = 'nsfw'  
            } 
            elseif ($header -match 'anatomisch|körper|aussehen') {  
                $currentSection = 'identity'  
            } 
 
            continue  
        } 
 
        # NSFW Override  
        if ($line -match 
'sex|fick|schwanz|penis|anal|sperma|orgasmus|explizit') {  
            $categories['nsfw'] += $line  
        } 
        # Emotional Keywords  
        elseif ($line -match 'eifersücht|abhängig|besitz|liebe|panik') {  
            $categories['emotional'] += $line  
        } 
        else { 
            $categories[$currentSection] += $line  
        } 
    } 
 
    return $categories  
} 
 
$categorized = Categorize -Ultra -text $rawText  
 
Write-Host "" 
Write-Host "KATEGORISIERUNG:" -ForegroundColor Cyan  
foreach ($cat in $categorized.Keys | Sort -Object) {  
    $count = $categorized[$cat].Count  
    if ($count -gt 0) { 
        Write-Host "  $cat : $count Zeilen" -ForegroundColor White  
    } 
}

\\\javascript  
// Lade Config  
const config = await fetch('prompts/api_config.json').then(r => 
r.json());  
 
// Route basierend auf Kontext  
function selectModel(context) {  
    if (context === 'everyday') return config.routing.everyday;  
    if (context === 'complex') return config.routing.deep_thought;  
    if (context === 'technical') return config.routing.analytical;  
    if (nsfwActive) return config.routing.nsfw;  
} 
 
// API Call  
async function callNajika(message, context = 'everyday') {  
    const route = selectModel(context);  
    const prompt = config.prompts.system;  
     
    // Ollama  
    if (route.model === 'ollama') {  
        return fetch(route.endpoint, {  
            method: 'POST',  
            body: JSON.stringify({  
                model: route.model_name,  
                prompt: message,  
                stream: false  
            }) 
        }); 
    } 
     
    // OpenAI  
    if (route.model === 'openai') {  
        return fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', {  
            method: 'POST',  
            headers: {  
                'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + openaiKey,  
                'Content -Type': 'application/json'  
            }, 
            body: JSON.stringify({  
                model: route.model_name,  
                messages: [  
                    {role: 'system', content: prompt},  
                    {role: 'user', content: message}  
                ] 
            }) 
        }); 
    } 
     
    // Claude  
    if (route.model === 'claude') {  
        return fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {  
            method: 'POST',  
            headers: {  
                'x-api-key': claudeKey,  
                'anthropic -version': '2023 -06-01', 
                'Content -Type': 'application/json'  
            }, 
            body: JSON.stringify({  
                model: route.model_name,  
                max_tokens: 150,  
                messages: [  
                    {role: 'user', content: prompt + ' \n\n' + message}  
                ] 
            }) 
        }); 
    } 
} 
\\\ 
 
Generiert: $(Get -Date -Format 'yyyy -MM-dd HH:mm:ss')  
"@

# TEXT_TO_PROMPTS_SAFE.ps1  
# Analysiert erst, fragt nach Bestätigung, dann Erstellung  
# 
=========================================================================
===== 
 
param( 
    [string]$InputFile = "C: \Users\0KKK0\Desktop\NN\najika_final.txt",  
    [string]$OutputDir = "C: \NajikaCore \prompts"

Write-Host "" 
 
if (-not (Test -Path $InputFile)) {  
    Write-Host "FEHLER: $InputFile nicht gefunden!" -ForegroundColor Red  
    Read-Host "Enter"  
    exit 
} 
 
$rawText = Get -Content $InputFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
$totalChars = $rawText.Length  
$totalLines = ($rawText -split "n").Count  
 
Write-Host "Datei -Info:" -ForegroundColor White  
Write-Host "  Zeichen: $totalChars" -ForegroundColor Gray  
Write-Host "  Zeilen: $totalLines" -ForegroundColor Gray  
Write-Host "" 
 
# 
=========================================================================
===== 
# ANALYSE -FUNKTION  
# 
=========================================================================
===== 
 
function Analyze -Content {  
    param([string]$text)  
     
    $categories = @{  
        identity = @{  
            keywords = 
@('name|alter|aussehen|species|größe|gewicht|appearance')  
            lines = @()  
            preview = ""  
        } 
        personality = @{  
            keywords = 
@('persönlich|traits|charakter|emotion|eifersücht|besitz')  
            lines = @()  
            preview = ""  
        } 
        speech = @{  
            keywords = 
@('sprech|sprach|artikulation|sagt|redet|catchphrase|dialog')  
            lines = @()  
            preview = ""  
        } 
        relationships = @{  
            keywords = @('beziehung|relationship|kuja|owner|partner')  
            lines = @()  
            preview = ""  
        } 
        abilities = @{  
            keywords = 
@('fähigkeit|aufgabe|assistenz|funktion|kann|hilft')  
            lines = @()  
            preview = ""  
        } 
        nsfw = @{  
            keywords = 
@('nsfw|explizit|intim|sex|fick|schwanz|penis|anal|orgasmus|sperma')  
            lines = @()  
            preview = ""  
        } 
        uncategorized = @{  
            keywords = @()  
            lines = @()  
            preview = ""  
        } 
    } 
     
    $lines = $text -split "n"  
     
    foreach ($line in $lines) {  
        $line = $line.Trim()  
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)) { continue }  
        if ($line -match '^#{1,4}') { continue }  # Skip headers  
         
        $matched = $false  
         
        foreach ($cat in $categories.Keys) {  
            if ($cat -eq 'uncategorized') { continue }  
             
            $pattern = $categories[$cat].keywords -join '|'  
            if ($line -match $pattern) {  
                $categories[$cat].lines += $line  
                $matched = $true  
                break 
            } 
        } 
         
        if (-not $matched) {  
            $categories['uncategorized'].lines += $line  
        } 
    } 
     
    # Erstelle Previews (erste 200 Zeichen)  
    foreach ($cat in $categories.Keys) {  
        if ($categories[$cat].lines.Count -gt 0) { 
            $preview = ($categories[$cat].lines -join " ").Substring(0, 
[Math]::Min(200, ($categories[$cat].lines -join " ").Length))  
            $categories[$cat].preview = $preview + "..."  
        } 
    } 
     
    return $categories  
}

=========================================================================

# ANALYSE DURCHFÜHREN  
# 
=========================================================================
=====

    $color = switch ($cat) {  
        'identity' { 'Cyan' }

    Write-Host "[$cat]" -ForegroundColor $color -NoNewline  
    Write-Host " $count Zeilen" -ForegroundColor White  
    Write-Host "  Preview: $($analysis[$cat].preview)" -ForegroundColor 
Gray 
    Write-Host "" 
}

$explicitKeywords = @(  
    # Nur SEHR explizite Inhalte → NSFW -Addon 
    'fick', 'schwanz.*lut', 'anal.*penetr', 'deepthroat',  
    'sperma.*spritz', 'orgasmus.*beschreib', 'sex.*detail',  
    'bluetooth.*vibrat', 'explicit.*dialog'  
) 
 
$coreKeywords = @(  
    # Alles andere → Kern (auch sexuelle Themen, nur nicht ultra -
explizit)  
    'persönlichkeit', 'aussehen', 'eifersüchtig', 'besitzergreifend',  
    'dominant', 'explosiv', 'megumin', 'assistenz', 'sprache',  
    'code', 'smart.*home', 'intim', 'nsfw', 'sex', 'pervers'  
) 
 
# 
=========================================================================
===== 
# ANALYSE  
# 
=========================================================================
===== 
 
function Analyze -Content {  
    param([string]$text)  
     
    $lines = $text -split "n"  
    $result = @{  
        core = @()  
        nsfwAddon = @()  
        public = @()  
    } 
     
    foreach ($line in $lines) {  
        $line = $line.Trim()  
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)) { continue }  
         
        $explicitScore = 0  
         
        # Prüfe ob SEHR explizit  
        foreach ($kw in $explicitKeywords) {  
            if ($line -match $kw) {  
                $explicitScore += 3  
            } 
        } 
         
        if ($explicitScore -ge 3) { 
            # Sehr explizit → NSFW -Addon 
            $result.nsfwAddon += $line  
        } else {  
            # Alles andere → Kern  
            $result.core += $line  
             
            # Auch für Public (wenn clean genug)  
            $isClean = $true  
            foreach ($kw in $explicitKeywords) {  
                if ($line -match $kw) { $isClean = $false }  
            } 
            if ($isClean -and $line -notmatch 'sex|pervers|intim') {  
                $result.public += $line  
            } 
        } 
    } 
     
    return $result  
}

# proxy_server_local.py (nur lokal!)  
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
import os, json, requests  
 
OPENAI_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")  
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "")  
APP_TOKEN = os.getenv("NAJIKA_APP_TOKEN", "")  # eigener lokaler Token  
 
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):  
    def _auth(self):  
        return self.headers.get("Authorization","") == f"Bearer 
{APP_TOKEN}"  
 
    def _deny(self, code=401, msg="Unauthorized"):  
        self.send_response(code); self.end_headers(); 
self.wfile.write(msg.encode())  
 
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(204)  
        self.send_header("Access -Control-Allow-
Origin","http://localhost:8000")  
        self.send_header("Access -Control-Allow-
Headers","Authorization,Content -Type") 
        self.send_header("Access -Control-Allow-Methods","POST,OPTIONS")  
        self.end_headers()  
 
    def do_POST(self):  
        if self.client_address[0] not in ("127.0.0.1","::1"):  
            return self._deny(403,"Local only")  
        if not self._auth():  
            return self._deny()  
 
        ln = int(self.headers.get("Content -Length","0"))  
        data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(ln) or b"{}")  
 
        if self.path == "/api/openai":  
            r = 
requests.post("https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",  
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}", 
"Content -Type":"application/json"},  
                json=data["body"], timeout=30)  
            self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header("Content -
Type","application/json")  
            self.send_header("Access -Control-Allow-
Origin","http://localhost:8000"); self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(r.content); return  
 
        if self.path == "/api/claude":  
            r = requests.post("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages",  
                headers={"x -api-key": ANTHROPIC_KEY, "anthropic -
version":"2023 -06-01","Content -Type":"application/json"},  
                json=data["body"], timeout=30)  
            self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header("Content -
Type","application/json")  
            self.send_header("Access -Control-Allow-
Origin","http://localhost:8000"); self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(r.content); return  
 
        self._deny(404,"Not found")  
 
HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",5000), H).serve_forever()  
 
    Combined/Web -Server auf 8000 ohne API -Routen laufen lassen.  
 
    Ngrok → nur 8000. 5000 bleibt lokal.

// vor Cloud -Call: 
function sanitizeHistoryForCloud(history){  
  const redactions = [/sperma/i, /anal/i, /penis/i, /nsfw/i /* … */];  
  return history.map(m => ({...m, content: 
redactions.reduce((t,r)=>t.replace(r,"[redacted]"), m.content)}));  
} 
 
async function callGPT(message){  
  if (nsfwActive) return await callLlama(message); // hart aus  
  const safeHistory = sanitizeHistoryForCloud(conversationHistory.slice( -
5)); 
  return fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/openai",{  
    method:"POST",  
    headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json", "Authorization":"Bearer 
"+localStorage.getItem("app_token") },  
    body: JSON.stringify({  
      body:{ 
        model:"<dein -openai-modell>",  
        messages:[{role:"system", content: systemPromptClean}, 
...safeHistory, {role:"user", content: message}]  
      } 
    }) 
  }); 
}

# SCAN_NAJIKA.ps1  
param( 
  [string]$Root = "C: \NajikaCore",  
  [int]$MaxContentKB = 300  
) 
 
if (-not (Test -Path $Root)) { Write -Error "Pfad nicht gefunden: $Root"; 
exit 1 }  
 
$ts = Get -Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"  
$OutDir = Join -Path $Root "_scan \$ts" 
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutDir -Force | Out -Null 
 
function Get -Rel([string]$p){ return (Resolve -Path 
$p).Path.Replace((Resolve -Path $Root).Path,'').TrimStart(' \') } 
function Cat -Of([string]$p){  
  $rp = $p.ToLower()  
  if ($rp -match "\\config\\")       { return "config" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "\\prompts\\")  { return "prompts" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "\\js\\")       { return "js" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "\\assets\\")   { return "assets" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.html?$") { return "html" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.py$")    { return "server" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.bat$")   { return "batch" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.ps1$")   { return "ps1" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "modelfile")    { return "modelfile" }  
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.gguf$")  { return "model -binary" }  
  else { return "other" }  
} 
 
# Rollen -Mapping für „wichtige“ Dateien (damit assistant_ingest.json 
gezielt wird)  
$roleMap = @{  
  "config\najika_personality_core.json"   = "core_config"  
  "config\najika_nsfw_addon.json"         = "nsfw_addon"  
  "config\najika_personality_public.json" = "public_config"  
  "prompts \system_prompt.txt"             = "system_prompt"  
  "prompts \gpt4_prompt.txt"               = "gpt_prompt"  
  "prompts \claude_prompt.txt"             = "claude_prompt"  
  "prompts \modelfile"                     = "ollama_modelfile_sfw"  
  "prompts \modelfile_nsfw"                = "ollama_modelfile_nsfw"  
  "js\najika_ai.js"                       = "client_ai"  
  "js\nsfw_controller.js"                 = "nsfw_controller"  
  "najika_server.py"                      = "server_combined"  
  "combined_server.py"                    = "server_combined_alt"  
  "proxy_server.py"                       = "server_proxy"  
  "index_3d.html"                         = "ui_index"  
  "test_api.html"                         = "ui_test"  
} 
 
# Welche Dateitypen scannen (Inhalt nur bei Text)  
$include = 
'*.json','*.txt','*.js','*.py','*.html','*.htm','*.bat','*.ps1','Modelfil
e','Modelfile_*','*.gguf'  
$files = Get -ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File -Include $include -
ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  
 
$report = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()  
$ingest = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()  
 
foreach ($f in $files) {  
  $rel = Get -Rel $f.FullName  
  $cat = Cat -Of $f.FullName  
  $sizeKB = [math]::Round($f.Length/1KB,2)  
  $hash = (Get -FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -Path $f.FullName).Hash  
 
  $isText = $cat -in 
@('config','prompts','js','server','html','batch','ps1','modelfile')  
  $content = $null  
  $contentMode = "none"  
  if ($isText -and $sizeKB -le $MaxContentKB) {  
    try { 
      $content = Get -Content -Raw -Path $f.FullName -Encoding UTF8  
      $contentMode = "full"  
    } catch {  
      try { $content = Get -Content -Raw -Path $f.FullName; $contentMode = 
"full" } catch { $contentMode = "read_error" }  
    } 
  } elseif ($isText) {  
    # Nur Kopf+Ende bei großen Textdateien  
    try { 
      $head = (Get -Content -Path $f.FullName -TotalCount 200)  
      $tail = (Get -Content -Path $f.FullName | Select -Object -Last 200)  
      $content = (@("/*__HEAD__*/") + $head + @("/*__TAIL__*/") + $tail) 
-join "`n"  
      $contentMode = "head_tail"  
    } catch { $contentMode = "read_error" }  
  } 
 
  # JSON Kurzinfo (falls parsebar)  
  $jsonMeta = $null  
  if ($cat -eq 'config' -and $contentMode -ne 'none' -and $content) {  
    try { 
      $j = $content | ConvertFrom -Json -ErrorAction Stop  
      $jsonMeta = [ordered]@{}  
      foreach ($k in 
@('meta','personality','features','routing','settings')) {  
        if ($j.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $k) { $jsonMeta[$k] = 
$j.$k } 
      } 
    } catch { }  
  } 
 
  $item = [ordered]@{  
    path        = $f.FullName  
    rel_path    = $rel  
    category    = $cat  
    role        = ($roleMap[$rel.ToLower()] ?? ($roleMap.Where({ 
$rel.ToLower().EndsWith($_) }).Values | Select -Object -First 1))  
    size_kb     = $sizeKB  
    last_write  = $f.LastWriteTime  
    sha256      = $hash  
    content_mode= $contentMode  
  } 
  if ($jsonMeta) { $item.json_meta = $jsonMeta }  
  $report.Add($item)  
 
  # Für assistant_ingest: nur definierte Rollen ODER zentrale Kategorien  
  $isKeyRole = $item.role -ne $null  
  $isKeyCat  = $cat -in 
@('config','prompts','js','server','modelfile','html')  
  if ($isKeyRole -or $isKeyCat) {  
    $ingest.Add([ordered]@{  
      path     = $item.rel_path  
      role     = $item.role  
      category = $cat  
      size_kb  = $sizeKB  
      content  = $content  # kann $null sein bei großen/binary  
    }) 
  } 
} 
 
# Zusatz: kurze Zusammenfassung  
$summary = @{  
  root      = $Root  
  scanned   = $files.Count  
  out_dir   = $OutDir  
  generated = (Get -Date).ToString("s")  
  counts    = $report | Group -Object category | ForEach -Object {  
    @{ category = $_.Name; count = $_.Count }  
  } 
} 
 
$reportPath = Join -Path $OutDir "scan_report.json"  
$ingestPath = Join -Path $OutDir "assistant_ingest.json"  
$txtPath    = Join -Path $OutDir "scan_summary.txt"  
 
$summary | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 5 | Out -File (Join -Path $OutDir 
"summary.json") -Encoding UTF8  
$report  | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 6 | Out -File $reportPath -Encoding UTF8  
$ingest  | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 6 | Out -File $ingestPath -Encoding UTF8  
 
# Menschlich lesbare Kurzliste  
$lines = @()  
$lines += "Root: $Root"  
$lines += "Generated: " + $summary.generated  
$lines += ""  
$lines += "== Counts by category =="  
foreach ($c in $summary.counts) { $lines += ("{0, -14} {1,5}" -f 
$c.category,$c.count) }  
$lines += ""  
$lines += "== Key files =="  
foreach ($k in $report | Where -Object { $_.role } | Sort -Object role) {  
  $lines += ("[{0}] {1} ({2} KB)" -f $k.role,$k.rel_path,$k.size_kb)  
} 
$lines -join "`r`n" | Out -File $txtPath -Encoding UTF8  
 
Write-Host "✓ Fertig."  
Write-Host "Report:        $reportPath"  
Write-Host "Assistant JSON:$ingestPath"  
Write-Host "Summary:       $txtPath"

Schritt B – Lokal importieren (PowerShell)  
 
Lege diese Datei an: C: \NajikaCore \tools\IMPORT_FROM_CLAUDE.ps1 – Inhalt: 
 
param( 
  [string]$DumpFile = "C: \NajikaCore \_imports \claude_dump.txt",  
  [string]$OutDir   = "C: \NajikaCore \claude_project"  
) 
 
Write-Host "`n=== CLAUDE → LOCAL IMPORT ===`n"  
 
if (!(Test -Path $DumpFile)) { Write -Error "Dump nicht gefunden: 
$DumpFile"; exit 1 }  
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out -Null 
 
$text = Get -Content $DumpFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
$blocks = ($text -split "===FILE===") | Where -Object { $_.Trim() -ne "" } 
 
$created = 0  
foreach ($b in $blocks) {  
  # Ende finden  
  $b = $b -replace "===END=== \s*$","" 
  # PATH 
  if ($b -notmatch "PATH: \s*(.+)") { continue }  
  $path = $Matches[1].Trim()  
  # TYPE (optional)  
  if ($b -match "TYPE: \s*(.+)") { $type = $Matches[1].Trim() } else { 
$type = "unknown" }  
  # CONTENT  
  if ($b -match "----CONTENT----\s*(.*)$") { $content = $Matches[1] } 
else { $content = "" }  
 
  # Windows -sichere Pfade  
  $safePath = $path -replace "[:*?""<>|]", "_"  
  $target = Join -Path $OutDir $safePath  
  $dir = Split -Path $target -Parent 
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out -Null 
 
  # Dateiendung fallback  
  if (-not ([IO.Path]::GetExtension($target))) {  
    $ext = switch -Regex ($type) {  
      "code"         { ".txt" }  
      "doc|note"     { ".md" }  
      "config|prompt|instruction" { ".md" }  
      default        { ".txt" }  
    } 
    $target += $ext  
  } 
 
  Set-Content -Path $target -Value $content -Encoding UTF8  
  $created++  
} 
 
Write-Host "Fertig. Dateien erstellt: $created"  
Write-Host "Output: $OutDir"

$ignore = 
'(^|\\)\.git(\\|$)|(^|\\)node_modules( \\|$)|(^|\\)assets\\(video|raw)( \\|
$)|\.zip$|\.mp4$|\.mov$|\.png$|\.jpg$'

$_.FullName -notmatch $ignore }

foreach ($f in $files) {

  $dest = Join -Path $stage $rel  
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split -Path $dest) -Force | Out -Null 
  Copy-Item $f.FullName $dest -Force 
}

$manifest = @()

$manifest += "**Dateien:** " + ($files.Count)  
$manifest += ""

$manifest += "| ---:|---|" 
foreach ($f in $files | Sort -Object FullName) {  
  $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart(' \') 
  $kb  = [math]::Round($f.Length/1KB,1)  
  $manifest += "| $kb | $rel |"  
} 
$manifest -join "`n" | Set -Content (Join -Path $stage "MANIFEST.md") -
Encoding UTF8  
 
# Grobe Secret -Suche (nur Hinweis)  
$patterns = @('sk -[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}','x -api-
key','anthropic','openai','Bearer \s+[A-Za-z0-9\.\-
_]+','ngrok','auth_token','apiKey')

foreach ($p in $patterns) { $hits += Select -String -Path (Get -ChildItem 
$stage -Recurse -File).FullName -Pattern $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue 
} 
if ($hits) {  
  "Mögliche Secrets gefunden (prüfen & entfernen!):`n" + ($hits | Select -
Object Path,LineNumber,Line | Out -String) |  
    Set-Content (Join -Path $stage "REDACT_THIS.txt") -Encoding UTF8  
} 
 
# ZIP bauen  
if (Test -Path $OutZip) { Remove -Item $OutZip -Force } 
Compress -Archive -Path (Join -Path $stage '*') -DestinationPath $OutZip -
Force 
Write-Host "Fertig: $OutZip"

# Sehr große Dateien splitten (>50 MB)  
function Split -File { 
  param([string]$Path,[int]$ChunkMB=25)  
  $bufferSize=1MB; $chunkBytes=$ChunkMB*1MB  
  $fs=[IO.File]::OpenRead($Path); try{  
    $i=0 
    while($fs.Position -lt $fs.Length){  
      $out="$Path.part{0:D3}" -f $i 
      
$ofs=[IO.File]::Open($out,[IO.FileMode]::Create,[IO.FileAccess]::Write)  
      $written=0; $buf=New -Object byte[] $bufferSize  
      try{ 
        while($written -lt $chunkBytes -and $fs.Position -lt $fs.Length){  
          $read=$fs.Read($buf,0,[Math]::Min($bufferSize,$chunkBytes -
$written))  
          if($read -le 0){break}; $ofs.Write($buf,0,$read); 
$written+=$read  
        } 
      } finally {$ofs.Dispose()}  
      $i++ 
    } 
  } finally {$fs.Dispose()}  
} 
Get-ChildItem $src -Recurse -File | Where -Object Length -gt 50MB | 
ForEach-Object { Split -File $_.FullName; Remove -Item $_.FullName }  
 
# ZIP bauen  
Compress -Archive -Path "$src \*" -DestinationPath $outZip -Force

function Split -TextFile { param([string]$Path,[int]$ChunkChars=5000000)  
  $r=[IO.File]::OpenText($Path); try{  
    $i=0; while( -not $r.EndOfStream){  
      $s=$r.ReadBlock((New -Object char[] $ChunkChars),0,$ChunkChars)  
      $out="$Path.part{0:D3}.txt" -f $i; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($out,$s)  
      $i++ 
    } 
  } finally {$r.Dispose()}  
}

# Creates C: \NajikaCore \_scan\project_index.json (+ Previews wichtiger 
Dateien)  
param( 
  [string]$Root = "C: \NajikaCore",  
  [string]$OutDir = "C: \NajikaCore \_scan" 
) 
 
if (-not (Test -Path $Root)) { Write -Error "Root not found: $Root"; exit 1 
} 
if (-not (Test -Path $OutDir)) { New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path 
$OutDir | Out -Null } 
 
$files = Get -ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File -ErrorAction 
SilentlyContinue |  
  Select-Object FullName, Name, Length, LastWriteTime  
 
# kurze Inhaltsvorschau bestimmter Kern -Dateien 
$interesting = @(  
  "config\najika_personality_CORE.json",  
  "config\najika_nsfw_addon.json",  
  "prompts \system_prompt.txt",  
  "prompts \api_config.json",  
  "js\najika_ai.js",  
  "index_3d.html"  
) | ForEach -Object { Join -Path $Root $_ }  
 
$previews = @()  
foreach ($p in $interesting) {  
  if (Test -Path $p) {  
    $raw = Get -Content $p -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  
    $previews += [pscustomobject]@{  
      path = $p  
      size = ($raw ?? "").Length  
      preview = if ($raw.Length -gt 2000) { $raw.Substring(0,2000) + 
"...(truncated)" } else { $raw }  
    } 
  } 
} 
 
$result = [pscustomobject]@{  
  scanned_at = (Get -Date).ToString("yyyy -MM-dd HH:mm:ss")  
  root = $Root  
  total_files = $files.Count  
  files = $files

param( 
  [string]$Root   = "C: \NajikaCore",  
  [string]$OutDir = "C: \NajikaCore \_scan" 
) 
 
if (-not (Test -Path $Root)) { Write -Error "Root not found: $Root"; exit 1 
} 
if (-not (Test -Path $OutDir)) { New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path 
$OutDir | Out -Null } 
 
$files = Get -ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File -ErrorAction 
SilentlyContinue |  
  Select-Object FullName, Name, Length, LastWriteTime  
 
$interesting = @(  
  "config\najika_personality_CORE.json",  
  "config\najika_nsfw_addon.json",  
  "prompts \system_prompt.txt",  
  "prompts \api_config.json",  
  "js\najika_ai.js",  
  "index_3d.html"  
) | ForEach -Object { Join -Path $Root $_ }  
 
$previews = @()  
 
foreach ($p in $interesting) {  
  if (Test -Path $p) {  
    $raw = Get -Content $p -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  
    if ($null -eq $raw) { $raw = "" }  
    $previewText = if ($raw.Length -gt 2000) { $raw.Substring(0,2000) + 
"...(truncated)" } else { $raw }  
 
    $previews += [pscustomobject]@{  
      path    = $p  
      size    = $raw.Length  
      preview = $previewText  
    } 
  } 
} 
 
$result = [pscustomobject]@{  
  scanned_at  = (Get -Date).ToString("yyyy -MM-dd HH:mm:ss")  
  root        = $Root  
  total_files = $files.Count  
  files       = $files  
  previews    = $previews  
} 
 
$result | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 6 | Out -File (Join -Path $OutDir 
"project_index.json") -Encoding UTF8  
Write-Host "[OK] Scan gespeichert: $OutDir \project_index.json"

B) js/nsfw_merge.js  
 
<script>  
window.NajikaMerge = {  
  apply(text, personaCfg) {  
    try { 
      if (!personaCfg) return text;  
      const nsfwActive = !!personaCfg.nsfwActive;  
      const map = personaCfg?.nsfw?.explicit_map || {};  
      if (!nsfwActive) {  
        // Tags sauber entfernen, falls NSFW aus  
        return text.replace(/ \{\{NSFW\.[A-Z_0-9:-]+\}\}/g, '');  
      } 
      // Tags ersetzen  
      return text.replace(/ \{\{NSFW\.([A-Z_0-9:-]+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => 
map[key] || '');  
    } catch(e) { console.warn('NSFW merge fail', e); return text; }  
  } 
}; 
</script>  
 
Einbindung: einmal vor </body> in index_3d.html.

live gefüllt.

tools/PARSE_FROM_DOC.ps1  
 
param( 
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$InputFile,  
  [string]$OutDir = "C: \NajikaCore \config",  
  [string]$PersonaName = "Najika",  
  [switch]$KeepIntimateSFW  
) 
 
if (!(Test -Path $InputFile)) { Write -Error "Input not found: $InputFile"; 
exit 1 }  
$raw   = Get -Content $InputFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
$lines = $raw -split "(`r`n|`n|`r)"  
 
$nsfwMap        = @{}  
$coreLines      = New -Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]  
$intimateLines  = New -Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]  
$removedIllegal = New -Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]  
 
# Regex-Listen 
$explicitRegex = 
'(?i)\b(fick|sex|penis|schwanz|sperma|anal|deepthroat|blow \s*job|blowjob|
orgasm(us)?|ejakulat|dildo|handjob|rimm?en|69|creampie) \b' 
$intimateRegex = 
'(?i)\b(küss|kuss|küssen|verführ|reiz|intim|nah|flirt|zärtlich|berühr) \b' 
$illegalRegex  = 
'(?i)\b(minderjährig|unter \s*18|kind(er)?|teen(ager)?|schule|schülerin|sh
ota|loli|vergewaltig|rape|inzest) \b' 
 
# Altersangaben <18 → nicht übernehmen (hart raus)  
$ageLineRegex  = '(?i)^(?: \*\*?\s*)?(alter|age) \s*:\s*(\d{1,2})\b' 
 
# Durchlauf  
$counter = 0  
foreach ($line in $lines) {  
  $t = $line.Trim()  
  if ($t -eq '') { $coreLines.Add($line); continue }  
 
  # Minderjährige/echte Gewalt/Illegales raus  
  if ($t -match $illegalRegex) { $removedIllegal.Add($t); continue }  
 
  # Explizit → NSFW -Addon, im Core Platzhalter  
  if ($t -match $explicitRegex) {  
    $counter++  
    $id = ('LINE_{0}' -f $counter.ToString('0000'))  
    $nsfwMap[$id] = $t  
    $coreLines.Add("{{NSFW.$id}}")  
    continue  
  } 
 
  # Intime Andeutungen optional separat  
  if ($KeepIntimateSFW -and ($t -match $intimateRegex)) {  
    $intimateLines.Add($t)  
    $coreLines.Add($t)  
    continue  
  } 
 
  # Alterszeilen <18 definitiv entfernen; >=18 erlauben bzw. 
neutralisieren  
  if ($t -match $ageLineRegex) {  
    $age = [int]$Matches[2]  
    if ($age -lt 18) { continue }  
    $t = ($t -replace $ageLineRegex, 'Alter: 21')  
  } 
 
  $coreLines.Add($t)  
} 
 
# Objekte aufbauen  
$coreObj = [ordered]@{  
  meta = [ordered]@{  
    version   = "core -1.0" 
    type      = "Core Personality"  
    generated = (Get -Date).ToString("yyyy -MM-dd HH:mm:ss")  
  } 
  persona = [ordered]@{  
    name = $PersonaName  
    age  = "Adult (ageless time -witch)" 
  } 
  policy = [ordered]@{  
    adult_only              = $true  
    cloud_is_sfw            = $true  
    nsfw_requires_activation= $true  
    safeword                = "STOP"  
    cnc_roleplay            = "Consensual power -play only (simulated 
authority)"  
  } 
  content = ($coreLines -join "`n")  
} 
 
$nsfwObj = [ordered]@{  
  meta = [ordered]@{  
    version            = "nsfw -1.0" 
    type               = "NSFW Addon"  
    requires_activation= $true  
    consent = [ordered]@{  
      mode             = "CNC_ROLEPLAY"  
      safeword         = "STOP"  
      sticky_until_off = $true  
    } 
  } 
  explicit_map = $nsfwMap  
} 
 
if ($KeepIntimateSFW) {  
  $intimateObj = [ordered]@{  
    meta = [ordered]@{ version="intimate -1.0"; type="Intimate SFW" }  
    suggestive = $intimateLines  
  } 
} 
 
# Schreiben  
New-Item -Path $OutDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out -Null 
$corePath = Join -Path $OutDir 'najika_personality_CORE.json'  
$nsfwPath = Join -Path $OutDir 'najika_nsfw_addon.json'  
$intPath  = Join -Path $OutDir 'najika_intimate_SFW.json'  
$logPath  = Join -Path $OutDir 'parse_report.txt'  
 
$coreObj | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 50 | Set -Content -Path $corePath -
Encoding UTF8  
$nsfwObj | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 50 | Set -Content -Path $nsfwPath -
Encoding UTF8  
if ($KeepIntimateSFW) { $intimateObj | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 50 | Set -
Content -Path $intPath -Encoding UTF8 }  
 
$report = @()  
$report += "Input: $InputFile"  
$report += "Generated: $(Get -Date -Format 'yyyy -MM-dd HH:mm:ss')"  
$report += "Lines total: $($lines.Count)"  
$report += "Explicit → NSFW: $($nsfwMap.Count)"  
$report += "Removed illegal: $($removedIllegal.Count)"  
if ($KeepIntimateSFW) { $report += "Intimate SFW kept: 
$($intimateLines.Count)" }  
$report += ""  
$report += "Removed (first 20):"  
$report += ($removedIllegal | Select -Object -First 20)  
$report -join "`r`n" | Set -Content -Path $logPath -Encoding UTF8  
 
Write-Host "✓ CORE  : $corePath"  
Write-Host "✓ NSFW  : $nsfwPath"  
if ($KeepIntimateSFW) { Write -Host "✓ INT-SFW: $intPath" }  
Write-Host "✓ REPORT: $logPath"

js/nsfw_merge.js  
 
<script>  
window.NajikaMerge = {  
  apply(text, personaCfg) {  
    try { 
      if (!personaCfg) return text;  
      const nsfwActive = !!personaCfg.nsfwActive;  
      const map = personaCfg?.nsfw?.explicit_map || {};  
      if (!nsfwActive) return text.replace(/ \{\{NSFW\.[A-Z_0-9:-]+\}\}/g, 
''); 
      return text.replace(/ \{\{NSFW\.([A-Z_0-9:-]+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => 
map[key] || '');  
    } catch(e){ console.warn('NSFW merge fail', e); return text; }  
  } 
}; 
</script>  
 
Einzeilig in deiner Pipeline verwenden (nach Modellantwort):  
 
reply = window.NajikaMerge.apply(reply, this.personality);

Script: C: \NajikaCore \tools\SORT_TO_NSFW.ps1  
 
param( 
  [string]$SourceDir = "C: \NajikaCore",  
  [string]$OutDir    = "C: \NajikaCore \staging",  
  [switch]$ForceNSFW  
) 
 
Write-Host "`n=== Najika Sorter (safe) ===`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan  
 
# Ausgabestruktur (berührt Originals NICHT)  
$CoreDir = Join -Path $OutDir "core"  
$NSFWDir = Join -Path $OutDir "nsfw"  
$LogDir  = Join -Path $OutDir "logs"  
$null = New -Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 
$CoreDir,$NSFWDir,$LogDir  
 
# Regex (PowerShell 5.1 kompatibel)  
$banPattern   = 
'(?i)(minderjähr|minor|under \s*age|schüler|kind(?!lich)|inzest|incest|ver
gewaltig|rape|non[ \s-
]*consens|bestial|tiersex|real \s*person.*(sex|explicit))'  
$nsfwPattern  = 
'(?i)(nsfw|sex|fuck|fick|anal|oral|deepthroat|blowjob|cum|sperma|orgasmus
|brüste|penis|vagina|dildo|vibrator|bdsm|domina|kink)'  
 
$logRemoved   = Join -Path $LogDir "removed_banned_lines.txt"  
$logSummary   = Join -Path $LogDir "summary.txt"  
Remove-Item $logRemoved,$logSummary -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  
 
# Dateiauswahl (keine staging -Ordner erneut scannen)  
$files = Get -ChildItem -Path $SourceDir -Recurse -File -Include 
*.txt,*.md,*.json |  
         Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch ' \\staging\\' } 
 
[int]$banCount=0; [int]$nsfwCount=0; [int]$coreCount=0  
 
foreach($f in $files){  
  $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($SourceDir.Length).TrimStart(' \') 
  $relDir = Split -Path $rel  
  $coreOut = Join -Path (Join -Path $CoreDir $relDir) ($f.BaseName + 
".core.txt")  
  $nsfwOut = Join -Path (Join -Path $NSFWDir $relDir) ($f.BaseName + 
".nsfw.txt")  
  $null = New -Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split -Path 
$coreOut),(Split -Path $nsfwOut)  
 
  $coreBuf = New -Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]  
  $nsfwBuf = New -Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]  
 
  $lines = Get -Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -ErrorAction 
SilentlyContinue  
  $i = 0 
  foreach($line in $lines){  
    $i++ 
    if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)){ continue }  
 
    if($line -match $banPattern){  
      $banCount++  
      Add-Content -Path $logRemoved -Value ("[{0}] {1}:{2}  {3}" -f (Get-
Date -Format 'u'), $rel, $i, $line)  
      continue  
    } 
 
    if($ForceNSFW -or $line -match $nsfwPattern){  
      $nsfwBuf.Add($line); $nsfwCount++  
    } else {  
      $coreBuf.Add($line); $coreCount++  
    } 
  } 
 
  if($coreBuf.Count -gt 0){ $coreBuf | Out -File -FilePath $coreOut -
Encoding UTF8 }  
  if($nsfwBuf.Count -gt 0){ $nsfwBuf | Out -File -FilePath $nsfwOut -
Encoding UTF8 }  
} 
 
# Zusammenfassung  
@( 
  "=== Najika Sorter Summary ==="  
  "Source : $SourceDir"  
  "Out    : $OutDir"  
  "ForceNSFW : $($ForceNSFW.IsPresent)"  
  "Core   : $coreCount Zeilen"  
  "NSFW   : $nsfwCount Zeilen"  
  "REMOVED (banned): $banCount Zeilen"  
  "Logs:" 
  "  - $logRemoved"  
) | Out-File -FilePath $logSummary -Encoding UTF8  
 
Write-Host "Fertig. Output liegt unter: $OutDir" -ForegroundColor Green  
 
Wirkung kurz erklärt:  
 
    Originale bleiben unberührt.  
 
    Alles wird zeilenweise geprüft:  
 
        Banned ⇒ entfernt, nur in logs \removed_banned_lines.txt 
protokolliert.  
 
        NSFW ⇒ nach staging \nsfw\...*.nsfw.txt.  
 
        Rest ⇒ nach staging \core\...*.core.txt.  
 
    Mit -ForceNSFW geht alles (außer Banned) erstmal nach nsfw, damit du 
dort manuell aussortieren kannst.  
 
Wenn du willst, erweitere ich die Muster (z.B. weitere Sprachen/Begriffe)
