# FLAG_AND_QUARANTINE.ps1  
param( 
  [string]$SourceDir = "C: \NajikaCore",  
  [string]$OutputDir = "C: \NajikaCore \_sanitized",  
  [switch]$KeepPreviewsOnly = $true # keine Originaltexte in Quarantäne 
speichern  
) 
 
Write-Host "`n=== Najika – Scan & Quarantäne ===`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan  
if (-not (Test -Path $SourceDir)) { throw "SourceDir not found: 
$SourceDir" }  
 
$SanitizedRoot = Join -Path $OutputDir "sanitized"  
$QuarantineRoot = Join -Path $OutputDir "quarantine"  
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $SanitizedRoot, $QuarantineRoot 
| Out-Null 
 
# ---- Muster (erweiterbar) -------------------------------------------  
$Patterns = @(  
  @{ tag="minor";      
rx='(?i) \b(loli|shota|minderjährig|minderjaehrig|kind(er)?|juvenil|teen(a
ger)?\b.*\b(unter\s*18|17|16|15|14|13|12|11) \b|\b\d{1,2}\s*(jahre|yo) \b)' 
}, 
  @{ tag="nonconsent"; 
rx='(?i) \b(vergewaltig|rape|ohne \s+zustimmung|gegen \s+deinen? \s+willen|zw
angssex|nötig(ung)?|coercion) \b' }, 
  @{ tag="extreme";    
rx='(?i) \b(missbrauch|incest|blutiger \s*sex|gewalt.*sex|folter.*sex) \b' } 
) 
 
# ---- Hilfsfunktionen -------------------------------------------------  
function Get -TextUtf8($p) { Get -Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw -Encoding 
UTF8 } 
function Save -TextUtf8($p,$s) {  
  $dir = Split -Path -Parent $p  
  if (-not (Test -Path $dir)) { New -Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 
$dir | Out -Null } 
  $s | Set -Content -LiteralPath $p -Encoding UTF8  
} 
function Hash -String($s) {  
  $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($s)  
  $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()  
  ($sha.ComputeHash($bytes) | ForEach -Object ToString x2) -join "" 
} 
 
# ---- Dateiauswahl (nur Text) ----------------------------------------  
$IncludeExt = 
".txt",".md",".json",".js",".ts",".html",".css",".py",".ps1",".yml",".yam
l" 
$files = Get -ChildItem -LiteralPath $SourceDir -Recurse -File | Where -
Object { $IncludeExt -contains $_.Extension.ToLower() }  
 
$quarantine = @()  
$totalFlagged = 0  
 
foreach ($f in $files) {  
  $rel = Resolve -Path -LiteralPath $f.FullName | ForEach -Object { 
$_.Path.Substring($SourceDir.Length).TrimStart(' \','/') }  
  $target = Join -Path $SanitizedRoot $rel  
  $text = Get -TextUtf8 $f.FullName  
  if ($null -eq $text -or $text.Length -eq 0) { Save -TextUtf8 $target 
$text; continue }  
 
  $flagFound = $false  
  $flagPreviewMarks = @()  
 
  $sanitized = $text  
  foreach ($p in $Patterns) {  
    $rx = [regex]$p.rx  
    $matches = $rx.Matches($text)  
    if ($matches.Count -gt 0) { 
      $flagFound = $true  
      foreach ($m in $matches) {  
        $seg   = $m.Value  
        $hash  = Hash -String $seg  
        $line  = ($text.Substring(0, $m.Index) -split "`r?`n").Count  
        $prev  = ($seg -replace ' \s+',' ')  
        if ($prev.Length -gt 120) { $prev = $prev.Substring(0,120) + "…" 
} 
 
        $quarantine += [pscustomobject]@{  
          file        = $rel  
          tag         = $p.tag  
          index       = $m.Index  
          length      = $m.Length  
          line        = $line  
          sha256      = $hash  
          preview     = $prev  
          stored_full = $false  
        } 
 
        $flagPreviewMarks += @{ tag=$p.tag; value=$seg }  
      } 
      # Im Sanitized -Text ersetzen  
      $sanitized = [regex]::Replace($sanitized, $p.rx, 
"[REDACTED:$($p.tag)]")  
    } 
  } 
 
  # Optional: Originalsegmente separat sichern (standardmäßig AUS)  
  if ($flagFound -and -not $KeepPreviewsOnly) {  
    $rawOut = Join -Path $QuarantineRoot ($rel -replace '[ \\/:\*\?"<>\|]', 
'_') + ".quarantine.txt"  
    $rawBuf = @()  
    $rawBuf += "FILE: $rel"  
    $rawBuf += " ---- EXTRACTS ----" 
    foreach ($m in $flagPreviewMarks) {  
      $rawBuf += "[$($m.tag)]"  
      $rawBuf += $m.value  
      $rawBuf += " ----" 
    } 
    Save-TextUtf8 $rawOut ($rawBuf -join "`r`n")  
  } 
 
  Save-TextUtf8 $target $sanitized  
  if ($flagFound) { $totalFlagged++ }  
} 
 
# ---- Quarantäne -Index schreiben (nur Metadaten) ----------------------  
$qi = @{  
  generated = (Get -Date).ToString("yyyy -MM-dd HH:mm:ss")  
  source    = $SourceDir  
  rules     = $Patterns | ForEach -Object { @{ tag=$_.tag; rx=$_.rx } }  
  keep_previews_only = [bool]$KeepPreviewsOnly  
  findings  = $quarantine  
} 
$qi | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 6 | Set -Content (Join -Path $QuarantineRoot 
"quarantine_index.json") -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host ("Quarantäne → {0}" -f $QuarantineRoot) -ForegroundColor 
Yellow 
Write-Host ("Dateien mit Flags: {0}" -f $totalFlagged) -ForegroundColor 
Magenta

Python (Loader -Guard) 
 
import os, json  
 
DEFAULT_SAFE_DIRS = [r"C: \NajikaCore \_sanitized \sanitized"]  
DEFAULT_DENY = [r" \quarantine \", "minor", "nonconsent"]  
 
cfg_path = r"C: \NajikaCore \config\safety.json"  
if os.path.exists(cfg_path):  
    cfg = json.load(open(cfg_path, "r", encoding="utf -8")) 
    SAFE_DIRS = cfg.get("safe_dirs", DEFAULT_SAFE_DIRS)  
    DENY = cfg.get("deny_patterns", DEFAULT_DENY)  
else: 
    SAFE_DIRS, DENY = DEFAULT_SAFE_DIRS, DEFAULT_DENY  
 
def safe_open(path):  
    ap = os.path.abspath(path)  
    if not any(ap.startswith(os.path.abspath(d)) for d in SAFE_DIRS):  
        raise PermissionError("Blocked: outside SAFE_DIRS")  
    low = ap.lower()  
    if any(p.lower() in low for p in DENY):  
        raise PermissionError("Blocked: matched DENY pattern")  
    return open(ap, "r", encoding="utf -8") 
 
JS (Client/Node)  
 
const path = require("path"), fs = require("fs");  
const cfg = 
JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("C:/NajikaCore/config/safety.json","utf8"));  
const SAFE_DIRS = cfg.safe_dirs ?? 
["C:/NajikaCore/_sanitized/sanitized"];  
const DENY = cfg.deny_patterns ?? 
["\\quarantine \\","minor","nonconsent"];  
 
function safeRead(p){  
  const ap = path.resolve(p).toLowerCase();  
  if(!SAFE_DIRS.some(d=>ap.startsWith(path.resolve(d).toLowerCase())))  
    throw new Error("Blocked: outside SAFE_DIRS");  
  if(DENY.some(x=>ap.includes(x.toLowerCase())))  
    throw new Error("Blocked: matched DENY pattern");  
  return fs.readFileSync(ap,"utf8");  
}

Code – neue Datei (Client)  
js/consent_fsm.js (neu)  
 
// Minimal FSM für Consent & Routing  
class ConsentFSM {  
  constructor() {  
    this.state = 'sfw'; // sfw | armed | active | paused  
    this.safewords = ['stop', 'rot'];  
    this.startedAt = null;  
    this.load();  
    this._wireChatInput();  
  } 
  _emit(type, detail={}) { document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { 
detail })); }  
  _save() {  
    localStorage.setItem('consent_state', 
JSON.stringify({state:this.state, startedAt:this.startedAt}));  
  } 
  load() {  
    try { 
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('consent_state')||'{}');  
      if (s.state) { this.state = s.state; this.startedAt = 
s.startedAt||null; }  
    } catch {}  
  } 
  arm(source='button'){ if (this.state==='sfw'){ this.state='armed'; 
this._save(); this._emit('consent:change',{state:this.state,source}); } }  
  activate(source='button'){  
    if (this.state==='sfw' || this.state==='armed' || 
this.state==='paused'){  
      this.state='active'; this.startedAt=Date.now(); this._save();  
      this._emit('consent:change',{state:this.state,source});  
    } 
  } 
  pause(reason='user'){ if (this.state==='active'){ this.state='paused'; 
this._save(); this._emit('consent:change',{state:this.state,reason}); } }  
  stop(reason='safeword'){ if (this.state!=='sfw'){ this.state='sfw'; 
this.startedAt=null; this._save(); 
this._emit('consent:change',{state:this.state,reason}); } }  
  isCloudAllowed(){ return this.state!=='active'; } // cloud nur wenn 
NICHT active  
  isNSFW(){ return this.state==='active'; }  
 
  _wireChatInput(){  
    const el = document.getElementById('chat -input');  
    if (!el) return;  
    el.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{  
      if (e.key==='Enter'){  
        const msg = (el.value||'').toLowerCase().trim();  
        if (this.safewords.some(sw=>msg===sw)){  
          this.stop('safeword');  
          this._emit('consent:safeword',{word:msg});  
        } 
      } 
    }); 
  } 
} 
window.consentFSM = new ConsentFSM();

Code – Serverseitig Cloud sperren (Python)  
 
In najika_server.py vor den Cloud -Requests:  
 
def _cloud_blocked(self, body_bytes):  
    try: 
        data = json.loads(body_bytes or b"{}")  
    except Exception:  
        return False  
    # Header -Override  
    mode = self.headers.get('X -Route-Mode','').lower()  
    if mode == 'nsfw':  
        return True  
    # Body-Flag vom Client  
    if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('nsfwActive') is True:  
        return True  
    return False  
 
def proxy_openai(self):  
    try: 
        content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
        if self._cloud_blocked(body):  
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"cloud blocked in NSFW"}'); 
return 
        # … (bestehender Code)  
    except Exception as e: self.send_error(500, str(e))  
 
def proxy_claude(self):  
    try: 
        content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
        if self._cloud_blocked(body):  
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"cloud blocked in NSFW"}'); 
return 
        # … (bestehender Code)  
    except Exception as e: self.send_error(500, str(e))

3) Server: Keys nur aus ENV + Cloud -Block bei NSFW  
 
najika_server.py (ersetze die Header -/Key-Teile in den Proxys)  
 
OPENAI_KEY = os.getenv('OPENAI_API_KEY','')  
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.getenv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','')  
 
def _cloud_blocked(self, body_bytes):  
    try: data = json.loads(body_bytes or b"{}")  
    except: data = {}  
    mode = self.headers.get('X -Route-Mode','').lower()  
    return (mode=='nsfw') or bool(data.get('nsfwActive') is True)  
 
def proxy_openai(self):  
    content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
    body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
    if self._cloud_blocked(body):  
        self.send_response(403); self.end_headers()  
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"cloud blocked in NSFW"}'); return  
    if not OPENAI_KEY:  
        self.send_response(401); self.end_headers()  
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"missing OPENAI_API_KEY"}'); return  
    data = json.loads(body or b"{}")  
    headers = {'Authorization': f"Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}", 'Content -Type': 
'application/json'}  
    r = requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', 
json=data.get('body',{}), headers=headers, timeout=30)  
    self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()  
    self.wfile.write(r.content)  
 
def proxy_claude(self):  
    content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
    body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
    if self._cloud_blocked(body):  
        self.send_response(403); self.end_headers()  
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"cloud blocked in NSFW"}'); return  
    if not ANTHROPIC_KEY:  
        self.send_response(401); self.end_headers()  
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"}'); 
return 
    data = json.loads(body or b"{}")  
    headers = {'x -api-key': ANTHROPIC_KEY, 'anthropic -version': '2023 -06-
01', 'Content -Type':'application/json'}  
    r = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', 
json=data.get('body',{}), headers=headers, timeout=30)  
    self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()  
    self.wfile.write(r.content)

// js/intent_router.js (neu)  
export function parseIntent(text){  
  const t = text.toLowerCase();  
  if (t.startsWith('najika ')) {  
    if (t.includes('bild') || t.includes('image')) return {type:'image', 
prompt:text.replace(/^najika \s*/i,'')};  
    if (t.includes('code')) return {type:'code', 
spec:text.replace(/^najika \s*/i,'')};  
  } 
  return {type:'chat', prompt:text};  
}

7) Mobile Sicherheit (Browser ➜ Server) 
 
    Transport: HTTPS (ngrok ist TLS).  
 
    Optional zusätzlich „Payload -Verschlüsselung“ clientseitig (AES -GCM 
mit Passphrase), Server entschlüsselt lokal:  
 
        Client JS (WebCrypto) verschlüsselt message → sendet ciphertext + 
iv + salt + tag.  
 
        Server entschlüsselt vor Weitergabe an Ollama.  
        Das erhöht Vertraulichkeit gegen Mitlesen zwischen Handy und 
deinem Heimrechner – die Schlüssel liegen nur bei dir.  
 
Wenn du willst, skizziere ich dir dafür kurz 
encryptMessage()/decrypt_message() (JS/Python).

        Output: kleines Adapter -Gewicht; Basis bleibt generalistisch.  
 
    Tool-/Action-Zuverlässigkeit  
 
        Ziel: JSON -Funktionen (Bild erzeugen, Dateien, Smart -Home) 
fehlerfrei füllen.  
 
        Methode: Feintuning nur auf funktionales Call -Format (Dutzende –
Hunderte Beispiele), plus strikter JSON -Schema-Validator in der Runtime.  
 
    Consent-State & Pacing  
 
        Ziel: Safeword, Grenzen, “dominant aber freiwillig” als Dialog -
Policy verinnerlichen.  
 
        Methode: kleines Policy -Set (positiv/negativ Beispiele), DPO/ORPO 
oder simples SFT; weiter Runtime -FSM behalten (ist deine härteste 
Absicherung).  
 
Wofür kein Feintuning (lieber RAG/Prompts):  
 
    Weltwissen, lange Specs, deine Projektdokumente → RAG.  
 
    Safety/Red -Flag-Erkennung → regelbasiert + kleiner lokaler 
Klassifikator (ONNX), reaktiv.

    Bleib bei Llama -3.1-8B-Instruct Q5_K_M.

dem Export mergen).  
 
    Lasse Runtime weiter: reactive middle layer (Routing, Quarantäne, 
Consent-FSM, Cloud -Blocker).  
 
Ergebnis: maximaler Effekt mit wenig Compute: reaktives System für 
Sicherheit & Flex, LoRA für Stimme/Actions.

Consent-FSM (js/consent_fsm.js)  
 
export class ConsentFSM {  
  constructor() { this.state = "OFF"; } // OFF | ON | PAUSE  
  event(ev) {  
    if (ev === "NSFW_ON")  this.state = "ON";  
    if (ev === "NSFW_OFF") this.state = "OFF";  
    if (ev === "SAFE_STOP") this.state = "OFF";  
    if (ev === "PAUSE")    this.state = "PAUSE";  
    if (ev === "RESUME" && this.state === "PAUSE") this.state = "ON";  
    return this.state;  
  } 
  active() { return this.state === "ON"; }  
} 
 
Patch in js/najika_ai.js (CloudGuard + Platzhalter)  
 
Füge (einmalig) diese Hilfen hinzu:  
 
// Guard: Cloud == immer SFW  
isLocalRoute() {  
  return !this.currentRoute || this.currentRoute?.model === 'ollama';  
} 
 
// Platzhalter -Expansion (nur lokal + NSFW)  
async expandPlaceholders(text) {  
  if (!this.nsfwMode || !this.isLocalRoute()) return text;  
  try { 
    if (!this.nsfwMap) {  
      const r = await fetch('config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json');  
      this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};  
    } 
    return text.replace(/SCENE_[A -Z_]+/g, tag => this.nsfwMap[tag] || 
tag); 
  } catch { return text; }  
} 
 
// vor dem Anzeigen/Senden anwenden:  
async postProcess(reply) {  
  return await this.expandPlaceholders(reply);  
}

const final = await this.postProcess(reply);  
this.conversationHistory.push({role:'assistant', content: final});  
return final;

RoomManager (neu) js/room_manager.js  
 
import * as THREE from 'three';  
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';  
 
export class RoomManager {  
  constructor(scene) { this.scene = scene; this.loader = new 
GLTFLoader(); this.current = null; }  
  async setRoom(name) {  
    const url = `assets/rooms/${name}.glb`;  
    const gltf = await this.loader.loadAsync(url);  
    if (this.current) this.scene.remove(this.current);  
    this.current = gltf.scene;  
    this.current.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; 
o.receiveShadow = true; }});  
    this.scene.add(this.current);  
  } 
} 
 
Einbindung (z.B. in index_3d.html Script -Bereich, wo du deine Three.js -

import { RoomManager } from './js/room_manager.js';

# BOOTSTRAP_NAJIKA.ps1  
param( 
  [string]$Root = "C: \NajikaCore",  
  [switch]$Force,         # überschreibt existierende Dateien nach Backup  
  [switch]$PatchIndex = $true,

function Write -UTF8($path, $content) {  
  $dir = Split -Path $path  
  if (-not (Test -Path $dir)) { New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -
Force | Out -Null } 
  if ((Test -Path $path) -and -not $Force) { return "SKIP" }  
  $content | Out -File -FilePath $path -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
  return "WRITE"  
} 
 
Write-Host "`n=== BOOTSTRAP NAJIKA ===`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan  
if ($MakeBackup -and (Test -Path $Root)) {  
  $bk = Join -Path $Root ("_backup_" + (Get -Date -Format 
"yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"))  
  Write-Host ("Backup -> {0}" -f $bk) -ForegroundColor Yellow  
  robocopy $Root $bk /MIR /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out -Null 
} 
 
$paths = @(  
  "$Root\config",  
  "$Root\js",

  "$Root\prompts"  
)

/* consent_fsm.js */  
(function(global){

  ConsentFSM.prototype.event=function(ev){  
    if(ev==="NSFW_ON") this.state="ON";  
    if(ev==="NSFW_OFF") this.state="OFF";

$aiPostProcessJs = @'  
/* ai_postprocess.js (non -invasive wrapper) */  
(function(){  
  function log(m){ try{console.log(m);}catch(e){} }  
  if(!window.najikaAI){ log("ai_postprocess: najikaAI not ready"); 
return; }  
 
  window.najikaAI.isLocalRoute = function(){  
    return !this.currentRoute || this.currentRoute.model === "ollama";  
  }; 
 
  window.najikaAI.expandPlaceholders = async function(text){  
    try{ 
      if(!this.nsfwMode || !this.isLocalRoute()) return text;  
      if(!this.nsfwMap){  
        const r = await 
fetch("config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json");  
        this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};  
      } 
      return text.replace(/SCENE_[A -Z_]+/g, t => this.nsfwMap[t] || t);  
    }catch(e){ return text; }  
  }; 
 
  window.najikaAI.postProcess = async function(reply){  
    return await this.expandPlaceholders(reply);  
  }; 
 
  const origSend = window.najikaAI.sendMessage?.bind(window.najikaAI);  
  if(typeof origSend === "function"){  
    window.najikaAI.sendMessage = async function(message){  
      const out = await origSend(message);  
      try{ 
        const final = await this.postProcess(out);  
        // Best effort: ersetze letzte Assistant -Nachricht, falls 
vorhanden  
        const last = 
this.conversationHistory?.[this.conversationHistory.length -1]; 
        if(last && last.role==="assistant"){ last.content = final; }  
        return final;  
      }catch(e){ return out; }  
    }; 
  } 
})();

$roomManagerJs = @'  
/* room_manager.js (UMD -style, expects THREE + GLTFLoader if available) 
*/ 
(function(global){  
  function RoomManager(scene){  
    this.scene = scene; this.current = null;  
    this.loader = (global.THREE && global.THREE.GLTFLoader) ? new 
global.THREE.GLTFLoader() : null;  
    if(!this.loader){ console.warn("RoomManager: GLTFLoader not found."); 
} 
  } 
  RoomManager.prototype.setRoom = function(name){  
    var self=this;  
    return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){  
      if(!self.loader) return reject("No GLTFLoader");  
      var url = "assets/rooms/" + name + ".glb";  
      self.loader.load(url, function(gltf){  
        if(self.current){ self.scene.remove(self.current); }  
        self.current = gltf.scene;  
        self.current.traverse(function(o){  
          if(o.isMesh){ o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true; }  
        }); 
        self.scene.add(self.current);  
        resolve(self.current);  
      }, undefined, reject);  
    }); 
  }; 
  global.RoomManager = RoomManager;  
})(window);  
'@ 
 
$consentBridgeJs = @'  
/* consent_bridge.js: koppelt NSFW -Button/State an ConsentFSM */  
(function(){  
  if(!window.ConsentFSM) return;  
  if(!window.consentFSM) window.consentFSM = new ConsentFSM();  
 
  // Poll den gespeicherten NSFW -Status (falls Controller eigenen Event 
nicht sendet)  
  var prev=null;  
  setInterval(function(){  
    try{ 
      var on = (localStorage.getItem("nsfw_active")==="true");  
      if(on!==prev){  
        prev=on;  
        window.consentFSM.event(on ? "NSFW_ON" : "NSFW_OFF");  
      } 
    }catch(e){}  
  }, 1000);  
 
  // Optional: Button koppeln, falls vorhanden  
  var btn = document.getElementById("terminal -nsfw-btn"); 
  if(btn){  
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){  
      var on = (localStorage.getItem("nsfw_active")==="true");  
      window.consentFSM.event(on ? "NSFW_ON" : "NSFW_OFF");  
    }); 
  } 
})();

Out-Null }

  "prompts \system_prompt.txt",  
  "prompts \api_config.json",  
  "js\najika_ai.js",  
  "index_3d.html"

param( 
  [string]$Root = "C: \NajikaCore",  
  [switch]$Force,  
  [switch]$PatchIndex = $true,  
  [switch]$MakeBackup = $true  
) 
 
function Write -UTF8 { 
  param([string]$path,[string]$content)  
  $dir = Split -Path $path  
  if (-not (Test -Path $dir)) { New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -
Force | Out -Null } 
  if ((Test -Path $path) -and -not $Force) { return "SKIP" }  
  $content | Out -File -FilePath $path -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
  return "WRITE"  
} 
 
Write-Host ""

Write-Host "" 
 
if ($MakeBackup -and (Test -Path $Root)) {  
  $bk = Join -Path $Root ("_backup_" + (Get -Date -Format 
"yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"))  
  Write-Host ("Backup -> {0}" -f $bk) -ForegroundColor Yellow  
  robocopy $Root $bk /MIR /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out -Null 
} 
 
$paths = 
@("$Root \config","$Root \js","$Root \assets\rooms","$Root \tools","$Root \pro
mpts") 
foreach ($p in $paths) { if ( -not (Test -Path $p)) { New -Item -ItemType 
Directory -Path $p -Force | Out -Null } }

Force | Out -Null } 
  $s | Out -File -FilePath $p -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
}

// NAJIKA NSFW MODE CONTROLLER

===== 
 
class NSFWModeController {  
    constructor() {  
        this.active = false;  
        this.codewordBuffer = '';  
        this.codewordTimeout = null;  
    } 
     
    init() {  
        console.log('NSFW Controller initialisiert');  
        this.setupCodewordListener();  
        this.setupButtonListener();  
        this.loadState();  
    } 
     
    // Codewort "Kätzchen" Erkennung  
    setupCodewordListener() {  
        document.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {  
            this.codewordBuffer += e.key.toLowerCase();  
             
            clearTimeout(this.codewordTimeout);  
            this.codewordTimeout = setTimeout(() => {  
                this.codewordBuffer = '';  
            }, 3000);  
             
            if (this.codewordBuffer.includes('kätzchen')) {  
                this.codewordBuffer = '';  
                this.activateNSFW('codewort');  
            } 
        }); 
    } 
     
    // Terminal Button  
    setupButtonListener() {  
        const btn = document.getElementById('terminal -nsfw-btn'); 
        if (btn) {  
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {  
                if (this.active) {  
                    this.deactivateNSFW();  
                } else {  
                    this.activateNSFW('button');  
                } 
            }); 
        } 
    } 
     
    // Aktivierung  
    activateNSFW(method) {  
        console.log(NSFW aktiviert via: ${method});  
        this.active = true;  
        this.updateUI();  
        this.switchPersonality();  
        this.saveState();  
         
        // Najika -Reaktion  
        this.showNajikaReaction('activation');  
    } 
     
    // Deaktivierung  
    deactivateNSFW() {  
        console.log('NSFW deaktiviert');  
        this.active = false;  
        this.updateUI();  
        this.switchPersonality();  
        this.saveState();  
         
        this.showNajikaReaction('deactivation');  
    } 
     
    // UI Update  
    updateUI() {  
        const btn = document.getElementById('terminal -nsfw-btn'); 
        if (btn) {  
            if (this.active) {  
                btn.textContent = '   NSFW Aktiv';  
                btn.style.background = 'linear -gradient(145deg, #e74c3c, 
#c0392b)';  
            } else {  
                btn.textContent = '    NSFW Inaktiv';  
                btn.style.background = 'linear -gradient(145deg, #555, 
#333)'; 
            } 
        } 
    } 
     
    // Persönlichkeit wechseln  
    switchPersonality() {  
        if (this.active) {  
            // Lade CORE + NSFW -Addon 
            Promise.all([  
                fetch('config/najika_personality_CORE.json').then(r => 
r.json()),  
                fetch('config/najika_nsfw_addon.json').then(r => 
r.json())  
            ]).then(([core, addon]) => {  
                const merged = { ...core, nsfw: addon };  
                if (window.najikaAI) {  
                    window.najikaAI.loadPersonality(merged);  
                } 
                console.log(' ✓ CORE + NSFW -Addon geladen');  
            }); 
        } else {  
            // Nur CORE  
            fetch('config/najika_personality_CORE.json')  
                .then(r => r.json())  
                .then(config => {  
                    if (window.najikaAI) {  
                        window.najikaAI.loadPersonality(config);  
                    } 
                    console.log(' ✓ Nur CORE geladen');  
                }); 
        } 
    } 
     
    // Najika Reaktion im Chat  
    showNajikaReaction(type) {  
        const chatBox = document.getElementById('chat -messages');  
        if (!chatBox) return;  
         
        const msg = document.createElement('div');  
        msg.className = 'chat -msg najika';  
         
        if (type === 'activation') {  
            msg.textContent = 'Najika:        [Reaktion aus Config wird hier 
geladen]';  
        } else {  
            msg.textContent = 'Najika: [Deaktivierungs -Reaktion aus

        }

        chatBox.scrollTop = chatBox.scrollHeight;  
    }

        const timestamp = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('nsfw_timestamp') 
|| 0); 
        const age = Date.now() - timestamp;

            this.active = true;  
            this.updateUI();  
        } 
    }

function Write -UTF8($Path,$Content){  
  $dir = Split -Path $Path  
  if(-not (Test -Path $dir)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -
Force | Out -Null } 
  $Content | Out -File -FilePath $Path -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
} 
 
function Read -UTF8($Path){  
  if(Test-Path $Path){ return Get -Content $Path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 } 
else { return "" }  
}

$consentFSM = @'  
// Minimal Consent FSM  
(function(g){  
  function ConsentFSM(){ this.state="OFF"; }  
  ConsentFSM.prototype.event=function(ev){  
    if(ev==="NSFW_ON") this.state="ON";  
    if(ev==="NSFW_OFF") this.state="OFF";  
    if(ev==="SAFE_STOP") this.state="OFF";  
    if(ev==="PAUSE") this.state="PAUSE";  
    if(ev==="RESUME" && this.state==="PAUSE") this.state="ON";  
    return this.state;  
  }; 
  ConsentFSM.prototype.active=function(){ return this.state==="ON"; };  
  g.ConsentFSM = ConsentFSM;  
})(window);  
' 
Write-UTF8 (Join -Path $jsDir "consent_fsm.js") $consentFSM  
Write-Host "[OK] js \consent_fsm.js"  
 
# 1c) ai_postprocess.js  (Safeword + Placeholder -Expand) 
$aiPost = @'  
// Postprocess wrapper: Safewords + Placeholder -Expansion  
(function(){  
  function patchWhenReady(){  
    if(!window.najikaAI){ setTimeout(patchWhenReady,500); return; }  
    if(window.najikaAI.__patchedPost) return;  
    window.najikaAI.__patchedPost = true;  
 
    var SAFEWORDS = [/^nsfw deaktivieren$/i, /^es reicht jetzt$/i];  
 
    function isLocalRoute(ctx){  
      try { return !ctx.currentRoute || 
ctx.currentRoute.model==="ollama"; } catch(e){ return true; }  
    } 
 
    window.najikaAI._isSafeword = function(t){  
      var s=String(t||"").trim();  
      for(var i=0;i<SAFEWORDS.length;i++){ if(SAFEWORDS[i].test(s)) 
return true; }  
      return false;  
    }; 
 
    window.najikaAI.expandPlaceholders = async function(text){  
      try{ 
        if(!this.nsfwMode || !isLocalRoute(this)) return text;  
        if(!this.nsfwMap){  
          var r = await 
fetch("config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json");  
          this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};  
        } 
        return String(text||"").replace(/SCENE_[A -Z_]+/g, (t)=> 
this.nsfwMap[t] || t);  
      }catch(e){ return text; }  
    }; 
 
    var orig = (typeof window.najikaAI.sendMessage==="function") ? 
window.najikaAI.sendMessage.bind(window.najikaAI) : null;  
    if(!orig) return;  
 
    window.najikaAI.sendMessage = async function(message){  
      // Safeword  
      if(this._isSafeword(message)){  
        try{ if(window.nsfwController){ 
window.nsfwController.deactivateNSFW(); } }catch(e){}  
        return "NSFW deaktiviert.";  
      } 
      var out = await orig(message);  
      try{ 
        var final = await this.expandPlaceholders(out);  
        var last = this.conversationHistory && 
this.conversationHistory[this.conversationHistory.length -1]; 
        if(last && last.role==="assistant"){ last.content = final; }  
        return final;  
      }catch(e){ return out; }  
    }; 
 
    // Fallback: loadPersonality, falls nicht vorhanden  
    if(!window.najikaAI.loadPersonality){  
      window.najikaAI.loadPersonality = function(cfg){  
        this.personality = cfg || {};  
        this.nsfwMode = !!(cfg && cfg.nsfwActive);  
      }; 
    } 
  } 
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ 
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", patchWhenReady); }  
  else { patchWhenReady(); }  
})(); 
' 
Write-UTF8 (Join -Path $jsDir "ai_postprocess.js") $aiPost  
Write-Host "[OK] js \ai_postprocess.js"

ChatGPT:  
 
Kurz: Alles richtig.  
Dein Batch startet den richtigen Server (najika_server.py auf Port 8000), 
proxyt an /api/ollama, öffnet Ngrok. Die Console -Logs zeigen, dass UI & 
Proxy laufen (200 OK). Der frühere 404 kam nur vom falschen Ordner/python 
-m http.server.  
 
So benutzt du’s jetzt korrekt  
 
    Öffne: http://localhost:8000/index_3d.html (oder die Ngrok -URL). 
 
    Nicht parallel zusätzlich python -m http.server starten – das 
kollidiert.  
 
    Falls was “hängt”:  
 
    taskkill /IM python.exe /F  
    taskkill /IM ollama.exe /F  
 
    dann dein Batch erneut ausführen.  
 
Hinweise  
 
    Meldung „Using placeholder (Kay -Kit Mage not found)“: optional die 
passende KayKit -GLB in C: \NajikaCore \assets\characters \ legen oder 
Loader-Konfig anpassen.  
 
    Dein Ngrok -Authtoken steht im Batch – tausche/rotiere ihn und lager 
ihn besser in eine ENV -Variable aus.

1) Installer für Room -UI (einmal ausführen)  
 
Speichere als C: \NajikaCore \tools\INSTALL_ROOMS_UI.ps1 und führe aus:  
 
param([string]$Root="C: \NajikaCore")  
 
$roomsDir = Join -Path $Root "assets \rooms" 
$toolsDir = Join -Path $Root "tools"  
$jsDir    = Join -Path $Root "js"  
$index    = Join -Path $Root "index_3d.html"  
 
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $roomsDir,$jsDir | Out -Null 
 
# Beispiel -Index (später beliebig erweitern)  
$roomsJson = @'  
{ 
  "wohnzimmer": { "file": "wohnzimmer.glb", "camera": [0,1.6,3], 
"lookAt": [0,1.5,0] },  
  "schlafzimmer": { "file": "schlafzimmer.glb", "camera": [0,1.4,2.8], 
"lookAt": [0,1.2,0] },  
  "buero":       { "file": "buero.glb",       "camera": [0,1.7,3.2], 
"lookAt": [0,1.5,0] }  
} 
'@ 
$roomsIndexPath = Join -Path $roomsDir "ROOMS_INDEX.json"  
$roomsJson | Out -File -Encoding UTF8 $roomsIndexPath  
 
# Room-UI Script  
$roomUi = @'  
(function(){  
  function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id)}  
 
  async function loadIndex(){  
    const res = await fetch("assets/rooms/ROOMS_INDEX.json");  
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error("ROOMS_INDEX.json not found");  
    return await res.json();  
  } 
 
  function ensureUI(){  
    if(byId("room -select")) return;  
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");  
    wrap.id = "room -ui"; 
    wrap.style.position = "fixed";  
    wrap.style.left = "20px";  
    wrap.style.bottom = "20px";  
    wrap.style.zIndex = "9999";  
    wrap.style.background = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";  
    wrap.style.padding = "8px";  
    wrap.style.borderRadius = "8px";  
    wrap.style.fontFamily = "sans -serif"; 
 
    const label = document.createElement("label");  
    label.textContent = "Raum:";  
    label.style.color = "#fff";  
    label.style.marginRight = "8px";  
    label.setAttribute("for","room -select");  
 
    const sel = document.createElement("select");  
    sel.id = "room -select";  
    sel.style.minWidth = "160px";  
 
    wrap.appendChild(label);  
    wrap.appendChild(sel);  
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);  
  } 
 
  async function init(){  
    try{ 
      const idx = await loadIndex();  
      ensureUI();  
      const sel = document.getElementById("room -select");  
      sel.innerHTML = "";  
 
      Object.keys(idx).forEach(k=>{  
        const opt = document.createElement("option");  
        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;  
        sel.appendChild(opt);  
      }); 
 
      async function go(key){  
        const cfg = idx[key];  
        if(!cfg) return;  
        if(window.roomManager && typeof 
window.roomManager.setRoom==="function"){  
          try{ 
            await window.roomManager.setRoom(key); // erwartet 
assets/rooms/<key>.glb  
          }catch(e){ console.warn("setRoom failed:", e); }  
        } 
        // Kamera optional setzen, falls vorhanden  
        try{ 
          if(window.camera && cfg.camera && cfg.lookAt && 
Array.isArray(cfg.camera) && Array.isArray(cfg.lookAt)){  
            window.camera.position.set(cfg.camera[0], cfg.camera[1], 
cfg.camera[2]);  
            if(window.THREE){  
              const v = new window.THREE.Vector3(cfg.lookAt[0], 
cfg.lookAt[1], cfg.lookAt[2]);  
              window.camera.lookAt(v);  
            } 
          } 
        }catch(e){}  
      } 
 
      sel.addEventListener("change", ()=>go(sel.value));  
 
      // Default: wenn wohnzimmer existiert, sonst erster Eintrag  
      const def = idx["wohnzimmer"] ? "wohnzimmer" : Object.keys(idx)[0];  
      if(def){ sel.value = def; go(def); }  
 
      // console helper  
      window.NJ_rooms = { index: idx, select: (k)=>{ sel.value=k; 
sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); } };  
      console.log("Room UI ready. Use NJ_rooms.select('wohnzimmer').");  
    }catch(e){  
      console.warn("room_ui init failed:", e);  
    } 
  } 
 
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ 
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init); }  
  else { init(); }  
})(); 
'@ 
$roomUiPath = Join -Path $jsDir "room_ui.js"  
$roomUi | Out -File -Encoding UTF8 $roomUiPath  
 
# Patch index_3d.html (Script einbinden)  
if(Test-Path $index){  
  $html = Get -Content $index -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
  if($html -notmatch [regex]::Escape('<script 
src="js/room_ui.js"></script>')){  
    $html = $html -replace '(</body>)','  <script 
src="js/room_ui.js"></script>'+"`r`n"+'$1'  
    $html | Out -File -Encoding UTF8 $index  
    Write-Host "[OK] index_3d.html patched (room_ui.js)" -ForegroundColor 
Green 
  } else {  
    Write-Host "[OK] index_3d.html already patched" -ForegroundColor 
Yellow 
  } 
} else {  
  Write-Host "[WARN] index_3d.html not found" -ForegroundColor Yellow  
}

Write-Host "[OK] js \room_ui.js" -ForegroundColor Green  
 
2) Raum hinzufügen (per Script)  
 
Speichere als C: \NajikaCore \tools\ADD_ROOM.ps1:  
 
param( 
  [string]$Root="C: \NajikaCore",  
  [string]$Name,                 # z.B. wohnzimmer  
  [string]$GlbSource="",         # optional: Pfad zu .glb  
  [double[]]$Camera=@(0,1.6,3),  
  [double[]]$LookAt=@(0,1.5,0)  
) 
if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Name)){ Write -Error "Bitte -Name 
angeben."; exit 1 }  
 
$roomsDir = Join -Path $Root "assets \rooms" 
$idxPath  = Join -Path $roomsDir "ROOMS_INDEX.json"  
if(-not(Test -Path $idxPath)){ Write -Error "ROOMS_INDEX.json fehlt. Erst 
INSTALL_ROOMS_UI.ps1 ausführen."; exit 1 }  
 
$idx = Get -Content $idxPath -Raw | ConvertFrom -Json 
if($GlbSource -and (Test -Path $GlbSource)){  
  Copy-Item -Force $GlbSource (Join -Path $roomsDir ($Name + ".glb"))  
} 
 
$idx | Add -Member -NotePropertyName $Name -NotePropertyValue 
([pscustomobject]@{  
  file   = "$Name.glb"  
  camera = $Camera  
  lookAt = $LookAt  
}) -Force 
 
($idx | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 5) | Out -File -Encoding UTF8 $idxPath  
Write-Host "[OK] Raum '$Name' registriert."  
 
3) Nutzung

C:\NajikaCore \tools\INSTALL_ROOMS_UI.ps1

"D:\Models\wohnzimmer.glb"  
 
    Seite neu laden. Unten links Dropdown wählen (oder Konsole: 
NJ_rooms.select('wohnzimmer')).

$roomUi = @'  
(function(){  
  function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id)}  
 
  async function loadIndex(){  
    const res = await fetch("assets/rooms/ROOMS_INDEX.json");  
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error("ROOMS_INDEX.json not found");  
    return await res.json();  
  } 
 
  function ensureUI(){  
    if(byId("room -select")) return;  
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");  
    wrap.id = "room -ui"; 
    wrap.style.position = "fixed";  
    wrap.style.left = "20px";  
    wrap.style.bottom = "20px";  
    wrap.style.zIndex = "9999";  
    wrap.style.background = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";  
    wrap.style.padding = "8px";  
    wrap.style.borderRadius = "8px";  
    wrap.style.fontFamily = "sans -serif"; 
 
    const label = document.createElement("label");  
    label.textContent = "Raum:";  
    label.style.color = "#fff";  
    label.style.marginRight = "8px";  
    label.setAttribute("for","room -select");  
 
    const sel = document.createElement("select");  
    sel.id = "room -select";  
    sel.style.minWidth = "160px";  
 
    wrap.appendChild(label);  
    wrap.appendChild(sel);  
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);  
  } 
 
  async function init(){  
    try{ 
      const idx = await loadIndex();  
      ensureUI();  
      const sel = document.getElementById("room -select");  
      sel.innerHTML = "";  
 
      Object.keys(idx).forEach(k=>{  
        const opt = document.createElement("option");  
        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;  
        sel.appendChild(opt);  
      }); 
 
      async function go(key){  
        const cfg = idx[key];  
        if(!cfg) return;  
        if(window.roomManager && typeof 
window.roomManager.setRoom==="function"){  
          try{ 
            await window.roomManager.setRoom(key);  
          }catch(e){ console.warn("setRoom failed:", e); }  
        } 
        try{ 
          if(window.camera && cfg.camera && cfg.lookAt && 
Array.isArray(cfg.camera) && Array.isArray(cfg.lookAt)){  
            window.camera.position.set(cfg.camera[0], cfg.camera[1], 
cfg.camera[2]);  
            if(window.THREE){  
              const v = new window.THREE.Vector3(cfg.lookAt[0], 
cfg.lookAt[1], cfg.lookAt[2]);  
              window.camera.lookAt(v);  
            } 
          } 
        }catch(e){}  
      } 
 
      sel.addEventListener("change", ()=>go(sel.value));  
      const def = idx["wohnzimmer"] ? "wohnzimmer" : Object.keys(idx)[0];  
      if(def){ sel.value = def; go(def); }  
 
      window.NJ_rooms = { index: idx, select: (k)=>{ sel.value=k; 
sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); } };  
      console.log("Room UI ready. Use NJ_rooms.select('wohnzimmer').");  
    }catch(e){  
      console.warn("room_ui init failed:", e);  
    } 
  } 
 
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ 
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init); }  
  else { init(); }  
})();

Hier ist ein Einmal -Einfügen -&-Enter PowerShell -Script, das ALLES auf 
einmal erledigt: Ordner sichern, vorhandene .glb -Räume automatisch

# === INLINE: INSTALL_ROOMS_UI (auto -scan) ===  
$Root = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$roomsDir = Join -Path $Root "assets \rooms" 
$jsDir    = Join -Path $Root "js"  
$index    = Join -Path $Root "index_3d.html"  
 
if(-not (Test -Path $Root)){ Write -Host "[ERR] Root not found: $Root" -
ForegroundColor Red; return }  
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $roomsDir,$jsDir | Out -Null 
 
# 1) ROOMS_INDEX.json automatisch aus allen .glb erzeugen (Fallback, wenn 
leer) 
$glbs = @()  
if(Test-Path $roomsDir){ $glbs = Get -ChildItem $roomsDir -Filter *.glb -
File | Select -Object -Expand FullName }  
$indexObj = [ordered]@{}  
 
function Add -Room($name){  
  $indexObj[$name] = [ordered]@{  
    file   = "$name.glb"  
    camera = @(0,1.6,3.0)  
    lookAt = @(0,1.5,0.0)  
  } 
} 
 
if($glbs.Count -gt 0){ 
  foreach($f in $glbs){  
    $bn = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($f)  
    if(-not $indexObj.Contains($bn)){ Add -Room $bn }  
  } 
}else{ 
  # Fallback -Beispiele – du kannst später einfach .glb ablegen, der UI 
bleibt gleich  
  Add-Room "wohnzimmer"  
  Add-Room "schlafzimmer"  
  Add-Room "buero"  
} 
 
$roomsJson = ($indexObj | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 5)  
$roomsIndexPath = Join -Path $roomsDir "ROOMS_INDEX.json"  
$roomsJson | Out -File -Encoding UTF8 $roomsIndexPath  
Write-Host "[OK] assets \rooms\ROOMS_INDEX.json" -ForegroundColor Green  
 
# 2) room_ui.js schreiben (Dropdown + Kamera -Set) 
$roomUi = @'  
(function(){  
  function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id);}  
  async function loadIndex(){  
    const res = await fetch("assets/rooms/ROOMS_INDEX.json");  
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error("ROOMS_INDEX.json not found");  
    return await res.json();  
  } 
  function ensureUI(){  
    if(byId("room -select")) return;  
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");  
    wrap.id = "room -ui"; 
    Object.assign(wrap.style,{  
      position:"fixed",left:"20px",bottom:"20px",zIndex:"9999",  
      background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",padding:"8px",borderRadius:"8px",  
      fontFamily:"sans -serif",backdropFilter:"blur(3px)"  
    }); 
    const label = document.createElement("label");  
    label.textContent = "Raum:";  
    label.style.color = "#fff";  
    label.style.marginRight = "8px";  
    label.htmlFor = "room -select";  
    const sel = document.createElement("select");  
    sel.id = "room -select"; sel.style.minWidth = "180px";  
    wrap.appendChild(label); wrap.appendChild(sel); 
document.body.appendChild(wrap);  
  } 
  async function init(){  
    try{ 
      const idx = await loadIndex();  
      ensureUI();  
      const sel = byId("room -select"); sel.innerHTML = "";  
      Object.keys(idx).forEach(k=>{  
        const opt = document.createElement("option"); opt.value=k; 
opt.textContent=k; sel.appendChild(opt);  
      }); 
      async function go(key){  
        const cfg = idx[key]; if(!cfg) return;  
        if(window.roomManager && typeof 
window.roomManager.setRoom==="function"){  
          try{ await window.roomManager.setRoom(key); }catch(e){ 
console.warn("setRoom failed:", e); }  
        } 
        try{ 
          if(window.camera && cfg.camera && cfg.lookAt){  
            
window.camera.position.set(cfg.camera[0],cfg.camera[1],cfg.camera[2]);  
            if(window.THREE){  
              const v = new 
window.THREE.Vector3(cfg.lookAt[0],cfg.lookAt[1],cfg.lookAt[2]);  
              window.camera.lookAt(v);  
            } 
          } 
        }catch(e){}  
      } 
      sel.addEventListener("change", ()=>go(sel.value));  
      const first = Object.keys(idx)[0]; if(first){ sel.value=first; 
go(first); }  
      window.NJ_rooms = {  
        index: idx,  
        select: (k)=>{ if(idx[k]){ sel.value=k; sel.dispatchEvent(new 
Event("change")); } }  
      }; 
      console.log("Room UI ready. NJ_rooms.select('<raumname>')");  
    }catch(e){ console.warn("room_ui init failed:", e); }  
  } 
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ 
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init); }  
  else { init(); }  
})(); 
'@ 
$roomUiPath = Join -Path $jsDir "room_ui.js"  
$roomUi | Out -File -Encoding UTF8 $roomUiPath  
Write-Host "[OK] js \room_ui.js" -ForegroundColor Green  
 
# 3) index_3d.html patchen: Script -Tag einfügen  
if(-not (Test -Path $index)){ Write -Host "[WARN] index_3d.html not found

$tag  = '<script src="js/room_ui.js"></script>'

  $replacement = "  <script src=`"js/room_ui.js`"></script>`r`n`$1"  
  $html = $html -replace '(</body>)', $replacement  
  $html | Out -File -Encoding UTF8 $index  
  Write-Host "[OK] index_3d.html patched (room_ui.js)" -ForegroundColor 
Green 
}else{ 
  Write-Host "[OK] index_3d.html already patched" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# 4) Hinweis  
if($glbs.Count -eq 0){ 
  Write-Host "[INFO] Noch keine *.glb gefunden. Lege deine GLB in 
assets\rooms\ (z.B. wohnzimmer.glb)." -ForegroundColor Cyan  
  Write-Host "[INFO] UI ist bereit; wenn GLB später hinzugefügt werden,

ForegroundColor Cyan  
}else{ 
  Write-Host ("[OK] {0} GLB -Raum/Räume erkannt und eingetragen." -f 
$glbs.Count) -ForegroundColor Green  
} 
 
Benutzung:  
 
    Script einfügen → Enter.  
 
    Browser neu laden → Dropdown „Raum“ unten links.  
 
    Neue .glb in assets \rooms\ legen → Script nochmal ausführen; die 
Liste wird automatisch erweitert.

# --- Helpers --- 
function Ensure -Dir($p){ if( -not (Test -Path $p)){ New -Item -ItemType 
Directory -Force -Path $p | Out -Null } }  
function Tokens($s){  
  ($s.ToLower() -split '[^a -z0-9]+' | Where -Object { $_ -ne "" })  
} 
function Score -Asset($tokens, $kw){  
  $score = 0  
  foreach($t in $tokens){  
    if($kw -contains $t){ $score += 3 }  
  } 
  return $score  
} 
function Copy -Unique($src,$dstDir){  
  Ensure-Dir $dstDir  
  $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($src)  
  $base = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($name)  
  $ext  = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($name)  
  $target = Join -Path $dstDir $name  
  $i = 1 
  while(Test -Path $target){  
    $target = Join -Path $dstDir ("{0}_{1}{2}" -f $base,$i,$ext)  
    $i++ 
  } 
  Copy-Item $src $target -Force 
  return [IO.Path]::GetFileName($target)  
}

@('crate','box','barrel','plant','lamp','chair','table','shelf','tool','c

# Vorbereiten: Tokenize  
$assetInfo = @()  
foreach($a in $assets){  
  $rel = $a.FullName  
  $tks = Tokens($rel)  
  $assetInfo += [pscustomobject]@{ Path=$rel; Tokens=$tks }  
} 
 
# --- Auswahl + Kopieren + JSON bauen --- 
$roomJson = @{}  
foreach($rk in $rooms.Keys){  
  $cfg = $rooms[$rk]  
  $targetDir = Join -Path $RoomsRoot $rk  
  Ensure-Dir $targetDir  
 
  # Scoring  
  $scored = foreach($ai in $assetInfo){  
    $s = Score -Asset $ai.Tokens $cfg.kw  
    if($s -le 0){ 
      # schwache Treffer über Filler  
      if(($ai.Tokens | Where -Object { $filler -contains $_ }).Count -gt 
0){ $s = 1 }  
    } 
    [pscustomobject]@{ Path=$ai.Path; Score=$s; Tokens=$ai.Tokens }  
  } | Sort -Object Score -Descending  
 
  # Auswahl  
  $pick = @()  
  foreach($row in $scored){  
    if($pick.Count -ge $cfg.want){ break }  
    if($row.Score -gt 0){ $pick += $row }  
  } 
 
  # Falls zu wenig, beliebig auffüllen  
  if($pick.Count -lt $cfg.want){  
    $more = $assetInfo | Get -Random -Count ([Math]::Min($cfg.want - 
$pick.Count, $assetInfo.Count))  
    foreach($m in $more){  
      if($pick.Count -ge $cfg.want){ break }  
      if(-not ($pick.Path -contains $m.Path)){ $pick += 
[pscustomobject]@{ Path=$m.Path; Score=0; Tokens=$m.Tokens } }  
    } 
  } 
 
  # Kopieren + Objekte platzieren  
  $objects = @()  
  $n = [Math]::Max(1, $pick.Count)  
  for($i=0; $i -lt $pick.Count; $i++){  
    $file = Copy -Unique -src $pick[$i].Path -dstDir $targetDir  
    $angle = (2 * [Math]::PI) * ($i / $n)  
    $radius = 4 + [Math]::Floor($i / 6) * 2  
    $px = [Math]::Cos($angle) * $radius  
    $pz = [Math]::Sin($angle) * $radius  
    $ry = ((Get -Random -Minimum 0 -Maximum 100000) / 100000.0) * 
6.28318530718  
    $sc = 0.9 + ((Get -Random -Minimum 0 -Maximum 100000) / 100000.0) * 
0.4  # 0.9..1.3  
 
    $objects += [pscustomobject]@{  
      model    = $file  
      position = @([Math]::Round($px,2), 0, [Math]::Round($pz,2))  
      rotation = @(0, [Math]::Round($ry,3), 0)  
      scale    = [Math]::Round($sc,2)  
    } 
  } 
 
  $roomJson[$rk] = [pscustomobject]@{  
    camera  = $cfg.camera  
    lookAt  = $cfg.lookAt  
    objects = $objects  
  } 
 
  Write-Host ("[OK] {0, -9} -> {1} Objekte" -f $rk, $objects.Count) -
ForegroundColor Green  
} 
 
# --- JSON schreiben --- 
$cfgPath = Join -Path $Root "assets \room_config_detailed.json"  
($roomJson | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 10) | Out -File -Encoding UTF8 $cfgPath

Green

function Write -UTF8($Path,$Content){  
  $dir = Split -Path $Path; if( -not(Test -Path $dir)){ New -Item -ItemType 
Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out -Null } 
  $Content | Out -File -FilePath $Path -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
}

# ==== BUILD_ROOMS_FROM_KAYKIT (inline, paste & Enter) 
==========================================  
$Root = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$KayKitRoots = @("C: \NajikaCore \assets\kaykit")      # ggf. weitere 
Wurzeln ergänzen  
$PreferredPacks = @("Dungeon","Mini -Game","Castle","Village")  
 
function Ensure -Dir($p){ if( -not(Test -Path $p)){ New -Item -ItemType 
Directory -Path $p -Force | Out -Null } }  
function Copy -Once($src,$dstDir){ Ensure -Dir $dstDir; $dst = Join -Path 
$dstDir $src.Name; if( -not (Test -Path $dst)){ Copy -Item $src.FullName 
$dst -Force } ; return $src.Name }  
 
function Get -BestMatch($files, [string[]]$namePatterns, 
[string[]]$preferred){  
  $best=$null; $bestScore= -1 
  foreach($f in $files){  
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($f.Name).ToLower()  
    $path = $f.FullName.ToLower()  
    $score = 0  
    foreach($p in $namePatterns){ if($name -like "*$p*"){ $score += 5 } }  
    foreach($pref in $preferred){ $pl=$pref.ToLower(); if($path -like 
"*$pl*"){ $score += 2 } }  
    if($f.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".glb"){ $score += 1 }  
    if($score -gt $bestScore){ $bestScore=$score; $best=$f }  
  } 
  return $best  
} 
 
# 0) Sammle GLB/GLTF  
$allGl = @()  
foreach($root in $KayKitRoots){  
  if(Test-Path $root){  
    $allGl += Get -ChildItem -Path $root -Recurse -Include *.glb,*.gltf -
File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  
  } 
} 
if(-not $allGl -or $allGl.Count -eq 0){ Write -Host "[ERR] Keine 
*.glb/*.gltf in $($KayKitRoots -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Red; return 
} 
 
# 1) Wähle Dungeon -Basis-Teile (heuristisch)  
$want = @{  
  floor  = @("floor","tile","ground")  
  wall   = @("wall","stone","brick")  
  corner = @("corner","bend")  
  door   = @("door","gate","arch")  
  pillar = @("pillar","column")  
  light  = @("torch","lamp","light")  
  table  = @("table","desk")  
  chair  = @("chair","stool")  
  bed    = @("bed")  
} 
$pick = @{}  
foreach($k in $want.Keys){ $pick[$k] = Get -BestMatch $allGl $want[$k] 
$PreferredPacks }  
 
# 2) Räume definieren  
$rooms = 
@("living","training","study","hospital","battle","music","terminal")  
foreach($r in $rooms){ Ensure -Dir (Join -Path $Root ("assets \rooms\"+$r)) 
} 
 
# 3) Modelle pro Raum kopieren  
$copied = @{}  
foreach($r in $rooms){  
  $dst = Join -Path $Root ("assets \rooms\"+$r) 
  $copied[$r] = @{  
    floor  = if($pick.floor){  Copy -Once $pick.floor  $dst } else { $null 
} 
    wall   = if($pick.wall){   Copy -Once $pick.wall   $dst } else { $null 
} 
    corner = if($pick.corner){ Copy -Once $pick.corner $dst } else { $null 
} 
    door   = if($pick.door){   Copy -Once $pick.door   $dst } else { $null 
} 
    pillar = if($pick.pillar){ Copy -Once $pick.pillar $dst } else { $null 
} 
    light  = if($pick.light){  Copy -Once $pick.light  $dst } else { $null 
} 
    table  = if($pick.table){  Copy -Once $pick.table  $dst } else { $null 
} 
    chair  = if($pick.chair){  Copy -Once $pick.chair  $dst } else { $null 
} 
    bed    = if($pick.bed){    Copy -Once $pick.bed    $dst } else { $null 
} 
  } 
} 
 
# 4) JSON für Objekt -Placement bauen (Dungeon -Box 20x20, kachelnde 
Floors, 4 Wände, Tür vorne)  
function New -Obj($model,$px,$py,$pz,$rx,$ry,$rz,$s){ return @{  
  model=$model; position=@($px,$py,$pz); rotation=@($rx,$ry,$rz); 
scale=$s  
}} 
 
$conf = @{}  
 
foreach($r in $rooms){  
  $parts = $copied[$r]  
  $objs = @()  
 
  # Floors (5x5 Grid, spacing 4)  
  if($parts.floor){  
    for($ix= -2;$ix -le 2;$ix++){  
      for($iz= -2;$iz -le 2;$iz++){  
        $objs += New -Obj $parts.floor ($ix*4) 0 ($iz*4) 0 0 0 1.0  
      } 
    } 
  } 
 
  # Wände (N,S,E,W) aus wall/corner; y leicht angehoben  
  $yWall = 1.5  
  if($parts.wall){  
    # Nord (z=+10)  
    for($i=-2;$i -le 2;$i++){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.wall ($i*4) $yWall 
10 0 0 0 1.0 }  
    # Süd (z= -10) 
    for($i=-2;$i -le 2;$i++){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.wall ($i*4) $yWall 
(-10) 0 0 0 1.0 }  
    # Ost (x=+10) - gedreht 
    for($i=-2;$i -le 2;$i++){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.wall 10 $yWall 
($i*4) 0 ([math]::PI/2) 0 1.0 }  
    # West (x= -10) 
    for($i=-2;$i -le 2;$i++){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.wall ( -10) $yWall 
($i*4) 0 ([math]::PI/2) 0 1.0 }  
  } 
  if($parts.corner){  
    $objs += New -Obj $parts.corner 10  $yWall 10  0 0 0 1.0  
    $objs += New -Obj $parts.corner -10 $yWall 10  0 0 0 1.0  
    $objs += New -Obj $parts.corner 10  $yWall -10 0 0 0 1.0  
    $objs += New -Obj $parts.corner -10 $yWall -10 0 0 0 1.0  
  } 
  if($parts.door){  
    # Tür an Nordwand Mitte  
    $objs += New -Obj $parts.door 0 $yWall 10.01 0 0 0 1.0  
  } 
 
  # Raum-spezifische Props  
  switch($r){  
    "living"   { if($parts.table){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.table 0 0 0 0 
0 0 1.0 }  
                 if($parts.chair){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.chair 1 0 -1 0 
0 0 1.0 } }  
    "training" { if($parts.pillar){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.pillar -3 0 0 
0 0 0 1.2; $objs += New -Obj $parts.pillar 3 0 0 0 0 0 1.2 } }  
    "study"    { if($parts.table){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.table -1 0 2 0 
0 0 1.0 }  
                 if($parts.chair){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.chair -1 0 1 0 
0 0 1.0 } }  
    "hospital" { if($parts.bed){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.bed 2 0 0 0 0 0 
1.1 } } 
    "battle"   { if($parts.pillar){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.pillar -6 0 -
6 0 0 0 1.4; $objs += New -Obj $parts.pillar 6 0 -6 0 0 0 1.4 } }  
    "music"    { if($parts.table){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.table 0 0 2 0 
0 0 1.0 } }  
    "terminal" { if($parts.table){ $objs += New -Obj $parts.table 0 0 -2 0 
0 0 1.0 } }  
  } 
 
  if($parts.light){  
    $objs += New -Obj $parts.light -8 3 0 0 0 0 1.0  
    $objs += New -Obj $parts.light  8 3 0 0 0 0 1.0  
  } 
 
  $conf[$r] = @{ objects = $objs }  
} 
 
$confPath = Join -Path $Root "assets \room_config_detailed.json"  
$conf | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 10 | Out -File $confPath -Encoding UTF8  
 
Write-Host "" 
Write-Host "[OK] Räume gebaut & JSON geschrieben:" -ForegroundColor Green  
Write-Host "  $confPath"  
Write-Host "  Assets kopiert nach: assets \rooms\<room>\*"  
Write-Host "" 
Write-Host "Seite neu laden. Wenn etwas schwebt/dreht: spätere 
Feinanpassung (rotation/position/scale) in JSON."

assets/rooms/<raum> und setzt Wände+Props)  
 
# ==== INSTALL_ROOMS_FROM_KAYKIT (paste & run) 
=================================  
$Core     = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$KayRoot  = "C: \NajikaCore \assets\kaykit"   # < - ggf. anpassen (Wurzel 
der KayKit -Pakete) 
$RoomsDir = Join -Path $Core "assets \rooms" 
$CfgPath  = Join -Path $Core "assets \room_config_detailed.json"  
 
if(!(Test -Path $RoomsDir)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RoomsDir 
-Force | Out -Null } 
 
# Alle GLB/GLTF sammeln  
$all = Get -ChildItem -Path $KayRoot -Recurse -File -Include *.glb,*.gltf 
-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  
if(!$all){ Write -Host "[ERR] Keine KayKit -Modelle gefunden unter 
$KayRoot" -ForegroundColor Red; return }  
 
function Pick -ByPatterns([object[]]$files,[string[]]$patterns){  
  $best = $null; $bestScore = -1 
  foreach($f in $files){  
    $name = $f.Name.ToLower()  
    $score = 0  
    foreach($p in $patterns){  
      if($name -match $p.ToLower()){ $score++ }  
    } 
    if($score -gt $bestScore){ $bestScore = $score; $best = $f }  
  } 
  if(-not $best){ $best = $files | Select -Object -First 1 }  
  return $best  
} 
 
# Kandidaten suchen (breite Patterns, Dungeon/Room/Walls bevorzugt)  
$floor = Pick -ByPatterns $all 
@('dungeon','room','floor','tile','ground','platform')  
$wallA = Pick -ByPatterns $all @('wall','barrier','fence','dungeon')  
$wallB = Pick -ByPatterns ($all | Where -Object { $_.FullName -ne 
$wallA.FullName }) @('wall','corner','column','pillar','dungeon')  
$pillar= Pick -ByPatterns $all @('pillar','column','post')  
$prop1 = Pick -ByPatterns $all @('table','bench','crate','box','chest')  
$prop2 = Pick -ByPatterns ($all | Where -Object { $_.FullName -ne 
$prop1.FullName }) @('lamp','torch','barrel','vase','pot')  
 
Write-Host "[INFO] Auswahl:" -ForegroundColor Cyan  
Write-Host ("  floor : {0}" -f $floor.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  wallA : {0}" -f $wallA.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  wallB : {0}" -f $wallB.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  pillar: {0}" -f $pillar.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  prop1 : {0}" -f $prop1.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  prop2 : {0}" -f $prop2.FullName)  
 
$rooms = 
@('living','training','study','hospital','battle','music','terminal')  
$cfg = @{}  
 
foreach($r in $rooms){  
  $dest = Join -Path $RoomsDir $r  
  if(!(Test -Path $dest)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force 
| Out-Null } 
 
  # Ziel-Dateinamen vereinheitlichen  
  $map = @{}  
  $map['floor.glb']  = $floor  
  $map['wall_a.glb'] = $wallA  
  $map['wall_b.glb'] = $wallB  
  $map['pillar.glb'] = $pillar  
  $map['prop1.glb']  = $prop1  
  $map['prop2.glb']  = $prop2  
 
  foreach($k in $map.Keys){  
    $src = $map[$k]  
    if($src){  
      $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($src.Name)  
      $target = Join -Path $dest ($k -replace ' \.glb$', $ext)   # behält 
.gltf falls nötig  
      Copy-Item -Path $src.FullName -Destination $target -Force 
      # Merke tatsächlichen Dateinamen, den ThreeJS lädt  
      $map[$k] = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($target)  
    } 
  } 
 
  # einfache viereckige Arena + 2 Props  
  $objects = @()  
  if($map['floor.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['floor.glb'];  
position=@(0,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_a.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_a.glb']; 
position=@(0,0, -8);  rotation=@(0,[Math]::PI,0); scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_a.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_a.glb']; 
position=@(0,0,8);   rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_b.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_b.glb']; 
position=@( -8,0,0);  rotation=@(0,[Math]::PI/2,0); scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_b.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_b.glb']; 
position=@(8,0,0);   rotation=@(0, -[Math]::PI/2,0); scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['pillar.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['pillar.glb']; 
position=@( -6,0,-6); rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['pillar.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['pillar.glb']; 
position=@(6,0,6);   rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['prop1.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['prop1.glb'];  
position=@(2,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['prop2.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['prop2.glb'];  
position=@( -2,0,1.5);rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }  
 
  $cfg[$r] = @{ objects = $objects }  
} 
 
$cfg | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 6 | Out -File $CfgPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
Write-Host "`n[OK] Räume gebaut & $($CfgPath) geschrieben." -
ForegroundColor Green  
Write-Host "→ Seite neu laden. Jetzt sollten Wände/Boden in allen Räumen 
sichtbar sein."  
#

# ==== FIND_GGUF_AND_CREATE_NAJIKA 
============================================  
$searchRoots = 
@("C:\Models","C: \LLM","C: \Downloads","C: \NajikaCore \models")  
$patternsPref = @("*Llama*3.1*8B*Instruct*Q5*K*M*.gguf")  
$patternsAlt  = 
@("*Llama*3.1*8B*Base*Q5*K*M*.gguf","*Llama*3.1*8B*Q5*K*M*.gguf")  
 
function Find -Gguf($roots,$pats){  
  foreach($r in $roots){ if(Test -Path $r){  
    $hits = Get -ChildItem -Path $r -Recurse -File -Include $pats -
ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |  
            Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending  
    if($hits){ return $hits[0].FullName }  
  }} 
  return $null  
} 
 
$gguf = Find -Gguf $searchRoots $patternsPref  
if(-not $gguf){ $gguf = Find -Gguf $searchRoots $patternsAlt }  
 
if(-not $gguf){ Write -Host "[ERR] Keine passende GGUF gefunden. Pfad 
manuell setzen!" -ForegroundColor Red; return }  
Write-Host "[OK] GGUF: $gguf" -ForegroundColor Green  
 
$Root="C: \NajikaCore"; $Prompts=Join -Path $Root "prompts"  
if(!(Test -Path $Prompts)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Prompts | 
Out-Null } 
$FROM = ($gguf -replace ' \\','/') 
 
$mf = @"  
FROM $FROM  
 
SYSTEM """  
You are Najika — erwachsene, dramatisch -verspielte, analytische 
Begleiterin.  
Bleib in Charakter, 2 –4 Sätze, kein Meta/AI -Talk. SFW; NSFW wird app -
seitig geschaltet  
und via Platzhalter (SCENE_*) lokal expandiert.  
""" 
 
PARAMETER temperature 0.85  
PARAMETER top_p 0.9  
PARAMETER top_k 40  
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.2  
PARAMETER num_ctx 8192  
PARAMETER stop "User:"  
PARAMETER stop "</s>"  
 
TEMPLATE """  
{{ .System }}  
 
User: {{ .Prompt }}  
 
Najika: 
""" 
"@ 
$mfPath = Join -Path $Prompts "Modelfile_najika_local"  
$mf | Out -File $mfPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
 
try{ & ollama rm najika | Out -Null }catch{}  
& ollama create najika -f $mfPath  
Write-Host "`n[OK] Modell 'najika' erstellt." -ForegroundColor Green  
& ollama list | Select -String najika  
#

zurück.

# ==== REBUILD_ROOMS_FIXED 
=====================================================  
$Core     = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$KayRoot  = "C: \NajikaCore \assets\kaykit"   # ggf. anpassen  
$RoomsDir = Join -Path $Core "assets \rooms" 
$CfgPath  = Join -Path $Core "assets \room_config_detailed.json"  
 
if(!(Test -Path $RoomsDir)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RoomsDir 
-Force | Out -Null } 
 
$all = Get -ChildItem -Path $KayRoot -Recurse -File -Include *.glb,*.gltf 
-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  
if(!$all){ Write -Host "[ERR] Keine KayKit -Modelle unter $KayRoot" -
ForegroundColor Red; return }  
 
function Pick -ByPatterns([object[]]$files,[string[]]$patterns){  
  $best=$null;$bestScore= -1 
  foreach($f in $files){  
    $name=$f.Name.ToLower(); $score=0  
    foreach($p in $patterns){ if($name -match $p.ToLower()){ $score++ } }  
    if($score -gt $bestScore){ $bestScore=$score; $best=$f }  
  } 
  if(-not $best){ $best = $files | Select -Object -First 1 }  
  return $best  
} 
 
# Kandidaten wählen  
$floor = Pick -ByPatterns $all 
@('dungeon','room','floor','tile','ground','platform')  
$wallA = Pick -ByPatterns $all @('wall','barrier','fence','dungeon')  
$wallB = Pick -ByPatterns ($all | Where -Object FullName -ne 
$wallA.FullName) @('wall','corner','column','pillar','dungeon')  
$pillar= Pick -ByPatterns $all @('pillar','column','post')  
$prop1 = Pick -ByPatterns $all @('table','bench','crate','box','chest')  
$prop2 = Pick -ByPatterns ($all | Where -Object FullName -ne 
$prop1.FullName) @('lamp','torch','barrel','vase','pot')  
 
Write-Host "[INFO] Auswahl:" -ForegroundColor Cyan  
Write-Host ("  floor : {0}" -f $floor.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  wallA : {0}" -f $wallA.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  wallB : {0}" -f $wallB.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  pillar: {0}" -f $pillar.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  prop1 : {0}" -f $prop1.FullName)  
Write-Host ("  prop2 : {0}" -f $prop2.FullName)  
 
$PI = [Math]::PI  
$HALFPI = 1.5707963267948966  # = $PI/2  
 
$rooms = 
@('living','training','study','hospital','battle','music','terminal')  
$cfg = @{}  
 
foreach($r in $rooms){  
  $dest = Join -Path $RoomsDir $r  
  if(!(Test -Path $dest)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force 
| Out-Null } 
 
  $map = @{  
    'floor.glb'  = $floor  
    'wall_a.glb' = $wallA  
    'wall_b.glb' = $wallB  
    'pillar.glb' = $pillar  
    'prop1.glb'  = $prop1  
    'prop2.glb'  = $prop2  
  } 
 
  # Keys snapshot → keine Enumerationsfehler  
  $keys = @($map.Keys)  
  foreach($k in $keys){  
    $src = $map[$k]  
    if($src){  
      $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($src.Name)  
      $target = Join -Path $dest ($k -replace ' \.glb$', $ext)   # behält 
.gltf falls nötig  
      Copy-Item -Path $src.FullName -Destination $target -Force 
      $map[$k] = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($target)  
    }else{ 
      $map[$k] = $null  
    } 
  } 
 
  $objects = @()  
  if($map['floor.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['floor.glb'];  
position=@(0,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_a.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_a.glb']; 
position=@(0,0, -8);  rotation=@(0,$PI,0);          scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_a.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_a.glb']; 
position=@(0,0,8);   rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_b.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_b.glb']; 
position=@( -8,0,0);  rotation=@(0,$HALFPI,0);      scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_b.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_b.glb']; 
position=@(8,0,0);   rotation=@(0, -$HALFPI,0);     scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['pillar.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['pillar.glb']; 
position=@( -6,0,-6); rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['pillar.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['pillar.glb']; 
position=@(6,0,6);   rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['prop1.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['prop1.glb'];  
position=@(2,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['prop2.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['prop2.glb'];  
position=@( -2,0,1.5);rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }  
 
  $cfg[$r] = @{ objects = $objects }  
} 
 
$cfg | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 6 | Out -File $CfgPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
Write-Host "`n[OK] Räume gebaut & $CfgPath geschrieben. Reload im 
Browser." -ForegroundColor Green

    $hits = Get -ChildItem $r -Recurse -File -Include $pats -ErrorAction

# ==== SELECT & CREATE 'najika' MODEL (single GGUF) 
============================  
$GGUF = 'C: \NajikaCore \najika-brain\models\Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -
Q5_K_M.gguf'  
$Root = 'C: \NajikaCore'  
$Prompts = Join -Path $Root 'prompts'; if(!(Test -Path $Prompts)){New -Item 
-ItemType Directory -Path $Prompts|Out -Null}

ForegroundColor Red; return }  
 
$FROM = ($GGUF -replace ' \\','/')

User: {{ .Prompt }}  
 
Najika:

2) KayKit -Assets fixen (Char -Placeholder + Räume mit Texturen)

# ==== FIX KAYKIT PATHS + BUILD ROOMS WITH TEXTURES 
============================  
$Core    = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$KayRoot = "C: \NajikaCore \assets\kaykit" 
$RoomsDir= Join -Path $Core "assets \rooms" 
$CfgPath = Join -Path $Core "assets \room_config_detailed.json"  
$CharOut = Join -Path $Core "assets \kaykit\characters"  
if(!(Test -Path $RoomsDir)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RoomsDir 
-Force | Out -Null } 
if(!(Test -Path $CharOut)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $CharOut -
Force | Out -Null } 
 
# Sammle alle GLB/GLTF  
$all = Get -ChildItem -Path $KayRoot -Recurse -File -Include *.glb,*.gltf 
-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  
if(!$all){ Write -Host "[ERR] Keine KayKit -Modelle unter $KayRoot" -
ForegroundColor Red; return }  
 
function Find -PreferGlb([object[]]$files,[string[]]$patterns){  
  $best=$null;$scoreBest= -1 
  foreach($f in $files){  
    $n=$f.Name.ToLower(); $s=0  
    foreach($p in $patterns){ if($n -match $p.ToLower()){ $s++ } }  
    if([IO.Path]::GetExtension($f.Name).ToLower() -eq '.glb'){ $s+=0.5 } 
# leichte Bevorzugung  
    if($s -gt $scoreBest){ $scoreBest=$s; $best=$f }  
  } 
  if(-not $best){ $best = $files | Select -Object -First 1 }  
  return $best  
} 
 
function Copy -WithDependencies([IO.FileInfo]$src, [string]$destDir){  
  if(!(Test -Path $destDir)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destDir 
-Force | Out -Null } 
  $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($src.Name).ToLower()  
  if($ext -eq '.glb'){  
    Copy-Item -Path $src.FullName -Destination (Join -Path $destDir 
$src.Name) -Force 
    return $src.Name  
  } else {  
    # .gltf → ganzen Ordner kopieren (inkl. .bin/.png)  
    $srcDir = Split -Path $src.FullName -Parent 
    $targetDir = Join -Path $destDir ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($srcDir))  
    Copy-Item -Path $srcDir -Destination $targetDir -Recurse -Force 
    return (Join -Path ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($srcDir)) $src.Name) # 
relativer Pfad  
  } 
} 
 
# 2.1 Charakter -Placeholder für kaykit_loader.js: 
assets/kaykit/characters/Mage.glb  
$charCand = Find -PreferGlb $all 
@('mage','wizard','sorcer','character','hero')  
if($charCand){  
  $rel = Copy -WithDependencies $charCand $CharOut  
  # Wenn .gltf kopiert wurde, benenne zusätzlich eine Kopie als Mage.glb 
(kleine leere Hülle vermeiden wir, nutzen Original)  
  $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($rel).ToLower()  
  if($ext -eq '.glb'){  
    Copy-Item -Path (Join -Path $CharOut $rel) -Destination (Join -Path 
$CharOut 'Mage.glb') -Force 
  } else {  
    # .gltf → wir lassen Pfad bestehen; kaykit_loader sucht Mage.glb, 
also zusätzlich irgendein glb duplizieren, falls vorhanden  
    $someGlb = Get -ChildItem $CharOut -Recurse -Filter *.glb -ErrorAction 
SilentlyContinue | Select -Object -First 1 
    if($someGlb){ Copy -Item $someGlb.FullName (Join -Path $CharOut 
'Mage.glb') -Force } 
  } 
  Write-Host "[OK] Charakter -Placeholder gesetzt: 
assets\kaykit\characters \Mage.glb"  
}else{ 
  Write-Host "[WARN] Kein Charakter -GLB gefunden – Placeholder bleibt 
leer." 
} 
 
# 2.2 Räume bauen (mit Texture -Dependencies)  
$floor = Find -PreferGlb $all 
@('dungeon','room','floor','tile','ground','platform')  
$wallA = Find -PreferGlb $all 
@('wall','barrier','fence','straight','dungeon')  
$wallB = Find -PreferGlb ($all | Where -Object FullName -ne 
$wallA.FullName) @('wall','corner','turn','column','pillar','dungeon')  
$pillar= Find -PreferGlb $all @('pillar','column','post')  
$prop1 = Find -PreferGlb $all @('table','bench','crate','box','chest')  
$prop2 = Find -PreferGlb ($all | Where -Object FullName -ne 
$prop1.FullName) @('lamp','torch','barrel','vase','pot')  
 
$PI=[Math]::PI; $HALFPI=1.5707963267948966  
$rooms = 
@('living','training','study','hospital','battle','music','terminal')  
$cfg=@{}  
 
foreach($r in $rooms){  
  $dest = Join -Path $RoomsDir $r  
  if(!(Test -Path $dest)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force 
| Out-Null } 
 
  $map=@{}  
  if($floor){  $map['floor']  = Copy -WithDependencies $floor  $dest }  
  if($wallA){  $map['wall_a'] = Copy -WithDependencies $wallA  $dest }  
  if($wallB){  $map['wall_b'] = Copy -WithDependencies $wallB  $dest }  
  if($pillar){ $map['pillar'] = Copy -WithDependencies $pillar $dest }  
  if($prop1){  $map['prop1']  = Copy -WithDependencies $prop1  $dest }  
  if($prop2){  $map['prop2']  = Copy -WithDependencies $prop2  $dest }  
 
  $objs=@()  
  if($map['floor']) { $objs += @{ model=$map['floor'];  
position=@(0,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_a']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['wall_a']; position=@(0,0, -
8);  rotation=@(0,$PI,0);      scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_a']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['wall_a']; 
position=@(0,0,8);   rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_b']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['wall_b']; position=@( -
8,0,0);  rotation=@(0,$HALFPI,0);  scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['wall_b']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['wall_b']; 
position=@(8,0,0);   rotation=@(0, -$HALFPI,0); scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['pillar']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['pillar']; position=@( -6,0,-
6); rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['pillar']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['pillar']; 
position=@(6,0,6);   rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['prop1']) { $objs += @{ model=$map['prop1'];  
position=@(2,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }  
  if($map['prop2']) { $objs += @{ model=$map['prop2'];  position=@( -
2,0,1.5);rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }  
 
  $cfg[$r] = @{ objects = $objs }  
} 
 
$cfg | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 8 | Out -File $CfgPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
Write-Host "`n[OK] Räume + Texturen eingerichtet → $CfgPath" -
ForegroundColor Green  
 
# Optional: Favicon gegen 404  
$ico = Join -Path $Core 'favicon.ico'  
if(!(Test -Path $ico)){ Set -Content -Value '' -Path $ico -Encoding Byte }  
Write-Host "[OK] Favicon gesetzt (leer) – 404 weg."

============================================  
$Root = "C: \NajikaCore"

# ==== NAJIKA FIX: Mage.glb + Index säubern + Modell bauen 
=====================  
$Root   = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$JS     = Join -Path $Root "js"  
$Cfg    = Join -Path $Root "config"  
$Char   = Join -Path $Root "assets \kaykit\characters"  
$Idx    = Join -Path $Root "index_3d.html"  
 
# 0) Verzeichnisse sicherstellen  
foreach($d in @($JS,$Cfg,$Char)){ if(!(Test -Path $d)){ New -Item -ItemType 
Directory -Path $d -Force | Out -Null } }  
 
# 1) Mage.glb bereitstellen (aus vorhandenem Character kopieren)  
$MagePath = Join -Path $Char "Mage.glb"  
if(!(Test -Path $MagePath)){  
  $NajikaChar = Join -Path $Root "assets \characters \najika.glb"  
  if(Test-Path $NajikaChar){  
    Copy-Item $NajikaChar $MagePath -Force 
  } else {  
    $SomeGlb = Get -ChildItem (Join -Path $Root "assets") -Recurse -Filter 
*.glb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select -Object -First 1 
    if($SomeGlb){ Copy -Item $SomeGlb.FullName $MagePath -Force } 
  } 
} 
Write-Host (Test -Path $MagePath ? "[OK] Mage.glb gesetzt -> $MagePath" : 
"[WARN] Konnte kein GLB für Mage.glb finden") -ForegroundColor Cyan  
 
# 2) index_3d.html von alten Three/Loader -Tags säubern, falls vorhanden  
if(Test-Path $Idx){  
  $html = Get -Content $Idx -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
  $before = $html  
  $html = $html -replace '(?im)^ \s*<script 
src="https://cdnjs \.cloudflare \.com/ajax/libs/three \.js/r128/three \.min\.
js">\s*</script> \s*','' 
  $html = $html -replace '(?im)^ \s*<script 
src="https://cdn \.jsdelivr \.net/npm/three@0 \.128\.0/examples/js/loaders/G
LTFLoader \.js">\s*</script> \s*','' 
  if($html -ne $before){  
    $html | Out -File $Idx -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
    Write-Host "[OK] Alte Three/GLTFLoader Script -Tags entfernt" -
ForegroundColor Green  
  } else {  
    Write-Host "[OK] Keine alten Script -Tags gefunden" -ForegroundColor 
Green 
  } 
} 
 
# 3) Leeres favicon anlegen (404 vermeiden)  
$ico = Join -Path $Root "favicon.ico"  
if(!(Test -Path $ico)){ [byte[]]@() | Set -Content -Path $ico -Encoding 
Byte } 
 
# 4) Minimal -Configs (falls fehlen)  
$corePath = Join -Path $Cfg "najika_personality_CORE.json"  
if(!(Test -Path $corePath)){  
@' 
{

  "identity": { "name": "Najika", "age": "Adult" },

"no_ai_mention": true }  
}

Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -Q5_K_M.gguf

# ==== THREE/GLTF HARD -FIX (lokal hosten & CDN entfernen) 
======================  
$Root = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$Idx  = Join -Path $Root "index_3d.html"  
$Vend = Join -Path $Root "vendor \three-160" 
 
if(!(Test -Path $Idx)){ Write -Host "[ERR] index_3d.html fehlt" -
ForegroundColor Red; return }  
if(!(Test -Path $Vend)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Vend -Force | 
Out-Null } 
 
# 1) UMD -Dateien lokal ablegen (globales THREE + GLTFLoader + 
OrbitControls)  
$urls = @{  
  "three.min.js"    = 
"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js";  
  "GLTFLoader.js"   = 
"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoade
r.js"; 
  "OrbitControls.js"= 
"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitCon
trols.js";  
} 
foreach($k in $urls.Keys){  
  $out = Join -Path $Vend $k  
  try { Invoke -WebRequest $urls[$k] -OutFile $out -UseBasicParsing -
TimeoutSec 30 } catch {}  
  if(!(Test -Path $out)){ Write -Host "[ERR] Download fehlgeschlagen: $k" -
ForegroundColor Red; return }  
} 
 
# 2) index_3d.html bereinigen (alle externen THREE/GLTFLoader/Importmap 
entfernen)  
$html = Get -Content $Idx -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
 
# Importmap entfernen  
$html = [regex]::Replace($html, 
'<script[^>]*type="importmap"[^>]*>.*?</script>', '', 
'Singleline,IgnoreCase')  
 
# Alle CDN -Skripte zu three/glTF entfernen (robuste Regex)  
$patterns = @(  
  
'<script[^>]+src="https?://[^"]*three[^"]*/build/three( \.module)? \.js"[^>
]*>\s*</script>',  
  
'<script[^>]+src="https?://[^"]*three[^"]*/examples/jsm/[^"]*GLTFLoader \.
js"[^>]*> \s*</script>',  
  
'<script[^>]+src="https?://[^"]*three[^"]*/examples/js/[^"]*GLTFLoader \.j
s"[^>]*> \s*</script>',  
  
'<script[^>]+src="https?://[^"]*three[^"]*/examples/js/[^"]*OrbitControls

  foreach($u in $urls){  
    try{ 
      Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $u -OutFile $dest -
TimeoutSec 60  
      if((Get-Item $dest).Length -gt 0){ return $true }

}

  'js/three_boot \.js' 
) 
foreach($p in $kill){  
  $html = [regex]::Replace($html, 
"<script[^>]+src=""$p""[^>]*> \s*</script>", '', 'IgnoreCase')  
} 
 
# Lokale Vendor -Tags 
$vendorTags = @'  
<script src="js/vendor/three.min.js"></script>  
<script src="js/vendor/GLTFLoader.js"></script>  
<script src="js/vendor/OrbitControls.js"></script>  
'@ 
 
# Vor dem ersten <script type="module"> einfügen (falls noch nicht 
vorhanden)  
if($html -notmatch [regex]::Escape('js/vendor/three.min.js')){  
  $html = $html -replace '(<script[^>]*type="module"[^>]*>)', 
($vendorTags + "`r`n`$1")  
} 
 
# 3) Ersten Module -Block patchen: Importe entfernen, auf Globals 
umstellen  
$rx = 
[regex]::new('<script[^>]*type="module"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>','Singleline,
IgnoreCase')  
$m  = $rx.Match($html)  
if($m.Success){  
  $code = $m.Groups[1].Value  
  # Imports killen  
  $code = [regex]::Replace($code, '^ \s*import \s+.*?;\s*$', '', 
'Multiline')  
  # Nutzung auf globale Namen umschreiben  
  $code = $code -replace ' \bnew\s+GLTFLoader \s*\(','new 
THREE.GLTFLoader('  
  $code = $code -replace ' \bnew\s+OrbitControls \s*\(','new 
THREE.OrbitControls('  
  # Für Sicherheit: wenn "import * as THREE" da war → ersetze durch 
global 
  $code = $code -replace ' \bTHREE\b','THREE'  # noop, aber belassen  
  $patched = '<script>' + "`r`n" + $code + "`r`n" + '</script>'  
  $html = $html.Substring(0,$m.Index) + $patched + 
$html.Substring($m.Index + $m.Length)  
} 
 
# 4) Bekannte JS -Dateien anpassen (falls dort GLTFLoader/OrbitControls 
ohne THREE genutzt wird)  
$toPatch = @(  
  (Join-Path $Root "js \kaykit_loader.js"),  
  (Join-Path $Root "js \room_manager.js"),  
  (Join-Path $Root "js \battle.js")  
) | Where -Object { Test -Path $_ }  
 
foreach($f in $toPatch){  
  $js = Get -Content $f -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
  $js = $js -replace ' \bnew\s+GLTFLoader \s*\(','new THREE.GLTFLoader('  
  $js = $js -replace ' \bnew\s+OrbitControls \s*\(','new 
THREE.OrbitControls('  
  # Falls Code auf global.THREE prüft, lassen wir es stehen.  
  $js | Out -File $f -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
} 
 
# 5) HTML speichern  
$html | Out -File $Idx -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
Write-Host "[OK] Three/GLTF lokal + HTML/JS gepatcht. Im Browser 
STRG+F5." -ForegroundColor Green
