ChatGPT:  
 
Alles klar — ich hab erst recherchiert, warum deine Fehler auftreten:  
 
    „THREE is not defined“ und „GLTFLoader … undefined“ kommen fast immer 
vom Mischen von ES -Modules und klassischen Global -Scripts oder vom 
zweifachen Laden von three.js. Man muss sich für eine Variante 
entscheiden oder sauber „bridgen“ (Module → globale window.THREE).  
    three.js forum  
 
    Die „nosniff/MIME“ -Blocks bei GLTFLoader.js entstehen, wenn der CDN 
falschen Content -Type liefert; dann blockt der Browser das Script. Fix: 
andere Quelle oder lokal hosten.  
    MDN Web Docs  
 
Unten ist ein Einmal -Fix (zum Einfügen in PowerShell, Enter), der nichts 
„zwischenspeichert“:  
 
    legt js/three_boot.js an, das einmalig die ES -Module von three.js 
lädt und sie als globale Variablen (window.THREE, window.GLTFLoader, …) 
bereitstellt,  
 
    hängt den Booter früh im <head> ein,  
 
    setzt ein globales window.__najikaReady -Promise (damit .then(...) 
nicht crasht),  
 
    repariert den Mage -Placeholder.  
 
    Einfügen & ausführen:  
 
# ==== NAJIKA THREE FIX (paste & run) 
==========================================  
$Root = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$Idx  = Join -Path $Root "index_3d.html"  
$JS   = Join -Path $Root "js"  
if (!(Test -Path $JS)) { New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $JS -Force | 
Out-Null } 
 
# 1) three_boot.js erzeugen (lädt Module & exponiert globale Objekte)  
$boot = @"  
(function(){  
  // Stellt ein Promise bereit, auf das andere Skripte warten können  
  window.__najikaReady = (async function(){  
    const THREE = await 
import('https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js');  
    const GLTF  = await 
import('https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.j
s'); 
    const Ctl   = await 
import('https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitContro
ls.js');  
 
    // -> globale Bridge für Nicht -Module 
    window.THREE         = THREE;  
    window.GLTF          = GLTF;  
    window.GLTFMod       = GLTF;  
    window.GLTFLoader    = GLTF.GLTFLoader;  
    window.OrbitControls = Ctl.OrbitControls;  
 
    return true;  
  })(); 
})(); 
"@ 
$bootPath = Join -Path $JS "three_boot.js"  
$boot | Out -File $bootPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force 
 
# 2) index_3d.html patchen: Boot -Script früh im <head> einfügen 
(einmalig)  
if (Test -Path $Idx) {  
  $bak = "$Idx.bak_$(Get -Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"  
  Copy-Item $Idx $bak -Force

  if ($html -notmatch 'three_boot.js') {  
    $inject = '  <script type="module" src="js/three_boot.js"></script>'

  } else {  
    Write-Host "[OK] three_boot.js bereits eingebunden"  
  } 
} else {  
  Write-Host "[ERR] index_3d.html nicht gefunden: $Idx" -ForegroundColor 
Red 
} 
 
# 3) Mage -Placeholder sicherstellen  
$MagePath = Join -Path $Root "assets \kaykit\characters \Mage.glb"

Filter *.glb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select -Object -First 1

Out-Null

  } else {  
    Write-Host "[WARN] Kein *.glb in assets \kaykit gefunden – Character 
bleibt Platzhalter."  
  }

ForegroundColor Cyan

Was das behebt  
 
    THREE steht wieder global zur Verfügung → kein „THREE is not 
defined“.  
 
    GLTFLoader & OrbitControls kommen aus den ES -Modules, werden aber als 
Globals bereitgestellt → kein „GLTF… undefined“.  
    three.js forum  
 
    „nosniff“ -Blockaden umgehen wir, da diese Module zuverlässig von 
unpkg mit korrektem MIME -Type kommen. (Hintergrund zu nosniff:  
    MDN Web Docs  
    ) 
 
Wenn danach noch ein „Multiple instances of Three.js being imported“ -
Warning erscheint, ist das nur ein Hinweis (kein Blocker). Sie kommt, 
wenn three.js zusätzlich über andere Tags geladen wird. Ziel ist am Ende 
genau ein Import; der obige Booter reicht. W enn du möchtest, gebe ich dir 
eine zweite Ein -Zeilen-Patchroutine, die alte <script src="...three..."> -
Zeilen automatisiert entfernt.

// Digivice Core Logic (mit Plündern + Skill -Steal) 
class Digivice {  
  constructor() {  
    this.currentRoom = 'status';  
    this.menuOpen = false;  
    this.selectedMenuItem = 0;  
 
    // Reihenfolge (mit Skills -Raum) 
    this.rooms = [  
      { id: 'status', name: 'Status', icon: '      ' }, 
      { id: 'chat', name: 'Chat', icon: '   ' }, 
      { id: 'feed', name: 'Füttern', icon: '     ' }, 
      { id: 'train', name: 'Training', icon: '           ' }, 
      { id: 'battle', name: 'Raufen', icon: '  ' }, 
      { id: 'skills', name: 'Skills', icon: '     ' }, 
      { id: 'medicine', name: 'Medizin', icon: '    ' }, 
      { id: 'discipline', name: 'Disziplin', icon: '    ' }, 
      { id: 'light', name: 'Licht', icon: '      ' } 
    ]; 
 
    // Minigame/Battle State  
    this.plunderGame = null;  
    this.battle = null;  
 
    this.init();  
  } 
 
  init() {  
    document.getElementById('btn -menu').addEventListener('click', () => 
this.toggleMenu());  
    document.getElementById('btn -left').addEventListener('click', () => 
this.navigate('left'));  
    document.getElementById('btn -action').addEventListener('click', () => 
this.action());  
    document.getElementById('btn -right').addEventListener('click', () => 
this.navigate('right'));  
 
    // Najika Brain  
    if (typeof NajikaBrain !== 'undefined') window.najika = new 
NajikaBrain();  
 
    this.loadRoom(this.currentRoom);  
  } 
 
  toggleMenu() {  
    this.menuOpen = !this.menuOpen;  
    if (this.menuOpen) this.showMenu();  
    else this.loadRoom(this.currentRoom);  
  } 
 
  showMenu() {  
    const content = document.getElementById('screen -content');  
    content.innerHTML = '<div class="menu -overlay" id="menu"></div>';  
    const menu = document.getElementById('menu');  
 
    this.rooms.forEach((room, index) => {  
      const item = document.createElement('div');  
      item.className = 'menu -item' + (index === this.selectedMenuItem ? ' 
selected' : '');  
      item.innerHTML = `${room.icon} ${room.name}`;  
      item.addEventListener('click', () => {  
        this.currentRoom = room.id;  
        this.menuOpen = false;  
        this.loadRoom(room.id);  
      }); 
      menu.appendChild(item);  
    }); 
  } 
 
  navigate(direction) {  
    if (this.menuOpen) {  
      if (direction === 'left') this.selectedMenuItem = Math.max(0, 
this.selectedMenuItem - 1); 
      else if (direction === 'right') this.selectedMenuItem = 
Math.min(this.rooms.length - 1, this.selectedMenuItem + 1);  
      this.showMenu();  
      return; 
    } 
    this.roomSpecificNavigation(direction);  
  } 
 
  action() {  
    if (this.menuOpen) {  
      this.currentRoom = this.rooms[this.selectedMenuItem].id;  
      this.menuOpen = false;  
      this.loadRoom(this.currentRoom);  
      return; 
    } 
    this.roomSpecificAction();  
  } 
 
  loadRoom(roomId) {  
    const c = document.getElementById('screen -content');  
    c.innerHTML = '';  
 
    const title = document.createElement('div');  
    title.className = 'room -title'; 
    const room = this.rooms.find(r => r.id === roomId);  
    title.textContent = room ? `${room.icon} ${room.name}` : '';  
    c.appendChild(title);  
 
    // Reset room -local states  
    this.plunderGame = null;  
 
    switch (roomId) {  
      case 'status': this.loadStatusRoom(c); break;  
      case 'chat': this.loadChatRoom(c); break;  
      case 'feed': this.loadFeedRoom(c); break;  
      case 'train': this.loadTrainRoom(c); break;  
      case 'battle': this.loadBattleRoom(c); break;  
      case 'skills': this.loadSkillsRoom(c); break;  
      case 'medicine': this.loadMedicineRoom(c); break;  
      case 'discipline': this.loadDisciplineRoom(c); break;  
      case 'light': this.loadLightRoom(c); break;  
    } 
  }

        const resp = this.getNajikaResponse(txt);  
        this.addMessageToDOM(messagesDiv, resp, 'najika');  
        this.chatMessages.push({ text: resp, sender: 'najika' });  
      }, 400 + Math.random() * 600);  
    }; 
    sendBtn.addEventListener('click', send);  
    input.addEventListener('keypress', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') 
send(); });  
 
    setTimeout(() => { messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight; 
}, 100);  
  } 
  addMessageToDOM(container, text, sender) {  
    const d = document.createElement('div');  
    d.className = `message ${sender}`;  
    const b = document.createElement('div');  
    b.className = 'bubble';  
    b.textContent = text;  
    d.appendChild(b);  
    container.appendChild(d);  
    setTimeout(() => { container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight; }, 
30); 
  } 
  getNajikaResponse(t) {  
    const s = t.toLowerCase();  
    if (s.includes('explosion')) return 'EXPLOSION!!!   '; 
    if (s.includes('hallo') || s.includes('hi')) return 'Kuja! Endlich 
sprichst du mit mir!';  
    if (s.includes('kampf')) return 'Lass uns kämpfen! Ich bin bereit!';  
    if (s.includes('plünder') || s.includes('stehl')) return 'Ich übe das 
Stehlen wie in KonoSuba!     '; 
    const r = ['Kuja!', 'Erzähl mir mehr!', 'Können wir explodieren?', 
'Beachte mich mehr!', 'Okay!'];  
    return r[Math.floor(Math.random() * r.length)];  
  } 
 
  // ===== FEED =====  
  loadFeedRoom(c) {  
    const grid = document.createElement('div');  
    grid.className = 'food -grid'; 
    ['    ', '                  ', '  ', '   ', '    ', '       '].forEach(food => {  
      const item = document.createElement('div');  
      item.className = 'food -item'; 
      item.textContent = food;  
      item.addEventListener('click', () => {  
        if (!window.najika) return;  
        window.najika.feed(food);  
        this.updateStats();  
        this.showMessage(`Najika isst ${food}!`);  
      }); 
      grid.appendChild(item);  
    }); 
    c.appendChild(grid);  
  } 
 
  // ===== TRAIN (Explosion + Plündern üben) =====  
  loadTrainRoom(c) {

Explosion -Call · ► = —';

Zone!</div>  
      <div id="plunder -result" style="margin -top:8px;font -
weight:bold;"></div>  
    `; 
    c.appendChild(meterWrap);  
 
    this.plunderGame = {  
      running: false,  
      pos: 0, dir: 1, timer: null,  
      speed: 1.8 // px per tick  
    }; 
    this.updatePlunderBar(0);  
  } 
  updatePlunderBar(percent) {  
    const el = document.getElementById('plunder -bar'); 
    if (el) el.style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent)) + '%';  
  } 
  startPlunderMinigame() {  
    if (!this.plunderGame || this.plunderGame.running) return;  
    this.plunderGame.running = true;  
    this.plunderGame.pos = 0; this.plunderGame.dir = 1;  
    const step = () => {  
      if (!this.plunderGame?.running) return;  
      this.plunderGame.pos += this.plunderGame.dir * 
this.plunderGame.speed;  
      if (this.plunderGame.pos <= 0) { this.plunderGame.pos = 0; 
this.plunderGame.dir = 1; }  
      if (this.plunderGame.pos >= 100) { this.plunderGame.pos = 100; 
this.plunderGame.dir = -1; } 
      this.updatePlunderBar(this.plunderGame.pos);  
      this.plunderGame.timer = setTimeout(step, 16);  
    }; 
    step(); 
  } 
  stopPlunderMinigame() {  
    if (!this.plunderGame || !this.plunderGame.running) return;  
    this.plunderGame.running = false;  
    clearTimeout(this.plunderGame.timer);  
    const p = this.plunderGame.pos;  
    const inGreen = p >= 55 && p <= 65;  
    const res = document.getElementById('plunder -result');  
    if (!window.najika) return;  
 
    if (inGreen) {  
      const outcome = window.najika.trainingPlunderSuccess();  
      res.textContent = `Erfolg! ${outcome.item} erhalten · Meisterschaft 
${outcome.mastery}`;  
      this.showMessage('Plündern gelungen!              '); 
      this.updateStats();  
    } else {  
      res.textContent = 'Daneben. Keine Beute.';  
      this.showMessage('Daneben… versuch es nochmal!');  
    } 
  } 
 
  // ===== BATTLE (mit Plündern & Skill -Steal) =====  
  loadBattleRoom(c) {  
    // Neues Gefecht  
    this.battle = {  
      enemy: { name: 'Räuber', hp: 100, alert: 1 },  
      cooldownUntil: 0  
    }; 
 
    const div = document.createElement('div');  
    div.className = 'room -content';  
    div.innerHTML = `  
        Kampf · ◄ = Plündern · ● = Angriff · ► = Block<br><br>  
      <div style="margin:10px auto;width:85%;">  
        <div style="font -size:14px;color:#333;">${this.battle.enemy.name} 
HP</div>  
        <div class="bar"><div class="bar -fill" id="enemy -hp" 
style="width:100%"></div></div>  
        <div id="plunder -cd" class="cooldown"></div>  
      </div> 
    `; 
    c.appendChild(div);  
  } 
 
  // Link/Rechts in Räumen  
  roomSpecificNavigation(direction) {  
    if (this.currentRoom === 'train') {  
      if (direction === 'left') {  
        // Start/Stop Plündern -Minispiel  
        if (!this.plunderGame.running) this.startPlunderMinigame();  
        else this.stopPlunderMinigame();  
      } 
    } 
 
    if (this.currentRoom === 'battle') {  
      if (!window.najika || !this.battle) return;  
      const now = Date.now();  
 
      if (direction === 'left') {  
        // Plündern im Kampf (Cooldown 10s)  
        if (now < this.battle.cooldownUntil) {  
          const s = Math.ceil((this.battle.cooldownUntil - now) / 1000);  
          this.showMessage(`Plündern CD: ${s}s`);  
          return; 
        } 
        this.battle.cooldownUntil = now + 10000;  
        const cd = document.getElementById('plunder -cd'); 
        if (cd) cd.textContent = 'Plündern… (10s CD)';  
 
        const res = window.najika.attemptPlunder({ alert: 
this.battle.enemy.alert });  
        this.showMessage(res.message);  
        if (res.item) this.updateStats();  
      } 
 
      if (direction === 'right') {  
        this.showMessage('Block vorbereitet!');  
      } 
    } 
  } 
 
  // Action in Räumen  
  roomSpecificAction() {  
    switch (this.currentRoom) {  
      case 'train':  
        this.showMessage('EXPLOSION!!!   '); 
        break; 
 
      case 'battle':  
        if (!this.battle) return;  
        // Einfacher Angriff  
        this.battle.enemy.hp = Math.max(0, this.battle.enemy.hp - 22); 
        const hpEl = document.getElementById('enemy -hp'); 
        if (hpEl) hpEl.style.width = this.battle.enemy.hp + '%';  
 
        if (this.battle.enemy.hp === 0) {  
          // Sieg → Chance auf „Skill stehlen“  
          const steal = window.najika.onBattleWin();  
          if (steal.learned) {  
            this.showMessage(`Neuer Skill erlernt: ${steal.skill}     `); 
          } else {  
            this.showMessage('Sieg! Keine Skills erbeutet.');  
          } 
          this.battle = null;  
        } else {  
          this.showMessage('Treffer!');  
        } 
        break; 
 
      case 'light':  
        if (window.najika) {  
          window.najika.toggleSleep();  
          this.loadRoom('light');  
        } 
        break; 
    } 
  } 
 
  // ===== SKILLS =====

  }

    najika_brain.js (GANZES FILE ERSETZEN)  
 
// Najika Brain (mit Plündern + Skill -Steal) 
class NajikaBrain {  
  constructor() {  
    this.stats = {  
      hunger: 10, energy: 10, mood: 'happy',  
      attention: 10, combat_urge: 5, boredom: 3,  
      sleeping: false, level: 0  
    }; 
 
    this.inventory = [];           // Beute  
    this.skills = ['Explosion'];   // Basis -Skill 
    this.maxSkillSlots = 8;        // gestohlene/gelernte Slots  
 
    this.plunder = { mastery: 1, xp: 0, cooldownUntil: 0 };  
 
    this.phrases = {  
      greetings: ['Kuja!   ','EXPLOSION?!','Endlich bist du da!','Lass 
uns was machen!'],  
      hungry: ['Ich habe Hunger...','Fütter mich!     ','Mein Magen 
knurrt...'],  
      happy: ['Das war lecker!       ','Ich bin glücklich!','Danke, Kuja! 
  '], 
      bored: ['Mir ist langweilig...','Lass uns kämpfen!           ','Können wir 
was machen?']  
    }; 
 
    this.startAutonomy();  
  } 
 
  // ===== Basics =====  
  getGreeting() { return 
this.phrases.greetings[Math.floor(Math.random()*this.phrases.greetings.le
ngth)]; }  
  feed(food) { this.stats.hunger = Math.min(10, this.stats.hunger + 2); 
this.stats.mood='happy'; 
this.stats.boredom=Math.max(0,this.stats.boredom -1); } 
  toggleSleep() { this.stats.sleeping = !this.stats.sleeping; if 
(this.stats.sleeping) this.stats.energy = Math.min(10, this.stats.energy 
+ 3); } 
  startAutonomy() {  
    setInterval(() => {  
      this.stats.hunger = Math.max(0, this.stats.hunger - 1); 
      this.stats.energy = Math.max(0, this.stats.energy - 1); 
      this.stats.attention = Math.max(0, this.stats.attention - 1); 
      this.stats.boredom = Math.min(10, this.stats.boredom + 1);  
      if (this.stats.hunger < 3 || this.stats.energy < 3) this.stats.mood 
= 'sad';  
      else if (this.stats.boredom > 7) this.stats.mood = 'neutral';  
      else if (this.stats.attention < 3) this.stats.mood = 'angry';  
      else this.stats.mood = 'happy';  
    }, 30000);  
  } 
 
  // ===== Plündern (Training -Minispiel Resultat) =====  
  trainingPlunderSuccess() {  
    // fixe, belohnende Dummy -Tabelle 
    const lootTable = ['Kleiner Trank', 'Kupfermünzen', 'Altes Tuch', 
'Dietrich', 'Kräuter'];  
    const item = lootTable[Math.floor(Math.random()*lootTable.length)];  
    this.inventory.push(item);  
    this.gainPlunderXP(8);  
    return { item, mastery: this.plunder.mastery };  
  } 
  gainPlunderXP(x) {  
    this.plunder.xp += x;  
    // einfache Kurve: alle 40 XP +1 Meisterschaft  
    while (this.plunder.xp >= 40) {  
      this.plunder.xp -= 40; 
      this.plunder.mastery = Math.min(20, this.plunder.mastery + 1);  
    } 
  } 
 
  // ===== Plündern im Kampf =====  
  attemptPlunder(ctx) {  
    // Erfolgschance: Basis 30% + 3% pro Meisterschaft – 5%*Alert  
    const chance = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, 0.30 + 
0.03*this.plunder.mastery - 0.05*(ctx.alert||0)));  
    const roll = Math.random();  
    if (roll <= chance) {  
      const rare = Math.random() < 0.15;  
      const item = rare ? 'Seltener Talisman' : 
(['Münzen','Kräuter','Trank','Fetzen','Dietrich'][Math.floor(Math.random(
)*5)]); 
      this.inventory.push(item);  
      this.gainPlunderXP(10 + (rare?5:0));  
      return { ok:true, item, message:`Geklaut: ${item}!` };  
    } 
    return { ok:false, item:null, message:'Plündern fehlgeschlagen.' };  
  } 
 
  // ===== Skill Stehlen nach Sieg =====  
  onBattleWin() {  
    // Grundchance 2% + 0.3% pro Meisterschaft (KonoSuba -Style selten!)  
    const chance = Math.min(0.12, 0.02 + 0.003*this.plunder.mastery);  
    if (Math.random() <= chance && this.skills.length < 
this.maxSkillSlots) {  
      const pool = 
['Wirbelhieb','Schattentritt','Gegenstandskunde','Flinke 
Finger','Galanterie'];  
      const skill = pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];  
      if (!this.skills.includes(skill)) {  
        this.skills.push(skill);  
        return { learned:true, skill };  
      } 
    } 
    return { learned:false };  
  } 
}

    Sieg → kleine Chance Skill zu stehlen (KonoSuba -Style selten).  
 
    Skills (     ): Übersicht Meisterschaft, Skills & Inventar.

    <script>  
        // Basic THREE.js Setup  
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();  
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x1a1a2e);  
         
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth 
/ window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);  
        camera.position.z = 5;  
         
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });  
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);  
        document.getElementById('canvas -
container').appendChild(renderer.domElement);  
         
        // Add Light  
        const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);  
        light.position.set(0, 10, 10);  
        scene.add(light);  
         
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);  
        scene.add(ambientLight);  
         
        // Add Ground  
        const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(20, 20);  
        const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 
0x2c3e50 });  
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);  
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;  
        ground.position.y = -2; 
        scene.add(ground);  
         
        // Add Placeholder (Najika wird später durch .glb ersetzt)  
        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 1.5, 0.5);  
        const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9b59b6 
}); 
        const najika = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);  
        najika.position.y = 0;  
        scene.add(najika);  
         
        // Animation Loop  
        function animate() {  
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);  
             
            // Rotate Najika slowly  
            najika.rotation.y += 0.01;  
             
            renderer.render(scene, camera);  
        } 
         
        animate();  
         
        // Resize Handler  
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {  
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;  
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();  
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);  
        }); 
         
        console.log('Digivice loaded successfully!');  
 
        // Init Kay -Kit Loader  
        window.kayKitLoader = new KayKitLoader(scene);  
        kayKitLoader.loadCharacter('Mage'); // Najika als Mage  
        kayKitLoader.loadRoom('wohnzimmer');  
         
        // Animation Loop Update  
        const clock = new THREE.Clock();  
        const originalAnimate = animate;  
        animate = function() {  
            const delta = clock.getDelta();  
            if (window.kayKitLoader) kayKitLoader.update(delta);  
            originalAnimate();  
        }; 
    </script>

<script>// MOBILE TOUCH OPTIMIZATION  
(function() {  
    if (!('ontouchstart' in window)) return;  
     
    console.log('Mobile device detected - optimizing touch');  
     
    // Disable double -tap zoom on buttons  
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {  
        if (e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON') {  
            e.preventDefault();  
        } 
    }, { passive: false });  
     
    // Optimize battle buttons  
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {  
        const optimizeButtons = () => {  
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.battle -start-btn, 
.battle-btn, .nav -btn'); 
             
            buttons.forEach(btn => {  
                // Larger touch target  
                btn.style.minHeight = '48px';  
                btn.style.minWidth = '48px';  
                 
                // Touch feedback  
                btn.addEventListener('touchstart', function() {  
                    this.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';  
                }); 
                 
                btn.addEventListener('touchend', function() {  
                    this.style.transform = '';  
                }); 
            }); 
        }; 
         
        // Run on load  
        optimizeButtons();  
         
        // Re-run when new buttons appear  
        const observer = new MutationObserver(optimizeButtons);  
        observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true 
}); 
    }); 
})();</script>  
<script>  
// MOBILE CLICK FIX  
(function() {  
    console.log('Mobile Click Fix loaded');  
     
    // Force click events on mobile  
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {  
        const isMobile = 
/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent);  
        console.log('Is Mobile:', isMobile);  
         
        if (isMobile) {  
            // Fix all buttons  
            const fixButtons = () => {  
                const allButtons = document.querySelectorAll('button, 
.nav-btn, .battle -start-btn, .battle -btn'); 
                 
                allButtons.forEach(btn => {  
                    // Remove old listeners  
                    btn.replaceWith(btn.cloneNode(true));  
                }); 
                 
                // Re-query after clone  
                const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button, .nav -
btn, .battle -start-btn, .battle -btn'); 
                 
                buttons.forEach(btn => {  
                    btn.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {  
                        e.preventDefault();  
                        this.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';  
                        this.style.opacity = '0.8';  
                    }, {passive: false});  
                     
                    btn.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {  
                        e.preventDefault();  
                        this.style.transform = '';  
                        this.style.opacity = '';  
                         
                        // Trigger click  
                        this.click();  
                    }, {passive: false});  
                }); 
                 
                console.log(Fixed ${buttons.length} buttons);  
            }; 
             
            // Initial fix  
            fixButtons();  
             
            // Re-fix when DOM changes  
            const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {  
                setTimeout(fixButtons, 100);  
            }); 
             
            observer.observe(document.body, {  
                childList: true,  
                subtree: true  
            }); 
        } 
    }); 
})();</script>

<script>  
function toggleChat() {  
    const chat = document.getElementById('chat -container');  
    chat.style.display = chat.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 
'none'; 
} 
 
async function sendChatMessage() {  
    const input = document.getElementById('chat -input');  
    const messages = document.getElementById('chat -messages');  
    const msg = input.value.trim();  
     
    if (!msg) return;  
     
    // User message  
    const userDiv = document.createElement('div');  
    userDiv.className = 'chat -msg chat -msg-user'; 
    userDiv.textContent = msg;  
    messages.appendChild(userDiv);  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
     
    input.value = '';  
    input.disabled = true;  
     
    // Najika thinking  
    const thinkDiv = document.createElement('div');  
    thinkDiv.className = 'chat -msg chat -msg-najika';  
    thinkDiv.textContent = 'Najika denkt nach...';  
    messages.appendChild(thinkDiv);  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
     
    try { 
        const reply = await window.najikaAI.sendMessage(msg);  
         
        thinkDiv.textContent = reply;  
         
    } catch (e) {  
        thinkDiv.textContent = 'Fehler: ' + e.message;  
        thinkDiv.style.color = '#e74c3c';  
    } 
     
    input.disabled = false;  
    input.focus();  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
} 
 
// Enter key  
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {  
    const input = document.getElementById('chat -input');  
    if (input) {  
        input.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {  
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {  
                sendChatMessage();  
            } 
        }); 
    } 
}); 
</script>

<script type="module">  
async function bootNajika(){  
  const CDNS = [  
    { 
      three: "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js",  
      gltf:  
"https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js",  
      orbit: 
"https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js",  
    }, 
    { 
      three: 
"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js",  
      gltf:  
"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoad
er.js", 
      orbit: 
"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitCo
ntrols.js",  
    } 
  ]; 
  let THREEmod, GLTF, ORBIT;  
  for (const cdn of CDNS){  
    try{ 
      THREEmod = await import(cdn.three);  
      GLTF    = await import(cdn.gltf);  
      ORBIT   = await import(cdn.orbit);  
      if(THREEmod && GLTF && ORBIT) break;  
    }catch(e){ /* try next */ }  
  } 
  if(!THREEmod){ console.error("three.js Import fehlgeschlagen"); return; 
} 
  // Expose als Globals für bestehende Skripte  
  window.THREE = THREEmod;  
  window.GLTFLoader = GLTF.GLTFLoader;  
  window.OrbitControls = ORBIT.OrbitControls;  
 
  // Jetzt lokale Skripte in korrekter Reihenfolge nachladen  
  const chain = [  
    "js/consent_fsm.js",  
    "js/room_manager.js",  
    "js/battle.js",  
    "js/kaykit_loader.js",  
    "js/najika_ai.js"  
  ]; 
  for (const src of chain){  
    await new Promise((res,rej)=>{  
      const s=document.createElement("script");  
      s.src = src; s.onload = res; s.onerror = ()=>rej(new Error("Load 
fail: "+src));  
      document.head.appendChild(s);  
    }); 
  } 
  console.log("Najika bootstrap OK");  
} 
bootNajika();  
</script>

# ==== USE_WORKING_DIGIVICE_INDEX + FIX WALLS 
==================================  
$Root      = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$SrcDir    = Join -Path $Root "digivice"  
$SrcIdx    = Join -Path $SrcDir "index_3d.html"  
$DstIdx    = Join -Path $Root "index_3d.html"  
$CfgPath   = Join -Path $Root "assets \room_config_detailed.json"  
$VendDir   = Join -Path $Root "js \vendor"

  $alt = Get -ChildItem $SrcDir -File -Filter "index_3d*.html" | Sort -
Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select -Object -First 1 
  if($alt){ $SrcIdx = $alt.FullName } else { Write -Host "[ERR] Keine 
Digivice -Index im Ordner gefunden." -Fore Red; return }  
} 
 
# 1) Arbeitskopie erstellen  
$srcHtml = Get -Content $SrcIdx -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
Copy-Item $DstIdx "$DstIdx.bak_$(Get -Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')" -
ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out -Null 
 
# 2) Störende Module -/CDN-Teile zuverlässig entfernen (wir behalten deine 
Logik, aber ohne ESModule -Doppel-Load) 
#    - three_boot  
$srcHtml = $srcHtml -replace 
'(?is)<script[^>]+src=["'']js/three_boot \.js["''][^>]*> \s*</script>',''  
#    - importmap / type=module Blöcke, die three von CDN importieren  
$srcHtml = $srcHtml -replace 
'(?is)<script[^>]*type=["'']module["''][^>]*>.*?(unpkg \.com/three|cdn \.js
delivr\.net/npm/three).*?</script>',''  
#    - weitere GLTFLoader/OrbitControls aus CDN als module  
$srcHtml = $srcHtml -replace 
'(?is)<script[^>]*type=["'']module["''][^>]*>.*?(GLTFLoader|OrbitControls
).*?</script>',''  
 
# 3) Lokale Vendor -Skripte sicherstellen (kein CDN!)  
if(!(Test -Path $VendDir)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $VendDir -
Force | Out -Null } 
$needFiles = @(  
  @{url='https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js';           
out='three.min.js'},  
  
@{url='https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls
.js'; out='OrbitControls.js'},  
  
@{url='https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader.js'
;     out='GLTFLoader.js'}  
) 
foreach($n in $needFiles){  
  $dst = Join -Path $VendDir $n.out  
  if(!(Test -Path $dst)){  
    try{ Invoke -WebRequest $n.url -OutFile $dst -UseBasicParsing -
TimeoutSec 30 }catch{ }  
  } 
} 
 
# 4) Benötigte Skripte (nur anhängen, wenn noch nicht vorhanden) – 
Reihenfolge vor Inline -3D-Code sichern (am Ende vor </body>)

  '<script src="js/vendor/three.min.js"></script>',  
  '<script>try{window.THREE=THREE}catch(e){}</script>',  
  '<script src="js/vendor/GLTFLoader.js"></script>',  
  '<script src="js/vendor/OrbitControls.js"></script>',  
  '<script src="js/kaykit_loader.js"></script>',

  '<script src="js/battle.js"></script>',

  '<script src="js/consent_fsm.js"></script>',  
  '<script src="js/ai_postprocess.js"></script>',  
  '<script src="js/consent_bridge.js"></script>'  
) 
foreach($t in $tags){

    foreach($r in $rooms){  
      $objs = $json.$r.objects  
      if(-not $objs){ continue }  
      foreach($o in $objs){

else {$o.scale=1.5} }

          if($o.position.Count -ge 3){ 
            # Heuristik: vorn/hinten → z=±12, links/rechts → x=±12

[Math]::Abs([double]$o.position[0])){  
              $o.position[2] = 
[double]([Math]::Sign([double]$o.position[2])) * 12  
            } else {  
              $o.position[0] = 
[double]([Math]::Sign([double]$o.position[0])) * 12  
            } 
          } 
        } 
      } 
    } 
    ($json | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 10) | Set -Content $CfgPath -Encoding 
UTF8 
    Write-Host "[OK] Wände nach außen & Boden skaliert → $CfgPath (Reload 
im Browser)" -Fore Green  
  }catch{ 
    Write-Host "[WARN] Konnte $CfgPath nicht anpassen – übersprungen." -
Fore Yellow  
  } 
}else{ 
  Write-Host "[INFO] Kein room_config_detailed.json gefunden – Wandalign 
übersprungen." -Fore Cyan  
} 
 
Write-Host "`nFertig. Browser **STRG+F5** auf: 
http://127.0.0.1:8000/index_3d.html" -Fore Cyan

# ==== FINAL DIGIVICE INTEGRATION (clean, single -run) 
==========================  
$Root    = "C: \NajikaCore"  
$SrcDir  = Join -Path $Root "digivice"  
$SrcIdx  = Join -Path $SrcDir "index_3d.html"  
$DstIdx  = Join -Path $Root "index_3d.html"  
$VendDir = Join -Path $Root "js \vendor" 
$CfgPath = Join -Path $Root "assets \room_config_detailed.json"  
$KayRoot = Join -Path $Root "assets \kaykit" 
 
if(!(Test -Path $SrcIdx)){  
  $alt = Get -ChildItem $SrcDir -File -Filter "index_3d*.html" | Sort -
Object LastWriteTime -desc | Select -Object -First 1 
  if(!$alt){ Write -Host "[ERR] Keine Digivice -Index im Ordner gefunden." 
-Fore Red; return }  
  $SrcIdx = $alt.FullName  
} 
 
# Backup & Laden  
if(Test-Path $DstIdx){ Copy -Item $DstIdx "$DstIdx.bak_$(Get -Date -Format 
'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')" -Force } 
$html = Get -Content $SrcIdx -Raw -Encoding UTF8  
 
# Problematische Module -/CDN-Loads entfernen (Ursache für THREE -Fehler) 
$html = $html -replace 
'(?is)<script[^>]+type=["'']module["''][^>]*src=["''][^"'']*three_boot \.j
s["''][^>]*> \s*</script>',''  
$html = $html -replace 
'(?is)<script[^>]*type=["'']module["''][^>]*>.*?</script>',''  
$html = $html -replace 
'(?is)<script[^>]+src=["'']https?://[^"'']*three[^"'']*["''][^>]*> \s*</sc
ript>',''  
$html = $html -replace 
'(?is)<script[^>]+src=["'']https?://[^"'']*/examples/jsm/[^"'']*["''][^>]
*>\s*</script>',''  
$html = $html -replace 
'(?is)\s*<script[^>]+src=["'']js/vendor/(three \.min|GLTFLoader|OrbitContr
ols)\.js["''][^>]*> \s*</script>',''  
# eventuelle Reste von __najikaReady neutralisieren  
$html = $html -replace 'window \.__najikaReady','Promise.resolve()'  
 
# Vendor -Verzeichnis und lokale Libs  
if(!(Test -Path $VendDir)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $VendDir -
Force | Out -Null } 
$dl = @(  
  @{u='https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js';                      
f='three.min.js'},  
  
@{u='https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';       
f='GLTFLoader.js'},  
  
@{u='https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.j
s';   f='OrbitControls.js'}  
) 
foreach($d in $dl){  
  $dst = Join -Path $VendDir $d.f  
  if(!(Test -Path $dst)){  
    try{ Invoke -WebRequest $d.u -OutFile $dst -UseBasicParsing -
TimeoutSec 40 }catch{  
      Write-Host "[WARN] Download fehlgeschlagen: $($d.f). Versuche 
jsDelivr..." -Fore Yellow  
      $alt = $d.u -replace 'unpkg \.com','cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm'  
      try{ Invoke -WebRequest $alt -OutFile $dst -UseBasicParsing -
TimeoutSec 40 }catch{  
        Write-Host "[ERR] Konnte $($d.f) nicht laden. Abbruch." -Fore 
Red; return  
      } 
    } 
  } 
} 
 
# Vendor -Tags direkt NACH <head> einfügen (vor jedem Inline -THREE-Code) 
$vendorBlock = @"  
  <!-- VENDOR (local, non -module) --> 
  <script src="js/vendor/three.min.js"></script>  
  <script src="js/vendor/GLTFLoader.js"></script>  
  <script src="js/vendor/OrbitControls.js"></script>  
"@ 
if($html -notmatch 'js/vendor/three \.min\.js'){ 
  $html = [regex]::Replace($html,'(?is)(<head[^>]*>)',{  
    param($m) $m.Groups[1].Value + "`r`n" + $vendorBlock  
  },1) 
} 
 
# App-Skripte in stabiler Reihenfolge (nur anhängen, wenn fehlen)  
$apps = @(  
  'js/consent_fsm.js',  
  'js/ai_postprocess.js',  
  'js/consent_bridge.js',  
  'js/room_manager.js',  
  'js/battle.js',  
  'js/kaykit_loader.js',  
  'js/najika_ai.js'  
) 
foreach($a in $apps){  
  $tag = '<script src="' + $a + '"></script>'  
  if($html -notmatch [regex]::Escape($tag)){  
    $html = $html -replace '(?i)(</body>)',("  {0}`r`n$1" -f $tag) 
  } 
} 
 
# Speichern  
Set-Content -Path $DstIdx -Value $html -Encoding UTF8  
Write-Host "[OK] index_3d.html aktualisiert (lokale THREE zuerst, keine 
Module/CDN -Doppler)" -Fore Green  
 
# Mage.glb bereitstellen (echtes Modell aus KayKit suchen, kein 0 -Byte) 
$CharDir = Join -Path $KayRoot "characters"  
if(!(Test -Path $CharDir)){ New -Item -ItemType Directory -Path $CharDir -
Force | Out -Null } 
$MageDst = Join -Path $CharDir "Mage.glb"  
if(!(Test -Path $MageDst)){  
  $candidate = Get -ChildItem $KayRoot -Recurse -File -Include 
*mage*.glb,*wizard*.glb,*hero*.glb,*character*.glb -ErrorAction 
SilentlyContinue | Select -Object -First 1 
  if($candidate){  
    Copy-Item $candidate.FullName $MageDst -Force 
    Write-Host "[OK] Mage.glb gesetzt -> $MageDst"  
  } else {  
    Write-Host "[WARN] Kein Mage.glb gefunden – KayKit-Char wird ggf. 
übersprungen." -Fore Yellow  
  } 
} 
 
# Räume justieren: Wände nach außen, Boden größer (falls config 
existiert)  
if(Test-Path $CfgPath){  
  try{ 
    $cfg = Get -Content $CfgPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom -Json 
    foreach($room in $cfg.psobject.Properties.Name){  
      $objs = $cfg.$room.objects  
      if(!$objs){ continue }  
      foreach($o in $objs){  
        if($o.model -match 'floor|tile'){ $o.scale = 
[double](([double]($o.scale|?{$_ -is [double]}) | Select -Object -First 1) 
+ 0); if( -not $o.scale){$o.scale=1}; $o.scale = 
[Math]::Round($o.scale*1.5,3) }  
        if($o.model -match 'wall' -and $o.position.Count -ge 3){ 
          if([Math]::Abs([double]$o.position[2]) -ge 
[Math]::Abs([double]$o.position[0])){  
            $o.position[2] = 12 * [Math]::Sign([double]$o.position[2])  
          } else {  
            $o.position[0] = 12 * [Math]::Sign([double]$o.position[0])  
          } 
        } 
      } 
    } 
    ($cfg | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 12) | Set -Content $CfgPath -Encoding 
UTF8 
    Write-Host "[OK] room_config_detailed.json angepasst (Wände raus, 
Boden größer)" -Fore Green  
  }catch{ Write -Host "[WARN] Konnte Räume nicht anpassen – weiter." -Fore 
Yellow }  
} else {  
  Write-Host "[INFO] Keine room_config_detailed.json – Wand/Floor -
Anpassung übersprungen."  
} 
 
Write-Host "`nFertig. Im Browser hart neu laden (STRG+F5): 
http://127.0.0.1:8000/index_3d.html" -Fore Cyan

TimeoutSec 40 }

      $alt = $d.u -replace 'unpkg \.com','cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm'  
      Invoke-WebRequest $alt -OutFile $dst -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 
40

OrbitControls.js → Consent → Room → Battle → KayKit → NajikaAI.

$Root = "C: \NajikaCore"

$need = @(  
  '<script src="js/vendor/three.min.js"></script>',  
  '<script src="js/vendor/GLTFLoader.js"></script>',

  }

  $overlay = @'

display:flex;align -items:center;justify -content:center;z -
index:99999;font:600 18px/1.4 Segoe UI,Arial">  
  Lade Najika…  
</div> 
'@ 
  $html = $html -replace '(?is)<body([^>]*)>', "<body`$1>`r`n$overlay"  
} 
 
# 4) Bootstrap einfügen: setzt THREE/Loader global, wartet bis alles da 
ist, schaltet UI frei  
$boot = @'  
<script>  
(function(){  
  // Mehrfachimporte verhindern  
  if(window.__najikaBootApplied){ return; }  
  window.__najikaBootApplied = true;  
 
  // Safety: Buttons nicht disabled lassen  
  function enableButtons(){  
    try{ 
      document.querySelectorAll('button,.nav -btn,.battle -start-
btn,.battle -btn').forEach(function(b){  
        b.disabled = false; b.style.pointerEvents='auto'; 
b.style.opacity='';  
      }); 
    }catch(e){}  
  } 
 
  // Lade-Overlay ausblenden  
  function hideLoading(){  
    var l = document.getElementById('loading');  
    if(l){ l.style.display='none'; }  
  } 
 
  // Warten bis THREE + GLTFLoader + App -Skripte vorhanden  
  function ready(){  
    return !!(window.THREE && (window.GLTFLoader || (window.THREE && 
window.THREE.GLTFLoader))  
              && window.najikaAI   // Skript geladen  
              && window.RoomManager // Räume  
              && window.KayKitLoader); // KayKit  
  } 
 
  // Ein paar Fallbacks auf Globals legen (UMD -Loader) 
  function bridge(){  
    if(window.THREE && !window.OrbitControls && 
window.THREE.OrbitControls){ window.OrbitControls = 
window.THREE.OrbitControls; }  
    if(window.THREE && !window.GLTFLoader && window.THREE.GLTFLoader){ 
window.GLTFLoader = window.THREE.GLTFLoader; }  
  } 
 
  // Start  
  function boot(){  
    bridge();  
    hideLoading();  
    enableButtons();  
    console.log('Najika bootstrap: READY');  
  } 
 
  (function waitLoop(){  
    try{ bridge(); }catch(e){}  
    if(ready()){ boot(); } else { setTimeout(waitLoop, 200); }  
  })(); 
})(); 
</script>  
'@ 
 
if($html -notmatch 'Najika bootstrap: READY'){  
  $html = $html -replace '(?is)</body>', "$boot`r`n</body>"

$newServer = @'  
# NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER - Mobile Ready  
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
from urllib.parse import urlparse  
import json  
import requests  
import os  
 
class NajikaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):  
     
    def end_headers(self):  
        # CORS für alles  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Origin', '*')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, 
OPTIONS')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Headers', '*')  
        super().end_headers()  
     
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(200)  
        self.end_headers()  
     
    def do_GET(self):  
        if self.path == '/health':  
            self.send_response(200)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type', 'application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status': 'ok', 'service': 
'Najika Server'}).encode())  
        else: 
            super().do_GET()  
     
    def do_POST(self):  
        # Proxy für OpenAI  
        if self.path == '/api/openai':  
            self.proxy_openai()  
        # Proxy für Claude  
        elif self.path == '/api/claude':  
            self.proxy_claude()  
        # Proxy für Ollama (lokal)  
        elif self.path == '/api/ollama':  
            self.proxy_ollama()  
        else: 
            self.send_error(404)  
     
    def proxy_ollama(self):  
        try: 
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content -Length'])  
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
             
            # Forward zu lokalem Ollama  
            response = requests.post(  
                'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate',  
                data=body,  
                headers={'Content -Type': 'application/json'},  
                timeout=60  
            ) 
             
            self.send_response(response.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type', 'application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(response.content)  
             
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_error(500, str(e))  
     
    def proxy_openai(self):  
        try: 
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content -Length'])  
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
            data = json.loads(body)  
             
            headers = {  
                'Authorization': f"Bearer {data['apiKey']}",  
                'Content -Type': 'application/json'  
            } 
             
            response = requests.post(  
                'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',  
                json=data['body'],  
                headers=headers,  
                timeout=30  
            ) 
             
            self.send_response(response.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type', 'application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(response.content)  
             
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_error(500, str(e))  
     
    def proxy_claude(self):  
        try: 
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content -Length'])  
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
            data = json.loads(body)  
             
            headers = {  
                'x-api-key': data['apiKey'],  
                'anthropic -version': '2023 -06-01', 
                'Content -Type': 'application/json'  
            } 
             
            response = requests.post(  
                'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',  
                json=data['body'],  
                headers=headers,  
                timeout=30  
            ) 
             
            self.send_response(response.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type', 'application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(response.content)  
             
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_error(500, str(e))  
 
if __name__ == '__main__':  
    PORT = 8000  
    os.chdir('C:/NajikaCore')  
     
    server = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', PORT), NajikaHandler)  
     
    print('='*70)  
    print('NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready)')  
    print('='*70)  
    print(f'HTTP:        http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}')  
    print(f'Health:      http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/health')  
    print(f'Ollama Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/ollama')  
    print(f'OpenAI Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/openai')  
    print(f'Claude Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/claude')  
    print('='*70)  
     
    server.serve_forever()  
'@

$mobileAI = @'  
class NajikaAI {  
    constructor() {  
        this.personality = null;  
        this.nsfwMode = false;  
        this.conversationHistory = [];  
        this.baseURL = window.location.origin;  
         
        console.log('Najika AI - Base URL:', this.baseURL);  
    } 
     
    async init() {  
        console.log('Najika AI initialized');  
        await this.loadConfig();  
         
        // Test Connection  
        try { 
            const test = await fetch(${this.baseURL}/health);  
            const data = await test.json();  
            console.log('Server Status:', data.status);  
        } catch (e) {  
            console.warn('Server offline:', e);  
        } 
    } 
     
    async loadConfig() {  
        try { 
            const response = await 
fetch('config/najika_personality_CORE.json');  
            this.personality = await response.json();  
            console.log('Personality loaded');  
        } catch (e) {  
            console.warn('Config not found');  
        } 
    } 
     
    async sendMessage(message) {  
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw aktivieren')) {  
            this.nsfwMode = true;  
            return 'NSFW -Modus aktiviert.';  
        } 
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw deaktivieren')) {  
            this.nsfwMode = false;  
            return 'NSFW -Modus deaktiviert.';  
        } 
         
        this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'user', content: message});  
        if (this.conversationHistory.length > 10) {  
            this.conversationHistory = this.conversationHistory.slice( -
10); 
        } 
         
        // Immer zuerst Ollama versuchen  
        return await this.callOllama(message);  
    } 
     
    async callOllama(message) {  
        try { 
            let systemPrompt = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist 
Najika, eine eifersüchtige 11 -jährige KI.';  
            if (this.nsfwMode) systemPrompt += ' \n\nNSFW MODE';  
             
            const context = this.conversationHistory.slice( -3).map(m =>  
                ${m.role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Najika'}: ${m.content}  
            ).join(' \n'); 
             
            const fullPrompt = ${systemPrompt} \n\n${context} \n\nUser: 
${message} \n\nNajika:;  
             
            console.log('Calling Ollama via Proxy...');  
             
            const response = await fetch(${this.baseURL}/api/ollama, {  
                method: 'POST',  
                headers: {'Content -Type': 'application/json'},  
                body: JSON.stringify({  
                    model: 'najika',  
                    prompt: fullPrompt,  
                    stream: false,  
                    options: {  
                        temperature: 0.92,  
                        repeat_penalty: 1.45,  
                        num_predict: 100  
                    } 
                }) 
            }); 
             
            if (!response.ok) {  
                throw new Error(HTTP ${response.status});  
            } 
             
            const data = await response.json();  
            const reply = data.response || 'Keine Antwort.';  
             
            this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'assistant', content: 
reply});  
             
            console.log('Najika:', reply);  
            return reply;  
             
        } catch (error) {  
            console.error('Ollama Error:', error);  
            return 'Entschuldigung, ich kann gerade nicht antworten...';  
        } 
    } 
} 
 
window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();  
 
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {  
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => 
window.najikaAI.init());  
} else {  
    window.najikaAI.init();  
} 
'@

<script>  
function toggleChat() {  
    const chat = document.getElementById('chat -container');  
    chat.style.display = chat.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 
'none'; 
} 
 
async function sendChatMessage() {  
    const input = document.getElementById('chat -input');  
    const messages = document.getElementById('chat -messages');  
    const msg = input.value.trim();  
     
    if (!msg) return;  
     
    // User message  
    const userDiv = document.createElement('div');  
    userDiv.className = 'chat -msg chat -msg-user'; 
    userDiv.textContent = msg;  
    messages.appendChild(userDiv);  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
     
    input.value = '';  
    input.disabled = true;  
     
    // Najika thinking  
    const thinkDiv = document.createElement('div');  
    thinkDiv.className = 'chat -msg chat -msg-najika';  
    thinkDiv.textContent = 'Najika denkt nach...';  
    messages.appendChild(thinkDiv);  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
     
    try { 
        const reply = await window.najikaAI.sendMessage(msg);  
         
        thinkDiv.textContent = reply;  
         
    } catch (e) {  
        thinkDiv.textContent = 'Fehler: ' + e.message;  
        thinkDiv.style.color = '#e74c3c';  
    } 
     
    input.disabled = false;  
    input.focus();  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
} 
 
// Enter key  
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {  
    const input = document.getElementById('chat -input');  
    if (input) {  
        input.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {  
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {  
                sendChatMessage();  
            } 
        }); 
    } 
}); 
</script>

# Bessere Detection -Keywords  
$fixedAI = @'  
class NajikaAI {  
    // ... (alles wie vorher bis shouldUseAPI) ...  
     
    shouldUseAPI(message) {  
        const msg = message.toLowerCase();  
         
        // SEHR SPEZIFISCHE Keywords für APIs  
        const gptKeywords = [  
            'erkläre ausführlich',  
            'schreibe einen',  
            'erstelle eine geschichte',  
            'deep dive',  
            'analysiere komplex',  
            'philosophie',  
            'psychologie'  
        ]; 
         
        const claudeKeywords = [  
            'programmiere',  
            'code', 
            'debugge',  
            'function',  
            'class',  
            'algorithm',  
            'optimize',  
            'refactor'  
        ]; 
         
        // Check Claude (prioritär für Code)  
        if (claudeKeywords.some(kw => msg.includes(kw))) {  
            console.log('   Nutze CLAUDE für Code/Analytik');  
            return 'claude';  
        } 
         
        // Check GPT (für komplexe Texte)  
        if (gptKeywords.some(kw => msg.includes(kw))) {  
            console.log('   Nutze GPT -4 für komplexe Anfrage');  
            return 'gpt';  
        } 
         
        // Längere Anfragen (>50 Wörter) → GPT  
        if (msg.split(' ').length > 50) {  
            console.log('   Nutze GPT -4 (lange Anfrage)');  
            return 'gpt';  
        } 
         
        // Standard: Llama  
        console.log('    Nutze LLAMA (Standard)');  
        return 'llama';  
    } 
     
    async sendMessage(message) {  
        // ... NSFW check wie vorher ...  
         
        const apiChoice = this.shouldUseAPI(message);  
         
        if (apiChoice === 'claude') {  
            const key = localStorage.getItem('claude_key');  
            if (key) return await this.callClaude(message, key);  
        } 
         
        if (apiChoice === 'gpt') {  
            const key = localStorage.getItem('openai_key');  
            if (key) return await this.callGPT(message, key);  
        } 
         
        // Fallback: Llama  
        return await this.callLlama(message);  
    } 
     
    // ... Rest bleibt gleich ...  
}

$battleJSPath = "C: \NajikaCore \js\battle.js"  
 
$enhancedBattleJS = @'  
// NAJIKA BATTLE SYSTEM - MIT UI 
class NajikaBattle {  
    constructor() {  
        this.player = {  
            hp: 100,  
            maxHp: 100,  
            attack: 15,  
            defense: 10,  
            speed: 12  
        }; 
         
        this.najika = {  
            hp: 150,  
            maxHp: 150,  
            attack: 20,  
            defense: 15,  
            speed: 18  
        }; 
         
        this.enemies = [];  
        this.turn = 'player';  
        this.battleActive = false;  
    } 
     
    startBattle(enemyCount = 1) {  
        console.log(Battle Start: ${enemyCount} Gegner!);  
         
        // Reset  
        this.player.hp = this.player.maxHp;  
        this.najika.hp = this.najika.maxHp;  
         
        // Gegner generieren  
        this.enemies = [];  
        for (let i = 0; i < enemyCount; i++) {  
            this.enemies.push(this.generateEnemy(i));  
        } 
         
        this.battleActive = true;  
        this.turn = 'player';  
         
        // Zeige UI  
        document.getElementById('battle -
overlay').classList.add('active');  
         
        this.updateUI();  
        this.addLog('Najika: Lass uns kämpfen, Kuja! EXPLOSION!');  
    } 
     
    endBattle() {  
        this.battleActive = false;  
        document.getElementById('battle -
overlay').classList.remove('active');  
    } 
     
    generateEnemy(index) {  
        const types = [  
            {name: 'Schwacher Gegner', hp: 40, atk: 8, def: 3},  
            {name: 'Normaler Gegner', hp: 60, atk: 12, def: 6},  
            {name: 'Starker Gegner', hp: 90, atk: 18, def: 10}  
        ]; 
         
        const type = types[Math.min(index, 2)];  
         
        return {  
            id: index,  
            name: ${type.name} ${index + 1},  
            hp: type.hp,  
            maxHp: type.hp,  
            attack: type.atk,  
            defense: type.def,  
            alive: true  
        }; 
    } 
     
    playerAttack(enemyIndex) {  
        if (!this.battleActive || this.turn !== 'player') return;  
         
        const enemy = this.enemies[enemyIndex];  
        if (!enemy || !enemy.alive) return;  
         
        const damage = Math.max(1, this.player.attack - enemy.defense + 
Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) - 5); 
        enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - damage);  
         
        this.addLog(Du greifst ${enemy.name} an! ${damage} Schaden!);  
         
        if (enemy.hp <= 0) {  
            enemy.alive = false;  
            this.addLog(${enemy.name} wurde besiegt!);  
        } 
         
        this.updateUI();  
         
        if (this.checkBattleEnd()) return;  
         
        this.turn = 'najika';  
        setTimeout(() => this.najikaAttack(), 1000);  
    } 
     
    najikaAttack() {  
        if (!this.battleActive || this.turn !== 'najika') return;  
         
        const aliveEnemies = this.enemies.filter(e => e.alive);  
        if (aliveEnemies.length === 0) return;  
         
        const target = aliveEnemies[Math.floor(Math.random() * 
aliveEnemies.length)];  
        const damage = Math.max(1, this.najika.attack - target.defense + 
Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) - 7); 
        target.hp = Math.max(0, target.hp - damage);  
         
        this.addLog(Najika: EXPLOSION! ${damage} Schaden an 
${target.name}!);  
         
        if (target.hp <= 0) {  
            target.alive = false;  
            this.addLog(${target.name} wurde vernichtet!);  
        } 
         
        this.updateUI();  
         
        if (this.checkBattleEnd()) return;  
         
        this.turn = 'enemy';  
        setTimeout(() => this.enemyTurn(), 1500);  
    } 
     
    enemyTurn() {  
        if (!this.battleActive || this.turn !== 'enemy') return;  
         
        const aliveEnemies = this.enemies.filter(e => e.alive);  
         
        aliveEnemies.forEach(enemy => {  
            const target = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'player' : 'najika';  
            const targetObj = target === 'player' ? this.player : 
this.najika;  
             
            const damage = Math.max(1, enemy.attack - targetObj.defense + 
Math.floor(Math.random() * 8) - 4); 
            targetObj.hp = Math.max(0, targetObj.hp - damage);  
             
            this.addLog(${enemy.name} greift ${target === 'player' ? 
'Dich' : 'Najika'} an! ${damage} Schaden!);  
        }); 
         
        this.updateUI();  
         
        if (this.checkBattleEnd()) return;  
         
        this.turn = 'player';  
        this.updateUI();  
    } 
     
    checkBattleEnd() {  
        const aliveEnemies = this.enemies.filter(e => e.alive).length;  
         
        if (aliveEnemies === 0) {  
            this.battleActive = false;  
            this.addLog('               SIEG! Najika: Wir haben gewonnen, Kuja!');  
            setTimeout(() => this.endBattle(), 3000);  
            return true;  
        } 
         
        if (this.player.hp <= 0 || this.najika.hp <= 0) {  
            this.battleActive = false;  
            this.addLog('       NIEDERLAGE! Najika: Wir müssen stärker 
werden!');  
            setTimeout(() => this.endBattle(), 3000);  
            return true;  
        } 
         
        return false;  
    } 
     
    updateUI() {  
        // Update Ally HP  
        this.updateHPBar('player', this.player);  
        this.updateHPBar('najika', this.najika);  
         
        // Update Enemies  
        this.updateEnemyList();  
         
        // Update Actions  
        this.updateActions();  
         
        // Update Turn Indicator  
        const indicator = document.getElementById('battle -turn-
indicator');  
        if (indicator) {  
            if (this.battleActive) {  
                if (this.turn === 'player') {  
                    indicator.textContent = ' ▶ DEIN ZUG';  
                    indicator.style.color = '#00ff41';  
                } else if (this.turn === 'najika') {  
                    indicator.textContent = ' ▶ NAJIKA\'S ZUG';  
                    indicator.style.color = '#9b59b6';  
                } else {  
                    indicator.textContent = ' ▶ GEGNER-ZUG'; 
                    indicator.style.color = '#e74c3c';  
                } 
            } else {  
                indicator.textContent = '';  
            } 
        } 
    } 
     
    updateHPBar(id, character) {  
        const bar = document.getElementById(${id} -hp-bar); 
        const text = document.getElementById(${id} -hp-text); 
         
        if (bar) {  
            const percent = (character.hp / character.maxHp) * 100;  
            bar.style.width = ${percent}%;  
        } 
         
        if (text) {  
            text.textContent = ${character.hp}/${character.maxHp};  
        } 
    } 
     
    updateEnemyList() {  
        const list = document.getElementById('enemy -list'); 
        if (!list) return;  
         
        list.innerHTML = '';  
         
        this.enemies.forEach(enemy => {  
            const div = document.createElement('div');  
            div.className = 'battle -character' + (enemy.alive ? '' : ' 
enemy-defeated');  
             
            div.innerHTML =  
                <div class="battle -character -name">${enemy.name}</div>  
                <div class="battle -hp-bar"> 
                    <div class="battle -hp-fill" style="width: ${(enemy.hp 
/ enemy.maxHp) * 100}%;"></div>  
                </div> 
                <div class="battle -hp-
text">${enemy.hp}/${enemy.maxHp}</div>  
            ; 
             
            list.appendChild(div);  
        }); 
    } 
     
    updateActions() {  
        const actions = document.getElementById('battle -actions');  
        if (!actions) return;  
         
        actions.innerHTML = '';  
         
        if (this.turn === 'player' && this.battleActive) {  
            this.enemies.forEach((enemy, i) => {  
                if (enemy.alive) {  
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');  
                    btn.className = 'battle -btn'; 
                    btn.textContent =            Angriff auf ${enemy.name};  
                    btn.onclick = () => this.playerAttack(i);  
                    actions.appendChild(btn);  
                } 
            }); 
        } else {  
            const info = document.createElement('div');  
            info.style.color = 'white';  
            info.style.textAlign = 'center';  
            info.style.padding = '20px';  
            info.textContent = this.battleActive ? 'Warte...' : 'Kampf 
beendet';  
            actions.appendChild(info);  
        } 
    } 
     
    addLog(message) {  
        const log = document.getElementById('battle -log'); 
        if (!log) return;  
         
        const entry = document.createElement('div');  
        entry.className = 'battle -log-entry'; 
        entry.textContent = message;  
         
        log.appendChild(entry);  
        log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;  
         
        console.log(message);  
    } 
} 
 
window.battle = new NajikaBattle();  
 
// Test-Funktion für Kampfraum  
if (typeof window.testBattle === 'undefined') {  
    window.testBattle = function() {  
        battle.startBattle(3);  
    }; 
} 
'@ 
 
Set-Content $battleJSPath $enhancedBattleJS -Encoding UTF8  
 
Write-Host "✓ battle.js mit UI -Funktionen aktualisiert!" -ForegroundColor 
Green

        } 
         
        $config | ConvertTo -Json -Depth 10 | Set -Content $configPath -
Encoding UTF8  
        Write-Host "✓ Kampf-Action in room_config hinzugefügt!" -
ForegroundColor Green  
    } 
}

$newServer = @'  
# NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER - Mobile Ready  
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
from urllib.parse import urlparse  
import json  
import requests  
import os  
 
class NajikaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):  
     
    def end_headers(self):  
        # CORS für alles  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Origin', '*')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, 
OPTIONS')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Headers', '*')  
        super().end_headers()  
     
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(200)  
        self.end_headers()  
     
    def do_GET(self):  
        if self.path == '/health':  
            self.send_response(200)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type', 'application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status': 'ok', 'service': 
'Najika Server'}).encode())  
        else: 
            super().do_GET()  
     
    def do_POST(self):  
        # Proxy für OpenAI  
        if self.path == '/api/openai':  
            self.proxy_openai()  
        # Proxy für Claude  
        elif self.path == '/api/claude':  
            self.proxy_claude()  
        # Proxy für Ollama (lokal)  
        elif self.path == '/api/ollama':  
            self.proxy_ollama()  
        else: 
            self.send_error(404)  
     
    def proxy_ollama(self):  
        try: 
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content -Length'])  
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
             
            # Forward zu lokalem Ollama  
            response = requests.post(  
                'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate',  
                data=body,  
                headers={'Content -Type': 'application/json'},  
                timeout=60  
            ) 
             
            self.send_response(response.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type', 'application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(response.content)  
             
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_error(500, str(e))  
     
    def proxy_openai(self):  
        try: 
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content -Length'])  
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
            data = json.loads(body)  
             
            headers = {  
                'Authorization': f"Bearer {data['apiKey']}",  
                'Content -Type': 'application/json'  
            } 
             
            response = requests.post(  
                'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',  
                json=data['body'],  
                headers=headers,  
                timeout=30  
            ) 
             
            self.send_response(response.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type', 'application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(response.content)  
             
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_error(500, str(e))  
     
    def proxy_claude(self):  
        try: 
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content -Length'])  
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)  
            data = json.loads(body)  
             
            headers = {  
                'x-api-key': data['apiKey'],  
                'anthropic -version': '2023 -06-01', 
                'Content -Type': 'application/json'  
            } 
             
            response = requests.post(  
                'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',  
                json=data['body'],  
                headers=headers,  
                timeout=30  
            ) 
             
            self.send_response(response.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type', 'application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(response.content)  
             
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_error(500, str(e))  
 
if __name__ == '__main__':  
    PORT = 8000  
    os.chdir('C:/NajikaCore')  
     
    server = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', PORT), NajikaHandler)  
     
    print('='*70)  
    print('NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready)')  
    print('='*70)  
    print(f'HTTP:        http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}')  
    print(f'Health:      http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/health')  
    print(f'Ollama Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/ollama')  
    print(f'OpenAI Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/openai')  
    print(f'Claude Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/claude')  
    print('='*70)  
     
    server.serve_forever()  
'@

$mobileAI = @'  
class NajikaAI {  
    constructor() {  
        this.personality = null;  
        this.nsfwMode = false;  
        this.conversationHistory = [];  
        this.baseURL = window.location.origin;  
         
        console.log('Najika AI - Base URL:', this.baseURL);  
    } 
     
    async init() {  
        console.log('Najika AI initialized');  
        await this.loadConfig();  
         
        // Test Connection  
        try { 
            const test = await fetch(${this.baseURL}/health);  
            const data = await test.json();  
            console.log('Server Status:', data.status);  
        } catch (e) {  
            console.warn('Server offline:', e);  
        } 
    } 
     
    async loadConfig() {  
        try { 
            const response = await 
fetch('config/najika_personality_CORE.json');  
            this.personality = await response.json();  
            console.log('Personality loaded');  
        } catch (e) {  
            console.warn('Config not found');  
        } 
    } 
     
    async sendMessage(message) {  
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw aktivieren')) {  
            this.nsfwMode = true;  
            return 'NSFW -Modus aktiviert.';  
        } 
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw deaktivieren')) {  
            this.nsfwMode = false;  
            return 'NSFW -Modus deaktiviert.';  
        } 
         
        this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'user', content: message});  
        if (this.conversationHistory.length > 10) {  
            this.conversationHistory = this.conversationHistory.slice( -
10); 
        } 
         
        // Immer zuerst Ollama versuchen  
        return await this.callOllama(message);  
    } 
     
    async callOllama(message) {  
        try { 
            let systemPrompt = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist 
Najika, eine eifersüchtige 11 -jährige KI.';  
            if (this.nsfwMode) systemPrompt += ' \n\nNSFW MODE';  
             
            const context = this.conversationHistory.slice( -3).map(m =>  
                ${m.role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Najika'}: ${m.content}  
            ).join(' \n'); 
             
            const fullPrompt = ${systemPrompt} \n\n${context} \n\nUser: 
${message} \n\nNajika:;  
             
            console.log('Calling Ollama via Proxy...');  
             
            const response = await fetch(${this.baseURL}/api/ollama, {  
                method: 'POST',  
                headers: {'Content -Type': 'application/json'},  
                body: JSON.stringify({  
                    model: 'najika',  
                    prompt: fullPrompt,  
                    stream: false,  
                    options: {  
                        temperature: 0.92,  
                        repeat_penalty: 1.45,  
                        num_predict: 100  
                    } 
                }) 
            }); 
             
            if (!response.ok) {  
                throw new Error(HTTP ${response.status});  
            } 
             
            const data = await response.json();  
            const reply = data.response || 'Keine Antwort.';  
             
            this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'assistant', content: 
reply});  
             
            console.log('Najika:', reply);  
            return reply;  
             
        } catch (error) {  
            console.error('Ollama Error:', error);  
            return 'Entschuldigung, ich kann gerade nicht antworten...';  
        } 
    } 
} 
 
window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();  
 
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {  
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => 
window.najikaAI.init());  
} else {  
    window.najikaAI.init();  
} 
'@

<script>  
function toggleChat() {  
    const chat = document.getElementById('chat -container');  
    chat.style.display = chat.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 
'none'; 
} 
 
async function sendChatMessage() {  
    const input = document.getElementById('chat -input');  
    const messages = document.getElementById('chat -messages');  
    const msg = input.value.trim();  
     
    if (!msg) return;  
     
    // User message  
    const userDiv = document.createElement('div');  
    userDiv.className = 'chat -msg chat -msg-user'; 
    userDiv.textContent = msg;  
    messages.appendChild(userDiv);  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
     
    input.value = '';  
    input.disabled = true;  
     
    // Najika thinking  
    const thinkDiv = document.createElement('div');  
    thinkDiv.className = 'chat -msg chat -msg-najika';  
    thinkDiv.textContent = 'Najika denkt nach...';  
    messages.appendChild(thinkDiv);  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
     
    try { 
        const reply = await window.najikaAI.sendMessage(msg);  
         
        thinkDiv.textContent = reply;  
         
    } catch (e) {  
        thinkDiv.textContent = 'Fehler: ' + e.message;  
        thinkDiv.style.color = '#e74c3c';  
    } 
     
    input.disabled = false;  
    input.focus();  
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;  
} 
 
// Enter key  
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {  
    const input = document.getElementById('chat -input');  
    if (input) {  
        input.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {  
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {  
                sendChatMessage();  
            } 
        }); 
    } 
}); 
</script>

# Bessere Detection -Keywords  
$fixedAI = @'  
class NajikaAI {  
    // ... (alles wie vorher bis shouldUseAPI) ...  
     
    shouldUseAPI(message) {  
        const msg = message.toLowerCase();  
         
        // SEHR SPEZIFISCHE Keywords für APIs  
        const gptKeywords = [  
            'erkläre ausführlich',  
            'schreibe einen',  
            'erstelle eine geschichte',  
            'deep dive',  
            'analysiere komplex',  
            'philosophie',  
            'psychologie'  
        ]; 
         
        const claudeKeywords = [  
            'programmiere',  
            'code', 
            'debugge',  
            'function',  
            'class',  
            'algorithm',  
            'optimize',  
            'refactor'  
        ]; 
         
        // Check Claude (prioritär für Code)  
        if (claudeKeywords.some(kw => msg.includes(kw))) {  
            console.log('   Nutze CLAUDE für Code/Analytik');  
            return 'claude';  
        } 
         
        // Check GPT (für komplexe Texte)  
        if (gptKeywords.some(kw => msg.includes(kw))) {  
            console.log('   Nutze GPT -4 für komplexe Anfrage');  
            return 'gpt';  
        } 
         
        // Längere Anfragen (>50 Wörter) → GPT  
        if (msg.split(' ').length > 50) {  
            console.log('   Nutze GPT -4 (lange Anfrage)');  
            return 'gpt';  
        } 
         
        // Standard: Llama  
        console.log('    Nutze LLAMA (Standard)');  
        return 'llama';  
    } 
     
    async sendMessage(message) {  
        // ... NSFW check wie vorher ...  
         
        const apiChoice = this.shouldUseAPI(message);  
         
        if (apiChoice === 'claude') {  
            const key = localStorage.getItem('claude_key');  
            if (key) return await this.callClaude(message, key);  
        } 
         
        if (apiChoice === 'gpt') {  
            const key = localStorage.getItem('openai_key');  
            if (key) return await this.callGPT(message, key);  
        } 
         
        // Fallback: Llama  
        return await this.callLlama(message);  
    } 
     
    // ... Rest bleibt gleich ...  
} 
'@ 
 
Write-Host "Neue API -Detection:" -ForegroundColor Yellow  
Write-Host "  - Code/Programmieren → Claude" -ForegroundColor Magenta  
Write-Host "  - Komplexe Texte → GPT -4" -ForegroundColor Blue  
Write-Host "  - Alltag → Llama" -ForegroundColor Green
