// Najika AI — Lokal zuerst, optional Cloud via Toggle + Keyphrase  
class NajikaAI {  
  constructor(){  
    this.personality = null;  
    this.nsfwMode = false;  
    this.conversationHistory = [];  
    this.baseURL = window.location.origin;  
    this.cloudMode = localStorage.getItem('najika_cloud') === '1';  
    this.cloudUnlocked = localStorage.getItem('najika_cloud_unlocked') 
=== '1';  
  } 
 
  async init(){  
    await this.loadConfig();  
    try{ 
      const r = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/health");  
      console.log("Server:", (await r.json()).status);  
    }catch(e){ console.warn("Server offline:", e); }  
    this.updateCloudBadge();  
  } 
 
  updateCloudBadge(){  
    const b = document.getElementById('cloud -badge');  
    if (!b) return;  
    b.textContent = (this.cloudMode ? '    Cloud' : '     Lokal');  
    b.style.borderColor = this.cloudMode ? '#9b59b6' : '#00ff41';  
    b.style.color = this.cloudMode ? '#9b59b6' : '#00ff41';  
  } 
 
  toggleCloudMode(){  
    if (!this.cloudUnlocked){  
      if (!confirm("Cloud ist gesperrt. Jetzt entsperren?")) return;  
      // einfache Sperre: Passphrase  
      const pass = prompt("Codewort eingeben:");  
      if ((pass||"").trim().toLowerCase() !== "alpha -omega"){ 
alert("Falsch."); return; }  
      this.cloudUnlocked = true;  
      localStorage.setItem('najika_cloud_unlocked','1');  
    } 
    this.cloudMode = !this.cloudMode;  
    localStorage.setItem('najika_cloud', this.cloudMode ? '1' : '0');  
    this.updateCloudBadge();  
  } 
 
  async loadConfig(){  
    try{ 
      const r = await fetch("config/najika_personality_CORE.json");  
      this.personality = await r.json();  
    }catch(e){ /* optional */ }  
  } 
 
  shouldUseClaude(msg){  
    const m = msg.toLowerCase();  
    return 
['code','funktion','class','algorithm','debug','refactor','programmier','
typescript','javascript','python','c#','java']  
      .some(k => m.includes(k));  
  } 
 
  async sendMessage(message){  
    const m = message.toLowerCase();  
 
    // NSFW Flags (nur Schaltertext, keine Inhalte)  
    if (m.includes("nsfw aktivieren")) { this.nsfwMode = true;  return 
"NSFW-Modus aktiviert."; }  
    if (m.includes("nsfw deaktivieren")){ this.nsfwMode = false; return 
"NSFW-Modus deaktiviert."; }  
 
    // Cloud -Schalter per Text  
    if (m.includes("cloud mode aktivieren")) { this.cloudUnlocked = true; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_cloud_unlocked','1'); this.cloudMode = true; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_cloud','1'); this.updateCloudBadge(); return 
"Cloud-Modus AKTIV."; }  
    if (m.includes("cloud mode deaktivieren")) { this.cloudMode = false; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_cloud','0'); this.updateCloudBadge(); return 
"Cloud-Modus AUS."; }  
    if (m.includes("alpha -omega")) { this.cloudUnlocked = true; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_cloud_unlocked','1'); return "Cloud 
entsperrt."; }  
 
    this.conversationHistory.push({role:"user", content:message});  
    if (this.conversationHistory.length > 10) this.conversationHistory = 
this.conversationHistory.slice( -10); 
 
    // 1) immer LOKAL versuchen  
    const local = await this.tryLocal(message);  
    if (local.ok) return local.text;  
 
    // 2) falls erlaubt + Keys da → Cloud  
    if (this.cloudMode && this.cloudUnlocked){  
      const hasClaude = !!localStorage.getItem('claude_key');  
      const hasOpenAI = !!localStorage.getItem('openai_key');  
      if (hasClaude || hasOpenAI){  
        try{ 
          const useClaude = this.shouldUseClaude(message) && hasClaude;  
          const text = useClaude ? await this.callClaude(message) : await 
this.callOpenAI(message);  
          this.conversationHistory.push({role:"assistant", 
content:text});  
          return text;  
        }catch(e){ /* fällt unten auf Fehlermeldung */ }  
      } 
    } 
 
    return "Entschuldigung, ich kann gerade nicht antworten...";  
  } 
 
  async tryLocal(message){  
    try{ 
      let system = this.personality?.content || "Du bist Najika.";  
      if (this.nsfwMode) system += " \n\nNSFW MODE";  
      const ctx = this.conversationHistory.slice( -
3).map(m=>`${m.role==="user"?"User":"Najika"}: ${m.content}`).join(" \n"); 
      const prompt = `${system} \n\n${ctx}\n\nUser: 
${message} \n\nNajika:`;  
 
      const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/ollama", {  
        method:"POST",  
        headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" },  
        body: JSON.stringify({  
          model:"najika",  
          prompt, 
          stream:false,  
          options:{ temperature:0.9, repeat_penalty:1.45, num_predict:160 
} 
        }) 
      }); 
      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+resp.status);  
      const data = await resp.json();  
      const text = data.response || "…";  
      this.conversationHistory.push({role:"assistant", content:text});  
      return { ok:true, text };  
    }catch(e){  
      console.warn("Local/Ollama fail:", e);  
      return { ok:false };  
    } 
  } 
 
  async callOpenAI(message){  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('openai_key');  
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("OpenAI -Key fehlt");  
    let system = this.personality?.content || "Du bist Najika.";  
    if (this.nsfwMode) system += " \n\nNSFW MODE";  
    const body = {  
      model: "gpt -4o-mini", 
      messages: [  
        {role:'system', content: system},  
        ...this.conversationHistory.slice( -5), 
        {role:'user', content: message}  
      ], 
      temperature: 0.9,  
      max_tokens: 250  
    }; 
    const r = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/openai", {  
      method:"POST",  
      headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" },  
      body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey, body })  
    }); 
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("OpenAI "+r.status);  
    const j = await r.json();  
    return j.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "Keine Antwort.";  
  } 
 
  async callClaude(message){  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('claude_key');  
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("Claude -Key fehlt");  
    let system = this.personality?.content || "Du bist Najika.";  
    if (this.nsfwMode) system += " \n\nNSFW MODE";  
    const body = {  
      model: "claude -3-5-sonnet-20240620",  
      max_tokens: 250,  
      system, 
      messages: [  
        ...this.conversationHistory.slice( -5), 
        {role:'user', content: message}  
      ] 
    }; 
    const r = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/claude", {  
      method:"POST",  
      headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" },  
      body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey, body })  
    }); 
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Claude "+r.status);  
    const j = await r.json();  
    return j.content?.[0]?.text || "Keine Antwort.";  
  } 
}

}else{ 
  window.najikaAI.init();

2) C:\NajikaCore \digivice \js\najika_ai.js – komplett ersetzen  
 
(Cloud-Sperre, „cloud frei“, Provider -Buttons, OpenAI/Claude via Proxy, 
Fallback -Logik) 
 
// Najika AI - lokal + Cloud (gesperrt bis "cloud frei" oder Badge -Klick) 
class NajikaAI {  
  constructor(){  
    this.personality = null;  
    this.nsfwMode = false;  
    this.conversationHistory = [];  
    this.baseURL = window.location.origin;  
 
    // Cloud -Gate + Provider  
    this.cloudAllowed = false;            //     gesperrt bis "cloud frei" 
oder Badge  
    this.cloudProvider = 'openai';        // 'openai' | 'claude' 
(Standard: GPT -4) 
  } 
 
  async init(){  
    await this.loadConfig();  
    try{ 
      const r = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/health");  
      const j = await r.json();  
      console.log("Server Status:", j.status);  
    }catch(e){ console.warn("Server offline:", e); }  
    this.updateCloudBadge();  
  } 
 
  async loadConfig(){  
    try{ 
      const r = await fetch("config/najika_personality_CORE.json");  
      this.personality = await r.json();  
    }catch(e){ console.warn("Config not found"); }  
  } 
 
  // ===== UI Controls =====  
  toggleCloudMode(){  
    this.cloudAllowed = !this.cloudAllowed;  
    this.updateCloudBadge();  
  } 
  setCloudProvider(p, promptForKey=false){  
    if (p === 'openai' || p === 'claude') {  
      this.cloudProvider = p;  
      if (promptForKey) {  
        const kname = p === 'openai' ? 'openai_key' : 'claude_key';  
        const cur = localStorage.getItem(kname) || '';  
        if (!cur) {  
          const val = window.prompt(`Bitte 
${p==='openai'?'OpenAI':'Claude'} API Key eingeben:`, '');  
          if (val) localStorage.setItem(kname, val.trim());  
        } 
      } 
      this.cloudAllowed = true; // Klick auf GPT -4 erlaubt Cloud 
automatisch  
      this.updateCloudBadge();  
    } 
  } 
  updateCloudBadge(){  
    const el = document.getElementById('cloud -badge');  
    if (!el) return;  
    if (!this.cloudAllowed){  
      el.textContent = '     Lokal'; 
      el.style.borderColor = '#00ff41';  
      el.style.color = '#00ff41';  
      el.style.background = '#111';  
      el.title = 'Cloud gesperrt – klicke zum Freigeben';  
    } else {  
      const label = this.cloudProvider === 'openai' ? 'GPT -4' : 'Claude';  
      el.textContent = `     ${label}`;  
      el.style.borderColor = '#ffaa00';  
      el.style.color = '#ffaa00';  
      el.style.background = '#1b1400';  
      el.title = 'Cloud erlaubt – klicke zum Sperren';  
    } 
  } 
 
  // ===== Chat =====  
  async sendMessage(message){  
    const m = message.trim();  
    const low = m.toLowerCase();  
 
    // Admin -Kommandos  
    if (low.includes('cloud frei')) { this.cloudAllowed = true; 
this.updateCloudBadge(); return 'Cloud -Fallback freigegeben.'; }  
    if (low.includes('cloud sperren')) { this.cloudAllowed = false; 
this.updateCloudBadge(); return 'Cloud gesperrt.'; }  
    if (low.includes('nutze gpt4')) { this.setCloudProvider('openai', 
true); return 'Provider: GPT -4.'; } 
    if (low.includes('nutze claude')) { this.setCloudProvider('claude', 
true); return 'Provider: Claude.'; }  
    if (low.includes('nsfw aktivieren')) { this.nsfwMode = true; return 
'NSFW-Modus aktiviert.'; }  
    if (low.includes('nsfw deaktivieren')) { this.nsfwMode = false; 
return 'NSFW -Modus deaktiviert.'; }  
 
    this.conversationHistory.push({ role:'user', content:m });  
    if (this.conversationHistory.length > 12) this.conversationHistory = 
this.conversationHistory.slice( -12); 
 
    // 1) Lokal versuchen (Ollama)  
    const local = await this.tryOllama(m);  
    if (local.ok) return local.text;  
 
    // 2) wenn gesperrt → Meldung  
    if (!this.cloudAllowed){  
      return 'Lokal fehlgeschlagen. Sage **cloud frei** (oder klicke    ), 
um Cloud -Fallback zu erlauben.';  
    } 
 
    // 3) Cloud gemäß Auswahl  
    if (this.cloudProvider === 'openai') {  
      const t = await this.tryOpenAI(m);  
      if (t.ok) return t.text;  
      // Fallback auf Claude falls GPT -4-Key fehlt/fehlschlägt  
      const c = await this.tryClaude(m);  
      if (c.ok) return c.text;  
    } else {  
      const c = await this.tryClaude(m);  
      if (c.ok) return c.text;  
      const t = await this.tryOpenAI(m);  
      if (t.ok) return t.text;  
    } 
 
    return 'Entschuldigung, kein Modell erreichbar.';  
  } 
 
  // ===== Prompt Helper =====  
  buildMessages(userText){  
    const system = (this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika.') + 
(this.nsfwMode ? ' \n\nNSFW MODE' : '');  
    const msgs = [{ role:'system', content: system }];  
    // Kürze Verlauf  
    const recent = this.conversationHistory.slice( -6); 
    msgs.push(...recent);  
    msgs.push({ role:'user', content: userText });  
    return msgs;  
  } 
 
  // ===== Local (Ollama) =====  
  async tryOllama(userText){  
    try{ 
      const system = (this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika.') + 
(this.nsfwMode ? ' \n\nNSFW MODE' : '');  
      const ctx = this.conversationHistory.slice( -3).map(m => 
`${m.role==='user'?'User':'Najika'}: ${m.content}`).join(' \n'); 
      const prompt = `${system} \n\n${ctx}\n\nUser: 
${userText} \n\nNajika:`;  
 
      const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + '/api/ollama', {  
        method:'POST',  
        headers:{ 'Content -Type':'application/json' },  
        body: JSON.stringify({  
          model:'najika',  
          prompt, 
          stream:false,  
          options:{ temperature:0.92, repeat_penalty:1.45, 
num_predict:200 }  
        }) 
      }); 
      if (!resp.ok) return { ok:false };  
 
      const data = await resp.json();  
      const text = (data && (data.response || data.message || 
'').toString().trim()) || 'Keine Antwort.';  
      this.conversationHistory.push({ role:'assistant', content:text });  
      return { ok:true, text };  
    }catch(e){  
      console.warn('Ollama fail:', e);  
      return { ok:false };  
    } 
  } 
 
  // ===== OpenAI via Proxy =====  
  async tryOpenAI(userText){  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('openai_key');  
    if (!apiKey) return { ok:false, text:'OpenAI Key fehlt.' };  
    try{ 
      const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + '/api/openai', {  
        method:'POST',  
        headers:{ 'Content -Type':'application/json' },  
        body: JSON.stringify({  
          apiKey, 
          body: { 
            model: 'gpt -4', 
            messages: this.buildMessages(userText),  
            temperature: 0.9,  
            max_tokens: 300  
          } 
        }) 
      }); 
      if (!resp.ok) return { ok:false };  
      const data = await resp.json();  
      const text = data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || 'Keine 
Antwort.';  
      this.conversationHistory.push({ role:'assistant', content:text });  
      return { ok:true, text };  
    }catch(e){  
      console.warn('OpenAI fail:', e);  
      return { ok:false };  
    } 
  } 
 
  // ===== Claude via Proxy =====  
  async tryClaude(userText){  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('claude_key');  
    if (!apiKey) return { ok:false, text:'Claude Key fehlt.' };  
    try{ 
      const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + '/api/claude', {  
        method:'POST',  
        headers:{ 'Content -Type':'application/json' },  
        body: JSON.stringify({  
          apiKey, 
          body: { 
            model: 'claude -3-5-sonnet-20240620',  
            max_tokens: 300,  
            system: (this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika.') + 
(this.nsfwMode ? ' \n\nNSFW MODE' : ''),  
            messages: this.conversationHistory.slice( -6).concat([{ 
role:'user', content:userText }])  
          } 
        }) 
      }); 
      if (!resp.ok) return { ok:false };  
      const data = await resp.json();  
      const text = (data?.content?.[0]?.text || '').trim() || 'Keine 
Antwort.';  
      this.conversationHistory.push({ role:'assistant', content:text });  
      return { ok:true, text };  
    }catch(e){  
      console.warn('Claude fail:', e);  
      return { ok:false };  
    } 
  } 
} 
 
window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();

} else {  
  window.najikaAI.init();  
}

    def proxy_ollama(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
            body = self.rfile.read(n)  
            r = requests.post(  
                'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate',  
                data=body,  
                headers={'Content -Type':'application/json'},  
                timeout=60  
            ) 
            # Antworte – und ignoriere, wenn Client währenddessen 
abbricht  
            try: 
                self.send_response(r.status_code)  
                self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
                self.end_headers()  
                self.wfile.write(r.content)  
            except ConnectionAbortedError:  
                # Client hat Verbindung geschlossen – still ignorieren  
                pass 
        except Exception as e:  
            # Wenn hier schon Header gesendet wurden, nichts mehr 
schicken  
            try: 
                self.send_error(500, str(e))  
            except ConnectionAbortedError:  
                pass

# NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready) - robust gegen Client -Abbrüche  
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
import json, requests, os, shutil  
 
class NajikaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):  
    def end_headers(self):  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Origin', '*')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, 
OPTIONS')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Headers', '*')  
        super().end_headers()  
 
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers()  
 
    # Verhindert WinError 10053/BrokenPipe -Stacks bei abgebrochenen 
Downloads  
    def copyfile(self, source, outputfile):  
        try: 
            shutil.copyfileobj(source, outputfile)  
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError):  
            pass  # Client hat die Verbindung geschlossen – still 
ignorieren  
 
    def do_GET(self):  
        if self.path == '/health':  
            self.send_response(200)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status':'ok','service':'Najika 
Server'}).encode())  
            return 
        return super().do_GET()  
 
    def do_POST(self):  
        if   self.path == '/api/ollama': return self.proxy_ollama()  
        elif self.path == '/api/openai': return self.proxy_openai()  
        elif self.path == '/api/claude': return self.proxy_claude()  
        else: self.send_error(404, 'Route not found')  
 
    def proxy_ollama(self):

            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))

Type':'application/json'}, timeout=60)

                self.send_response(r.status_code)  
                self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
                self.wfile.write(r.content)  
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError):  
                pass 
        except Exception as e:  
            try: self.send_error(500, str(e))  
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError): pass

        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))

                                       'Content -

ConnectionAbortedError):  
                pass 
        except Exception as e:

            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError): pass

# NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready) – Root wählbar + '/' -> 
index_3d.html  
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
import json, requests, os, shutil  
 
HTTP_ROOT = os.environ.get('NAJIKA_HTTP_ROOT', r'C: \NajikaCore')  # < - 
Default: Skelett -Root 
 
class NajikaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):  
    def end_headers(self):  
        # CORS 
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Origin', '*')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, 
OPTIONS')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Headers', '*')  
        # Anti-Cache (damit nie alte Dateien kleben)  
        self.send_header('Cache -Control', 'no -store, no -cache, must -
revalidate, max -age=0') 
        self.send_header('Pragma', 'no -cache') 
        self.send_header('Expires', '0')  
        super().end_headers()  
 
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers()  
 
    # stille Behandlung bei Client -Abbruch (WinError 10053)  
    def copyfile(self, source, outputfile):  
        try: 
            shutil.copyfileobj(source, outputfile)  
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError):  
            pass 
 
    def do_GET(self):  
        if self.path == '/health':  
            self.send_response(200)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status':'ok','service':'Najika 
Server'}).encode()); return  
        # immer auf index_3d.html umbiegen  
        if self.path in ('/', '/index.html'):  
            self.path = '/index_3d.html'  
        return super().do_GET()  
 
    def do_POST(self):  
        if   self.path == '/api/ollama': return self.proxy_ollama()  
        elif self.path == '/api/openai': return self.proxy_openai()  
        elif self.path == '/api/claude': return self.proxy_claude()  
        else: self.send_error(404, 'Route not found')  
 
    def proxy_ollama(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); body = 
self.rfile.read(n)  
            r = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate', 
data=body,  
                              headers={'Content -
Type':'application/json'}, timeout=60)  
            try: 
                self.send_response(r.status_code)  
                self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
                self.wfile.write(r.content)  
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError): pass  
        except Exception as e:  
            try: self.send_error(500, str(e))  
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError): pass  
 
    def proxy_openai(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
            data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))  
            r = 
requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',  
                              json=data['body'],  
                              headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer 
{data['apiKey']}",  
                                       'Content -
Type':'application/json'}, timeout=45)  
            try: 
                self.send_response(r.status_code)  
                self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
                self.wfile.write(r.content)  
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError): pass  
        except Exception as e:  
            try: self.send_error(500, str(e))  
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError): pass  
 
    def proxy_claude(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
            data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))  
            r = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',  
                              json=data['body'],  
                              headers={'x -api-key': data['apiKey'],  
                                       'anthropic -version':'2023 -06-01', 
                                       'Content -
Type':'application/json'}, timeout=45)  
            try: 
                self.send_response(r.status_code)  
                self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
                self.wfile.write(r.content)  
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError): pass  
        except Exception as e:  
            try: self.send_error(500, str(e))  
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, 
ConnectionAbortedError): pass

        const target=Math.atan2(d.x,d.z), cur=najika.rotation.y, 
diff=((target -cur+Math.PI)%(Math.PI*2)) -Math.PI;

// Najika AI – Lokal (Ollama) mit optionalem Cloud -Fallback + Provider -
Buttons 
class NajikaAI {  
  constructor(){  
    this.personality = null;  
    this.nsfwMode = false;  
    this.history = [];  
    this.baseURL = window.location.origin;  
 
    this.provider = localStorage.getItem('najika_provider') || 'ollama'; 
// 'ollama' | 'openai' | 'claude'  
    this.cloudAllowed = localStorage.getItem('najika_cloud_allowed') === 
'1'; 
  } 
 
  async init(){  
    await this.loadConfig();  
    // Health -Check nur fürs Log  
    try{ 
      const r = await fetch(this.baseURL + '/health', {cache:'no -
store'});  
      console.log('Server Status:', (await r.json()).status);  
    }catch(e){ console.warn('Server offline:', e); }  
    this.updateBadges();  
  } 
 
  async loadConfig(){  
    try{ 
      const r = await fetch('config/najika_personality_CORE.json', 
{cache:'no -store'});  
      this.personality = await r.json();  
      console.log('Personality geladen');  
    }catch(e){ console.warn('Personality fehlt (ok)'); }  
  } 
 
  // === UI Helpers ===  
  updateBadges(){  
    const cb = document.getElementById('cloud -badge');  
    if (cb) cb.textContent = this.cloudAllowed ? '     Cloud' : '     
Lokal'; 
 
    const mark = (id, p) => {  
      const el = document.getElementById(id);  
      if (!el) return;  
      el.style.borderColor = (this.provider === p) ? '#00ff41' : '#555';  
      el.style.opacity = (this.provider === p) ? '1' : '0.75';  
    }; 
    mark('prov -ollama','ollama');  
    mark('prov -openai','openai');  
    mark('prov -claude','claude');  
  } 
  // Rückwärts -Kompatibilität  
  updateCloudBadge(){ this.updateBadges(); }  
 
  toggleCloudMode(){  
    this.cloudAllowed = !this.cloudAllowed;  
    localStorage.setItem('najika_cloud_allowed', this.cloudAllowed ? '1' 
: '0'); 
    this.updateBadges();  
  } 
 
  setProvider(p){  
    this.provider = p;  
    localStorage.setItem('najika_provider', p);  
    this.updateBadges();  
  } 
 
  // === Chat ===  
  async sendMessage(message){  
    const m = message.toLowerCase();  
    if (m.includes('nsfw aktivieren')) { this.nsfwMode = true;  return 
'NSFW-Modus aktiviert.'; }  
    if (m.includes('nsfw deaktivieren')){ this.nsfwMode = false; return 
'NSFW-Modus deaktiviert.'; }  
    if (m.includes('cloud frei') || m.includes('cloud unlock')) {  
      this.cloudAllowed = true; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_cloud_allowed','1'); this.updateBadges();  
      return 'Cloud -Fallback freigegeben.';  
    } 
 
    this.history.push({role:'user', content:message});  
    if (this.history.length > 10) this.history = this.history.slice( -10); 
 
    // Primärer Provider  
    try{ 
      if (this.provider === 'ollama') return await 
this.tryOllama(message, true);  
      if (this.provider === 'openai') return await 
this.callOpenAI(message);  
      if (this.provider === 'claude') return await 
this.callClaude(message);  
    }catch(e){ /* fällt unten in Fallback */ }  
 
    // Automatischer Fallback (wenn erlaubt)  
    if (this.cloudAllowed){  
      try{ return await this.callOpenAI(message); }catch(_){}  
      try{ return await this.callClaude(message); }catch(_){}  
    } 
    return 'Lokal fehlgeschlagen. Sage **cloud frei** (oder klicke    ), 
um Cloud -Fallback zu erlauben.';  
  } 
 
  // === Ollama (lokal) ===  
  async tryOllama(message, allowFallback){  
    try{ 
      return await this.callOllama(message);  
    }catch(err){  
      console.warn('Ollama Error:', err);  
      if (allowFallback && this.cloudAllowed){  
        try{ return await this.callOpenAI(message); }catch(_){}  
        try{ return await this.callClaude(message); }catch(_){}  
      } 
      throw err;  
    } 
  } 
 
  systemPrompt(){  
    let p = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika, eine 
beschützende KI -Begleiterin.';  
    if (this.nsfwMode) p += ' \n\n(NSFW MODE)';  
    return p;  
  } 
 
  // === Provider Calls ===  
  async callOllama(message){  
    const ctx = this.history.slice( -
3).map(m=>`${m.role==='user'?'User':'Najika'}: ${m.content}`).join(' \n'); 
    const prompt = `${this.systemPrompt()} \n\n${ctx}\n\nUser: 
${message} \n\nNajika:`;  
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + '/api/ollama', {  
      method: 'POST',  
      headers: {'Content -Type':'application/json'},  
      body: JSON.stringify({  
        model: 'najika',  
        prompt, 
        stream: false,  
        options: { temperature: 0.9, repeat_penalty: 1.4, num_predict: 
160 } 
      }) 
    }); 
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('Ollama HTTP '+resp.status);  
    const data = await resp.json();  
    const reply = data.response || '…';  
    this.history.push({role:'assistant', content:reply});  
    return reply;  
  } 
 
  async callOpenAI(message){  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('openai_key');  
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('OpenAI Key fehlt');  
    const body = {  
      model: 'gpt -4o-mini', 
      messages: [  
        { role: 'system', content: this.systemPrompt() },  
        { role: 'user',   content: message }  
      ], 
      temperature: 0.9,  
      max_tokens: 250  
    }; 
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + '/api/openai', {  
      method: 'POST',  
      headers: {'Content -Type':'application/json'},  
      body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey, body })  
    }); 
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('OpenAI HTTP '+resp.status);  
    const data = await resp.json();  
    const reply = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '…';  
    this.history.push({role:'assistant', content:reply});  
    return reply;  
  } 
 
  async callClaude(message){  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('claude_key');  
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('Claude Key fehlt');  
    const body = {  
      model: 'claude -3-5-sonnet-2024-06-20', 
      max_tokens: 300,  
      messages: [  
        { role: 'user', content: `${this.systemPrompt()} \n\n${message}` }  
      ] 
    }; 
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + '/api/claude', {  
      method: 'POST',  
      headers: {'Content -Type':'application/json'},  
      body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey, body })  
    }); 
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('Claude HTTP '+resp.status);  
    const data = await resp.json();  
    const reply = data.content?.[0]?.text || '…';  
    this.history.push({role:'assistant', content:reply});  
    return reply;  
  } 
} 
 
// Global  
window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();  
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {  
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ()=> 
window.najikaAI.init());  
} else {  
  window.najikaAI.init();  
}

# NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready)  
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
import json, requests, os, sys  
 
HTTP_ROOT = os.environ.get("NAJIKA_HTTP_ROOT", r"C: \NajikaCore \digivice")  
 
class NajikaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):  
    # ---- CORS ---- 
    def end_headers(self):  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Origin', '*')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, 
OPTIONS')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Headers', '*')  
        super().end_headers()  
 
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(200)  
        self.end_headers()  
 
    # ---- ROUTES ---- 
    def do_GET(self):  
        if self.path == '/health':  
            self.send_response(200)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status':'ok','service':'Najika 
Server'}).encode())  
            return 
        return super().do_GET()  
 
    def do_POST(self):  
        p = self.path.rstrip('/')  # tolerant gegen /api/ollama/  
        if   p == '/api/ollama': self.proxy_ollama()  
        elif p == '/api/openai': self.proxy_openai()  
        elif p == '/api/claude': self.proxy_claude()  
        else: 
            self.send_error(404, 'Route not found')  
 
    # ---- PROXIES ---- 
    def _safe_write(self, content: bytes):  
        try: 
            self.wfile.write(content)  
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionAbortedError):  
            # Client hat Verbindung abgebrochen – ignorieren  
            pass 
 
    def proxy_ollama(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
            body = self.rfile.read(n)  
            r = requests.post(  
                'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate',  
                data=body,  
                headers={'Content -Type':'application/json'},  
                timeout=60  
            ) 
            self.send_response(r.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(r.content)  
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_response(502)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(json.dumps({'error':str(e)}).encode())  
 
    def proxy_openai(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
            data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))  
            r = requests.post(  
                'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',  
                json=data['body'],  
                headers={  
                    'Authorization': f"Bearer {data['apiKey']}",  
                    'Content -Type':'application/json'  
                }, 
                timeout=45  
            ) 
            self.send_response(r.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(r.content)  
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_response(502)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(json.dumps({'error':str(e)}).encode())  
 
    def proxy_claude(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0'))  
            data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))  
            r = requests.post(  
                'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',  
                json=data['body'],  
                headers={  
                    'x-api-key': data['apiKey'],  
                    'anthropic -version':'2023 -06-01', 
                    'Content -Type':'application/json'  
                }, 
                timeout=45  
            ) 
            self.send_response(r.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(r.content)  
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_response(502)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json')  
            self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(json.dumps({'error':str(e)}).encode())  
 
if __name__ == '__main__':  
    os.chdir(HTTP_ROOT)  
    port = 8000  
    httpd = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), NajikaHandler)  
    print("="*70)  
    print("NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready)")  
    print("="*70)  
    print(f"HTTP Root:   {HTTP_ROOT}")  
    url = f"http://localhost:{port}"  
    print(f"HTTP:        {url}")  
    print(f"Health:      {url}/health")  
    print(f"Ollama:      {url}/api/ollama")  
    print(f"OpenAI:      {url}/api/openai")  
    print(f"Claude:      {url}/api/claude")  
    print("="*70)  
    try: 
        httpd.serve_forever()  
    except KeyboardInterrupt:  
        pass 
    finally:  
        httpd.server_close()

// Najika AI – Lokal/Cloud + Provider -Umschaltung (GPT -4 / Claude) + 
Badge/Buttons  
class NajikaAI {  
  constructor() {  
    this.baseURL = window.location.origin;  
    this.personality = null;  
 
    // Zustand  
    this.allowCloud = 
JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('najika_allow_cloud')||'false');  
    this.provider = localStorage.getItem('najika_provider') || 'ollama'; 
// 'ollama'|'openai'|'claude'  
    this.conversationHistory = [];  
 
    // UI 
    this.panelEl = null;  
  } 
 
  // ----------  Init ----------  
  async init() {  
    await this.loadConfig();  
    this.mountControls();  
 
    // Server Health  
    try { 
      const r = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/health", {cache:'no -
store'});  
      const j = await r.json();  
      console.log("Health:", j);  
    } catch (e) {  
      console.warn("Health check failed:", e);  
    } 
  } 
 
  async loadConfig() {  
    try { 
      const r = await fetch("config/najika_personality_CORE.json", 
{cache:'no -store'});  
      this.personality = await r.json();  
    } catch {  
      this.personality = {content: "Du bist Najika, ein quirliger KI -
Begleiter."};  
    } 
  } 
 
  // ----------  UI ----------  
  mountControls() {  
    // Panel oben rechts  
    let host = document.getElementById('cloud -panel');  
    if (!host) {  
      host = document.createElement('div');  
      host.id = 'cloud -panel'; 
      host.style.position = 'fixed';  
      host.style.top = '10px';  
      host.style.right = '10px';  
      host.style.zIndex = '2000';  
      document.body.appendChild(host);  
    } 
    host.innerHTML = `  
      <div id="najika -cloud-panel" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex -
wrap:wrap;justify -content:flex -end"> 
        <button id="cloud -toggle" 
          style="padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid 
#00ff41;background:#111;color:#00ff41;border -radius:10px;font -
weight:700;min -width:110px">  
          ${this.allowCloud ? '     Cloud' : '     Lokal'} 
        </button>  
        <button id="prov -local"  style="padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid 
#888;background:#111;color:#ddd;border -radius:10px">Lokal</button>  
        <button id="prov -gpt4"   style="padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid 
#888;background:#111;color:#ddd;border -radius:10px">GPT -4</button>  
        <button id="prov -claude" style="padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid 
#888;background:#111;color:#ddd;border -radius:10px">Claude</button>  
      </div> 
    `; 
    this.panelEl = host;  
 
    const setActive = () => {  
      ['prov-local','prov -gpt4','prov -claude'].forEach(id=>{  
        const el = document.getElementById(id);  
        const on = (id==='prov -local'  && this.provider==='ollama') ||  
                   (id==='prov -gpt4'   && this.provider==='openai') ||  
                   (id==='prov -claude' && this.provider==='claude');  
        el.style.borderColor = on ? '#00ff41' : '#888';  
        el.style.color = on ? '#00ff41' : '#ddd';  
      }); 
      document.getElementById('cloud -toggle').textContent = 
this.allowCloud ? '     Cloud' : '     Lokal'; 
      document.getElementById('cloud -toggle').style.borderColor = 
this.allowCloud ? '#00ff41' : '#00ff41';  
      document.getElementById('cloud -toggle').style.color = '#00ff41';  
    }; 
    setActive();  
 
    document.getElementById('cloud -toggle').onclick = () => {  
      this.toggleCloudMode();  
      setActive();  
    }; 
    document.getElementById('prov -local').onclick = () => { 
this.setProvider('ollama'); setActive(); };  
    document.getElementById('prov -gpt4').onclick  = () => { 
this.setProvider('openai'); setActive(); };  
    document.getElementById('prov -claude').onclick= () => { 
this.setProvider('claude'); setActive(); };  
  } 
 
  toggleCloudMode() {  
    this.allowCloud = !this.allowCloud;  
    localStorage.setItem('najika_allow_cloud', 
JSON.stringify(this.allowCloud));  
  } 
  setProvider(p) {  
    this.provider = p;  
    localStorage.setItem('najika_provider', p);  
  } 
  updateCloudBadge() { /* kompatibel zu altem HTML */ 
this.mountControls(); }  
 
  // ----------  Chat ----------  
  async sendMessage(message) {  
    // Sprach -Trigger 
    const m = message.toLowerCase();  
    if (m.includes('cloud frei')) { this.allowCloud = true; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_allow_cloud','true'); this.mountControls(); 
return 'Cloud -Fallback freigegeben. ✓'; } 
    if (m.includes('cloud zu')) { this.allowCloud = false; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_allow_cloud','false'); this.mountControls(); 
return 'Cloud -Fallback gesperrt. ✓'; } 
 
    const sys = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika.';  
    this.conversationHistory.push({role:'user', content: message});  
    if (this.conversationHistory.length > 16) this.conversationHistory = 
this.conversationHistory.slice( -16); 
 
    // 1) bevorzugten Provider  
    try { 
      if (this.provider === 'ollama') {  
        const reply = await this.callOllama(sys, message);  
        if (reply) return reply;  
      } else if (this.provider === 'openai') {  
        const reply = await this.callOpenAI(sys, message);  
        if (reply) return reply;  
      } else if (this.provider === 'claude') {  
        const reply = await this.callClaude(sys, message);  
        if (reply) return reply;  
      } 
    } catch {}  
 
    // 2) Fallback -Kaskade 
    if (this.provider !== 'ollama') {  
      // bevorzugt Cloud gewählt → optional lokal probieren?  
      try { 
        const reply = await this.callOllama(sys, message);  
        if (reply) return reply;  
      } catch {}  
    } 
    if (this.allowCloud) {  
      // Cloud -Reihenfolge: OpenAI → Claude  
      try { 
        const reply = await this.callOpenAI(sys, message);  
        if (reply) return reply;  
      } catch {}  
      try { 
        const reply = await this.callClaude(sys, message);  
        if (reply) return reply;  
      } catch {}  
    } 
 
    return 'Lokal fehlgeschlagen. Sage **cloud frei** (oder klicke    ), 
um Cloud -Fallback zu erlauben.';  
  } 
 
  // ----------  Providers ----------  
  async callOllama(systemPrompt, message) {  
    const ctx = this.buildPlainContext();  
    const prompt = `${systemPrompt} \n\n${ctx}\n\nUser: 
${message} \n\nNajika:`;  
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/ollama", {  
      method:"POST",  
      headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" },  
      body: JSON.stringify({  
        model:"najika",  
        prompt, 
        stream:false,  
        options:{ temperature:0.9, repeat_penalty:1.45, num_predict:200 }  
      }) 
    }); 
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('ollama http '+resp.status);  
    const data = await resp.json();  
    const reply = (data && data.response) ? data.response.trim() : '';  
    if (reply) this.conversationHistory.push({role:'assistant', content: 
reply});  
    return reply;  
  } 
 
  async callOpenAI(systemPrompt, message) {  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('openai_key') || '';  
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('openai key missing');  
    const body = {  
      model: "gpt -4o-mini", 
      messages: [  
        {role:"system", content: systemPrompt},  
        ...this.buildMessages(),  
        {role:"user", content: message}  
      ], 
      temperature: 0.9  
    }; 
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/openai", {  
      method:"POST",  
      headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" },  
      body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey, body })  
    }); 
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('openai http '+resp.status);  
    const j = await resp.json();  
    const reply = j?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || '';  
    if (reply) this.conversationHistory.push({role:'assistant', content: 
reply});  
    return reply;  
  } 
 
  async callClaude(systemPrompt, message) {  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('claude_key') || '';  
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error('claude key missing');  
    const body = {  
      model: "claude -3-5-sonnet-20240620",  
      system: systemPrompt,  
      messages: [  
        ...this.buildMessages().map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: 
m.content })),  
        {role:"user", content: message}  
      ], 
      max_tokens: 500,  
      temperature: 0.9  
    }; 
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/claude", {  
      method:"POST",  
      headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" },  
      body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey, body })  
    }); 
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('claude http '+resp.status);  
    const j = await resp.json();  
    const reply = j?.content?.[0]?.text?.trim() || '';  
    if (reply) this.conversationHistory.push({role:'assistant', content: 
reply});  
    return reply;  
  } 
 
  // ----------  Helpers ----------  
  buildPlainContext() {  
    const last = this.conversationHistory.slice( -6) 
      .map(m => `${m.role==='user'?'User':'Najika'}: 
${m.content}`).join(' \n'); 
    return last;  
  } 
  buildMessages() {  
    return this.conversationHistory.slice( -6); 
  } 
} 
 
window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();  
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {  
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => 
window.najikaAI.init());  
} else {  
  window.najikaAI.init();  
}

// Räume: Wände automatisch an den Rand legen & durchziehen (Rechteck 
30x30) 
(function () {  
  function autoFit() {  
    try { 
      const scene = window.scene;  
      if (!scene) return;  
 
      // Suche eine geladene "wall" -Instanz als Vorlage  
      let template = null;  
      scene.traverse(o => {  
        const n = (o.name || '').toLowerCase();  
        if (!template && (n.includes('wall') || n === 'wall') ) template 
= o.parent || o;  
      }); 
      if (!template) return;  
 
      // Dupliziere 4 Seiten, Original ausblenden  
      const parent = template.parent || scene;  
      const clones = [];  
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {  
        const w = template.clone(true);  
        w.name = 'wall_auto_' + i;  
        w.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh) { m.castShadow = true; 
m.receiveShadow = true; } });  
        parent.add(w);  
        clones.push(w);  
      } 
      template.visible = false;  
 
      // Rand-Kanten setzen (Quadrat 30 x 30 um Ursprung)  
      const size = 30, half = size / 2;  
      // Z- (hinten)  
      clones[0].position.set(0, 0, -half); 
      clones[0].rotation.set(0, 0, 0);  
      clones[0].scale.set(size, 1, 1);  
      // X+ (rechts)  
      clones[1].position.set(half, 0, 0);  
      clones[1].rotation.set(0, Math.PI/2, 0);  
      clones[1].scale.set(size, 1, 1);  
      // Z+ (vorn)  
      clones[2].position.set(0, 0, half);  
      clones[2].rotation.set(0, Math.PI, 0);  
      clones[2].scale.set(size, 1, 1);  
      // X- (links) 
      clones[3].position.set( -half, 0, 0);  
      clones[3].rotation.set(0, -Math.PI/2, 0);  
      clones[3].scale.set(size, 1, 1);  
    } catch (e) {  
      console.warn('autoFitWalls error:', e);  
    } 
  } 
 
  // läuft bei jedem Raumwechsel (Event wird von index_3d.html gefeuert)  
  window.addEventListener('najika -room-loaded', () => setTimeout(autoFit, 
50)); 
  // Fallback beim ersten Laden  
  if (window.scene) setTimeout(autoFit, 300);  
 
  // globaler Hook (falls manuell gebraucht)  
  window.autoFitWalls = autoFit;  
})();

  <script type="module">  
    import * as THREE from 'three';  
    import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';  
    import { OrbitControls } from 
'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';  
 
    // --- Scene --- 
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();  
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0e27);  
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0a0e27, 10, 50);  
    window.scene = scene; // < — global verfügbar für Helfer  
 
    const canvas = document.getElementById('three -canvas');  
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, canvas.clientWidth / 
canvas.clientHeight, 0.1, 100);  
    camera.position.set(0, 4, 12);  
 
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true 
}); 
    renderer.setSize(canvas.clientWidth, canvas.clientHeight);  
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));  
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;  
 
    const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas);  
    controls.enableDamping = true;  
    controls.minDistance = 1;  
    controls.maxDistance = 30;  
 
    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));  
    const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.9);  
    dirLight.position.set(5, 10, 5);  
    dirLight.castShadow = true;  
    scene.add(dirLight);  
 
    const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x00ff41, 0.4, 10);  
    pointLight.position.set(0, 2, 2);  
    scene.add(pointLight);  
 
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(  
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(15, 64),  
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2a2a2a, roughness: 0.8 })  
    ); 
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;  
    ground.receiveShadow = true;  
    scene.add(ground);  
 
    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(30, 30, 0x00ff41, 0x333333);  
    grid.position.y = 0.01;  
    scene.add(grid);  
 
    // --- Najika Charakter --- 
    let najika = null;  
    const loader = new GLTFLoader();  
    window.loader = loader;  
 
    loader.load('assets/characters/najika.glb', (gltf) => {  
      najika = gltf.scene;  
      najika.position.set(0, 0.5, 0);  
      najika.scale.set(1, 1, 1);  
      najika.traverse(child => { if (child.isMesh) child.castShadow = 
true; });  
      scene.add(najika);  
      document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';  
    }); 
 
    // --- Movement --- 
    const keys = {};  
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = 
true); 
    window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = 
false); 
 
    function updateMovement() {  
      if (!najika) return;  
      const speed = 0.15;  
      let moved = false;  
      const direction = {x: 0, z: 0};  
      if (keys['w']) { direction.z -= 1; moved = true; }  
      if (keys['s']) { direction.z += 1; moved = true; }  
      if (keys['a']) { direction.x -= 1; moved = true; }  
      if (keys['d']) { direction.x += 1; moved = true; }  
      if (moved) {  
        const length = Math.hypot(direction.x, direction.z);  
        if (length > 0) { direction.x /= length; direction.z /= length; }  
        najika.position.x += direction.x * speed;  
        najika.position.z += direction.z * speed;  
        const targetAngle = Math.atan2(direction.x, direction.z);  
        const currentAngle = najika.rotation.y;  
        let angleDiff = targetAngle - currentAngle;  
        let shortestAngle = ((angleDiff + Math.PI) % (Math.PI * 2)) - 
Math.PI;  
        najika.rotation.y += shortestAngle * 0.15;  
        najika.position.x = Math.max( -20, Math.min(20, 
najika.position.x));  
        najika.position.z = Math.max( -20, Math.min(20, 
najika.position.z));  
        const time = Date.now() * 0.005;  
        najika.position.y = 0.5 + Math.sin(time) * 0.05;  
      } else {  
        najika.position.y += (0.5 - najika.position.y) * 0.1;  
      } 
    } 
 
    // --- Rooms --- 
    let currentRoom = 'living';  
    window.currentRoom = currentRoom;  
    let environmentObjects = [];  
 
    const rooms = {  
      living:   { name: 'Wohnraum',     camera:[0,4,12], 
actions:[{id:'sleep',label:'        
Schlafen',class:'sleep'},{id:'eat',label:'      
Essen',class:'food'},{id:'toilet',label:'    Toilette',class:'toilet'}] },  
      training: { name: 'Training',     camera:[0,2,14], 
actions:[{id:'strength',label:'       
Kraft',class:''},{id:'agility',label:'                    Geschick',class:''}] },  
      study:    { name: 'Studienraum',  camera:[0,3,10], 
actions:[{id:'learn',label:'        Lernen',class:''},{id:'craft',label:'     
Craften',class:''}] },  
      hospital: { name: 
'Krankenstation',camera:[2,4,10],actions:[{id:'heal',label:'     
Heilen',class:''}] },  
      battle:   { name: 'Kampfarena',   camera:[6,4,16], 
actions:[{id:'fight',label:'            Kämpfen',class:''}] },  
      music:    { name: 'Musikraum',    camera:[0,3,10], 
actions:[{id:'relax',label:'   Entspannen',class:''}] },  
      terminal: { name: 'Terminal',     camera:[0,3,8],  
actions:[{id:'access',label:'        Zugriff',class:''}] }  
    }; 
    window.rooms = rooms;  
 
    function loadRoomEnvironment(roomId) {  
      // alte Objekte raus  
      environmentObjects.forEach(obj => {  
        scene.remove(obj);  
        if (obj.geometry) obj.geometry.dispose();  
        if (obj.material) obj.material.dispose();  
      }); 
      environmentObjects = [];  
 
      fetch('assets/room_config_detailed.json').then(r => 
r.json()).then(config => {  
        const roomData = config[roomId];  
        if (!roomData || !roomData.objects) {  
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event('najika -room-loaded'));  
          return; 
        } 
        let pending = roomData.objects.length;  
        roomData.objects.forEach(objData => {  
          loader.load('assets/rooms/' + roomId + '/' + objData.model, 
(gltf) => {  
            const obj = gltf.scene;  
            const nameHint = (objData.model||'').toLowerCase();  
            if (nameHint.includes('wall')) obj.name = 'wall';  
            obj.position.set(objData.position[0], objData.position[1], 
objData.position[2]);  
            obj.rotation.set(objData.rotation[0], objData.rotation[1], 
objData.rotation[2]);  
            obj.scale.setScalar(objData.scale);  
            obj.traverse(child => { if (child.isMesh) { child.castShadow 
= true; child.receiveShadow = true; }});  
            scene.add(obj);  
            environmentObjects.push(obj);  
            pending--; 
            if (pending === 0) {  
              // Event: Raum fertig geladen  
              window.dispatchEvent(new Event('najika -room-loaded'));  
            } 
          }, undefined, () => {  
            // Fehler → trotzdem runterzählen  
            pending--; 
            if (pending === 0) window.dispatchEvent(new Event('najika -
room-loaded'));  
          }); 
        }); 
      }); 
    } 
 
    function updateRoomActions(roomId) {  
      const actionsDiv = document.getElementById('room -actions');  
      const room = rooms[roomId];  
      if (!room || !room.actions || room.actions.length === 0) { 
actionsDiv.style.display = 'none'; return; }  
      actionsDiv.style.display = 'flex';  
      actionsDiv.innerHTML = '';  
      room.actions.forEach(action => {  
        const btn = document.createElement('button');  
        btn.className = 'room -action-btn ' + action.class;  
        btn.textContent = action.label;  
        btn.onclick = () => performAction(action.id);  
        actionsDiv.appendChild(btn);  
      }); 
    } 
 
    function performAction(actionId) {  
      switch(actionId) {  
        case 'sleep':  break;  
        case 'eat':    break;  
        case 'toilet': break;  
        case 'strength':  
        case 'agility':  
        case 'learn':  
        case 'craft':  
        case 'heal':  
        case 'fight':  
        case 'relax':  
          break; 
        case 'access': openTerminal(); break;  
      } 
    } 
 
    function switchRoom(roomId) {  
      if (!rooms[roomId]) return;  
      currentRoom = roomId;  
      window.currentRoom = currentRoom;  
 
      loadRoomEnvironment(roomId);  
      updateRoomActions(roomId);  
 
      const room = rooms[roomId];  
      const start = {x: camera.position.x, y: camera.position.y, z: 
camera.position.z};  
      const duration = 800, startTime = Date.now();  
      const animateCamera = () => {  
        const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime, p = Math.min(elapsed / 
duration, 1), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3); 
        camera.position.x = start.x + (room.camera[0] - start.x) * e;  
        camera.position.y = start.y + (room.camera[1] - start.y) * e;  
        camera.position.z = start.z + (room.camera[2] - start.z) * e;  
        if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(animateCamera);  
      }; 
      animateCamera();  
 
      document.getElementById('room -info').textContent = room.name;  
      document.getElementById('menu -btn').textContent = room.name;  
    } 
    window.switchRoom = switchRoom;  
 
    // --- UI Wiring --- 
    const menuBtn = document.getElementById('menu -btn'); 
    const roomMenu = document.getElementById('room -menu'); 
    menuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => 
roomMenu.classList.toggle('active'));  
    document.querySelectorAll('.room -item').forEach(item => {  
      item.addEventListener('click', () => {  
        switchRoom(item.dataset.room);  
        document.querySelectorAll('.room -item').forEach(r => 
r.classList.remove('current'));  
        item.classList.add('current');  
        roomMenu.classList.remove('active');  
      }); 
    }); 
 
    // Pfeil -Buttons unten  
    document.getElementById('btn -left')?.addEventListener('click', () => 
{ 
      const ids = Object.keys(rooms); const i = ids.indexOf(currentRoom);  
      switchRoom(ids[(i - 1 + ids.length) % ids.length]);  
    }); 
    document.getElementById('btn -right')?.addEventListener('click', () => 
{ 
      const ids = Object.keys(rooms); const i = ids.indexOf(currentRoom);  
      switchRoom(ids[(i + 1) % ids.length]);  
    }); 
    document.getElementById('btn -action')?.addEventListener('click', () 
=> { 
      if (currentRoom === 'terminal') { openTerminal(); return; }  
      if (najika) najika.rotation.y += Math.PI / 4;  
    }); 
 
    // Chat 
    function openChat(){ document.getElementById('chat -
modal').classList.add('show'); 
setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('chat -input').focus(),100); }  
    function closeChat(){ document.getElementById('chat -
modal').classList.remove('show'); }  
    async function sendChatMessage(){  
      const input = document.getElementById('chat -input');  
      const msg = input.value.trim(); if(!msg) return;  
      const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('chat -messages');  
      const userMsg = document.createElement('div'); 
userMsg.className='chat -msg user'; userMsg.textContent = 'Du: ' + msg; 
messagesDiv.appendChild(userMsg);  
      const loadingMsg = document.createElement('div'); 
loadingMsg.className='chat -msg najika'; loadingMsg.textContent='Najika 
denkt...'; loadingMsg.id='loading -msg'; 
messagesDiv.appendChild(loadingMsg);  
      messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight; input.value='';  
 
      try{ 
        const response = await window.najikaAI.sendMessage(msg);  
        document.getElementById('loading -msg')?.remove();  
        const najikaMsg = document.createElement('div'); 
najikaMsg.className='chat -msg najika'; najikaMsg.textContent = 'Najika: ' 
+ response; messagesDiv.appendChild(najikaMsg);  
      }catch(e){  
        document.getElementById('loading -msg')?.remove();  
        const errorMsg = document.createElement('div'); 
errorMsg.className='chat -msg'; errorMsg.style.color='#ff4444'; 
errorMsg.textContent='Fehler: '+e.message; 
messagesDiv.appendChild(errorMsg);  
      } 
      messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;  
    } 
    document.getElementById('btn -chat').addEventListener('click', 
openChat);  
    document.getElementById('chat -close-btn').addEventListener('click', 
closeChat);  
    document.getElementById('chat -send-btn').addEventListener('click', 
sendChatMessage);  
 
    // Terminal  
    function openTerminal(){ document.getElementById('terminal -
modal').classList.add('show'); setTimeout(()=>{ const 
input=document.getElementById('terminal -password'); input.value=''; 
input.focus(); },100); }  
    function closeTerminal(){ document.getElementById('terminal -
modal').classList.remove('show'); }  
    function checkTerminalPassword(){ const 
pw=document.getElementById('terminal -password').value; 
if(pw==='najika2025'){ closeTerminal(); 
setTimeout(()=>showTerminalContent(),200); } else { alert('Falsches 
Passwort!'); } }  
    function showTerminalContent(){  
      document.getElementById('terminal -content').classList.add('show');  
      document.getElementById('openai -key-input').value = 
localStorage.getItem('openai_key') || '';  
      document.getElementById('claude -key-input').value = 
localStorage.getItem('claude_key') || '';  
    } 
    function closeTerminalContent(){ document.getElementById('terminal -
content').classList.remove('show'); }  
    document.getElementById('terminal -cancel-
btn').addEventListener('click', closeTerminal);  
    document.getElementById('terminal -access-
btn').addEventListener('click', checkTerminalPassword);  
    document.getElementById('terminal -close-
btn').addEventListener('click', closeTerminalContent);  
    document.getElementById('save -keys-btn').addEventListener('click', () 
=> { 
      const openai = document.getElementById('openai -key-
input').value.trim();  
      const claude = document.getElementById('claude -key-
input').value.trim();  
      if (openai) localStorage.setItem('openai_key', openai);  
      if (claude) localStorage.setItem('claude_key', claude);  
      alert('Keys gespeichert!');  
    }); 
 
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {  
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {  
        const chatModal = document.getElementById('chat -modal'), 
termModal = document.getElementById('terminal -modal');  
        if (chatModal && chatModal.classList.contains('show')) { 
sendChatMessage(); e.preventDefault(); }  
        else if (termModal && termModal.classList.contains('show')) { 
checkTerminalPassword(); e.preventDefault(); }  
      } 
      if (e.key === 'Escape') document.querySelectorAll('.modal -
overlay').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('show'));  
    }); 
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if 
(e.target.classList.contains('modal -overlay')) 
e.target.classList.remove('show'); });  
 
    // Start  
    loadRoomEnvironment('living');  
    updateRoomActions('living');  
 
    function animate() {  
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);  
      updateMovement();  
      controls.update();  
      renderer.render(scene, camera);  
    } 
    animate();  
 
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {  
      camera.aspect = canvas.clientWidth / canvas.clientHeight;  
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();  
      renderer.setSize(canvas.clientWidth, canvas.clientHeight);  
    }); 
  </script>

# NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready)  
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer  
import json, requests, os  
 
HTTP_ROOT = os.environ.get("NAJIKA_HTTP_ROOT", r"C: \NajikaCore \digivice")  
 
class NajikaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):  
    def end_headers(self):  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Origin', '*')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, 
OPTIONS')  
        self.send_header('Access -Control-Allow-Headers', '*')  
        super().end_headers()  
 
    def do_OPTIONS(self):  
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers()  
 
    def do_GET(self):  
        if self.path == '/health':  
            self.send_response(200)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status':'ok','service':'Najika 
Server'}).encode()); return  
        return super().do_GET()  
 
    def _safe_write(self, b: bytes):  
        try: self.wfile.write(b)  
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionAbortedError): pass  
 
    def do_POST(self):  
        p = self.path.rstrip('/')  
        if   p == '/api/ollama': self.proxy_ollama(); return  
        elif p == '/api/openai': self.proxy_openai(); return  
        elif p == '/api/claude': self.proxy_claude(); return  
        self.send_error(404, 'Route not found')  
 
    def proxy_ollama(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); body = 
self.rfile.read(n)  
            r = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate',  
                              data=body, headers={'Content -
Type':'application/json'}, timeout=60)  
            self.send_response(r.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(r.content)  
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_response(502); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(json.dumps({'error':str(e)}).encode())  
 
    def proxy_openai(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); data = 
json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))  
            r = 
requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',  
                              json=data['body'],  
                              headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer 
{data['apiKey']}", 'Content -Type':'application/json'},  
                              timeout=45)  
            self.send_response(r.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(r.content)  
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_response(502); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(json.dumps({'error':str(e)}).encode())  
 
    def proxy_claude(self):  
        try: 
            n = int(self.headers.get('Content -Length','0')); data = 
json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))  
            r = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',  
                              json=data['body'],  
                              headers={'x -api-key': data['apiKey'], 
'anthropic -version':'2023 -06-01','Content -Type':'application/json'},  
                              timeout=45)  
            self.send_response(r.status_code)  
            self.send_header('Content -Type','application/json'); 
self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(r.content)  
        except Exception as e:  
            self.send_response(502); self.send_header('Content -
Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()  
            self._safe_write(json.dumps({'error':str(e)}).encode())  
 
if __name__ == '__main__':  
    os.chdir(HTTP_ROOT)  
    port = 8000  
    httpd = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), NajikaHandler)  
    print("="*70); print("NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready)"); 
print("="*70)  
    print(f"HTTP Root:   {HTTP_ROOT}")  
    print(f"HTTP:        http://localhost:{port}")  
    print(f"Health:      http://localhost:{port}/health")  
    print(f"Ollama:      http://localhost:{port}/api/ollama")  
    print(f"OpenAI:      http://localhost:{port}/api/openai")  
    print(f"Claude:      http://localhost:{port}/api/claude")  
    print("="*70)  
    try: httpd.serve_forever()  
    except KeyboardInterrupt: pass  
    finally: httpd.server_close()

// Najika AI – Lokal/Cloud + Provider -Umschaltung (GPT -4 / Claude) + 
Badge/Buttons  
class NajikaAI {  
  constructor() {  
    this.baseURL = window.location.origin;  
    this.personality = null;  
    this.allowCloud = 
JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('najika_allow_cloud')||'false');  
    this.provider = localStorage.getItem('najika_provider') || 'ollama'; 
// 'ollama'|'openai'|'claude'  
    this.conversationHistory = [];  
    this.panelEl = null;  
  } 
 
  async init() {  
    await this.loadConfig();  
    this.mountControls();  
    try { await (await fetch(this.baseURL + "/health",{cache:'no -
store'})).json(); } catch {}  
  } 
 
  async loadConfig() {  
    try { this.personality = await (await 
fetch("config/najika_personality_CORE.json",{cache:'no -store'})).json(); 
} 
    catch { this.personality = {content:"Du bist Najika, ein quirliger 
KI-Begleiter."}; }  
  } 
 
  mountControls() {  
    let host = document.getElementById('cloud -panel');  
    if (!host) { host = document.createElement('div'); host.id='cloud -
panel'; host.style.position='fixed'; host.style.top='10px'; 
host.style.right='10px'; host.style.zIndex='2000'; 
document.body.appendChild(host); }  
    host.innerHTML = `  
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex -wrap:wrap;justify -
content:flex -end"> 
        <button id="cloud -toggle" style="padding:8px 10px;border:2px 
solid #00ff41;background:#111;color:#00ff41;border -radius:10px;font -
weight:700;min -width:110px">  
          ${this.allowCloud ? '     Cloud' : '     Lokal'} 
        </button>  
        <button id="prov -local"  style="padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid 
#888;background:#111;color:#ddd;border -radius:10px">Lokal</button>  
        <button id="prov -gpt4"   style="padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid 
#888;background:#111;color:#ddd;border -radius:10px">GPT -4</button>  
        <button id="prov -claude" style="padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid 
#888;background:#111;color:#ddd;border -radius:10px">Claude</button>  
      </div>`;  
    const setActive = () => {  
      ['prov-local','prov -gpt4','prov -claude'].forEach(id=>{  
        const el = document.getElementById(id);  
        const on = (id==='prov -local'  && this.provider==='ollama') ||  
                   (id==='prov -gpt4'   && this.provider==='openai') ||  
                   (id==='prov -claude' && this.provider==='claude');  
        el.style.borderColor = on ? '#00ff41' : '#888';  
        el.style.color = on ? '#00ff41' : '#ddd';  
      }); 
      const t = document.getElementById('cloud -toggle');  
      t.textContent = this.allowCloud ? '     Cloud' : '     Lokal'; 
      t.style.borderColor = '#00ff41'; t.style.color = '#00ff41';  
    }; 
    setActive();  
    document.getElementById('cloud -toggle').onclick = ()=>{ 
this.allowCloud=!this.allowCloud; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_allow_cloud',JSON.stringify(this.allowCloud)
); setActive(); };  
    document.getElementById('prov -local').onclick=()=>{ 
this.provider='ollama'; localStorage.setItem('najika_provider','ollama'); 
setActive(); };  
    document.getElementById('prov -gpt4').onclick =()=>{ 
this.provider='openai'; localStorage.setItem('najika_provider','openai'); 
setActive(); };  
    document.getElementById('prov -claude').onclick=()=>{ 
this.provider='claude'; localStorage.setItem('najika_provider','claude'); 
setActive(); };  
  } 
 
  async sendMessage(message) {  
    const m = message.toLowerCase();  
    if (m.includes('cloud frei')) { this.allowCloud=true; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_allow_cloud','true'); this.mountControls(); 
return 'Cloud -Fallback freigegeben. ✓'; } 
    if (m.includes('cloud zu'))   { this.allowCloud=false; 
localStorage.setItem('najika_allow_cloud','false'); this.mountControls(); 
return 'Cloud -Fallback gesperrt. ✓'; } 
 
    const sys = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika.';  
    this.conversationHistory.push({role:'user', content: message});  
    if (this.conversationHistory.length > 16) this.conversationHistory = 
this.conversationHistory.slice( -16); 
 
    try { 
      if (this.provider==='ollama')  { const r = await 
this.callOllama(sys,message); if (r) return r; }  
      if (this.provider==='openai')  { const r = await 
this.callOpenAI(sys,message); if (r) return r; }  
      if (this.provider==='claude')  { const r = await 
this.callClaude(sys,message); if (r) return r; }  
    } catch {}  
 
    // Fallbacks  
    if (this.provider!=='ollama') { try { const r = await 
this.callOllama(sys,message); if (r) return r; } catch {} }  
    if (this.allowCloud) {  
      try { const r = await this.callOpenAI(sys,message); if (r) return 
r; } catch {}  
      try { const r = await this.callClaude(sys,message); if (r) return 
r; } catch {}  
    } 
    return 'Lokal fehlgeschlagen. Sage **cloud frei** (oder klicke    ), 
um Cloud -Fallback zu erlauben.';  
  } 
 
  buildMessages(){ return this.conversationHistory.slice( -6); } 
  buildPlainContext(){  
    return this.conversationHistory.slice( -6).map(m => 
`${m.role==='user'?'User':'Najika'}: ${m.content}`).join(' \n'); 
  } 
 
  async callOllama(systemPrompt, message) {  
    const prompt = 
`${systemPrompt} \n\n${this.buildPlainContext()} \n\nUser: 
${message} \n\nNajika:`;  
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/ollama", {  
      method:"POST", headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" },  
      body: JSON.stringify({ model:"najika", prompt, stream:false, 
options:{ temperature:0.9, repeat_penalty:1.45, num_predict:200 } })  
    }); 
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('ollama http '+resp.status);  
    const data = await resp.json();  
    const reply = (data && data.response) ? data.response.trim() : '';  
    if (reply) this.conversationHistory.push({role:'assistant', content: 
reply});  
    return reply;  
  } 
 
  async callOpenAI(systemPrompt, message) {  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('openai_key') || ''; if (!apiKey) 
throw new Error('openai key missing');  
    const body = { model:"gpt -4o-mini", 
messages:[{role:"system",content:systemPrompt}, ...this.buildMessages(), 
{role:"user",content:message}], temperature:0.9 };  
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/openai", { 
method:"POST", headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" }, body: 
JSON.stringify({ apiKey, body }) });  
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('openai http '+resp.status);  
    const j = await resp.json(); const reply = 
j?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || '';  
    if (reply) this.conversationHistory.push({role:'assistant', content: 
reply}); return reply;  
  } 
 
  async callClaude(systemPrompt, message) {  
    const apiKey = localStorage.getItem('claude_key') || ''; if (!apiKey) 
throw new Error('claude key missing');  
    const body = { model:"claude -3-5-sonnet-20240620", 
system:systemPrompt, messages:[...this.buildMessages(), 
{role:"user",content:message}], max_tokens:500, temperature:0.9 };  
    const resp = await fetch(this.baseURL + "/api/claude", { 
method:"POST", headers:{ "Content -Type":"application/json" }, body: 
JSON.stringify({ apiKey, body }) });  
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('claude http '+resp.status);  
    const j = await resp.json(); const reply = 
j?.content?.[0]?.text?.trim() || '';  
    if (reply) this.conversationHistory.push({role:'assistant', content: 
reply}); return reply;  
  } 
} 
window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();  
document.readyState==='loading' ? 
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>window.najikaAI.init()) 
: window.najikaAI.init();

// Räume: Wände automatisch an den Rand legen & durchziehen (Rechteck 
30x30) 
(function () {  
  function autoFit() {  
    try { 
      const scene = window.scene; if (!scene) return;  
      let template = null;  
      scene.traverse(o => { const n=(o.name||'').toLowerCase(); if 
(!template && (n.includes('wall')||n==='wall')) template = o.parent||o; 
}); 
      if (!template) return;  
 
      const parent = template.parent || scene, clones = [];  
      for (let i=0;i<4;i++){ const w=template.clone(true); 
w.name='wall_auto_'+i; w.traverse(m=>{ if(m.isMesh){m.castShadow=true; 
m.receiveShadow=true;} }); parent.add(w); clones.push(w); }  
      template.visible=false;  
 
      const size=30, half=size/2;  
      clones[0].position.set(0,0, -half); clones[0].rotation.set(0,0,0);            
clones[0].scale.set(size,1,1);  
      clones[1].position.set(half,0,0);  
clones[1].rotation.set(0,Math.PI/2,0);    clones[1].scale.set(size,1,1);  
      clones[2].position.set(0,0,half);  
clones[2].rotation.set(0,Math.PI,0);      clones[2].scale.set(size,1,1);  
      clones[3].position.set( -half,0,0); clones[3].rotation.set(0, -
Math.PI/2,0);   clones[3].scale.set(size,1,1);  
    } catch(e){ console.warn('autoFitWalls error:', e); }  
  } 
  window.addEventListener('najika -room-loaded', () => setTimeout(autoFit, 
50)); 
  if (window.scene) setTimeout(autoFit, 300);  
  window.autoFitWalls = autoFit;  
})();
