  <script type="module">  
    import * as THREE from 'three';  
    import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';  
    import { OrbitControls } from 
'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';  
    import { SkeletonHelper } from 
'three/addons/helpers/SkeletonHelper.js';  
 
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();  
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0e27);  
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0a0e27, 10, 50);  
    window.scene = scene;  
 
    const canvas = document.getElementById('three -canvas');  
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, canvas.clientWidth / 
canvas.clientHeight, 0.1, 100);  
    camera.position.set(0, 4, 12);  
 
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true 
}); 
    renderer.setSize(canvas.clientWidth, canvas.clientHeight);  
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));  
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;  
 
    const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas);  
    controls.enableDamping = true; controls.minDistance = 1; 
controls.maxDistance = 30;  
 
    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));  
    const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.9); 
dirLight.position.set(5,10,5); dirLight.castShadow = true; 
scene.add(dirLight);  
    const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x00ff41, 0.4, 10); 
pointLight.position.set(0,2,2); scene.add(pointLight);  
 
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(15,64), new 
THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color:0x2a2a2a, roughness:0.8 }));  
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; ground.receiveShadow = true; 
scene.add(ground);  
    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(30,30,0x00ff41,0x333333); 
grid.position.y = 0.01; scene.add(grid);  
 
    // Najika (GLTF mit Skelett & Animationen)  
    let najika = null, mixer = null, actions = {}, activeAction = null, 
skeletonHelper = null;  
    const clock = new THREE.Clock();  
    const loader = new GLTFLoader(); window.loader = loader;  
 
    function play(name, fade=0.25){  
      const a = actions[name]; if (!a) return;  
      if (activeAction === a) return;  
      if (activeAction) activeAction.fadeOut(fade);  
      a.reset().fadeIn(fade).play();  
      activeAction = a;  
    } 
 
    loader.load('assets/characters/najika.glb', (gltf) => {  
      najika = gltf.scene; najika.position.set(0,0,0); 
najika.scale.set(1,1,1);  
      najika.traverse(c=>{ if(c.isMesh){ c.castShadow=true; 
c.receiveShadow=true; } });  
 
      scene.add(najika);  
 
      // Animationen  
      if (gltf.animations && gltf.animations.length){  
        mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(najika);  
        // Versuche typische Namen zu finden  
        let clipIdle = gltf.animations.find(a => /idle/i.test(a.name)) || 
gltf.animations[0];  
        let clipWalk = gltf.animations.find(a => 
/walk|run|move/i.test(a.name));  
        actions.idle = mixer.clipAction(clipIdle);  
        if (clipWalk) actions.walk = mixer.clipAction(clipWalk);  
        actions.idle.enabled = true; 
actions.idle.setLoop(THREE.LoopRepeat); play('idle',0.0);  
      } 
 
      // Skeleton Helper (toggle mit Taste "B")  
      najika.traverse(n=>{ if(n.isSkinnedMesh && !skeletonHelper){ 
skeletonHelper = new SkeletonHelper(n); skeletonHelper.visible=false; 
scene.add(skeletonHelper); } });  
 
      document.getElementById('loading').style.display='none';  
    }, undefined, () => {  
      document.getElementById('loading').textContent = 'Model fehlt 
(404)'; 
    }); 
 
    // Movement + Anim -Wechsel 
    const keys = {};  
    window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = 
true; });  
    window.addEventListener('keyup',   e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = 
false; });  
 
    function updateMovement(dt){  
      if (!najika) return;  
      const speed = 3.0; // units / sec  
      let dx=0, dz=0;  
      if (keys['w']) dz -= 1; 
      if (keys['s']) dz += 1;  
      if (keys['a']) dx -= 1; 
      if (keys['d']) dx += 1;  
      const mag = Math.hypot(dx,dz);  
      if (mag>0){  
        dx/=mag; dz/=mag;  
        najika.position.x += dx * speed * dt;  
        najika.position.z += dz * speed * dt;  
        const targetAngle = Math.atan2(dx, dz);  
        const cur = najika.rotation.y;  
        let diff = ((targetAngle - cur + Math.PI)%(Math.PI*2)) -Math.PI;  
        najika.rotation.y += diff * 0.2;  
        if (actions.walk) play('walk'); else { // fallback: bobbing  
          const t = performance.now()*0.005; najika.position.y = 0.5 + 
Math.sin(t)*0.05;  
        } 
      } else {  
        if (actions.idle) play('idle');  
        najika.position.y += (0.0 - najika.position.y) * 0.1;  
      } 
      // Grenzen  
      najika.position.x = Math.max( -20, Math.min(20, najika.position.x));  
      najika.position.z = Math.max( -20, Math.min(20, najika.position.z));  
    } 
 
    // Räume  
    let currentRoom='living', environmentObjects=[];  
    const rooms = {  
      
living:{name:'Wohnraum',camera:[0,4,12],actions:[{id:'sleep',label:'        
Schlafen',class:'sleep'},{id:'eat',label:'      
Essen',class:'food'},{id:'toilet',label:'    Toilette',class:'toilet'}]},  
      
training:{name:'Training',camera:[0,2,14],actions:[{id:'strength',label:'
      Kraft',class:''},{id:'agility',label:'                    Geschick',class:''}]},  
      
study:{name:'Studienraum',camera:[0,3,10],actions:[{id:'learn',label:'        
Lernen',class:''},{id:'craft',label:'     Craften',class:''}]},  
      
hospital:{name:'Krankenstation',camera:[2,4,10],actions:[{id:'heal',label
:'    Heilen',class:''}]},  
      
battle:{name:'Kampfarena',camera:[6,4,16],actions:[{id:'fight',label:'            
Kämpfen',class:''}]},  
      
music:{name:'Musikraum',camera:[0,3,10],actions:[{id:'relax',label:'   
Entspannen',class:''}]},  
      
terminal:{name:'Terminal',camera:[0,3,8],actions:[{id:'access',label:'        
Zugriff',class:''}]}  
    }; 
    window.rooms = rooms;  
 
    const gltfLoader = loader; // wiederverwenden  
    function loadRoomEnvironment(roomId){  
      environmentObjects.forEach(o=>{ scene.remove(o); if(o.geometry) 
o.geometry.dispose(); if(o.material) o.material.dispose(); });  
      environmentObjects=[];  
      
fetch('assets/room_config_detailed.json').then(r=>r.json()).then(config=>
{ 
        const roomData=config[roomId];  
        if (!roomData || !roomData.objects){ window.dispatchEvent(new 
Event('najika -room-loaded')); return; }  
        let pending = roomData.objects.length;  
        roomData.objects.forEach(objData=>{  
          gltfLoader.load('assets/rooms/'+roomId+'/'+objData.model, 
(gltf)=>{  
            const obj = gltf.scene;  
            const nameHint = (objData.model||'').toLowerCase();  
            if (nameHint.includes('wall')) obj.name='wall';  
            obj.position.set(...objData.position);  
            obj.rotation.set(...objData.rotation);  
            obj.scale.setScalar(objData.scale);  
            obj.traverse(c=>{ if(c.isMesh){ c.castShadow=true; 
c.receiveShadow=true; }});  
            scene.add(obj); environmentObjects.push(obj);  
            if (--pending===0) window.dispatchEvent(new Event('najika -
room-loaded'));  
          }, undefined, ()=>{ if( --pending===0) window.dispatchEvent(new 
Event('najika -room-loaded')); });  
        }); 
      }); 
    } 
 
    function updateRoomActions(roomId){  
      const wrap = document.getElementById('room -actions'), room = 
rooms[roomId];  
      if (!room || !room.actions?.length){ wrap.style.display='none'; 
return; }  
      wrap.style.display='flex'; wrap.innerHTML='';  
      room.actions.forEach(a=>{ const b=document.createElement('button'); 
b.className='room -action-btn '+a.class; b.textContent=a.label; 
b.onclick=()=>performAction(a.id); wrap.appendChild(b); });  
    } 
 
    function performAction(id){  
      switch(id){  
        case 'access': openTerminal(); break;  
        default: /* später Logik */ break;  
      } 
    } 
 
    function switchRoom(roomId){  
      if(!rooms[roomId]) return;  
      currentRoom=roomId; loadRoomEnvironment(roomId); 
updateRoomActions(roomId);  
      const room=rooms[roomId], 
start={x:camera.position.x,y:camera.position.y,z:camera.position.z}, 
duration=800, t0=performance.now();  
      (function anim(){ const p=Math.min((performance.now() -
t0)/duration,1), e=1 -Math.pow(1 -p,3); 
        camera.position.x=start.x+(room.camera[0] -start.x)*e;  
        camera.position.y=start.y+(room.camera[1] -start.y)*e;  
        camera.position.z=start.z+(room.camera[2] -start.z)*e;  
        if(p<1) requestAnimationFrame(anim);  
      })(); 
      document.getElementById('room -info').textContent=room.name;  
      document.getElementById('menu -btn').textContent=room.name;  
    } 
    window.switchRoom = switchRoom;  
 
    // UI Verdrahtung  
    const menuBtn=document.getElementById('menu -btn'), 
roomMenu=document.getElementById('room -menu'); 
    
menuBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>roomMenu.classList.toggle('active'))
; 
    document.querySelectorAll('.room -item').forEach(item=>{  
      item.addEventListener('click',()=>{  
        switchRoom(item.dataset.room);  
        document.querySelectorAll('.room -
item').forEach(r=>r.classList.remove('current')); 
item.classList.add('current');  
        roomMenu.classList.remove('active');  
      }); 
    }); 
    document.getElementById('btn -left').addEventListener('click',()=>{  
      const ids=Object.keys(rooms); const i=ids.indexOf(currentRoom); 
switchRoom(ids[(i -1+ids.length)%ids.length]);  
    }); 
    document.getElementById('btn -right').addEventListener('click',()=>{  
      const ids=Object.keys(rooms); const i=ids.indexOf(currentRoom); 
switchRoom(ids[(i+1)%ids.length]);  
    }); 
    document.getElementById('btn -action').addEventListener('click',()=>{ 
if(currentRoom==='terminal'){ openTerminal(); } else if(najika){ 
najika.rotation.y += Math.PI/4; } });  
 
    // Chat 
    function openChat(){ document.getElementById('chat -
modal').classList.add('show'); 
setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('chat -input').focus(),100); }  
    function closeChat(){ document.getElementById('chat -
modal').classList.remove('show'); }  
    async function sendChatMessage(){  
      const input=document.getElementById('chat -input'); const 
msg=input.value.trim(); if(!msg) return;  
      const box=document.getElementById('chat -messages');  
      const u=document.createElement('div'); u.className='chat -msg user'; 
u.textContent='Du: '+msg; box.appendChild(u);  
      const l=document.createElement('div'); l.className='chat -msg 
najika'; l.textContent='Najika denkt...'; l.id='loading -msg'; 
box.appendChild(l);  
      box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight; input.value='';  
      try{ const response=await window.najikaAI.sendMessage(msg); 
document.getElementById('loading -msg')?.remove(); const 
a=document.createElement('div'); a.className='chat -msg najika'; 
a.textContent='Najika: '+response; box.appendChild(a); }  
      catch(e){ document.getElementById('loading -msg')?.remove(); const 
err=document.createElement('div'); err.className='chat -msg'; 
err.style.color='#ff4444'; err.textContent='Fehler: '+e.message; 
box.appendChild(err); }  
      box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight;  
    } 
    document.getElementById('btn -chat').addEventListener('click', 
openChat);  
    document.getElementById('chat -close-btn').addEventListener('click', 
closeChat);  
    document.getElementById('chat -send-btn').addEventListener('click', 
sendChatMessage);  
 
    // Terminal & Keys  
    function openTerminal(){ document.getElementById('terminal -
modal').classList.add('show'); setTimeout(()=>{ const 
i=document.getElementById('terminal -password'); i.value=''; i.focus(); 
},100); }  
    function closeTerminal(){ document.getElementById('terminal -

    // Hotkeys  
    document.addEventListener('keydown',(e)=>{  
      if (e.key==='Enter'){ const cm=document.getElementById('chat -
modal'), tm=document.getElementById('terminal -modal'); if

else if (tm.classList.contains('show')) { checkTerminalPa ssword(); 
e.preventDefault(); } }  
      if (e.key==='Escape'){ document.querySelectorAll('.modal -
overlay').forEach(m=>m.classList.remove('show')); }  
      if (e.key.toLowerCase()==='b' && skeletonHelper){ 
skeletonHelper.visible=!skeletonHelper.visible; 
document.getElementById('skeleton -badge').style.display = 
skeletonHelper.visible ? 'block' : 'none'; }  
    }); 
    document.addEventListener('click',(e)=>{ if 
(e.target.classList.contains('modal -overlay')) 
e.target.classList.remove('show'); });  
 
    // Start  
    function animate(){  
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);  
      const dt = clock.getDelta();  
      if (mixer) mixer.update(dt);  
      updateMovement(dt);  
      controls.update();  
      renderer.render(scene,camera);  
    } 
    loadRoomEnvironment('living'); updateRoomActions('living');  
    animate();  
 
    window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{  
      camera.aspect = canvas.clientWidth / canvas.clientHeight; 
camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); renderer.setSize(canvas.clientWidth, 
canvas.clientHeight);  
    });

// ESM: export default init function; receives deps from index.html  
export default function initNajika({ THREE, GLTFLoader, OrbitControls, 
buildRoom }) {  
  const mount = document.getElementById('sceneMount');  
  const status = document.getElementById('status');  
 
  // ----------  Renderer / Scene ----------  
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true 
}); 
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));  
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);  
  mount.appendChild(renderer.domElement);  
 
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();  
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, window.innerWidth / 
window.innerHeight, 0.1, 200);  
  camera.position.set(2.6, 1.8, 3.2);  
 
  const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);  
  controls.enableDamping = true;  
 
  // Lights  
  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));  
  const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.1);  
  key.position.set(4, 6, 3);  
  scene.add(key);  
 
  // ----------  Resize ----------  
  function onResize(){  
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;  
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();  
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);  
  } 
  window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);  
 
  // ----------  Room ----------  
  let currentRoom = 'living';  
  const roomApi = buildRoom(scene);     // returns helpers for switching  
  roomApi.setRoom(currentRoom);  
 
  // ----------  Model ----------  
  const loader = new GLTFLoader();  
  let model = null;  
 
  loader.load(  
    '/assets/characters/najika.glb',  
    async (gltf) => {  
      model = gltf.scene;  
      model.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = 
o.receiveShadow = true; }});  
      model.position.set(0, 0, 0);  
      scene.add(model);  
 
      // Try to add SkeletonHelper, but NEVER fail app if CORS blocks it  
      try { 
        // CDN first  
        const mod = await 
import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/helpers/S
keletonHelper.js')  
          .catch(async () => await 
import('/js/vendor/SkeletonHelper.js')); // local fallback (shim or real)  
        if (mod && mod.SkeletonHelper) {  
          const helper = new mod.SkeletonHelper(model);  
          helper.visible = false; // off by default; toggle with H  
          scene.add(helper);  
          window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if 
(e.key.toLowerCase() === 'h') helper.visible = !helper.visible; });  
        } 
      } catch (e) {  
        console.warn('SkeletonHelper unavailable, running without 
overlay.', e);  
      } 
    }, 
    undefined,  
    (err) => {  
      console.error('GLB load error:', err);  
      setStatus('     Konnte Modell nicht laden.');  
    } 
  ); 
 
  // ----------  Render Loop ----------  
  function tick(){  
    controls.update();  
    renderer.render(scene, camera);  
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);  
  } 
  tick(); 
 
  // ----------  UI: Rooms ----------  
  document.querySelectorAll('#bottomBar .btn').forEach(btn=>{  
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{  
      const room = btn.dataset.room;  
      if (room && room !== currentRoom) {  
        currentRoom = room;  
        roomApi.setRoom(room);  
      } 
    }); 
  }); 
 
  // ----------  LLM Provider & Cloud Fallback ----------  
  let provider = 'ollama';      // 'ollama' | 'openai' | 'claude'  
  let cloudAllowed = false;  
 
  const pOllama = document.getElementById('p -ollama');  
  const pGpt4   = document.getElementById('p -gpt4'); 
  const pClaude = document.getElementById('p -claude');  
  const lock    = document.getElementById('lock');  
 
  function selectProvider(p){  
    provider = p;  
    [pOllama,pGpt4,pClaude].forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active'));  
    if (p === 'ollama') pOllama.classList.add('active');  
    if (p === 'openai') pGpt4.classList.add('active');  
    if (p === 'claude') pClaude.classList.add('active');  
  } 
  pOllama.onclick = ()=> selectProvider('ollama');  
  pGpt4.onclick   = ()=> selectProvider('openai');  
  pClaude.onclick = ()=> selectProvider('claude');  
 
  lock.onclick = ()=>{  
    cloudAllowed = !cloudAllowed;  
    lock.textContent = cloudAllowed ? '     cloud frei' : '     cloud 
gesperrt';  
    lock.classList.toggle('active', cloudAllowed);  
  }; 
 
  // ----------  Chat ----------  
  const chatInput = document.getElementById('chatInput');  
  const chatSend  = document.getElementById('chatSend');  
 
  chatSend.onclick = async ()=>{  
    const text = (chatInput.value||'').trim();  
    if (!text) return;  
    chatInput.value = '';  
    await askNajika(text);  
  }; 
  chatInput.addEventListener('keydown',(e)=>{ if(e.key==='Enter'){ 
e.preventDefault(); chatSend.click(); }});  
 
  async function askNajika(userText){  
    setStatus('…');  
    const tryLocal = async ()=>{  
      const r = await 
fetch('/api/ollama',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content -
Type':'application/json'},  
        body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: userText })});  
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('local not ok');  
      const j = await r.json();  
      return j.reply || j.text || JSON.stringify(j);  
    }; 
 
    const tryOpenAI = async ()=>{  
      const r = await 
fetch('/api/openai',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content -
Type':'application/json'},  
        body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: userText, model: 'gpt -4o-mini' 
})}); 
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('openai not ok');  
      const j = await r.json();  
      return j.reply || j.text || JSON.stringify(j);  
    }; 
 
    const tryClaude = async ()=>{  
      const r = await 
fetch('/api/claude',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content -
Type':'application/json'},  
        body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: userText, model: 'claude -3-haiku' 
})}); 
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('claude not ok');  
      const j = await r.json();  
      return j.reply || j.text || JSON.stringify(j);  
    }; 
 
    try { 
      let answer;  
      if (provider === 'ollama') {  
        try { answer = await tryLocal(); }  
        catch (e) {  
          if (!cloudAllowed) {  
            setStatus('Najika: Lokal fehlgeschlagen. Sage **cloud frei** 
(oder klicke    ), um Cloud -Fallback zu erlauben.');  
            return; 
          } 
          // Fallback zu OpenAI als Standard  
          try { answer = await tryOpenAI(); }  
          catch { answer = await tryClaude(); }  
        } 
      } else if (provider === 'openai') {  
        answer = await tryOpenAI();  
      } else {  
        answer = await tryClaude();  
      } 
      setStatus('Najika: ' + answer);  
    } catch (e) {  
      console.error(e);  
      setStatus('     Anfrage fehlgeschlagen.');  
    } 
  } 
 
  function setStatus(msg){ status.textContent = msg; }  
} 
 
C:\NajikaCore \digivice \js\room_walls_autofit.js  
 
// Simple, robust room builder with tight corner alignment  
// export: buildRoom(scene) -> { setRoom(name) }  
import * as THREE from 
'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';  
 
export function buildRoom(scene){  
  const group = new THREE.Group();  
  scene.add(group);  
 
  const materials = {  
    floor: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x232a38, roughness: 1 
}), 
    wall:  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1b2232, roughness: 1 
}) 
  }; 
 
  function clear(){  
    for (let i = group.children.length - 1; i >= 0; i --) 
group.remove(group.children[i]);  
  } 
 
  function makeRoom({ w=6, d=6, h=3 } = {}){  
    // Floor  
    const floorGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, d);  
    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(floorGeo, materials.floor);  
    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;  
    floor.position.set(0, 0, 0);  
    floor.receiveShadow = true;  
    group.add(floor);  
 
    // 4 walls (perfectly meeting at edges)  
    const wallGeoW = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h);  
    const wallGeoD = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(d, h);  
 
    const wallN = new THREE.Mesh(wallGeoW, materials.wall); // +Z  
    wallN.position.set(0, h/2, d/2);  
    // plane faces -Z by default; flip so inside faces camera  
    wallN.rotation.y = Math.PI;  
    const wallS = new THREE.Mesh(wallGeoW, materials.wall); // -Z 
    wallS.position.set(0, h/2, -d/2); 
 
    const wallE = new THREE.Mesh(wallGeoD, materials.wall); // +X  
    wallE.position.set(w/2, h/2, 0);  
    wallE.rotation.y = -Math.PI/2;  
 
    const wallW = new THREE.Mesh(wallGeoD, materials.wall); // -X 
    wallW.position.set( -w/2, h/2, 0);  
    wallW.rotation.y = Math.PI/2;  
 
    [wallN, wallS, wallE, wallW].forEach(wl=>{  
      wl.castShadow = wl.receiveShadow = true;  
      group.add(wl);  
    }); 
  } 
 
  function setRoom(name){  
    clear();  
    switch(name){  
      case 'training': makeRoom({w:7,d:7,h:3.2}); break;  
      case 'study':    makeRoom({w:6,d:5.5,h:3}); break;  
      case 'terminal': makeRoom({w:5.5,d:4.5,h:2.8}); break;  
      case 'music':    makeRoom({w:6.5,d:5.5,h:3}); break;  
      case 'battle':   makeRoom({w:8,d:8,h:4}); break;  
      case 'hospital': makeRoom({w:6,d:6,h:3.2}); break;  
      default:         makeRoom({w:6,d:6,h:3}); break;  
    } 
  } 
 
  return { setRoom };  
}

// Safe local fallback (shim) if CDN helper fails.  
// Exports a minimal no -op SkeletonHelper so app never crashes.  
export class SkeletonHelper {  
  constructor(object3d){ this.object = object3d; this.visible = false; 
this.isHelper = true; }  
  add(){ /* no -op */ } 
  remove(){ /* no -op */ } 
}

4) Frontend Komponenten  
 
    index.html  
 
        Lädt THREE, GLTFLoader, OrbitControls vom CDN.  
 
        Bindet lokale Module js/najika_ai.js und 
js/room_walls_autofit.js.  
 
        UI-Badges:       lokal, GPT -4, Claude; Lock -Badge    /    für Cloud -
Fallback.  
 
        Bottom-Bar-Buttons wechseln Räume.  
 
    js/najika_ai.js  
 
        Setup: Renderer, Kamera, Lichter, OrbitControls.  
 
        Lädt najika.glb; versucht SkeletonHelper via CDN, fällt bei 
Fehler auf js/vendor/SkeletonHelper.js zurück (App bleibt 
funktionsfähig).  
 
        Chat-Flow: 
 
            Versuche /api/ollama (lokal).  
 
            Bei Fehler + cloudAllowed=true → /api/openai, dann 
/api/claude.  
 
        Status-Area zeigt Antworten/Fehler.  
 
    js/room_walls_autofit.js  
 
        Baut Räume prozedural (PlaneGeometry) mit sauber bündigen Ecken.  
 
        API: buildRoom(scene).setRoom(name).  
 
    js/vendor/SkeletonHelper.js  
 
        Minimal-Shim, damit fehlende/gebrochene CDN -Helper nie die App 
lahmlegen.  
 
5) Server (najika_server.py)  
 
    Dient als Static Server (Root = $env:NAJIKA_HTTP_ROOT) und API -Proxy: 
 
        GET /health → 200 OK (Lebenszeichen).  
 
        POST /api/ollama → an lokalen Ollama -Daemon (Prompt -JSON). 
 
        POST /api/openai → an OpenAI Proxy/Key (Prompt -JSON). 
 
        POST /api/claude → an Claude Proxy/Key (Prompt -JSON). 
 
    Hinweis zum IST -Zustand: In manchen Logs kommt 501 Unsupported method 
für /api/* → deutet auf eine Server -Variante ohne do_POST -Implementation 
(oder falsches Routing). (Siehe Issues.)  
 
6) Aktueller Zustand (aus deinen Logs)  
 
    Statische Files, GLB und Räume laden i. d. R. 200.  
 
    Fehler für Drei -Module: 
    „Uncaught TypeError: Der Spezifizierer three war ein blanker 
Spezifizierer …“  
    → tritt auf, wenn ein importiertes Modul (z. B. GLTFLoader aus CDN) 
intern from 'three' (bare specifier) erwartet, aber keine Import -
Map/Bundler vorhanden ist.  
 
    Frühere Probleme, inzwischen entschärft:  
 
        SkeletonHelper via CDN → MIME/CORS blockiert → lokaler Shim 
vorgesehen.  
 
        Einzelne hospital -Assets 404 (Deko -Props). 
 
    LLM-Routen: 
 
        teils 404/501 für /api/claude//api/openai → Server -
Variante/Routing prüfen.  
 
7) Bekannte Issues & empfohlene nächsten Schritte (keine Fixes jetzt)  
 
    ESM „bare specifier 'three'“ (aktueller Kernfehler)  
    Option A (ohne Bundler, empfohlen für schnell):  
 
        Alle Three -„examples/jsm“ lokal hosten und in den Files die 
Imports auf die lokale three.module.js relativ umschreiben.  
        Option B (Import -Map): 
 
        In index.html eine Import -Map definieren: "three": 
"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/.../three.module.js".  
        Option C (Bundler):  
 
        Vite/Rollup nutzen, three als Dependency resolven lassen.  
 
    /api/ → 501/404*  
 
        Sicherstellen, dass do_POST für /api/ollama|openai|claude 
implementiert ist (Requests -Proxy), inkl.:  
 
            Timeouts, Streaming (optional), CORS -Header, Fehler -Mapping 
(4xx/5xx → klare JSON -Fehler).  
 
        Claude-Route Name und Pfad angleichen.  
 
    Fehlende Hospital -Assets 
 
        Entweder Platzhalter hinzufügen oder die Raum -Config so anpassen, 
dass Props optional sind.  
 
    Robustheit  
 
        Bei jeder externen Abhängigkeit (CDN) einen lokalen Fallback 
bereitstellen (Pattern wie bei SkeletonHelper).  
 
    UI-Konstanz  
 
        Sicherstellen, dass immer index.html (3D -Version) aktiv ist und 
alte 2D-Dateien (style.css/digivice.js/najika_brain.js) nicht mehr 
referenziert werden.

Najika – KI-Übersicht (Stand jetzt)  
1) Rolle & Verhalten  
 
    Ziel: freundliche, spielerische Assistentin in 3D -Szene (Rooms), mit 
lokalem LLM als Standard und Cloud -Fallback nur nach Freigabe.  
 
    Trigger/Kommandos (Beispiele):  
 
        cloud frei → Cloud -Fallback aktivieren (    ). 
 
        cloud zu → Cloud sperren (    ). 
 
        raum <name> → Raumwechsel (living, training, study, terminal, 
music, battle, hospital).  
 
        debug an/aus → zusätzliche Logs in der UI.  
 
    Sicherheitsprinzip: Lokal first; Cloud nur opt -in. 
 
2) Betriebsmodi & Provider -Matrix 
 
    Lokal (Default): /api/ollama → reply/text.  
 
    Fallback (wenn erlaubt): /api/openai → dann /api/claude.  
 
    UI-Badges:       Lokal, GPT -4, Claude +    /    (Freigabe).  
 
    Persistenz: localStorage → cloudAllowed, activeProvider, activeRoom.  
 
3) Zustandsautomat (vereinfacht)  
 
idle → loading_model → ready ↔ chatting  
          ↓                 ↑  
        error  ← recover ───┘  
Events: init, modelLoaded, messageSend, messageDone, error, roomChange, 
providerToggle, cloudToggle

    Antwort normalisieren → UI -Ausgabe, State chatting → ready.  
 
    Fehler → UI -Hinweis + optionaler Re -Try/Provider -Wechsel.

1) Ziel & Leitprinzip

Chat-UI mit lokalem LLM als Standard und Cloud -Fallback nur nach 
ausdrücklicher Freigabe.

7) Provider & Fallback -Logik 
 
    Standard: Lokal → POST /api/ollama  
 
    Fallback: nur wenn freigegeben → zuerst OpenAI → dann Claude  
 
    Reihenfolge (Soll): local → openai → claude  
 
    Persistenz: localStorage  
 
        cloudAllowed (true|false, Default false)  
 
        activeProvider (local|openai|claude, Default local)  
 
        activeRoom (z. B. living)  
 
Einheitliches Antwort -Schema (im Frontend normalisiert):  
 
{ "reply": "<Text>" }  
 
POST-Payloads (einfach gehalten):  
 
    /api/ollama → { "prompt": "<Text>" }  
 
    /api/openai → { "prompt": "<Text>", "model": "gpt -4o-mini" } 
 
    /api/claude → { "prompt": "<Text>", "model": "claude -3-haiku" }  
 
8) Persona/Regeln (Config – editierbar)

10) Bekannte Fehlerbilder (IST) & Einordnung  
 
    CDN/CORS/MIME auf three/examples (SkeletonHelper)  
 
        Meldungen wie „CORS fehlgeschlagen“ oder „MIME 'text/plain' 
blockiert“.  
 
        Warum: Browser blockt „bare specifiers“ bzw. ungeeignete MIME -
Types vom CDN.  
 
        Heute mitigiert durch: lokalen Fallback 
js/vendor/SkeletonHelper.js.  
        (Saubere Dauerlösung: Import -Map oder Bundler – ist bewusst als 
Aufgabe offen.)  
 
    „bare specifier 'three'“ (TypeError, Module -Import) 
 
        Warum: import { ... } from 'three' ohne Import -Map/Bundler.  
 
        Status: Startaufgabe für neue Umgebung. Zwei Wege:  
 
            Import-Map im index.html (alle three -Module auf CDN pfaden 
mappen), oder  
 
            lokale Vendor -Kopie der benötigten Module mit relativen 
Imports.  
 
    501/404 auf /api/*  
 
        404: Route nicht vorhanden/falscher Pfad  
 
        501: Methode nicht erlaubt (Server ohne do_POST oder blockiert)  
 
        Heutige Erwartung: najika_server.py bietet POST auf 
/api/ollama|openai|claude.  
        (Wenn 501 auftaucht: falsche Server -Version/Fork oder Prozess -
Konflikt.)  
 
    WinError 10053 (ConnectionAborted)  
 
        Client brach Verbindung während Stream/Antwort ab (häufig 
unkritisch).  
 
        Hinweis: Sollte den Server nicht töten; nur Stacktrace in der 
Konsole.  
 
    Fehlende Assets (hospital -Deko) 
 
        404s sind bekannt; sollten keinen Crash verursachen.  
 
        Kurzfristig: auskommentieren oder Platzhalter legen.  
 
11) Stabilitäts -Checkliste (akzeptiert = „rund“)  
 
    Seite lädt ohne rote Fehler (oder mit sauber abgefangenem Fallback).  
 
    Najika-Modell lädt (oder fällt ohne Crash auf „ohne Skeleton“ 
zurück).  
 
    Alle Bottom -Room-Buttons funktionieren, Wände bündig über die gesamte 
Kante. 
 
    Chat funktioniert lokal; Cloud nur nach cloud frei/    , Badges 
sichtbar (      /GPT-4/Claude).  
 
    /health → 200, keine 501/404 auf aktiven Routen.  
 
    Keine hängenden Requests/Abbrüche bei normaler Nutzung.  
 
12) Zuständigkeiten – was du selbst direkt machen kannst  
 
    Persona feintunen: config/najika_personality_CORE.json (Ton, 
Kommandos, Safety).  
 
    Provider -Default & Badges: in index.html sicherstellen, in 
najika_ai.js activeProvider='local'; GPT -4/Claude -Buttons sichtbar 
lassen. 
 
    Cloud-Policy: Default cloudAllowed=false (UI -Texte kannst du selbst 
verschärfen/entschärfen).  
 
    Raum-Inhalte: room_config_detailed.json (Props 
aktivieren/deaktivieren, Materialien).  
 
    Fehlende Assets: Props auskommentieren oder Platzhalterdateien 
ablegen.  
 
    Export/Log: einfache „Copy Chat“/„Save JSON“ -Helfer in najika_ai.js 
pflegen (falls noch nicht drin).  
 
    Import-Map/Bundling (Startaufgabe):  
    – Entweder Import -Map hinzufügen  
    – Oder lokale vendor -Module mit relativen Imports nutzen.  
    (Beides geht ohne Backend -Änderung.)

2. Python -Script (falls installiert):  
python 
 
with open('große_datei.txt', 'r', encoding='utf -8') as f:  
    content = f.read()  
 
chunk_size = 8000  
chunks = [content[i:i+chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(content), 
chunk_size)]  
 
for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):  
    with open(f'teil_{i+1:03d}.txt', 'w', encoding='utf -8') as f:  
        f.write(chunk)

# Mobile Game mit KI -Terminal - Flask Backend  
import os  
import json  
import hashlib  
from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify  
from flask_socketio import SocketIO, emit  
import sqlite3  
from datetime import datetime  
 
app = Flask(__name__)  
app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = 'najika_mobile_game'  
socketio = SocketIO(app, cors_allowed_origins="*")  
 
# Database Setup  
DB_FILE = "najika_game.db"  
 
def init_database():  
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)  
    c = conn.cursor()  
     
    # Game State Table  
    c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_state(  
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,  
        hp INTEGER DEFAULT 100,  
        mana INTEGER DEFAULT 100,  
        gold INTEGER DEFAULT 50,  
        level INTEGER DEFAULT 1,  
        position_x INTEGER DEFAULT 300,  
        position_y INTEGER DEFAULT 300,  
        current_area TEXT DEFAULT 'starttown'  
    )''') 
     
    # Secure Terminal Table  
    c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS secure_terminal(  
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,  
        user_authenticated BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,  
        session_token TEXT,  
        last_access TIMESTAMP,  
        terminal_data TEXT  
    )''') 
     
    # Game Events  
    c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_events(  
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,  
        event_type TEXT,  
        event_data TEXT,  
        timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP  
    )''') 
     
    # Initialize default data if empty  
    c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_state')  
    if c.fetchone()[0] == 0:  
        c.execute('INSERT INTO game_state(id) VALUES(1)')  
     
    conn.commit()  
    conn.close()

    def gain_skill_xp(self, skill_name, amount, 
activity_type="practice"):  
        if skill_name not in self.skills:  
            return {"error": f"Unknown skill: {skill_name}"}  
             
        skill = self.skills[skill_name]  
        skill["xp"] += amount  
         
        level_ups = 0  
        techniques_learned = []  
         
        # Handle level progression  
        while skill["xp"] >= skill["xp_to_next"]:  
            skill["xp"] -= skill["xp_to_next"]  
            skill["level"] += 1  
            level_ups += 1  
             
            # Check for technique unlock  
            if skill_name in self.available_techniques:  
                available_at_level = 
self.available_techniques[skill_name]  
                if skill["level"] in available_at_level:  
                    technique = available_at_level[skill["level"]]  
                    self.learned_techniques[skill_name].add(technique)  
                    techniques_learned.append({  
                        "technique": technique,  
                        "level": skill["level"],  
                        "description": 
self.get_technique_description(skill_name, technique)  
                    }) 
             
            skill["xp_to_next"] = 
self.calculate_xp_to_next_level(skill["level"])  
         
        return {  
            "skill": skill_name,  
            "xp_gained": amount,  
            "new_level": skill["level"],  
            "level_ups": level_ups,  
            "techniques_learned": techniques_learned,  
            "activity": activity_type  
        } 
     
    def get_technique_description(self, skill, technique):  
        descriptions = {  
            "fishing": {  
                "bait_selection": "Choose perfect bait for each fish type 
- 20% better catch rate",  
                "water_reading": "Read water currents and depths - find 
fish hotspots",  
                "perfect_cast": "Master casting technique - 30% longer 
casting distance",  
                "weather_timing": "Fish behavior in different weather - 
optimal timing",  
                "legendary_patience": "Zen -like focus - rare fish 
attraction increased",  
                "fish_whisperer": "Understand fish psychology - can catch 
mythical species"  
            }, 
            "cooking": {  
                "heat_control": "Perfect temperature control - no more 
burnt food",  
                "ingredient_prep": "Efficient knife work - 25% faster 
cooking",  
                "flavor_balance": "Taste harmony mastery - dishes give 
better buffs",  
                "presentation": "Beautiful plating - meals restore mood 
as well as HP",  
                "improvisation": "Cook without recipes - create new 
dishes",  
                "masterchef_instinct": "Culinary genius - any ingredients 
become gourmet"  
            }, 
            "smithing": {  
                "metal_reading": "Understand metal properties - choose 
perfect materials",  
                "hammer_rhythm": "Perfect striking pattern - 15% 
durability bonus",  
                "temperature_mastery": "Forge heat control - prevents 
material waste",  
                "folding_technique": "Advanced metalworking - creates 
superior weapons",  
                "soul_forging": "Imbue items with essence - weapons gain 
special properties",  
                "legendary_smith": "Craft mythical items - create unique 
legendary equipment"  
            }, 
            "alchemy": {  
                "ingredient_synergy": "Understand component interactions 
- stronger potions",  
                "timing_precision": "Perfect brewing timing - no more 
failed batches",  
                "purity_control": "Refine ingredients - double potion 
effectiveness",  
                "effect_amplification": "Enhance magical properties - 
longer lasting effects",  
                "transmutation": "Transform base materials - create rare 
ingredients",  
                "philosopher_stone": "Master alchemist - transmute any 
material"  
            } 
        } 
         
        return descriptions.get(skill, {}).get(technique, f"Advanced 
{technique.replace('_', ' ')} technique")  
     
    def get_skill_bonus(self, skill_name, base_value):  
        """Calculate bonus based on skill level and learned techniques"""  
        if skill_name not in self.skills:  
            return base_value  
         
        level = self.skills[skill_name]["level"]  
        technique_count = len(self.learned_techniques.get(skill_name, 
set())) 
         
        # Level bonus (5% per level above 15)  
        level_bonus = 1.0 + (level - 15) * 0.05  
         
        # Technique bonus (10% per technique)  
        technique_bonus = 1.0 + technique_count * 0.10  
         
        return int(base_value * level_bonus * technique_bonus)  
 
# Advanced Crafting and Alchemy System  
class CraftingSystem:  
    def __init__(self):  
        self.recipes = {  
            "cooking": {  
                "grilled_fish": {  
                    "ingredients": {"fish": 1, "herbs": 1},  
                    "skill_req": 15,  
                    "result": {"hp_restore": 25, "duration": 300}  
                }, 
                "stamina_stew": {  
                    "ingredients": {"meat": 2, "vegetables": 3, "spices": 
1},

                }, 
                "masterchef_feast": {  
                    "ingredients": {"rare_meat": 1, "exotic_herbs": 2, 
"magic_seasoning": 1},

                    "result": {"all_stats_boost": 25, "duration": 1800}  
                } 
            }, 
            "alchemy": {  
                "healing_potion": {  
                    "ingredients": {"red_herb": 2, "pure_water": 1},  
                    "skill_req": 15,  
                    "result": {"hp_restore": 50, "type": "instant"}  
                }, 
                "mana_elixir": {  
                    "ingredients": {"blue_mushroom": 2, "crystal_dust": 
1}, 
                    "skill_req": 25,  
                    "result": {"mana_restore": 40, "type": "instant"}  
                }, 
                "explosion_catalyst": {  
                    "ingredients": {"fire_crystal": 3, "volatile_powder": 
2, "stabilizer": 1},  
                    "skill_req": 60,  
                    "result": {"destruction_damage_boost": 50, 
"duration": 900}  
                }, 
                "philosophers_elixir": {  
                    "ingredients": {"dragons_blood": 1, 
"phoenix_feather": 1, "time_essence": 1},  
                    "skill_req": 100,  
                    "result": {"temporary_immortality": True, "duration": 
3600} 
                } 
            }, 
            "smithing": {  
                "iron_sword": {  
                    "ingredients": {"iron_ingot": 3, "leather": 1},  
                    "skill_req": 20,  
                    "result": {"damage": 25, "durability": 100}  
                }, 
                "enchanted_blade": {  
                    "ingredients": {"steel_ingot": 5, "magic_crystal": 2, 
"rare_leather": 1},  
                    "skill_req": 65,  
                    "result": {"damage": 60, "magic_damage": 20, 
"durability": 200}  
                }, 
                "legendary_weapon": {  
                    "ingredients": {"mithril": 3, "dragon_scale": 2, 
"soul_gem": 1},  
                    "skill_req": 95,  
                    "result": {"damage": 100, "special_ability": 
"soul_strike", "durability": 500}  
                } 
            } 
        } 
         
        self.discovered_recipes = {  
            "cooking": set(["grilled_fish"]),  
            "alchemy": set(["healing_potion"]),  
            "smithing": set(["iron_sword"])  
        } 
     
    def attempt_craft(self, recipe_type, recipe_name, 
ingredients_available, skill_system):  
        if recipe_type not in self.recipes:  
            return {"success": False, "error": "Unknown crafting type"}  
             
        if recipe_name not in self.recipes[recipe_type]:  
            return {"success": False, "error": "Unknown recipe"}  
             
        recipe = self.recipes[recipe_type][recipe_name]  
         
        # Check skill requirement  
        skill_name = recipe_type  # cooking, alchemy, smithing  
        current_level = skill_system.skills[skill_name]["level"]  
         
        if current_level < recipe["skill_req"]:  
            return {  
                "success": False,  
                "error": f"Requires {skill_name} level 
{recipe['skill_req']}"  
            } 
         
        # Check ingredients  
        for ingredient, needed in recipe["ingredients"].items():  
            if ingredients_available.get(ingredient, 0) < needed:  
                return {  
                    "success": False,  
                    "error": f"Need {needed} {ingredient}, have 
{ingredients_available.get(ingredient, 0)}"  
                } 
         
        # Calculate success chance based on skill  
        base_success = 0.7  # 70% base  
        skill_bonus = (current_level - recipe["skill_req"]) * 0.05  # 5% 
per level above requirement  
         
        # Technique bonuses  
        techniques = skill_system.learned_techniques.get(skill_name, 
set()) 
        technique_bonus = len(techniques) * 0.1  # 10% per technique  
         
        success_chance = min(0.95, base_success + skill_bonus + 
technique_bonus)  
         
        # Roll for success  
        if random.random() <= success_chance:  
            # Craft succeeded - give XP and item  
            xp_gain = recipe["skill_req"] * 2  # More XP for harder 
recipes 
            skill_result = skill_system.gain_skill_xp(skill_name, 
xp_gain, "crafting")  
             
            # Apply skill bonuses to result  
            result = recipe["result"].copy()  
            for key, value in result.items():  
                if isinstance(value, int) and "restore" in key or 
"damage" in key:  
                    result[key] = 
skill_system.get_skill_bonus(skill_name, value)  
             
            return {  
                "success": True,  
                "item_created": recipe_name,  
                "result_stats": result,  
                "skill_result": skill_result,  
                "quality": self.determine_quality(success_chance)  
            } 
        else: 
            # Failed - still get some XP but lose ingredients  
            xp_gain = max(5, recipe["skill_req"] // 2)  
            skill_result = skill_system.gain_skill_xp(skill_name, 
xp_gain, "failed_crafting")  
             
            return {  
                "success": False,  
                "error": "Crafting failed!",  
                "skill_result": skill_result,  
                "ingredients_lost": recipe["ingredients"]  
            } 
     
    def determine_quality(self, success_chance):  
        if success_chance >= 0.9:  
            return "Masterwork"  
        elif success_chance >= 0.8:  
            return "Superior"  
        elif success_chance >= 0.7:  
            return "Good"  
        else: 
            return "Standard"  
 
# Enhanced Mortal Kombat Training with Skyrim Integration  
# Digimon -Style Attack Learning System  
class AttackLearningSystem:  
    def __init__(self):  
        self.learned_attacks = set()  
        self.available_attacks = {  
            # Basic attacks everyone starts with  
            "basic_slash": {"damage": 10, "mana": 0, "skill_req": 
{"one_handed": 15}},  
            "basic_shot": {"damage": 8, "mana": 0, "skill_req": 
{"archery": 15}},  
             
            # Learnable from enemies/training  
            "explosion": {"damage": 50, "mana": 25, "skill_req": 
{"destruction": 25}, "source": "training_or_combat"},  
            "fire_slash": {"damage": 25, "mana": 10, "skill_req": 
{"one_handed": 30}, "source": "fire_enemy"},  
            "precise_shot": {"damage": 35, "mana": 5, "skill_req": 
{"archery": 40}, "source": "archer_enemy"},  
            "shield_bash": {"damage": 20, "mana": 5, "skill_req": 
{"block": 35}, "source": "guardian_enemy"},  
            "heal_burst": {"damage": -30, "mana": 15, "skill_req": 
{"restoration": 30}, "source": "healer_enemy"},  
            "stealth_strike": {"damage": 45, "mana": 15, "skill_req": 
{"sneak": 50}, "source": "assassin_enemy"},  
             
            # Master techniques from perfect training  
            "mega_explosion": {"damage": 100, "mana": 50, "skill_req": 
{"destruction": 75}, "source": "perfect_training"},  
            "legendary_strike": {"damage": 80, "mana": 30, "skill_req": 
{"one_handed": 80}, "source": "perfect_training"},  
            "soul_arrow": {"damage": 70, "mana": 20, "skill_req": 
{"archery": 70}, "source": "perfect_training"}  
        } 
         
        # Start with basic attacks  
        self.learned_attacks.add("basic_slash")  
        self.learned_attacks.add("basic_shot")  
     
    def attempt_learn_attack(self, attack_name, learning_source, 
current_skills):  
        if attack_name not in self.available_attacks:  
            return {"learned": False, "reason": "Unknown attack"}  
         
        if attack_name in self.learned_attacks:  
            return {"learned": False, "reason": "Already known"}  
         
        attack_data = self.available_attacks[attack_name]  
         
        # Check skill requirements  
        for skill, required_level in attack_data["skill_req"].items():  
            if current_skills.skills[skill]["level"] < required_level:  
                return {  
                    "learned": False,  
                    "reason": f"Requires {skill} level {required_level}"  
                } 
         
        # Check if learning source matches  
        required_source = attack_data.get("source", "any")  
        if required_source != "any" and learning_source != 
required_source:  
            return {  
                "learned": False,  
                "reason": f"Can only learn from {required_source}"  
            } 
         
        # Success - learn the attack  
        self.learned_attacks.add(attack_name)  
        return {  
            "learned": True,  
            "attack": attack_name,  
            "damage": attack_data["damage"],  
            "mana_cost": attack_data["mana"],  
            "description": f"New attack learned: 
{attack_name.replace('_', ' ').title()}!"  
        } 
     
    def get_available_attacks_for_combat(self):  
        """Return attacks player can actually use"""  
        return {name: data for name, data in 
self.available_attacks.items()  
                if name in self.learned_attacks}  
 
# Enhanced Training System - Focuses on Attack Learning  
class SkyrimTrainingGrounds:  
    def __init__(self):  
        self.active_training = None  
        self.training_types = {  
            "destruction_training": {  
                "skill": "destruction",  
                "location": "Magierakademie",  
                "description": "Master explosive magic techniques",  
                "phases": 5,  
                "difficulty": "medium",  
                "teaches_attacks": ["explosion", "mega_explosion"]  
            }, 
            "archery_training": {  
                "skill": "archery",  
                "location": "Arena",  
                "description": "Perfect your bow techniques",  
                "phases": 7,  
                "difficulty": "hard",  
                "teaches_attacks": ["precise_shot", "soul_arrow"]  
            }, 
            "smithing_training": {  
                "skill": "smithing",  
                "location": "Handelsstadt",  
                "description": "Learn advanced forging techniques",  
                "phases": 4,  
                "difficulty": "easy",  
                "teaches_attacks": []  # Smithing improves weapon 
quality, not combat moves  
            }, 
            "one_handed_training": {  
                "skill": "one_handed",  
                "location": "Arena",  
                "description": "Master sword techniques",  
                "phases": 6,  
                "difficulty": "medium",  
                "teaches_attacks": ["fire_slash", "legendary_strike"]  
            }, 
            "block_training": {  
                "skill": "block",  
                "location": "Arena",  
                "description": "Learn defensive combat techniques",  
                "phases": 5,  
                "difficulty": "medium",  
                "teaches_attacks": ["shield_bash"]  
            } 
        } 
     
    def complete_training(self, skill_system, attack_system):  
        if not self.active_training:  
            return {"error": "No training to complete"}  
         
        final_score = self.active_training["score"]  
        perfect_count = self.active_training["perfect_hits"]  
        max_phases = self.active_training["max_phases"]  
        skill_name = self.active_training["skill"]  
        training_type = self.active_training["type"]  
         
        # Moderate XP reward - not the main focus anymore  
        base_xp = 25  # Reduced from 50  
        score_multiplier = final_score / (max_phases * 100)  
        xp_reward = int(base_xp * (1 + score_multiplier))  
         
        # Give normal XP  
        skill_result = skill_system.gain_skill_xp(skill_name, xp_reward, 
"mk_training")  
         
        # Attack learning based on performance  
        attacks_learned = []  
        training_info = self.training_types[training_type]  
         
        for attack_name in training_info["teaches_attacks"]:  
            # Perfect training (all perfect hits) can teach master 
techniques  
            learning_source = "perfect_training" if perfect_count == 
max_phases else "training_or_combat"  
             
            learn_result = attack_system.attempt_learn_attack(  
                attack_name, learning_source, skill_system  
            ) 
             
            if learn_result["learned"]:  
                attacks_learned.append(learn_result)  
         
        self.active_training = None  
         
        return {  
            "training_complete": True,  
            "skill_result": skill_result,  
            "attacks_learned": attacks_learned,  
            "performance_rating": self.get_training_rating(final_score, 
max_phases),  
            "perfect_hits": perfect_count,  
            "max_phases": max_phases  
        } 
 
# Enhanced Combat System with Learned Attacks  
class DigimonCombatSystem:  
    def __init__(self):  
        self.combat_active = False  
        self.partner_stats = {"hp": 100, "stamina": 100, "mood": 
"normal"}  
        self.current_enemy = None  
        self.enemy_attacks_used = set()  # Track what enemy has used  
         
    def start_combat(self, enemy):  
        self.combat_active = True  
        self.current_enemy = enemy  
        self.enemy_attacks_used = set()  
         
        return {  
            "status": "Combat started",  
            "enemy": enemy,  
            "partner_hp": self.partner_stats["hp"],  
            "commands": ["attack", "defend", "item", "cheer"],  
            "enemy_attacks": []  # Will be populated as enemy uses them  
        } 
     
    def enemy_uses_attack(self, attack_name):  
        """Called when enemy uses an attack - chance to learn it"""  
        if attack_name not in self.enemy_attacks_used:  
            self.enemy_attacks_used.add(attack_name)  
            return {  
                "new_attack_observed": True,  
                "attack": attack_name,  
                "message": f"Enemy uses {attack_name}! You might be able 
to learn this..."  
            } 
        return {"new_attack_observed": False}  
     
    def attempt_learn_from_combat(self, attack_system, skill_system):  
        """Try to learn attacks observed in combat"""  
        attacks_learned = []  
         
        for attack_name in self.enemy_attacks_used:  
            # 30% chance to learn from combat observation  
            if random.random() < 0.3:  
                enemy_type = self.current_enemy.get("type", "unknown")  
                learning_source = f"{enemy_type}_enemy"  
                 
                learn_result = attack_system.attempt_learn_attack(  
                    attack_name, learning_source, skill_system  
                ) 
                 
                if learn_result["learned"]:  
                    attacks_learned.append(learn_result)  
         
        return attacks_learned  
 
# Enhanced Game State with Life Skills  
class GameState:  
    def __init__(self):  
        self.load_state()  
        self.life_skills = LifeSkillsSystem()  
        self.crafting = CraftingSystem()  
        self.training_grounds = SkyrimTrainingGrounds()  
        self.attack_learning = AttackLearningSystem()  
         
    def perform_activity(self, activity_type, context=None):  
        """Main function for all skill -gaining activities"""  
        results = []  
         
        if activity_type == "fishing":  
            catch_result = self.go_fishing(context)  
            skill_result = self.life_skills.gain_skill_xp("fishing", 20, 
"practice")  
            results = [catch_result, skill_result]  
             
        elif activity_type == "cooking":  
            cook_result = self.cook_meal(context)  
            results = [cook_result]  
             
        elif activity_type == "smithing":  
            smith_result = self.smith_item(context)  
            results = [smith_result]  
             
        elif activity_type == "alchemy":  
            brew_result = self.brew_potion(context)  
            results = [brew_result]  
             
        elif activity_type == "herbalism":  
            herb_result = self.gather_herbs(context)  
            skill_result = self.life_skills.gain_skill_xp("herbalism", 
15, "gathering")  
            results = [herb_result, skill_result]  
             
        elif activity_type == "mining":  
            mine_result = self.mine_ore(context)  
            skill_result = self.life_skills.gain_skill_xp("mining", 18, 
"extraction")  
            results = [mine_result, skill_result]  
         
        return results  
     
    def go_fishing(self, location="river"):  
        import random  
        fishing_level = self.life_skills.skills["fishing"]["level"]  
        techniques = self.life_skills.learned_techniques["fishing"]  
         
        # Base catch chance improved by level and techniques  
        base_chance = 0.6  
        level_bonus = (fishing_level - 15) * 0.02  
        technique_bonus = len(techniques) * 0.05  
         
        catch_chance = min(0.9, base_chance + level_bonus + 
technique_bonus)  
         
        if random.random() <= catch_chance:  
            # Determine fish type based on skill  
            fish_types = {  
                15: ["small_fish", "minnow"],  
                25: ["bass", "trout", "carp"],  
                40: ["salmon", "pike"],  
                60: ["rare_fish", "golden_carp"],  
                80: ["legendary_fish", "crystal_fish"]  
            } 
             
            available_fish = ["small_fish"]  # Always available  
            for level_req, fish_list in fish_types.items():  
                if fishing_level >= level_req:  
                    available_fish.extend(fish_list)  
             
            caught_fish = random.choice(available_fish)  
             
            return {  
                "success": True,  
                "caught": caught_fish,  
                "message": f"You caught a {caught_fish.replace('_', ' 
')}!", 
                "technique_used": random.choice(list(techniques)) if 
techniques else None  
            } 
        else: 
            return {  
                "success": False,  
                "message": "The fish got away...",  
                "xp_gained": 5  # Still get small XP for trying  
            } 
     
    def gather_herbs(self, location="forest"):  
        import random  
        herbalism_level = self.life_skills.skills["herbalism"]["level"]  
        techniques = self.life_skills.learned_techniques["herbalism"]  
         
        # Higher level = better herbs and more quantity  
        herb_types = {  
            15: {"red_herb": 1, "green_herb": 1},  
            30: {"blue_mushroom": 1, "healing_moss": 2},  
            45: {"rare_flower": 1, "magic_root": 1},  
            60: {"dragon_herb": 1, "phoenix_blossom": 1},  
            80: {"mythical_plant": 1, "time_flower": 1}  
        } 
         
        gathered = {}  
        for level_req, herbs in herb_types.items():  
            if herbalism_level >= level_req:  
                for herb, base_amount in herbs.items():  
                    # Techniques increase yield  
                    multiplier = 1.0 + len(techniques) * 0.2  
                    amount = max(1, int(base_amount * multiplier))  
                    if random.random() < 0.7:  # 70% chance for each herb 
type 
                        gathered[herb] = amount  
         
        return {  
            "success": True,  
            "herbs_gathered": gathered,  
            "techniques_used": list(techniques),  
            "location": location  
        } 
     
    def mine_ore(self, location="mountain"):  
        import random  
        mining_level = self.life_skills.skills["mining"]["level"]  
        techniques = self.life_skills.learned_techniques["mining"]  
         
        ore_types = {  
            15: {"iron_ore": 2, "copper_ore": 3},  
            35: {"silver_ore": 1, "gold_ore": 1},  
            55: {"mithril_ore": 1, "adamantite": 1},  
            75: {"dragon_ore": 1, "celestial_metal": 1}  
        } 
         
        mined = {}  
        for level_req, ores in ore_types.items():  
            if mining_level >= level_req:  
                for ore, base_amount in ores.items():  
                    # Techniques affect yield and rarity  
                    if "efficient_extraction" in techniques:  
                        base_amount += 1  
                    if "ore_sense" in techniques and random.random() < 
0.3: 
                        base_amount += 1  # 30% bonus ore  
                         
                    if random.random() < 0.6:  
                        mined[ore] = base_amount  
         
        return {  
            "success": True,  
            "ores_mined": mined,  
            "techniques_used": list(techniques),  
            "location": location  
        } 
     
    def load_state(self):  
        conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)  
        c = conn.cursor()  
        c.execute('SELECT * FROM game_state WHERE id=1')  
        row = c.fetchone()  
        if row: 
            self.hp = row[1]  
            self.mana = row[2]  
            self.gold = row[3]  
            self.level = row[4]  
            self.position = [row[5], row[6]]  
            self.current_area = row[7]  
        conn.close()  
     
    def save_state(self):  
        conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)  
        c = conn.cursor()  
        c.execute('''UPDATE game_state SET hp=?, mana=?, gold=?, level=?,  
                     position_x=?, position_y=?, current_area=? WHERE 
id=1''',  
                  (self.hp, self.mana, self.gold, self.level,  
                   self.position[0], self.position[1], 
self.current_area))  
        conn.commit()  
        conn.close()  
     
    def to_dict(self):  
        return {  
            'hp': self.hp,  
            'mana': self.mana,  
            'gold': self.gold,  
            'level': self.level,  
            'position': self.position,  
            'current_area': self.current_area  
        }

class SecureTerminal:  
    def __init__(self):  
        self.authenticated = False  
        self.session_token = None  
        self.najika_ai = NajikaAI()  
     
    def authenticate(self, access_key):  
        # Simple key -based authentication  
        expected_hash = "your_secure_hash_here"  # Replace with actual 
hash 
        provided_hash = hashlib.sha256(access_key.encode()).hexdigest()  
         
        if provided_hash == expected_hash:  
            self.authenticated = True  
            self.session_token = 
hashlib.md5(str(datetime.now()).encode()).hexdigest()  
            return True  
        return False  
     
    def execute_command(self, command, params=None):  
        if not self.authenticated:  
            return {"error": "Unauthorized access"}  
         
        # Comprehensive terminal commands  
        commands = {  
            'status': self.get_ai_status,  
            'analyze': self.run_analysis,  
            'research': self.conduct_research,  
            'create': self.creative_assist,  
            'learn': self.learning_mode,  
            'daily': self.daily_support,  
            'fitness': self.fitness_command,  
            'nutrition': self.nutrition_command,  
            'productivity': self.productivity_command,  
            'decision': self.decision_command,  
            'wellness': self.wellness_command,  
            'profile': self.profile_management,  
            'routine': self.routine_management,  
            'config': self.modify_ai_config,  
            'memory': self.memory_operations,  
            'backup': self.backup_ai_data,  
            'restore': self.restore_ai_data,  
            'help': self.show_help  
        } 
         
        if command in commands:  
            return commands[command](params)  
        else: 
            return {"error": f"Unknown command: {command}", "hint": "Type 
'help' for available commands"}  
     
    def daily_support(self, params):  
        """Daily life assistance coordinator"""  
        if not params:  
            return {

planning",

activity",

tomorrow"

"productivity", "wellness"]

        support_type = params[0]  
        data = {"request": " ".join(params[1:])} if len(params) > 1 else 
None

        """User profile and preferences"""  
        if not params:  
            return {  
                "current_profile": self.najika_ai.user_profile,  
                "operations": ["set", "get", "update"]  
            } 
         
        operation = params[0]  
        if operation == "set" and len(params) > 2:  
            key, value = params[1], " ".join(params[2:])  
            self.najika_ai.user_profile[key] = value  
            return {"status": f"Profile updated: {key} = {value}"}  
        elif operation == "get" and len(params) > 1:  
            key = params[1]  
            return {key: self.najika_ai.user_profile.get(key, "Not set")}  
         
        return {"error": "Invalid profile operation"}

        if not params:

    def memory_operations(self, params):  
        if not params:  
            return {  
                "memory_size": len(self.najika_ai.memory_bank),  
                "operations": ["store", "recall", "clear", "list"]

        operation = params[0]

            key, value = params[1], " ".join(params[2:])

            return {"status": f"Stored memory: {key}"}  
        elif operation == "recall" and len(params) > 1:  
            key = params[1]  
            value = self.najika_ai.memory_bank.get(key, "Memory not 
found") 
            return {"memory": {key: value}}  
        elif operation == "list":  
            return {"memories": list(self.najika_ai.memory_bank.keys())}  
         
        return {"error": "Invalid memory operation"}

# Digimon World Combat System with Cheering  
class DigimonCombatSystem:  
    def __init__(self):  
        self.combat_active = False  
        self.partner_stats = {"hp": 100, "stamina": 100, "mood": 
"normal"}  
        self.available_commands = ["attack", "defend", "item", "cheer"]  
        self.cheer_effects = {  
            "good": {"attack": 1.2, "defense": 1.1},  
            "great": {"attack": 1.4, "defense": 1.2},  
            "perfect": {"attack": 1.6, "defense": 1.3}  
        } 
     
    def start_combat(self, enemy):  
        self.combat_active = True  
        return {  
            "status": "Combat started",  
            "enemy": enemy,  
            "partner_hp": self.partner_stats["hp"],  
            "commands": self.available_commands  
        } 
     
    def cheer_partner(self, cheer_quality):  
        if not self.combat_active:  
            return {"error": "No combat active"}  
         
        effect = self.cheer_effects.get(cheer_quality, 
self.cheer_effects["good"])  
        self.partner_stats["mood"] = "motivated"  
         
        return {  
            "cheer_result": f"{cheer_quality.capitalize()} cheer!",  
            "attack_boost": f"+{int((effect['attack'] -1)*100)}%",  
            "defense_boost": f"+{int((effect['defense'] -1)*100)}%",  
            "partner_reaction": "Najika feels encouraged!"  
        } 
 
# Procedural World Generation System   
class ProceduralWorldGen:  
    def __init__(self):  
        self.world_seed = None  
        self.fixed_cities = GAME_AREAS  
        self.current_world_state = {}  
        self.dungeon_templates = [  
            {"type": "cave", "difficulty": "easy", "rooms": 5},  
            {"type": "ruins", "difficulty": "medium", "rooms": 8},  
            {"type": "tower", "difficulty": "hard", "rooms": 12}  
        ] 
         
    def generate_world_between_cities(self, from_city, to_city):  
        """Generate random landscape between fixed cities"""  
        import random  
         
        # Create deterministic seed based on city pair  
        seed = f"{from_city}_{to_city}"  
        random.seed(hash(seed))  
         
        terrain_types = ["forest", "plains", "mountains", "swamp", 
"desert"]  
        obstacles = ["river", "cliff", "monster_den", "ruins"]  
         
        world_section = {  
            "terrain": random.choice(terrain_types),  
            "size": random.randint(3, 7),  
            "obstacles": random.sample(obstacles, random.randint(1, 3)),  
            "dungeons": self.generate_random_dungeons(),  
            "resources": random.randint(2, 6),  
            "events": random.randint(1, 4)  
        } 
         
        return world_section  
     
    def generate_random_dungeons(self):  
        """Generate 1 -3 random dungeons in world section"""  
        import random  
         
        num_dungeons = random.randint(1, 3)  
        dungeons = []  
         
        for i in range(num_dungeons):  
            template = random.choice(self.dungeon_templates)  
            dungeon = {  
                "id": f"dungeon_{random.randint(1000, 9999)}",  
                "type": template["type"],  
                "difficulty": template["difficulty"],  
                "rooms": template["rooms"],  
                "boss": random.choice(["Goblin King", "Ancient Guardian", 
"Shadow Beast"]),  
                "loot": random.choice(["gold", "rare_item", 
"magic_scroll"]),  
                "layout": self.generate_dungeon_layout(template["rooms"])  
            } 
            dungeons.append(dungeon)  
             
        return dungeons  
     
    def generate_dungeon_layout(self, room_count):  
        """Generate random dungeon room layout"""  
        import random  
         
        rooms = []  
        for i in range(room_count):  
            room = {  
                "id": i + 1,  
                "type": random.choice(["combat", "treasure", "puzzle", 
"trap", "boss"]) if i == room_count -1 else random.choice(["combat", 
"treasure", "puzzle", "trap"]),  
                "enemies": random.randint(1, 4) if random.random() > 0.3 
else 0, 
                "treasure_chance": random.random() > 0.7,  
                "exits": random.randint(1, 3) if i < room_count -1 else 0  
            } 
            rooms.append(room)  
         
        return rooms  
     
    def regenerate_world_on_city_enter(self, city_name):  
        """Regenerate world when entering/leaving cities"""  
        # Save current progress in city  
        self.save_city_state(city_name)  
         
        # Regenerate all connecting world sections  
        for connected_city in GAME_AREAS[city_name].get("exits", []):  
            new_section = self.generate_world_between_cities(city_name, 
connected_city)  
            self.current_world_state[f"{city_name}_to_{connected_city}"] 
= new_section  
         
        return {  
            "status": f"World regenerated around {city_name}",  
            "new_areas": len(GAME_AREAS[city_name].get("exits", [])),  
            "dungeons_available": sum(len(section.get("dungeons", [])) 
for section in self.current_world_state.values())  
        } 
     
    def save_city_state(self, city_name):  
        """Persist city state while regenerating surroundings"""  
        # Cities remain unchanged, only wilderness regenerates  
        pass

combat_system = DigimonCombatSystem()

trail_events = OregonTrailEvents()

@socketio.on('get_game_state')  
def handle_get_state():  
    emit('game_update', {  
        'state': game_state.to_dict(),  
        'message': 'Spiel geladen!'  
    }) 
 
@socketio.on('player_move')  
def handle_move(data):  
    direction = data['direction']  
    # Simple movement logic - can be expanded  
    game_state.save_state()  
    emit('game_update', {  
        'state': game_state.to_dict(),  
        'message': f'Du bewegst dich nach {direction}'  
    }) 
 
@socketio.on('player_explore')   
def handle_explore():  
    import random  
    events = [  
        'Du findest 10 Gold!',  
        'Ein wilder Gegner erscheint!',  
        'Du entdeckst einen geheimen Pfad!',  
        'Du findest einen Heiltrank!'  
    ] 
    message = random.choice(events)  
     
    if 'Gold' in message:  
        game_state.gold += 10  
     
    game_state.save_state()  
    emit('game_update', {  
        'state': game_state.to_dict(),  
        'message': message  
    }) 
 
@socketio.on('player_rest')  
def handle_rest():  
    game_state.hp = min(100, game_state.hp + 20)  
    game_state.mana = min(100, game_state.mana + 15)  
    game_state.save_state()  
     
    emit('game_update', {  
        'state': game_state.to_dict(),  
        'message': 'Du hast gerastet und fühlst dich erfrischt!'  
    }) 
 
@socketio.on('terminal_auth')  
def handle_terminal_auth(data):  
    key = data['key']  
    success = terminal.authenticate(key)  
     
    emit('terminal_response', {  
        'authenticated': success,  
        'message': 'Access granted!' if success else 'Access denied!'  
    }) 
 
@socketio.on('enter_city')  
def handle_enter_city(data):  
    city_name = data.get('city')  
    if city_name in GAME_AREAS:  
        # Regenerate world when entering city  
        regen_result = 
world_generator.regenerate_world_on_city_enter(city_name)  
        game_state.current_area = city_name  
        game_state.save_state()  
         
        emit('game_update', {  
            'state': game_state.to_dict(),  
            'message': f'Du betrittst {GAME_AREAS[city_name]["name"]}. 
Die Welt um dich herum verändert sich...',  
            'world_regen': regen_result  
        }) 
 
@socketio.on('start_combat')  
def handle_combat_start(data):  
    enemy = data.get('enemy', 'Wild Beast')  
    combat_result = combat_system.start_combat(enemy)  
     
    emit('combat_started', combat_result)  
 
@socketio.on('cheer_partner')  
def handle_cheer(data):  
    cheer_quality = data.get('quality', 'good')  # good, great, perfect  
    result = combat_system.cheer_partner(cheer_quality)  
     
    emit('cheer_response', result)  
 
@socketio.on('explore_dungeon')  
def handle_dungeon_explore():  
    # Get available dungeons in current world section  
    current_section = 
world_generator.current_world_state.get(f"{game_state.current_area}_to_an
y", {}) 
    dungeons = current_section.get('dungeons', [])  
     
    if dungeons:  
        dungeon = random.choice(dungeons)  
        emit('dungeon_found', {  
            'dungeon': dungeon,  
            'message': f'Du entdeckst: {dungeon["type"].title()} 
({dungeon["difficulty"]})',  
            'rooms': len(dungeon['layout'])  
        }) 
    else: 
        emit('game_update', {  
            'state': game_state.to_dict(),  
            'message': 'Keine Dungeons in diesem Gebiet gefunden. Reise 
zu einer anderen Stadt!'  
        }) 
 
@socketio.on('travel_between_cities')  
def handle_travel(data):  
    destination = data.get('destination')  
     
    if random.random() < 0.4:  # 40% chance for Oregon Trail event  
        event = trail_events.trigger_travel_event()  
        emit('travel_event', {  
            'event': event,  
            'message': f'Auf dem Weg nach {destination}: 
{event["text"]}',  
            'choices': list(event['choices'].keys())  
        }) 
    else: 
        # Safe travel  
        game_state.current_area = destination  
        regen_result = 
world_generator.regenerate_world_on_city_enter(destination)  
        game_state.save_state()  
         
        emit('travel_complete', {  
            'state': game_state.to_dict(),  
            'message': f'Du erreichst sicher 
{GAME_AREAS[destination]["name"]}!',  
            'world_regen': regen_result  
        }) 
 
@socketio.on('use_weapon')  
def handle_weapon_use(data):  
    weapon_type = data.get('weapon', 'sword')  
    effectiveness = data.get('effectiveness', 1.0)  
     
    xp_result = game_state.use_weapon(weapon_type, effectiveness)  
     
    if xp_result.get('level_up'):  
        emit('level_up', {  
            'attribute': xp_result['attribute'],  
            'new_level': xp_result['new_level'],  
            'bonus': xp_result['bonus'],  
            'message': f"{xp_result['attribute'].replace('_', ' 
').title()} erreicht Level {xp_result['new_level']}!"  
        }) 
    else: 
        emit('xp_gained', {  
            'attribute': weapon_type,  
            'xp': xp_result['xp_gained'],  
            'message': f"+{xp_result['xp_gained']} XP in {weapon_type}"  
        }) 
 
@socketio.on('start_power_test')  
def handle_power_test_start(data):  
    test_type = data.get('type', 'destruction_test')  
    result = game_state.power_tests.start_power_test(test_type)  
     
    emit('power_test_started', result)  
 
@socketio.on('power_test_input')  
def handle_power_test_input(data):  
    timing = data.get('timing', 0.5)  # 0.0 to 1.0  
    strength = data.get('strength', 1.0)  
     
    result = game_state.power_tests.execute_test_input(timing, strength)  
     
    if result.get('test_complete'):  
        # Apply XP reward  
        xp_result = game_state.attributes.gain_xp(result['attribute'], 
result['xp_reward'])  
        result['xp_result'] = xp_result  
         
        emit('power_test_complete', result)  
    else: 
        emit('power_test_phase', result)

2. Python -Script (falls installiert):  
python 
 
with open('große_datei.txt', 'r', encoding='utf -8') as f:  
    content = f.read()  
 
chunk_size = 8000  
chunks = [content[i:i+chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(content), 
chunk_size)]  
 
for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):  
    with open(f'teil_{i+1:03d}.txt', 'w', encoding='utf -8') as f:  
        f.write(chunk)

cmd 
 
split -b 8k große_datei.txt teil_

def ambient_listening_mode(self, audio_input):  
    # Kontinuierliche Spracherkennung  
    if self.detect_question_pattern(audio_input):  
        return self.offer_assistance()  
    elif self.detect_incorrect_statement(audio_input):  
        return self.provide_gentle_correction()  
 
def provide_gentle_correction(self, statement):  
    return {  
        "correction": "Tatsächlich sind Feuerwehrautos meist rot 
lackiert",  
        "explanation": "Das dient der besseren Sichtbarkeit im Notfall",  
        "tone": "helpful_educational"  
    }

Meine ehrliche Bewertung:  
 
Das Skill -System würde definitiv die Spieltiefe erhöhen. Allerdings sehe 
ich einige praktische Herausforderungen:  
 
Mobile-Komplexität: Skill -Trees können auf kleinen Bildschirmen 
überwältigend werden. Eine vereinfachte 5 -Skill-Version wäre anfangs 
besser als Skyrim's 20+ Skills.  
 
Balancing -Aufwand: Jeder Skill braucht sorgfältige Balance -Tests. Das 
kann die Entwicklungszeit erheblich verlängern.  
 
UEFN-Transfer: Skills müssen später kompatibel mit Fortnite's System sein 
- das könnte Designbeschränkungen bedeuten.  
 
Empfohlener Kompromiss: Starten Sie mit 5 Kernkategorien (Combat, Magic, 
Survival, Social, Crafting) und testen Sie, wie sich diese auf Mobile 
anfühlen. Wenn das gut funktioniert, können Sie später erweitern.  
 
Die technische Basis ist definitiv stark genug für dieses Feature. Die 
Frage ist hauptsächlich, ob die zusätzliche Komplexität den Mobile -First-
Ansatz unterstützt oder behindert.
